PAY RANGE

The Target Pay Range for this position is $173,500.00-$211,900.00 annually. The full Pay Range is $135,100.00 - $250,600.00 annually. At BECU, compensation decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, and education or training. Should an offer for employment be made, we will consider individual qualifications. In addition to your salary, compensation incentives are available for the hired applicant. Incentives are performance based and targets vary by role.

BENEFITS – because people helping people starts with supporting you

  • 401(k) Company Match (up to 3%)

  • 4% annual contribution to your 401(k) by BECU

  • Medical, Dental and Vision (family contributions as well)

  • PTO Program + Exchange Program

  • Tuition Reimbursement Program

  • BECU Cares volunteer time off + donation match

IMPACT YOU’LL MAKE:


As the Director of Mortgage Servicing, you’ll shape the future of mortgage servicing at BECU by providing strategic leadership across all servicing functions. You’ll drive operational excellence, scalability, automation, and continuous improvement while ensuring an exceptional member experience. Through strong partnerships with our sub-servicer, retail banking, credit risk, and other key teams, you’ll bring people, processes, and technology together to build efficient, sustainable operations. You’ll oversee the mortgage servicing lifecycle, including performing and default servicing, member escalations, agency relationships, credit bureau reporting, dispute management, and default resolution.

Your leadership will strengthen vendor partnerships, champion regulatory compliance, optimize financial performance, and transform operations to support BECU’s continued growth. This is your opportunity to make a meaningful difference in our members’ financial lives while helping shape the future of mortgage servicing.

To join our dynamic team in this role, we require candidates to be residents of WA, OR, ID, CA, AZ, TX, NC, SC, GA, or VA. If you’re located in Washington state and within a reasonable driving distance to our Tukwila Headquarters (TFC), we encourage you come into the office on Tuesdays & Wednesdays each week. For those candidates that live outside the commutable distance to TFC and in any of our approved remote work locations, this role will be primarily remote. Remote or onsite, we are committed to ensuring you are fully engaged and included in our collaborative environment.


WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Build and Develop High-Performing Teams: You’ll build, lead, and develop a highly experienced mortgage servicing support team, establishing member-focused policies, practices, and operational standards that support sustainable growth and scalability.
  • Coach, Mentor, and Inspire: You’ll provide ongoing coaching, mentoring, and training to support employee development, strengthen performance, and encourage professional growth. You’ll meet with team members regularly to conduct performance evaluations using BECU competencies and SuccessFactors as performance measures.
  • Set Direction and Drive Accountability: You’ll establish departmental and individual goals aligned with BECU’s operating plan, providing clear direction, ongoing performance monitoring, and the support your team needs to deliver timely and accurate services.
  • Oversee End-to-End Servicing Operations: You’ll provide strategic oversight of mortgage servicing workflows across BECU and its sub-servicer, ensuring strong performance management, contractual compliance, and adherence to established service-level expectations.
  • Drive Process Improvement and Scalability: You’ll identify opportunities to streamline workflows, strengthen operational quality, and improve the member experience through automation, optimization, and scalable servicing solutions.
  • Champion the Member Experience: You’ll evaluate and respond to member and employee feedback regarding remote services and delivery channels, translating insights into effective solutions that improve service delivery and meet evolving member needs.
  • Strengthen Servicing Practices: You’ll maintain a comprehensive understanding of mortgage servicing operations, policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements to ensure consistent, effective, and compliant execution across the organization.
  • Own Financial Performance: You’ll oversee P&L and budget performance, identifying opportunities to optimize revenue, manage expenses, and deliver sustainable long-term business value.
  • Turn Insights into Action: You’ll lead business unit analytics and reporting, evaluate performance data, identify trends, and develop business cases that inform strategic decisions and operational improvements.
  • Monitor Business Performance: You’ll oversee operational performance, key performance indicators (KPIs), vendor and business partner relationships, and service levels to ensure alignment with organizational goals.
  • Champion Regulatory and Investor Compliance: You’ll maintain a strong oversight and internal control environment, proactively managing regulatory changes and ensuring adherence to applicable investor, agency, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Lead Vendor and Sub-Servicer Relationships: You’ll serve as the Credit Union’s primary point of contact for mortgage servicing matters, ensuring consistent, compliant practices across BECU and applicable vendors, including the sub-servicer.
  • Manage Complex Servicing Matters: You’ll oversee member escalations, agency relationship manager engagement, credit bureau management matters, consumer credit bureau reporting, default resolution, and dispute management.
  • Strengthen Operational Controls: You’ll ensure mortgage servicing activities are consistently managed in accordance with contractual obligations, regulatory expectations, and applicable Credit Union standards.
  • Translate Business Needs into Technology Solutions: You’ll lead system administration efforts by translating business requirements into technical specifications and ensuring technology solutions support business objectives.
  • Oversee System Testing and Issue Resolution: You’ll establish business unit protocols for User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and lead the resolution of technology issues impacting mortgage servicing operations.
  • Develop and Maintain Operational Documentation: You’ll lead the creation and ongoing maintenance of business workflows, procedure manuals, and supporting documentation, ensuring effective management of the forms library and compliance with state and federal regulations.
  • Support Broader Business Priorities: You’ll perform additional duties as assigned, bringing your expertise, leadership, and collaborative approach to evolving business needs.

This isn’t just about ticking off tasks on a list. It's about making a significant, positive change in BECU’s journey, where your contributions are valued, and your growth is continually fostered.

WHAT YOU’LL GAIN:

  • Strategic Influence: Shape the direction and future of BECU’s mortgage servicing operations, influencing business strategy and enterprise-wide initiatives.
  • Meaningful Leadership Impact: Lead and develop experienced professionals while building a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Enterprise-Level Visibility: Partner with senior leaders and cross-functional teams across retail banking, credit risk, technology, and operations.
  • Transformation Opportunities: Drive large-scale process improvements, automation, system enhancements, and operational modernization.
  • Purpose-Driven Work: Make a meaningful difference in the financial well-being of members while contributing to the success of a member-owned credit union.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, business operations or related field, or equivalent work or educational experience.
  • 8 years of experience in mortgage servicing operations, mortgage banking, or closely related field.

  • Effective leadership and negotiation skills and the ability to present information and/or training to individuals and groups.

JOIN THE JOURNEY:

Ready to make an indelible impact? Eager to be a part of a collaborative and innovative team where your ideas and contributions don’t just fill a role, but fuel the growth and success of BECU? This is more than a job – it’s a chance to elevate your career, skills, and future, all while contributing to the robust technological landscape of BECU.

jobs.excerpt: The RoleWe’re looking for an AI Video Editor who can independently create performance video ads — from angle and script to AI generation, edit, and final export.
jobs.description:
The Role

We’re looking for an AI Video Editor who can independently create performance video ads — from angle

and script to AI generation, edit, and final export. This is a performance role: your work will be judged by

how your ads perform, not by how cinematic they look. If you love testing hooks, reading the numbers,

and shipping the next variation fast, you’ll fit right in.

How your time will be spent

~60%

AI production & editing

~25%

Concepts, hooks & scripts

~15%

Testing & iteration

Your AI Toolkit

Claude Research, ad angles, scripts, hooks, and briefs

Arcads AI UGC-style ads with AI actors and avatars

Higgsfield AI video generation, camera control, and motion effects

Others AI voice (e.g. ElevenLabs) and other AI video/image tools as needed

Editing Premiere Pro, CapCut, After Effects, or DaVinci Resolve

What You’ll Do

Create & Produce

  • Own video ads end to end — concept, script, storyboard, AI generation, edit, and export — with minimal

hand-holding.

  • Produce UGC-style, avatar, and AI-generated ads using Claude, Arcads, Higgsfield, and similar tools.
  • Storyboard before you generate, and keep characters, product, and brand look consistent across AI shots.
  • Fix and polish AI output so it feels natural, on-brand, and platform-native.

Write & Ideate

  • Write direct-response scripts with scroll-stopping hooks in the first 3 seconds and clear calls to action.
  • Pitch new angles and concepts based on audience insights, competitor ads, and trending formats.

Test & Iterate

  • Build multiple variations of every ad (hooks, openings, voiceovers, formats) for structured testing.

MindfulSouls | | www.mindfulsouls.com Page 2

  • Review results with the marketing team — hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS — and turn learnings

into the next round.

  • Scale winners into fresh variations; retire what isn’t working.

Deliver

  • Export in all required ratios (9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9) for Meta, YouTube, and other channels.
  • Keep files clearly named and organised so ads are launch-ready.
  • Build and document repeatable AI workflows that make the team faster.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

Must-Have

  • 2–5 years of video editing, with hands-on experience making paid social / performance ads.
  • A portfolio of AI-made video ads, noting the tools used and your role in each.
  • Daily, practical use of AI creative tools such as Claude, Arcads, and Higgsfield.
  • Strong instinct for what converts: hooks, pacing, captions, and CTAs.
  • Working knowledge of ad metrics (hook rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS).
  • Proficiency in Premiere Pro or CapCut (After Effects / DaVinci Resolve a plus).
  • Ability to work independently, hit deadlines, and take fast feedback well.

• Good written and spoken English.

Good to Have

  • Experience with Meta Ads Manager or ad performance dashboards.
  • Experience with wellness, meditation, lifestyle, or DTC brands.
  • Motion graphics, colour grading, and audio mixing skills.

This role may not be for you if…

  • Your portfolio is only weddings, corporate films, or cinematic showreels with no ad work.
  • You prefer long, polished productions over fast testing and iteration.

OTE - Total projected compensation at full target achievement (base salary + variable pay) is € 76100 - 126800

Job Title: Coordonnateur(trice) principal(e) – Mise en place de projets de laboratoire

Coordonnateur principal – Mise en place de projets de laboratoire (Télétravail au Canada)


Aperçu du poste


Ce poste est offert en télétravail et peut être exercé de n'importe où au Canada.


Le coordonnateur principal fournit un soutien opérationnel lié aux projets, notamment la conception, le chargement, la configuration et la validation des bases de données de laboratoire dans les systèmes de gestion des essais cliniques (CTMS). Il veille à ce que le travail soit effectué conformément aux procédures opérationnelles normalisées (PON), aux politiques internes et aux bonnes pratiques professionnelles. Il est responsable de la qualité, de l'exactitude et de l'intégrité de la configuration des bases de données.


Responsabilités principales

  • Participer aux activités de validation des études.
  • Analyser et résoudre les problèmes, recueillir l'information pertinente et collaborer avec les équipes de laboratoire afin d'assurer la mise en place des projets selon les procédures établies et les exigences des clients.
  • Configurer les bases de données de projet, lorsque requis.
  • Maintenir une documentation de projet complète, exacte et à jour.
  • Informer les gestionnaires de mise en place, les gestionnaires de projet et les autres parties prenantes de tout enjeu pouvant affecter le bon déroulement des projets.
  • Coordonner les réunions avec les collègues et les services internes concernés, notamment les réunions de planification et de transfert.
  • Participer aux initiatives locales et mondiales d'amélioration continue conformément aux orientations de l'équipe responsable de l'amélioration des processus.
  • Participer aux audits internes, au besoin.
  • Communiquer avec les commanditaires d'études lorsque requis, notamment pour l'échange d'informations factuelles.
  • Contribuer à l'élaboration des exigences de conception des bases de données pour les protocoles et les amendements de protocole.
  • Participer à la planification des projets, notamment à l'élaboration d'échéanciers, au respect des exigences réglementaires et à l'identification des risques potentiels.
  • Gérer le processus de mise en place d'études de faible complexité, lorsque applicable.
  • Encadrer et soutenir la formation de membres de l'équipe moins expérimentés.
  • Effectuer l'ensemble des activités conformément à la ligne directrice ICH E6 sur les Bonnes pratiques cliniques (BPC).

Formation et expérience requises

  • Baccalauréat en sciences de la vie ou dans un domaine connexe, un atout. Une combinaison équivalente de formation, d'expérience et de compétences pourra être prise en considération.
  • Minimum d'un an d'expérience pertinente dans l'industrie clinique, médicale ou des soins de santé, ou combinaison équivalente de formation et d'expérience.

Connaissances, compétences et aptitudes

  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et de coordination.
  • Souci du détail démontré ainsi qu'un haut niveau de qualité et d'exactitude dans le travail.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication verbale et écrite.
  • Maîtrise des outils informatiques, notamment des logiciels de traitement de texte et de tableur.
  • Connaissance des systèmes de gestion des essais cliniques (CTMS), un atout.

  • Aptitude à établir et à maintenir des relations de travail efficaces avec les collègues, les gestionnaires et les clients.
  • Connaissance des processus de laboratoire et des systèmes informatiques, un atout.

Senior Project Set-Up Coordinator, Laboratory Services (Remote within Canada)


Job Overview


This is a fully remote position that may be performed from anywhere within Canada.


The Senior Project Set-Up Coordinator provides project-related support, including the design, loading, configuration, and validation of laboratory databases using Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS). The role ensures work is conducted in accordance with standard operating procedures, company policies, and industry best practices. The incumbent is accountable for the quality, accuracy, and integrity of database configuration activities.


Responsibilities

  • Research and resolve issues, gather relevant information, and liaise with laboratory teams to ensure projects are set up in accordance with established procedures and customer requirements.
  • Configure project databases, where applicable.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and up-to-date project documentation.

  • Contribute to project planning activities, including timeline development, regulatory milestone tracking, and risk identification.

POSITION OVERVIEW

XTEL is seeking an elite Solution Sales Principal to partner directly with our Enterprise Sales Executives. In this co-pilot role, the Enterprise Account Executive owns the account strategy and commercial relationship, while you own the solution vision, the technical win, and the executive trust. This requires a rare, multi-disciplined professional who deeply understands the nuances of the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry. You must possess a complete, equally balanced skillset across three distinct pillars: RGM Business Acumen, Enterprise Architecture, and Delivery Reality. If you cannot seamlessly weave together business value, complex IT integration, and practical implementation constraints, you cannot do this role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Your absolute strongest assets must be communication, leadership, and executive presence. You are the domain authority in the room. You must be able to command a boardroom, align business and IT stakeholders, and translate highly complex technical concepts into clear, compelling C-suite value.

The Three Pillars of Success

1. The Business Pillar: RGM & CPG Mastery. Act as the subject matter expert in Revenue Growth Management (RGM) and Trade Promotion Management (TPM) for large CPG manufacturers. Speak the language of the Chief Commercial Officer. You must deeply understand pricing strategies, trade spend optimization, promotional ROI, and commercial planning. Partner with Enterprise Sales Executives to build compelling, ROI-driven business cases that prove how the solution will drive top-line growth and bottom-line efficiency.

2. The Technology Pillar: Complex Enterprise Architecture. Operate as a peer to CPG Enterprise Architects and CIOs. You must understand how to insert a modern solution into highly complex, historically rigid CPG technology landscapes. Architect flexible, decoupled integrations. You must be fluent in modern data strategies (e.g., Databricks, agnostic data models, agentic AI connections) and core ERP environments (like SAP). Challenge customer IT assumptions constructively, guiding them away from fragile point-to-point connections toward scalable, future-proof architectures.

3. The Delivery Pillar: Implementation Reality. Ensure that what is sold can actually be delivered. You must possess a deep, practical understanding of enterprise software implementation within massive CPG organizations. Anticipate data-readiness issues, change management hurdles, and integration bottlenecks during the pre-sales cycle. Scope realistic delivery phases, ensuring a flawless transition from the pre-sales environment to the delivery and engineering teams.

QUALIFICATIONS & TRAITS

  • Commanding Presence: A natural gravity in high-stakes environments. You instill immediate confidence in both business leaders and highly technical IT teams.

  • Elite Communication: Exceptional ability to read the room and pivot messaging. You can seamlessly zoom in to a complex data-flow mapping session and immediately zoom out to a board-level financial impact discussion.

  • Strategic Co-Selling: Proven experience partnering with quota-carrying Enterprise Account Executives to drive eight-figure enterprise deals.

  • Demonstrated experience with modern software development practices, combined with a strong understanding of AI technologies and an agentic mindset focused on designing autonomous, intelligent solutions.

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Technology, or a related field or equivalent.

  • Flexible working hours;⌚

  • A challenging role in a fast-growing AI-driven company; 🪄

  • A diverse and international team with strong ownership and a can-do mentality.🌏

  • Opportunities to contribute meaningfully to the organization’s growth and development.🚀

jobs.excerpt: At Summit, we build and operate the infrastructure behind some of the most critical applications in regulated industries.
jobs.description:
At Summit, we build and operate the infrastructure behind some of the most critical applications in regulated industries. The work is complex, expectations are high, and the environments we support require precision and thoughtful execution.

We specialize in enterprise-class Application Hosting, Managed Services, and Cloud Solutions, with deep expertise in compliance, security, and performance. Our focus is simple: make the complex manageable and deliver technology that works - reliably, securely, and at scale.

Event Planner

Great events require great planning, and we're looking for someone who genuinely enjoys making things happen.

As Summit's Event Planner, you'll manage everything from simple conference registrations to major trade shows and multi-day company events. Some months, you'll juggle 10 or more events, each with different requirements, deadlines, and priorities.

We're looking for a motivated, positive, and highly organized person who takes pride in making everyone else's job easier. Someone who takes initiative, figures things out, follows through, and doesn't need to be reminded what's next.

You'll own the details from start to finish, keeping events organized, attendees prepared, vendors on track, and internal teams informed. You'll anticipate needs, solve problems, and bring a helpful, can-do attitude to everything you do.

The goal is simple: Make events run smoothly and make life easier for the people involved.

What You'll Do

Plan and manage events

·Own event planning from start to finish, managing timelines, people, budgets, deadlines, vendors, and logistics across multiple events.

·Proactively gather information, anticipate needs, solve problems, and follow through on every detail.

·Coordinate conferences, trade shows, sponsorships, virtual, and internal events, including Summit's annual Sales Kickoff and department meetups.

·Arrange hotel accommodations, meeting spaces, group dinners, happy hours, team-building activities, transportation, and other event logistics. Employees book their own flights through our corporate travel platform.

·Manage event registrations, sponsorship requirements, presentations, booth setups, and vendor relationships.

·Coordinate and track booth materials, swag, and shipments through our event inventory platform, including timely delivery and returns.

Keep everyone organized and informed

·Lead event planning meetings, assign action items, and follow up to ensure everything gets done.

·Prepare attendees with agendas, calendar invitations, hotel details, dress codes, schedules, and other important information.

·Communicate clearly and proactively with vendors, event organizers, and internal teams, keeping everyone informed of deadlines, progress, and outstanding needs.

·Make sure the right people are included in communications and always know what's been handled and what's next.

Coordinate marketing and event follow-up

·Work alongside members of the marketing team to complete all event deliverables, such as presentations, ads, landing pages, signage, collateral, giveaways, raffle items, bag inserts, and promotional emails.

·Identify marketing needs early, communicate requirements and deadlines, and ensure deliverables are ready on time.

·Coordinate event invitations, reminders, and post-event follow-up emails through HubSpot.

·Provide onsite support at assigned events, including setup, troubleshooting, and taking photos for marketing use.

·Conduct post-event reviews to evaluate results, gather feedback, and recommend improvements or future participation.

What Success Looks Like

·Nothing falls through the cracks. Deadlines are met, details are handled, and potential problems are caught early.

Account Executive, Mid-Market

US - Remote

About Mimecast

The work people build is worth protecting, and it's harder to protect than it used to be. AI agents now move at machine speed with human-level access, and a small slip-up can become a very public one. We disrupt cybercriminal activity before that happens. We think fast, go big, and always demand more of ourselves. We work hard, deliver, and repeat. We grow with real determination and put success well within reach. We push each other to be better and expect to be pushed back, in a community built on respect, where everyone is counted. Work Protected.

Overview

As an Account Executive, Mid-Market, you'll identify, engage, and win new business with organizations of 750-4,999 employees. You'll build a qualified pipeline and partner relationships that grow Mimecast's market share in this segment, owning your territory through the full sales cycle.

You'll work closely with Mimecast's partner community and teams across the business to turn qualified opportunities into new customers in a fast-paced, structured sales environment that continues to evolve.

What You'll Do

  • Research and prospect within your Mid-Market territory to identify new business opportunities and generate a qualified pipeline.
  • Develop and execute territory and account plans aligned with Mimecast's sales goals, managing opportunities through the full sales cycle.
  • Lead product demonstrations and value-based presentations tailored to the needs of mid-sized IT and security organizations.
  • Build trusted relationships with economic buyers, IT leaders, and other stakeholders across the buying committee.
  • Work with the Partner/Channel Development team and Mimecast's partner community to build and execute joint account plans that expand pipeline coverage.
  • Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual new business targets.
  • Collaborate with marketing, sales engineering, and customer success to support a smooth transition from prospect to onboarding.
  • Keep pipeline, activity, and forecast data current and accurate in Salesforce.
  • Stay informed about industry trends, competitive offerings, and Mimecast's evolving product suite.

What You'll Bring

  • Demonstrated success independently managing a full-cycle new business sales territory, from prospecting and pipeline development through negotiation and closing, with a track record of meeting or exceeding quota and sales KPIs.
  • Clear verbal and written communication, with the ability to explain complex solutions and connect their value to customer needs.
  • An understanding of corporate IT teams, technology buying processes, and the broader technology and cybersecurity stack.
  • The ability to build trust with clients and buying committees, supported by strong negotiation skills.
  • A proactive approach to identifying opportunities, managing your pipeline, and taking ownership of your territory.
  • Experience using Salesforce or another CRM to manage leads and opportunities.
  • New business sales experience in IT, SaaS, or cybersecurity is helpful, but not required.

The on-target earnings (OTE) range for this position is $176,000 - $264,000 USD (OTE) plus benefits. This range represents the minimum and maximum new hire compensation for this role. The position may also be eligible for incentive plans and additional benefits, in accordance with company policy and local regulations. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location with individual compensation also dependent on factors such as qualifications, experience, and skills. Final offers will reflect these considerations and may vary accordingly.

Belonging at Mimecast

Cybersecurity is a community effort. That’s why we’re committed to building an inclusive, diverse community that celebrates and welcomes everyone – unless they’re a cybercriminal, of course.

We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, and we’d encourage you to join us whatever your background. We particularly welcome applicants from traditionally underrepresented groups.

We consider everyone equally: your race, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, ability, marital status, nationality, or any other protected characteristic won’t affect your application.

Due to certain obligations to our customers, an offer of employment will be subject to your successful completion of applicable background checks, conducted in accordance with local law.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment.

jobs.description:
About Entegrata

Entegrata helps law firms turn data into decision-grade insights. Founded in 2023 and headquartered in Indianapolis, we are a venture-backed SaaS company delivering a turnkey, Azure-based data lakehouse platform purpose-built for law firms. Our platform consolidates siloed legal, operational, and financial data into a single governed source of truth, with AI-powered analytics on top. Our mission is to become the data platform of choice for the top law firms in the world.

The Role

The Customer Experience Manager (CXM) owns the customer relationship across its full lifecycle. As our delivery model matures, dedicated Implementation and Project Management functions now carry the hands-on execution, so the CXM focuses on relationship ownership, adoption, retention, and growth, while providing oversight and accountability for implementation and project delivery. You are the executive-level point of contact who makes each firm successful with Entegrata and turns satisfied customers into advocates and expansion revenue.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the Relationship and Drive Growth: Own the customer relationship and its outcomes across the full lifecycle using Customer Success best practices. Lead Executive Business Reviews, act on customer surveys, drive product stickiness and expansion, and serve as Voice of Customer to internal teams (Product, Engineering). Own Renewals & partner with Sales on expansions & upsells.
  • Drive product adoption and measurable business value, tracking health and acting early on risk.
  • Serve as the executive point of contact and trusted advisor to firm stakeholders, including partners, COOs, and CFOs.
  • Lead business reviews and account plans that connect platform usage to firm outcomes.
  • Own renewals & deliver results. Price & negotiate in partnership with Sales.
  • Operate in an Evolving Environment: Thrive in an environment where our processes are still maturing. Use good judgment to fill the gaps and help build repeatable playbooks and documentation as the company grows.
  • Data Integrations and Use: Manage the integration of customer data into their Entegrata Lakehouse. Gather requirements for reporting and customer AI projects and drive new use cases for data usage.
  • Mentor and Share Knowledge: Support newer team members and contribute reusable templates and documentation as the team and its processes grow.

What Success Looks Like (First 3/6/12 Months)

By month 3:

  • You have a solid working understanding of Entegrata's platform, implementation process, and current customer portfolio.
  • You've built working relationships with the customers and internal teams you support.

By month 6:

  • Own account plans and health tracking for your portfolio; run your first business reviews.
  • You're managing multiple concurrent in-implementation customers & live customers independently, prioritizing effectively as customer needs and deadlines shift.
  • You've helped mature the team's processes, contributing playbooks, documentation, or templates that make onboarding and implementation more repeatable.

By month 12:

  • You own a growing portfolio of customer relationships with a track record of driving adoption, renewals, and expansion.
  • You’ve demonstrate improved adoption and health across the portfolio with clear risk mitigation.
  • You're a trusted Voice of Customer to Product and Engineering, and a go-to resource for newer team members.

Qualifications:

  • Exceptional communication and problem-solving skills, with a consultative approach to customer engagement.
  • Has executive presence: can own & confidently drive meetings with stakeholders of all types and personalities.
  • Proven project management skills, comfortable building and managing plans and driving multiple work streams to completion.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Takes ownership of outcomes, carries a full and shifting workload, and moves work forward with a bias for action.
  • Team-first and low-ego, the kind of person who jumps in wherever needed and shares the load in busy stretches. We work like a close-knit team where everyone has each other's back.
  • Minimum of 3-5 years at a law firm or software company (ideally in the legal vertical) as the point person driving technical implementations and project delivery of enterprise IT systems, with hands-on experience in customer onboarding, implementation, and/or success.
  • Working technical fluency: comfortable examining data, merging data from various systems, and business reporting, without requiring deep hands-on engineering depth.
  • A background in general IT along with a good foundation of SaaS & PaaS basic architecture & concepts.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Prior experience in Customer Success or Professional Services, particularly with SaaS or PaaS products.
  • Strong technical acumen with experience across data integration, APIs, cloud solutions, or enterprise software deployment, including merging data from multiple systems into a unified source of truth.
  • General knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including but not limited to logically isolated subscriptions, encryption standards, and networking concepts such as peering and site-to-site tunnels.
  • Prior startup experience, working hands-on with Product & Engineering organizations.

Compensation and Benefits

Competitive salary, medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) with employer match, unlimited PTO and company holidays, professional development support, and flexible remote work.

Equal Opportunity

Entegrata is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

About Alpha USA

Alpha USA exists to equip and serve the Church in its mission to help people discover and develop a relationship with Jesus. Every staff member at Alpha plays a critical role in advancing this mission, contributing to a culture of prayer, hospitality, evangelism, and innovation.

Read more about the CFO opportunity here.

PURPOSE OF ROLE, SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES (INCLUDED BUT NOT LIMITED TO)

Key Responsibilities:

The role The Chief Finance Officer reports to John Wentz, Chief Executive Officer, and leads the Senior Director of Finance and the Staff Accountant. They work closely with the executive team, the board and Alpha International.

Strategy and leadership

  • Serve on the executive leadership team and contribute to organization-wide decisions. Develop and carry out a multi-year financial strategy, forecasting and planning tied to Alpha’s growth and the global campaign.
  • Prepare and present board-level reporting and partner with the board’s finance and audit committee

Revenue growth

  • Oversee current revenue streams, track their performance and improve them.
  • Identify, evaluate and launch new mission-aligned revenue opportunities.
  • Partner with development on revenue forecasting, grant budgeting and financial modeling

Financial Management

  • Oversee budgeting, forecasting, scenario planning and resource allocation across restricted and unrestricted funds.
  • Manage cashflow, reserves, and capital planning.
  • Track the KPIs that inform decisions, and drive efficiency and cost management at scale.

Legal, Compliance and Risk

  • Own legal compliance and risk forthe organization,includingarisk register.
  • Ensure compliance with GAAP and FASB, IRSrules, state charitable solicitation laws and federalgrantregulations.
  • Coordinate audits and Form 990, strengthen internal controls, oversee insurance, and review and negotiate contracts as the organization’s point person on legal matters.

Relationships and Team

  • Represent AlphaUSA’s financial interests with AlphaInternational so the relationship stays sound for both.
  • Work with major donors and foundations on financial matters, and with auditors, taxa dvisors, legal counsel and banks.
  • Lead and develop the Finance team and improve its systems as itgrows.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In the first year

  • Clear lines of responsibility for finance, legal and risk across the organization.
  • Board-ready financial reporting and forecasting that the CEO and board rely on.
  • A well-managed risk register and a stronger compliance position.
  • A revenue plan the board can act on, with the first new opportunities tested against mission fit.

What Will Be Hard

  • You will be building the new three-tier structure while running it, during a period of campaign growth.

  • Finding income that fits takes judgment as much as a business plan.
  • The remit is wide. This role pairs CFO work with ownership of legal, compliance and contracts.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 10+ years of progressive financial leadership, such as Controller, VP of Finance or CFO, ideally in global nonprofits or international mission-driven organizations.
  • A track record of financial strategy that supports sustainability and growth at a comparable scale, with a $30M+ budget preferred.
  • A strong grasp of nonprofit revenue models, including contributions, grants and earned income.
  • Experience launching or growing earned revenue is a real plus.
  • Deep expertise in nonprofit accounting, restricted funds, Form 990, internal controls and grant compliance. Experience with IFRS, multi-country reporting or cross-border compliance is a plus.
  • Contract expertise, plus experience with board governance, audits and reporting to many kinds of stakeholders.
  • Experience supervising senior finance staff.
  • A bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business or a related field, or equivalent experience. A CPA,
  • MBA or similar credential is strongly preferred.
  • Above all, someone who carries Alpha’s DNA of prayer, invitation and hospitality, and who will live by Alpha’s I Promise commitments to character, competence, chemistry and culture.

jobs.description:
About FreedUp

FreedUp places talented Executive Assistants with founders and executives at growing US companies. We free leaders up by saving them time and effort so they can focus on the work only they can do. For our EAs, we aim to be one of the best US companies for LATAM and Filipino talent, with a supportive environment and real room to grow.

About the role

We’re looking for a sharp, proactive Executive Assistant to support a US-based real estate investor and operator. He owns and operates apartment buildings, manages them in-house with his own staff, and has a development project underway. His work spans acquisitions, property analysis, financing, lenders, lawyers, insurance claims, accounting and tenant escalations. His staff handles day-to-day property issues, and he steps in when things escalate.

His inbox and calendar are the bottleneck. He receives a high volume of email across every part of the business, and no one manages his calendar today. You’ll take ownership of both: triaging his email, responding where appropriate, routing what needs his attention, and building his scheduling system from scratch.

This is not a task-taker role. He needs someone with strong judgment who can quickly learn who’s who and what matters, decide what’s urgent, and keep things moving without waiting to be told. Your first 30 days will focus on fixing his top three time-killers, and by 90 days you should be running his inbox and calendar with confidence.

This is a part-time, remote position. It requires excellent written communication, sound judgment and complete discretion.

Compensation: 600 to 800 USD per month (depends on experience)

Location: Remote, LATAM

Job Type: Part-time

What you'll do

Email triage and responsiveness (main priority)

  • Review all incoming email daily, then sort, prioritize and act on it.
  • Respond directly to routine and administrative emails on his behalf, in his voice.
  • Draft replies for messages that need his input or approval.
  • Track open threads and follow up so nothing falls through the cracks.

Judgment-based routing

  • Decide what’s urgent, what goes straight to him, and what goes to his staff with him cc’d.
  • Learn his key contacts (lenders, lawyers, brokers, insurers, accountants, staff) and how each should be handled.
  • Flag time-sensitive items, such as financing deadlines, legal matters and insurance claims, before they become problems.

Calendar and scheduling

  • Set up and manage his calendar from scratch, including a booking link and scheduling rules.
  • Schedule calls and meetings with lenders, lawyers, brokers, contractors and internal staff.
  • Protect his time so his calendar reflects his real priorities.

Process and partnership

  • Hold regular check-ins with him to review open items, routing decisions and what to adjust.
  • Build and maintain a living playbook of routing rules, key contacts and recurring processes.
  • Spot recurring time drains and propose practical fixes.

Our hiring process

  1. Apply online
  2. Record a short Loom video introducing yourself, then a prescreen call with a recruiter
  3. Final Interview with our Recruiting Lead
  4. Complete a work evaluation
  5. Final interview with the client

Requirements

Must-haves

    • At least 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant or in a similar executive support role, including experience working with US-based executives or companies.
    • A very proactive "second brain" who audits systems and spots gaps without being told.
    • Highly organized and detail-oriented.
    • Fast and responsive. He should never be left waiting.
    • Disciplined and professional.
    • Excellent written and spoken English.
    • Confident replying to emails on an executive's behalf, in his voice.
    • High discretion with financial, legal and tenant information.
    • Available part-time with consistent overlap during US business hours (exact schedule confirmed during the process).
    • Reliable high-speed internet and a quiet home office setup.

Nice-to-haves

    • Experience in real estate, property management, multifamily, acquisitions or development.
    • Experience working with lenders, lawyers, insurance claims or accounting teams.
    • Familiarity with property management software (e.g., AppFolio, Yardi, Buildium).
    • Experience setting up inbox rules, labels or automations in Gmail or Outlook.
    • Comfortable using AI tools to triage and draft email faster.
    • Experience writing and maintaining SOPs or playbooks.

Benefits

  • Compensation in USD
  • Year-end bonus, plus other applicable bonuses
  • Health insurance allowance
  • PTO + Holidays
  • Training and ongoing support from the FreedUp team

Key Responsibilities

Security Engineering & Architecture

  • Design, implement, and maintain enterprise security controls across cloud, infrastructure, and application environments.
  • Evaluate emerging threats and technologies and recommend improvements to the organization's security architecture.
  • Develop security standards, engineering patterns, and technical guidance to improve the overall security posture.

Security Automation & DevSecOps

  • Design and develop security automation solutions that improve operational efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Integrate security controls and validation activities into CI/CD pipelines and software delivery workflows.
  • Build and maintain GitHub Actions and related automation to support secure development practices.
  • Automate vulnerability management, policy enforcement, reporting, and remediation tracking activities.

Application Security

  • Lead security engineering efforts focused on protecting internally developed applications and APIs.
  • Perform and coordinate:
    • Threat modeling
    • Secure design and architecture reviews
    • Secure code reviews
    • Static Application Security Testing (SAST)
    • Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST)
    • Software Composition Analysis (SCA)
    • Open-source dependency and supply chain security reviews
    • Secret and credential exposure detection
    • API security testing and assessments
    • CI/CD pipeline security reviews
    • Security validation of application deployments
  • Partner with development teams to identify, prioritize, and remediate security risks.

Web Application Firewall (WAF) & Edge Security

  • Design, implement, and maintain Web Application Firewall (WAF) capabilities.
  • Develop and tune security rules, attack detection logic, bot mitigation, rate limiting, and application-layer protections.
  • Continuously monitor and improve protections against OWASP Top 10 and emerging web application threats.

Offensive Security & Penetration Testing

  • Conduct application red team exercises and adversarial security assessments.
  • Perform manual and automated penetration testing of web applications, APIs, and supporting services.

  • Document findings, provide remediation guidance, and validate corrective actions.

Collaboration & Security Operations Support

  • Partner with engineering, infrastructure, and cloud teams to implement secure solutions.
  • Support incident response investigations involving applications, cloud services, and development platforms.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship on security engineering practices and security tool adoption.

Success Measures

  • Increased automation and efficiency of security processes.
  • Successful integration of security controls into engineering and CI/CD workflows.
  • Reduction of application and cloud security risks.
  • Effective implementation and management of WAF protections.
  • Timely identification and remediation of vulnerabilities.
  • Successful execution of penetration testing and red team activities.
  • Improved security posture across applications, APIs, and software delivery platforms.

jobs.description:
AI Solutions Architect / Copilot Developer

Human-centered problem-solving meets Microsoft AI technology

Role Overview

We're looking for someone who thinks like a strategist, debates like a philosopher, and builds like an engineer. This role sits inside our AI Solutions Group, where the individual will need to reason clearly about ambiguous problems, build consensus among stakeholders, and translate that thinking into working solutions on the Microsoft Power Platform.

You'll partner directly with clients to figure out where AI can provide tangible improvements, gather and interpret requirements (even when clients aren't sure what they need), build solutions using Power Platform tools, help test and validate what you've built, and keep it optimized over time. This role is about people, logic, and persuasion as much as it is about implementation.

Why This Role Is Different

We believe the core skills for working effectively with AI aren't primarily technical. They're:

  • Creative problem solving: finding non-obvious paths through ambiguous, messy, or "less than optimal" situations
  • Strategic thinking: seeing the whole system, not just the ticket in front of you
  • Logic and structured reasoning: the same discipline that makes a good philosopher makes a good prompt engineer and a good solution architect
  • Communication and diplomacy: building consensus among stakeholders with competing priorities, teaching non-technical teams, and handholding through change

If you have a background in philosophy, strategy consulting, teaching, mediation, debate, logic, systems thinking, or similar disciplines, and you're excited by AI tools, we want to talk to you, even if your technical resume looks nontraditional.

What You'll Actually Do

With Clients

  • Act as a trusted advisor: ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and help clients articulate problems they haven't fully defined yet
  • Build consensus across stakeholders with different, sometimes conflicting, priorities. This is often the hardest part of the job
  • Teach and support end users through change, including patient handholding for less AI-fluent teams
  • Translate business problems into technical requirements, and technical constraints back into plain language

Building the Solution

  • Design and develop solutions in Power Automate, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and related Power Platform tools
  • When necessary, integrate adaptive cards, connectors, triggers, and APIs to extend functionality
  • Craft effective prompts and grounding strategies for Copilot, Claude, and related AI tools. This is applied logic and language craft as much as coding
  • Build and prototype using Copilot-related AI tools for development and automation, always within strict data-control guardrails
  • Where possible, apply this same workflow to working with Anthropic’s Claude

Keeping It Working

  • Participate in testing, validation, and quality assurance
  • Support ongoing maintenance, troubleshooting, and enhancement of deployed solutions
  • Document decisions and create user guides that make adoption easier, not harder
  • Escalate and resolve issues, mentoring teammates along the way

Staying Sharp

  • Continuously evaluate new AI tools and platforms, with a healthy respect for compliance, governance, and data protection in a regulated environment
  • Bring an "AI mindset": curious, experimental, but never careless with sensitive data

What We're Looking For

Core (non-negotiable) skills:

  • Strong critical thinking and structured reasoning: you can break down a fuzzy problem into a clear plan
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to and persuade skeptical or non-technical audiences
  • Diplomacy and consensus-building, with comfort navigating disagreement without avoiding it
  • A genuine curiosity about AI and a track record of picking up new tools quickly
  • Comfort improvising solutions to non-technical problems, including political, organizational, or human friction, not just code bugs

Technical qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or real-world experience equivalent, any field, with philosophy, humanities, and social sciences welcome, and 3+ years of relevant professional experience
  • Hands-on experience (or strong aptitude to quickly gain it) with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse) and Copilot Studio
  • Familiarity with modern AI tools, especially Microsoft Copilot and Claude, including prompt engineering and LLM behavior
  • Ability to work within a regulated environment with strict data controls, balancing experimentation against compliance

Preferred:

  • Background in strategy consulting, teaching, philosophy, logic, mediation/facilitation, or debate
  • Understanding of Microsoft Graph API, REST APIs, and system integrations
  • Experience with RAG-based architectures
  • Certifications in Power Platform, AI, or Copilot-related specialties
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery

Work Environment

  • Location: United States, Eastern Time Zone
  • Travel: None required
  • Schedule: Remote-first, asynchronous-friendly, with some real-time overlap for meetings and collaboration

The Bigger Picture

This is a strategic development role on a high-performing team helping organizations reimagine how they work with AI, using Microsoft Power Platform, Copilot, Claude, and beyond. The technology moves fast, and we have a need for people who can think clearly, communicate persuasively, and navigate ambiguity with grace. If that's you, let’s talk.

  • Opportunity to develop and advance within a growing organization

jobs.excerpt: Join Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific and help deliver accurate, high-quality cardiac data that supports clinical trials and patient safety around the world.
jobs.description:
Join Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific and help deliver accurate, high-quality cardiac data that supports clinical trials and patient safety around the world. As a Cardiac Specialist I in Budapest, you will analyze ECG, Holter, and ambulatory blood pressure data within a quality-focused production environment. This is an opportunity to apply your cardiovascular knowledge in clinical research while contributing to reliable cardiac safety data used in the development of life-changing therapies.


What We Offer


  • Competitive compensation and incentives.
  • Private medical coverage and MetLife protection.
  • SZÉP Card and telework reimbursement.
  • Engaging employee events and hybrid technology support.

What You’ll Be Doing


  • Perform interval duration and heart rate measurements on digital and paper ECGs in accordance with established procedures.
  • Evaluate ECG waveforms and accurately place and adjust digital calipers using approved measurement methodologies.
  • Use validated software to convert PNG images to XML format and verify waveform integrity following conversion.
  • Accurately calibrate and scale PDF images to enable measurements from paper ECGs.
  • Process cardiac data collected from continuous Holter recordings.
  • Extract protocol-specific 12-lead ECG timepoints and export XML files to designated systems for measurement.
  • Evaluate ECGs for potential safety or alert findings and notify appropriate teams according to established procedures.
  • Process Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitoring (ABPM) data in accordance with study and operational requirements.
  • Balance priorities across multiple workflows to ensure Cardiac Safety data is analyzed according to operational priorities and timelines.
  • Participate in Quality Assurance activities designed to demonstrate accuracy, precision, consistency, and repeatability.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Standard Work Instructions.
  • Meet established departmental productivity and quality expectations while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Identify and report system or application performance issues through established management and IT support channels.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, quality-focused environment that supports continuous improvement and reliable study delivery.

What We Look For


  • Associate’s degree required; Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare, Cardiac Physiology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related discipline strongly preferred.
  • ECG certification or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Strong knowledge of cardiovascular physiology and anatomy.
  • 1 to 2 years of experience within an ECG Core Lab, cardiac monitoring, clinical research, or another regulated healthcare environment.
  • Understanding of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), GDPR, data privacy, or regulated clinical research requirements.
  • Experience working with ECG, Holter, ABPM, or related cardiac data is highly desirable.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications, Excel, database systems, and web-based productivity tools.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to consistently produce accurate measurements.
  • Ability to work independently, demonstrate initiative, and solve problems effectively.
  • Strong communication, teamwork, adaptability, and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to meet short timelines and quality expectations within a metrics-driven production environment.
  • Professional fluency in English.

At Clario, a part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

The Sr. Data Quality Analyst, PDM is responsible for leading strategic and operational initiatives that improve the quality, accuracy, integrity, and governance of provider data across the organization. This role partners closely with Provider Operations, Credentialing, Network Management, Provider Enrollment, Claims, Digital, Compliance, Product, and Technology teams to ensure provider data is accurate, compliant, and consistently represented across all internal and external systems.

This role serves as a subject matter expert in provider data management and provider directory operations, driving data quality programs, root cause analysis, governance practices, monitoring frameworks, and corrective action plans that improve provider directory accuracy and member/provider experience while reducing operational and regulatory risk.

This position combines business process expertise, data analysis, governance leadership, and operational consulting to establish sustainable data quality processes and support provider data transformation initiatives.

Job Duties/Responsibilities:

Provider Data Quality & Integrity

  • Lead provider data quality initiatives across provider lifecycle management processes, including contracting, credentialing, enrollment, maintenance, and termination activities.
  • Develop and maintain data quality frameworks, standards, controls, and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Identify data quality issues through analytics, audits, monitoring, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Perform root cause analysis of provider data defects and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Establish ongoing quality assurance and validation processes to improve provider record accuracy.
  • Drive remediation efforts for identifying provider data discrepancies and systemic issues.

Provider Directory Accuracy & Regulatory Compliance

  • Support enterprise provider directory accuracy programs designed to meet regulatory and accreditation requirements.
  • Monitor directory performance metrics and identify trends impacting member and provider experience.
  • Partner with compliance teams to support CMS, state, NCQA, and accreditation-related directory requirements.
  • Design and implement controls that improve provider directory accuracy and reduce regulatory risk.
  • Support readiness activities, audits, corrective action plans, and regulatory reporting.

Data Governance

  • Serve as a business lead for provider data governance initiatives.
  • Define and maintain provider data definitions, business rules, standards, and stewardship responsibilities.
  • Partner with business and technology teams to establish governance processes for provider master data.
  • Facilitate governance forums and stakeholder discussions focused on data ownership, accountability, and quality improvement.
  • Support the development of policies, procedures, and operating models related to provider data management.

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Analyze provider data across multiple source systems to identify quality issues, trends, gaps, and opportunities.
  • Develop dashboards and reporting solutions that provide visibility into data quality performance and operational effectiveness.
  • Measure the impact of data quality initiatives through established metrics and business outcomes.
  • Present findings, recommendations, and progress updates to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Assess end-to-end provider operational processes and identify opportunities to improve data accuracy and operational efficiency.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives using structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Document current-state and future-state workflows related to provider data management and directory operations.
  • Partner with operational teams to implement sustainable process improvements.
  • Support automation and technology solutions that improve data quality, governance, and operational effectiveness.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Network Management, Credentialing, Provider Enrollment, Claims, Digital, Product, Compliance, and Technology teams.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor on provider data-related initiatives and enterprise transformation efforts.
  • Support strategic projects involving provider data modernization, provider lifecycle management, and directory optimization.
  • Facilitate stakeholder alignment and drive resolution of cross-functional data quality issues.
  • Other duties as assigned by your manager.

Job Requirements:

EXPERIENCE

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in healthcare provider operations, provider data management, provider enrollment, credentialing, network operations, or related functions.
  • 3+ years of experience leading data quality, data governance, or data integrity initiatives.
  • Experience supporting provider directory operations and provider data management processes.
  • Experience conducting root cause analysis and developing corrective action plans.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare provider lifecycle processes and provider master data.
  • Proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and SQL, with experience analyzing provider data, identifying data quality issues, and developing reports and dashboards.
  • Experience with Tableau or similar data visualization tool
  • Must be able to work Pacific Time (PST/PDT) business hours

Preferred:

  • Experience with Quest Analytics, particularly Network Adequacy analysis, monitoring, and reporting
  • Experience within a health plan or managed care environment.
  • Experience supporting CMS, NCQA, accreditation, or regulatory compliance activities.
  • Experience working with provider lifecycle management platforms and provider data repositories.
  • Experience supporting data governance or master data management programs.
  • Experience with quality improvement methodologies and operational transformation initiatives.

EDUCATION

  • Required: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Information Management, Data Analytics, Health Informatics, or related field.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

SPECIALIZED SKILLS

  • Deep understanding of provider operations, provider data management, and provider directory processes.
  • Knowledge of provider credentialing, enrollment, contracting, and network management workflows.
  • Advanced Excel skills and proficiency with Power BI and SQL for provider data analysis, reporting, and visualization.
  • Ability to analyze large provider datasets, identify data integrity issues, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Ability to translate complex data issues into business recommendations and operational actions.
  • Experience developing KPIs, scorecards, dashboards, and quality monitoring frameworks.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and drive results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Advanced proficiency with data analysis and reporting tools.

Global Regulatory Project Lead

As the Global Regulatory Project Lead, you will be a key individual contributor at the forefront of our innovation pipeline, guiding the regulatory strategy for novel farm and companion animal products. You will serve as the dedicated regulatory expert on global project teams, shaping development from the ground up and leading direct negotiations with agencies like the U.S. Food and Drug Administration's Center for Veterinary Medicine (CVM). jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of mobile development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile App Developer with strong Kotlin Multiplatform expertise and an excellent background in native Android development with Kotlin.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our application, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development. Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build Android applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our Android application using Kotlin and Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Design shared application logic and integrate it with platform-specific functionality.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical mobile challenges such as permissions, background execution, battery consumption, connectivity, and differences between devices.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and resolve problems that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and understandable explanations.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production Android applications with Kotlin.
  • Strong practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform, including shared code, platform-specific integrations, and the boundaries between them.
  • Solid understanding of Android architecture, Jetpack Compose, coroutines, Flow, application lifecycle, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills and the ability to investigate problems across application code, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain why an implementation is appropriate.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, sensor data, and proximity detection.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and signal-strength limitations.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful mobile development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing Android applications and Kotlin Multiplatform solutions.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio or GitHub links are welcome where available.

jobs.excerpt: Location: Fully remote Company: Latvia-based startup Compensation: We operate on a startup budget.
jobs.description:
Location: Fully remote
Company: Latvia-based startup
Compensation: We operate on a startup budget. Compensation will be discussed transparently during the hiring process and paid monthly in USD.
Engagement type: Full-time
Working hours: Flexible

About Us

We are a Latvia-based startup building a finance function that combines accurate accounting, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and practical AI automation.

We are looking for a finance professional who can personally manage our accounting, configure the systems supporting it and use AI agents to carry out the work more efficiently.

Job Description

You will personally perform and take ownership of our accounting and financial operations, using AI agents to support your work. Your responsibilities will cover daily bookkeeping, reconciliations, closing, financial reporting, cash planning and applicable Latvian tax reporting.

You will personally carry out the complete migration from QuickBooks to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, using AI agents to support your work. You will be responsible for all implementation tasks, from planning and data preparation through configuration, import, validation and go-live. No external implementation partners will be involved. As part of preparing and importing the data, you will review the complete accounting records for the past five years, identify gaps and errors, and reconcile the migrated data to the source records. You must be comfortable both doing the accounting and setting up the accounting system.

AI agents will assist with document processing, transaction preparation, matching, reconciliation and reporting. You will define their tasks, supervise their execution, investigate exceptions and verify their outputs. You remain responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, expense accounting and bank reconciliations.
  • Complete month-end and year-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and supporting documentation.
  • Set up, configure and maintain Business Central, including the chart of accounts, posting groups, dimensions, VAT setup, bank accounts, accounting periods and relevant financial workflows.
  • Personally execute the complete migration from QuickBooks to Business Central, including data extraction, account and tax mapping, cleansing, system configuration, trial imports, reconciliation and go-live. Review all accounting records for the past five years during migration preparation and import, investigate missing or incorrect entries, document corrections and preserve supporting documents and a traceable audit trail.
  • Prepare and manage applicable Latvian tax and statutory reporting, including VAT, corporate income tax, payroll-related obligations and VID/EDS processes.
  • Handle international customers, suppliers, contractors, foreign currencies and cross-border transactions.
  • Manage cash-flow forecasts, budgets, runway monitoring and management reporting.
  • Prepare payments and administer payroll and contractor payments within agreed approval controls.
  • Configure, instruct and supervise AI agents supporting accounting workflows; improve their performance through clear instructions, reliable source data and systematic verification.
  • Maintain traceability from original documents to accounting entries, resolve exceptions and protect confidential financial information.
  • Identify practical opportunities to reduce costs, improve financial controls and apply lawful tax efficiencies.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience personally performing the full accounting cycle for companies in one or more European countries.
  • Practical experience with accounting, taxation and statutory reporting in one or more European countries, and the ability to apply and verify Latvian requirements. Direct Latvian accounting and VID/EDS experience is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience independently setting up and configuring Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for real accounting operations, with the ability to personally execute a complete accounting-system migration.
  • The ability to translate business requirements into appropriate accounting configuration and verify that postings, reconciliations and reports work correctly.
  • Practical experience using AI agents or AI-supported automation in finance or accounting, including supervising outputs and handling errors.
  • Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate incomplete records and reconcile inconsistent data.
  • Independent working habits, ownership of deadlines and clear communication with the founder.
  • Professional working proficiency in English and the ability to work effectively with Latvian-language financial documents and reporting requirements.
  • A relevant accounting or finance qualification, or equivalent substantial practical experience.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building or improving the accounting function of a startup or small international business.
  • QuickBooks to Business Central migrations, Business Central implementations and comprehensive reviews and correction of historical accounting records.
  • Configuring integrations with banks, payment platforms, document systems and Microsoft 365.
  • Power Automate, Power BI, APIs or comparable tools used in practical finance workflows.
  • Accounting for digital services, subscriptions and international contractor relationships.
  • Preparing financial information for funding discussions or due diligence.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote role with direct collaboration with the founder.
  • Responsibility for both the accounting work and the systems supporting it.
  • The opportunity to shape how Business Central and AI agents work together in a startup.
  • A practical environment where reliable execution, sensible automation and cost awareness matter.

Remote Working Arrangement

You will organize your work independently, communicate progress clearly and meet agreed accounting and reporting deadlines. Financial systems and confidential information must be handled securely.

This is a full-time role with flexible working hours. You will organize your schedule around agreed accounting and reporting deadlines.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and briefly describe:

  • The European countries in which you have personally handled accounting and tax reporting, and your specific responsibilities.
  • A Business Central implementation or accounting-system migration you personally executed, including the setup, data migration and validation you performed yourself, and any experience with QuickBooks or historical accounting reviews.
  • How you have used AI agents or automation to perform accounting work and verify its accuracy.

Use anonymized examples and clearly distinguish your own work from work delivered by others.
