jobs.title: Vice President, Services
jobs.excerpt: Who We AreGreat Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Great Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007. As a for-profit, Public Benefit Corporation, we believe all students deserve access to meaningful, challenging content—and all teachers deserve tools that are intuitive, effective, and built for the realities of today’s classrooms.

We develop high-quality, knowledge-rich math, science and ELA curricula grounded in research and designed in collaboration with educators. Our materials reflect real classroom needs and are built to drive lasting student outcomes.

We are committed to usability, coherence, and practical implementation—supporting teachers not just through curriculum, but with professional learning, purposeful technology, and responsive service that enable strong adoption and impact.

What We Build

Our products—Eureka Math and Eureka Math², Wit & Wisdom, Geodes, and the newly launched Arts & Letters ELA—are trusted by thousands of schools and districts nationwide.

  • Eureka Math is the most widely used math curriculum in the U.S., and is focused on balancing conceptual understanding, procedural fluency, and application.

  • Wit & Wisdom® and Arts & Letters ELA™ anchor our reading strategy with content-rich, grade-level instruction that integrates literature, history, and the arts, grounded in the science of reading. Geodes® complements our reading suite with decodable texts that pair phonics with meaningful content to support early literacy.

These programs reflect a shared belief in high expectations, joyful rigor, and deep respect for educators and students.

Where We’re Headed

Great Minds is entering a new stage of growth and product maturity. We are focused on building more connected, customer-informed experiences across the full educator journey—from curriculum to professional learning to platform and support.

Our long-term vision is to become a true partner in impact—not just delivering curriculum, but supporting educators in achieving outcomes at scale.


Job Purpose

Reporting to the Chief Learning and Product Officer, the Vice President, Serviceswill serve as the general manager of Great Minds’ services product line. Great ideas only become great classrooms when the people leading them are supported well. Great Minds services, professional learning and coaching, are how that happens: long-haul partnership that helps teachers and district leaders rise to ambitious curriculum, in classrooms every week and in strategic conversations with leadership every month. The Vice President, Services will be the general manager of that work, owning the strategy, quality, and performance of our services so every district gets support that is rigorous, human, and built to last.

The Vice President, Services will lead more than 200 facilitators and coaches along with a services operations team that ensures the right resourcing to meet district and teacher needs. In addition, the Vice President, Services will work across Research, Learning, Sales and Marketing to connect services to stronger implementation and student outcomes.


Responsibilities

  • Own the services portfolio and its market fit:

    • In partnership with the Chief Learning and Product Officer and the leadership team of the Learning and Product team, set the strategy for the services product line, including which offerings Great Minds should develop, improve, scale, or retire and how to scale across our diverse market.

    • Define the right mix of free and paid support, and of digital, virtual, and in-person services.

    • Determine which needs can be met through scalable foundational support and where customers need paid expertise, coaching, or more intensive partnership.

    • Use customer needs, implementation evidence, field feedback, and service performance to identify gaps in the portfolio and opportunities for new offerings.

    • Partner with Research & Content to develop service content that is instructionally strong, practical for educators, and suited to each offering’s purpose and format.

    • Partner with Sales & Marketing to define the value, audience, positioning, and sales guidance for each offering. Ensure customer commitments match what Great Minds can deliver well.

    • Partner with the VP of Product to build an integrated product offering that provides direct and real-time training and support aligned to our instructional vision and training approach.

    • Partner with Finance and Revenue Operations on pricing, cost to serve, revenue, and margin, making deliberate choices about where to standardize and where to provide more tailored support.

  • Deliver excellent professional learning:

    • Establish clear standards for high-quality professional learning, including the knowledge and practices participants should take back to their schools and classrooms.

    • Define and monitor measures of delivery quality, participant learning and application, and contribution to implementation progress.

    • Create a model for national consistency and regional stewardship, specifying where content and delivery should be common and where adaptation to local context is valuable.

    • Use observation, participant feedback, and implementation evidence to identify variation in quality and improve offerings and delivery.

  • Build and develop the delivery workforce:

    • Lead the strategy for selecting, onboarding, certifying, developing, and managing over 200 full-time and part-time facilitators and coaches.

    • Ensure the workforce has the product, instructional, facilitation, and learning expertise required by Great Minds’ evolving implementation approach.

    • Develop leaders who can observe delivery, give useful feedback, and strengthen the performance of their teams.

  • Oversee operations and scale:

    • Lead the Service Operations function and hold it accountable for reliable staffing, scheduling, deployment, capacity planning, utilization, systems, and service economics.

    • Work with the Service Operations leader to match workforce capacity to demand, protect delivery quality as volume grows, and improve the efficiency and reliability of fulfillment.

    • Build service models, content, workforce practices, and operating systems that can scale without losing the elements that make services effective.

  • Connect services to implementation and outcomes:

    • Partner with Success to ensure services address customer goals, context, and implementation needs.

    • Ensure evidence from facilitators and coaches informs customer support, portfolio decisions, and Great Minds’ broader understanding of implementation.

    • Partner with Research to assess whether services produce the intended changes in educator knowledge, practice, and implementation, and use those findings to improve the portfolio.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 12+ years of professional experience with 7+ years of leadership experience in K-12 professional learning, coaching, or education services, including responsibility for the quality and performance of a delivery team

  • Strong understanding of district leadership: how leaders set priorities, make purchasing decisions, manage implementation, and judge whether a service has solved a meaningful problem

  • Ability to set a services strategy, identify market needs, and translate those needs into offerings that are instructionally strong, commercially viable, and practical to deliver at scale

  • Experience working closely with Sales and Marketing to shape offerings, communicate their value, support the sales process, and make commitments that delivery teams can fulfill

  • Ability to lead through other leaders while maintaining clear standards for facilitation, coaching, and customer experience

  • Comfort using customer feedback, field evidence, and financial and operational data to make portfolio decisions and improve service quality

  • Strong cross-functional judgment and the ability to work effectively with Product, Research, Success, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Operations

Required Education

Bachelor’s degree

Full-time

Location

Remote

Location: 100% Remote

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

About UsWe are a startup developing AI-powered solutions, business applications, integrations, and automations across different products and internal initiatives.

Microsoft technologies are an important part of our work. We want to turn business requirements into useful AI assistants, reliable workflows, and connected systems that deliver measurable results.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on implementation, can coordinate external specialists, and wants to help build and lead a growing team.

The RoleWe are seeking an experienced Microsoft AI Engineer with strong practical experience in Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.

You will take responsibility for projects from requirements discovery and solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing improvement. Your work will span different business processes and products.

Alongside technical delivery, your responsibilities may include project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced contributors. You should be comfortable discussing business priorities, organizing delivery, reviewing technical work, and helping colleagues improve.

Ownership of Our Microsoft EnvironmentYou will independently manage and develop our company's Microsoft environment across Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform. This includes taking ownership of configuration, access management, operational reliability, governance, documentation, and cost control.

We need someone who can identify issues, propose practical improvements, coordinate implementation, and verify that our systems continue to work reliably. You should be comfortable combining hands-on technical work with project management, team leadership, mentoring, and coordination of outsourced specialists.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain AI assistants and agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft Foundry.
  • Identify practical opportunities for Microsoft 365 Copilot and help teams use it effectively.
  • Connect AI solutions to relevant business knowledge and systems while respecting permissions and data boundaries.
  • Develop Power Automate workflows with reliable validation, exception handling, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Integrate Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, external APIs, and other business systems.
  • Implement custom connectors or supporting code where the project requires them.
  • Evaluate AI output quality, grounding, failure behavior, latency, and operating costs.
  • Establish appropriate human review and approval steps for consequential automated actions.
  • Independently administer our Microsoft 365, Azure, and Power Platform environments, including users, groups, roles, application registrations, permissions, and service connections.
  • Configure and manage GitHub-connected Power Platform solutions, including repositories, authentication, source control, branching, reviews, and deployment workflows.
  • Manage the solution lifecycle across development, testing, and production, including solution dependencies, environment variables, connection references, release verification, and recovery procedures.
  • Maintain secure application identities, credentials, and access configurations with clear ownership and appropriate permissions.
  • Monitor platform health, investigate failures, maintain operational documentation, and control licensing and cloud expenditure.
  • Translate business requirements into clear tasks, delivery milestones, and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Manage project scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder communication.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers, review their deliverables, and maintain clear ownership.
  • Mentor colleagues through practical demonstrations, reviews, and knowledge transfer.
  • Keep solutions maintainable and proportionate to the problem and startup budget.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience delivering production solutions using Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, and Power Automate.
  • Practical understanding of Microsoft 365 Copilot and its use in business workflows.
  • Experience building AI agents or assistants connected to business data, tools, and APIs.
  • Experience evaluating AI-generated answers and actions, including handling unreliable or unsupported output.
  • Strong knowledge of Power Automate cloud flows, connectors, expressions, approvals, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience integrating SharePoint, Teams, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph, or comparable business platforms.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, application permissions, authentication, and secure credential handling.
  • Ability to write and review supporting code or scripts, for example in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or PowerShell.
  • Proven experience independently administering a company's Microsoft environment, with responsibility for reliable operation and ongoing improvement.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing Power Platform solutions connected to GitHub.
  • Practical experience with GitHub Actions or comparable CI/CD workflows for Microsoft solutions.
  • Strong understanding of environment separation, managed and unmanaged solutions, dependencies, connection references, and environment-specific configuration.
  • Previous responsibility for technical project delivery, including planning and stakeholder communication.
  • Proven experience leading developers, mentoring colleagues, or coordinating distributed contributors.
  • The ability to take ownership of technical problems, communicate their business impact, and carry improvements through to a verified result.
  • Ability to work independently, explain technical decisions clearly, and prioritize within a limited startup budget.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Delivering Microsoft AI or automation projects in a startup or consulting environment.
  • Building retrieval workflows with documented knowledge sources and permission-aware access.
  • Working with Power Apps, Azure services, SQL databases, or Azure DevOps.
  • Experience with Azure API Management and its AI gateway capabilities, including authentication, model routing, usage limits, monitoring, and cost control.
  • Experience with related components such as Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Azure AI Search.
  • Experience building and maintaining Power BI reports and dashboards, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, scheduled refresh, workspace permissions, and row-level security.
  • Experience connecting reporting and analytics to operational workflows and business decisions.
  • Replacing fragile workflows with solutions that are easier to operate and maintain.
  • Coordinating outsourced implementation while retaining internal technical ownership.
  • Using AI development tools effectively and recognizing when generated solutions introduce unnecessary complexity.

Growth, Leadership and CompensationThis is an opportunity to join early and help shape our Microsoft AI and automation practice.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed responsibilities. As the business develops and your contribution grows, we aim to offer substantial salary progression during the first few years.

Strong contributors may progress into roles such as Microsoft AI Team Lead, AI & Automation Lead, Solutions Architect, or Head of AI & Automation. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. We will discuss expectations and progression milestones openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote role with a long-term perspective.
  • Ownership across AI implementation, automation, and project delivery.
  • The opportunity to mentor colleagues and build a distributed team.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • Varied projects with practical business impact.
  • Significant potential for career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots. This working arrangement will be explained during recruitment.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core role promptly and will review applications as they arrive. Applying early provides an opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our AI and automation work.

Please submit your CV and a short overview of:

  • A Copilot Studio or Microsoft Foundry solution you delivered, your contribution, and how you verified its results.
  • A Power Automate workflow you implemented and how you handled failures.
  • A Microsoft environment you administered and GitHub-connected solutions you managed.
  • A project you managed or a team you led or mentored.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced contributors.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please do not share confidential information or credentials.

About Waythrough

Waythrough provides specialist support across mental health, alcohol, drugs and related areas. We delivery high-quality, evidence-based services designed around the real needs of the people we serve.


Every year, we support around 125,000 people through over 250 services - and it's all made possible by our 3,500 brilliant staff and volunteers.

Make a real difference in your community

Are you passionate about helping others live safer, healthier, more independent lives? Join our team at Waythrough and support people facing challenges around mental health, substance use, housing or domestic abuse. This is more than just a job – it’s a chance to build meaningful relationships and create lasting change.



About the role

Make a meaningful contribution to Waythrough's future by joining our Finance and Investment Committee as an Independent Committee Member.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced finance or investment professional to use their expertise to support the financial sustainability and long-term success of a national charity. Working alongside Trustees and senior leaders, you will bring an independent perspective, specialist knowledge and constructive challenge to discussions around finance, investments and risk.


You will play an important advisory role in strengthening financial oversight, supporting informed decision-making and ensuring Waythrough's resources are managed effectively to support our mission of helping people overcome challenges and build better lives.


This is an advisory position rather than a Trustee role, meaning you can make a valuable contribution without holding the legal responsibilities associated with being a Charity Trustee.


The commitment involves four Committee meetings per year, each lasting approximately two hours, alongside preparation and occasional advice between meetings.


Key duties

  • Provide independent specialist advice and professional insight on financial, investment and treasury matters.
  • Contribute to discussions around investment strategy, fund management, treasury management and financial performance.
  • Review and scrutinise complex financial information, offering constructive challenge and supporting effective decision-making.
  • Help the Committee assess financial risks, assurance arrangements and opportunities for improvement.
  • Share relevant professional expertise, sector knowledge and best practice to strengthen the Committee's effectiveness.
  • Support the Committee Chair in ensuring discussions remain focused on the Committee's purpose and responsibilities.
  • Attend quarterly Committee meetings, reviewing relevant papers in advance and contributing actively to discussions.
  • Provide advice between meetings where appropriate on matters within the Committee's remit.
  • Maintain independence, confidentiality and appropriate professional boundaries, declaring and managing any potential conflicts of interest.

About you


We are looking for an experienced finance or investment professional who can bring specialist knowledge, independent thinking and constructive challenge to support Waythrough's long-term financial sustainability.


You will have:

  • Significant senior-level experience in finance, treasury management, investment management or a related discipline.
  • Experience of investment strategy, fund management, treasury management or asset oversight.
  • The ability to interpret and analyse complex financial information and communicate your insights clearly.
  • Confidence to provide objective, constructive challenge and contribute to high-level discussions.
  • A strong understanding of good governance and the responsible management of organisational resources.
  • A genuine interest in Waythrough's work and the importance of lived experience in shaping and improving services.
  • The ability to work collaboratively with Trustees, senior leaders and fellow Committee members.

It would also be beneficial if you have previous experience serving on boards, committees or advisory groups, alongside knowledge of charity finance, regulatory compliance and risk management.


Above all, you will share Waythrough's values of being honest, kind and courageous, and be passionate about using your professional expertise to make a positive difference to people's lives.

jobs.excerpt: Who We Are TrueComp partners with over 1,000 public sector agencies to modernize workforce planning, compensation, and benefits analysis.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

TrueComp partners with over 1,000 public sector agencies to modernize workforce planning, compensation, and benefits analysis. Its intuitive platform and expert consulting empower HR and finance leaders with transparency, efficiency, and equity to make smarter decisions in recruitment, retention, and budgeting. TrueComp provides instant and actionable insights to help government organizations attract top talent, optimize labor strategies, and achieve long-term fiscal sustainability. Dedicated to simplifying workforce challenges, TrueComp’s solutions enable data-driven decisions that improve organizational performance and drive meaningful outcomes. TrueComp was recognized among the Top 100 Government Services companies on the 2024 Inc. 5000.

About the role

  • The Customer Success Manager owns a book of 50-75 public agency accounts from the point a customer has produced real work in the platform through renewal. They are accountable for retention and adoption across that book.
  • Our customers are HR directors, finance directors, and the analysts who support them. They use TrueComp to price union proposals, build salary schedules, and defend numbers in front of elected officials. Success in this role depends on being credible in those conversations, not just responsive to them.
  • Roughly 15-20 accounts are named accounts managed on a set cadence. The remainder are covered through scheduled check-ins and usage-based triggers. Every account renews annually and the Customer Success Manager owns that conversation start to finish.
  • This role reports to the Chief Operations Officer and works closely with sales, support, and product.

What you'll do

Retention and Renewal

  • Own the renewal conversation for every account in your book, from early positioning through signed agreement.
  • Run a renewal calendar that starts 120 days out, not 30. In public sector, the paperwork takes longer than the decision.
  • Negotiate pricing and terms within your approved authority, and bring anything outside that band to the COO with a recommendation.
  • Manage the mechanics — purchase orders, fiscal year timing, contract amendments, and re-bid requirements where they apply.
  • Forecast renewals accurately and identify risk early enough to change the outcome.
  • Maintain an account health view you can defend in a forecast review.

Customer Relationships

  • Build working relationships with HR and finance leadership at each agency, not just your day-to-day contact.
  • Understand each customer's operating calendar — budget adoption, bargaining cycles, council meetings — and plan engagement around it.
  • Run a consistent cadence with named accounts covering usage, upcoming budget and negotiation cycles, and open issues.
  • Own escalations end to end, pulling in support, product, or executive help when the situation calls for it.
  • Identify and qualify expansion opportunities across additional modules, added agencies, and consulting engagements, and hand them to sales with the context needed to run them.

Collaboration and Product Input

  • Route customer feedback and feature requests into the roadmap process with enough context and evidence for product and engineering to act.
  • Work alongside the Onboarding Specialist from kickoff forward so the transition to your ownership is a handoff, not a reintroduction.
  • Share patterns you see across your book with the broader team — recurring friction, competitive pressure, emerging use cases.

Process and Tools

  • Track account activity, renewal forecasts, and escalations in Salesforce and keep records current.
  • Contribute to building the customer success playbook. We are a 30-person company and you will help define process, not just follow it.

Qualifications

  • Direct experience inside or alongside public sector HR or finance. That may be working at an agency, or working with agency HR and finance teams in a vendor, consulting, or advisory capacity.
  • Working knowledge of compensation benchmarking, labor costing, or actuarial analysis. You do not need to be an actuary. You do need to hold your own in a conversation with a compensation analyst.
  • Direct ownership of renewal outcomes in a prior role, including pricing conversations and negotiation.
  • Working knowledge of public sector procurement — purchase orders, fiscal year cycles, contract amendments, and when a renewal becomes a competitive re-bid.
  • 3-5 years managing customer relationships with direct retention and renewal accountability. SaaS experience preferred, not required.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a book of this size independently, prioritizing across accounts without close supervision.
  • Written communication clear and concise enough that an HR director will actually read it.
  • Preferred: Salesforce experience, prior work at a company under 100 employees, data literacy strong enough to read a usage report and know what it means.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Lead
jobs.excerpt: Do You... 1.  Get genuinely excited about testing campaign changes, analyzing the data, and optimizing for better results?
jobs.description:
Do You...

1. Get genuinely excited about testing campaign changes, analyzing the data, and optimizing for better results?
2. Think analytically rather than emotionally—trusting data over hunches, and learning just as much from failures as from wins?
3. Have hands-on experience managing substantial advertising budgets across multiple platforms (Google Ads, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube)?
4. Thrive on structured experimentation, documenting results, and systematically applying learnings to future campaigns?
5. Enjoy collaborating with creative, product, and engineering teams to solve growth problems end-to-end?
6. Have the discipline to work independently in a remote environment, maintain meticulous documentation, and report results weekly?
7. Combine the mindset of a scientist (hypothesis, testing, measurement) with the execution of an operator (speed, rigor, results)?
8. Take ownership of outcomes and continuously ask: 'How can we improve this?'

If you answered yes to most of these questions, we would love to talk to you!


About Together Light Inc.

Together Light Inc. operates several online businesses serving an international customer base, including Christian Filipina, Filipino Visa, and related travel services. Every month, thousands of prospective customers discover our brands through paid advertising.

We believe exceptional marketing is built through disciplined experimentation, rapid learning, and continuous optimization—not opinions.

We're looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing Lead who enjoys solving difficult growth problems, improving advertising performance, and using data to make better decisions.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who loves testing ideas, optimizing campaigns, and continuously improving results.

The Role

We are seeking a hands-on Performance Marketing Lead who thinks like a scientist, operates like an engineer, and reports like a professional. This is an execution-focused role for someone who loves solving growth problems, testing ideas, and seeing measurable business impact from their work.

This is not an administrative role; you'll be in the campaigns daily. You'll set up tracking, optimize targeting, launch experiments, analyze results, and make recommendations backed by data. You'll work closely with creative, product, and analytics teams to continuously improve customer acquisition and campaign efficiency.

The ideal candidate combines the empathy of understanding customer experience with the discipline of a process-driven operator—meticulous on documentation, firm on timelines, rigorous in testing, and persuasive in presenting data-backed recommendations.


What You'll Own

As Performance Marketing Lead, you will own the following functional areas:

1. Daily Paid Media Execution & Campaign Optimization
2. Build, launch, and manage campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max), Microsoft Ads (Bing), YouTube, and TikTok
3. Monitor campaign health daily: CTR, conversion rates, CPC, CAC, ROAS
4. Manage budgets to maximize ROI; scale winning campaigns, pause underperformers
5. Refine audience targeting, keywords, bidding strategies based on performance data
6. Report campaign performance to CEO weekly with clear insights and recommendations


Structured Experimentation & Learning Program

1. Design and execute 4-6 structured experiments per week across targeting, keywords, bidding, creative, landing pages, offers
2. Document 100% of experiment results with hypothesis, results, insights, and business impact
3. Conduct weekly performance reviews with CEO: analyze results, identify winners, plan next week's tests
4. Systematically scale winning experiments into ongoing campaigns; retire underperforming approaches

Creative Performance & Collaboration

1. Analyze ad performance by creative asset; identify winners and detect creative fatigue
2. Provide data-driven feedback to Creative Strategist on what's working and what to test next
3. Scale high-performing creative; test new hooks, messaging, and offers continuously

jobs.excerpt: Worth AI, a leader in AI onboarding and underwriting, is looking for a talented and experienced Senior Software Engineer - AI Innovation to join our team.
jobs.description:
Worth AI, a leader in AI onboarding and underwriting, is looking for a talented and experienced Senior Software Engineer - AI Innovation to join our team. At Worth AI, we are on a mission to revolutionize decision-making with the power of artificial intelligence helping fintechs, lenders, payment processors, and financial institutions onboard small businesses faster, smarter, and more confidently. We’re building the infrastructure that powers real-time KYB, KYC/IDV, underwriting, and continuous risk monitoring at enterprise scale, and the Worth Score™ our unified credit score derived from 1,200+ data points across 700M+ SMBs.

As a Senior Software Engineer - AI Innovation, you won’t be wiring up demos you’ll be designing and shipping production agent systems that make consequential decisions on regulated financial data. Worth’s platform consolidates onboarding and underwriting into a single AI-powered system, and our agents read, reason over, and act on the messy, high-stakes signals that come with that domain. You’ll own the end-to-end lifecycle: architecting agent graphs, building the retrieval and tool layers they rely on, instrumenting them with evals and observability, and getting them deployed against SOC 2 / GDPR / CCPA guardrails. You’ll partner closely with our Chief AI Officer, applied scientists, product, and platform teams to turn agentic patterns into customer outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Design and ship multi-step agentic systems (planner/executor, tool-using, multi-agent, human-in-the-loop) that automate KYB, underwriting, case review, and risk monitoring workflows.
  • Architect agent graphs in LangGraph (or comparable frameworks CrewAI, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK) with explicit state, durable execution, retries, and safe fallbacks.
  • Build and harden the retrieval layer powering our agents chunking strategies, hybrid search, reranking, and grounded citation across SoS filings, IRS records, bank data, and Worth’s 700M+ SMB graph.
  • Own the eval stack: golden sets, offline regression suites, LLM-as-judge, online A/B and shadow evals, and red-teaming for jailbreaks, prompt injection, and PII leakage.
  • Wire agents into Worth’s production systems via well-typed tools, MCP servers, and existing services (decisioning engine, case management, crosswalking). Treat tool surface area as a product.
  • Drive production MLOps for agents: deployment, versioning, traffic shaping, cost/latency budgets, observability (traces, token spend, tool call success), and on-call playbooks for agent incidents.
  • Partner with security, compliance, and legal to keep agents inside Worth’s SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, and fair-lending posture — building from day one, not bolted on.
  • Translate ambiguous product bets (“what if the underwriter had an AI co-pilot for this?”) into concrete agent designs, prototypes, and shipped features.
  • Mentor engineers across the org on agent patterns, prompt engineering hygiene, eval discipline, and the failure modes of LLM systems.
  • Stay ahead of the frontier new models, frameworks, and patterns — and bring back what actually works in production.

Technology Stack

  • Languages & Runtimes: Python, Node.js, TypeScript
  • Agent / LLM frameworks: LangGraph, LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, MCP, OpenAI SDK
  • Models: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, open-weight (Llama, Mistral) where appropriate
  • Retrieval & Data: PostgreSQL, pgvector / vector DBs, OpenSearch, Kafka, Redshift, Redis
  • Infra & Orchestration: AWS, Kubernetes (EKS), ArgoCD, Terraform
  • Evals & Observability: LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust-style tooling, DataDog, custom eval harnesses

Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building production LLM or agentic systems (not just notebooks or demos).
  • Solid software engineering experience - front-end, APIs, async patterns, queues, databases, and the failure modes of distributed systems.
  • Demonstrated ownership of major features or subsystems in production.
  • Demonstrated experience mentoring junior engineers and raising team quality standards.
  • Demonstrated experience with event-driven systems: enrichment, retries, dead-lettering, backpressure.
  • Experience managing containerized applications in Kubernetes, EKS, ArgoCD, operators, Kustomize.
  • Deep, hands-on experience with at least one modern agent framework (LangGraph strongly preferred) and a track record of shipping agents that actually run, fail gracefully, and recover.
  • Real experience with evals you’ve built golden sets, run offline and online evaluations, and used them to make ship/no-ship calls.
  • Production MLOps fluency: you’ve deployed LLM workloads under real latency, cost, and reliability constraints, and you instrument what you ship.
  • Strong proficiency in Python; comfortable in TypeScript / Node.js for integrating with Worth’s services.
  • Clear, calibrated communicator - able to explain agent trade-offs to product, security, and customers without hand-waving.
  • Operates with extreme ownership in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. Excited to work alongside a team that values “One Team”, “Extreme Ownership”, and “Create Raving Fans.”

Success Metrics

  • Agent Quality: Measurable improvements in task success rate, grounding accuracy, and hallucination rate on Worth’s eval suites, tied to customer-visible outcomes.
  • Production Reliability: Agents you own meet defined SLOs for latency (P90/P99), tool-call success rate, and cost per task.
  • Velocity: New agent capabilities go from prototype to production in weeks, not quarters, without skipping evals or guardrails.
  • Risk Posture: Zero material incidents tied to prompt injection, PII leakage, or unsafe tool use on agents you own.
  • Force Multiplier: Patterns, tools, and eval scaffolding you build are adopted by other engineers across Worth.

Bonus Points (nice to haves, not requirements)

  • Prior experience in fintech, lending, payments, KYB/KYC, fraud, or AML — or any other regulated, high-stakes data domain.
  • Experience building MCP servers or other structured tool interfaces for LLMs.
  • Background in classical ML (ranking, scoring, calibration) you can bring to bear alongside LLM systems.
  • Experience designing explainable / auditable AI workflows for regulated environments (SOC 2, model risk management, fair lending).
  • Open-source contributions to agent frameworks, eval tooling, or retrieval libraries.
  • Hands-on AWS depth (EKS, MSK, RDS, S3, Lambda) and IaC with Terraform.

**All Remote Hires — will be required to travel to Orlando, Florida at least twice per year for Town Halls and team collaboration, in addition to orientation in Orlando, Florida.

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plan (401k, IRA)
  • Life Insurance
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • 9 paid Holidays
  • Family Leave
  • Remote
  • Hybrid work (for Orlando Associates)
  • Free Food & Snacks (Orlando)
  • Wellness Resources

Preferred Experience

  • Cloud platforms (Azure, GCP, AWS); Terraform, GitOps/Argo CD, Helm, Kafka, Redis and relational/document databases.

jobs.excerpt: Stand. earth is seeking a Research Manager to play a key role in Stand.
jobs.description:
Stand.earth is seeking a Research Manager to play a key role in Stand.earth campaigns and research projects. If you are passionate about Stand.earth's mission, like taking on big challenges, and have a depth and breadth of experience in investigative research, then read on! This might be the perfect role for you.

You will be joining an international team of strategists, negotiators, campaigners, and activists that achieves outsized results and is bursting with creativity, innovation, and untapped potential.

We encourage applicants to apply by Monday, November 30th, 2026. This position is open until filled.

About Stand.earth

Stand.earth is a nonprofit environmental organization working to create a world where respect for people and the environment comes first. Our campaigns challenge destructive corporate and governmental practices, demand accountability, and create solutions that support all of us — and the environment and climate upon which we depend. Stand’s strategic approach and fierce determination have yielded extraordinary results: Since 2000, we’ve secured the protection of millions of acres of wilderness, shifted billions of dollars of corporate purchasing toward responsible options, and transformed the environmental practices of more than 100 major U.S. corporations. Stand.earth operates in the United States and Canada.

Stand recognizes and respects the sovereignty of First Nations and tribes, and the rights of Indigenous Peoples and frontline communities. These communities are often first and most directly impacted by environmental pollution and climate change, and they provide critical leadership in developing solutions.

Pollution, climate change, and corporations’ bad behavior disproportionately hurts the most marginalized people in society — including people of colour, people from working-class backgrounds, people with disabilities, women, and LGBTQ+ people. To develop transformative solutions, these communities must be centered in the work we do. Hence, we strongly encourage applications from people with these identities or who are members of other historically marginalized communities. If you require assistance applying to this opportunity, please contact .

The Position

The Research Manager is responsible for conducting comprehensive research on a variety of topics related to Stand’s work. This includes designing research plans, collecting and analyzing data, writing reports, and drafting data visualizations. The ideal candidate has deep experience in relevant research fields and a passion for holding governments and corporations accountable for their impacts on climate and the environment.

This is a full-time position. Salary is commensurate with experience and location, and will likely be within the range of $87,000 - $99,450 USD or $100,050 - $114,367.5 CAD. Stand.earth offers a generous and comprehensive benefits package including excellent health and dental insurance, 4 weeks paid vacation in the first year (increases in future years), 20 paid holidays, 4-day workweek, and a 3-month paid sabbatical after 7 years of continuous full-time employment. We also encourage employees to make use of our mindfulness sessions and professional development training opportunities that we offer. All staff can expect to travel periodically for in-person team meetings, retreats, and work events.

The location for this position is fully remote in the Americas, with a preference for working hours compatible with Pacific to Eastern time zones. There is an option of working out of our Bellingham, Washington, Vancouver, British Columbia, or Toronto, Ontario office if you are located in one of those cities.

Responsibilities
  • Conduct complex research and investigations: Managing projects from concept to execution, collaborating with stakeholders and proactively addressing emerging issues and opportunities.
  • Clearly articulate research findings in written and visual formats: Producing high-quality analysis briefs, written reports, and data visualizations using in-house tools or custom solutions. A solid track record of publishing complex research findings in accessible ways.
  • Explore new innovative ways to conduct research and investigations: Proactively engage with the latest methodologies and innovations relevant to Stand’s work and champion new experiments within the team.
  • Communicate with clients, partners and allies: Including scoping out research questions, building relationships, presenting findings and suggesting new areas for research.
  • Support profile building for Stand’s research work: Producing blogs, email content, presentations, and other assets used in funding pitches and across marketing. Actively championing Stand in relevant networks and collaborating with the team on building the team’s profile.
Required Skills and Qualifications
  • A master’s degree with 6+ years, or a Bachelor's degree with 8+ years, of related research experience
  • Experience in managing research projects, reviewing academic literature, integrating complex datasets, and translating findings into evidence-based conservation strategies.
  • Natural inclination for innovation and for lateral and creative thinking
  • Passion for learning new things
  • Familiarity with one or more of the following focus areas: deforestation-driver commodities, oil and gas, supply chains, data centers, financial markets, and the environmental and social impacts of natural resources extraction.
  • A highly organized work style and incredible attention to detail.
  • Commitment to Stand.earth’s principles of equity, authentic communication, and continual learning
  • Top-notch writing, editing, and spoken communication skills
  • Excellent time management
  • Ability​ ​and​ ​willingness​ ​to​ ​travel
Desired, but not required
  • Experience with research extension, including supporting Indigenous advocacy and responding to research needs from frontline communities.
  • Experience working or volunteering on issues of climate, environmental protection and/or environmental justice.
  • Additional language skills, particularly a working knowledge of a second language, are highly desirable.
  • Experience with GIS and spatial data analysis.

jobs.excerpt: AI Avatar Supplements CopywriterOrganic Instagram & Facebook Reels | Direct Response Copywriting About UsImpact Clients is a fast-growing, 100% bootstrapped online education and software company.
jobs.description:
AI Avatar Supplements Copywriter

Organic Instagram & Facebook Reels | Direct Response Copywriting

About Us

Impact Clients is a fast-growing, 100% bootstrapped online education and software company. Through courses, coaching, and software, we help everyday people develop practical skills and build digital product businesses.

We are launching an exciting new business division focused on AI avatars, viral health and wellness content, and supplement affiliate marketing.

We are hiring a full-time AI Avatar Supplements Copywriter to join our internal team and help us build a portfolio of highly successful Instagram and Facebook accounts that generate millions of organic views and drive supplement sales.

Your primary mission is simple: Research viral content, write exceptional short-form scripts, and turn organic views into supplement affiliate revenue.

This is a hands-on creative position for someone who understands how to capture attention, write compelling health and wellness content, and turn social media engagement into measurable revenue.

Company: Impact Clients

Website:Language: English

Availability: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Time Zone: ET business-hour overlap preferred
Work Type: Full-Time, Remote
Industry: Health & Wellness, Supplements, AI Avatars, Affiliate Marketing, Direct Response
Expected Compensation: 2,000 - 3,000 USD/month

Our Business Model

We are building a new portfolio of organic Instagram and Facebook accounts focused on health, wellness, longevity, and supplement-related topics.

Rather than using traditional human influencers, we use AI-generated avatars to create engaging, educational, and entertaining short-form videos.

Here's how the business works:

  1. Research Viral Content: Identify high-performing health and wellness videos, trending topics, proven hooks, and compelling educational angles.
  2. Write Scripts: Turn research into original, attention-grabbing Instagram and Facebook Reel scripts designed to maximize retention, engagement, and sharing.
  3. Create AI Avatar Videos: Our production team uses AI avatar technology and video editing to bring your scripts to life.
  4. Drive Organic Traffic: Publish content across our Instagram and Facebook accounts to generate views, followers, and product interest.
  5. Generate Affiliate Revenue: Direct interested viewers toward relevant supplements sold through affiliate partners, including Amazon product pages, where purchases can generate commissions.

Our goal is to build a repeatable, scalable content engine that consistently produces viral videos and generates meaningful affiliate revenue.

You will be responsible for the research, hooks, storytelling, and scripts that power this entire operation.

Example Accounts & Creative References

Below are examples of Instagram accounts operating in the type of health and wellness content space we are entering.

Please review these accounts before applying to understand the general content formats, topics, and creative styles we are looking to develop:

  • Nutrition Is Greatness:
  • Wellness Everyday Health:
  • Homestead Wellness Daily:
  • Tyler Wellness Daily:
  • Health Is Greatness:
  • Travis on Wellness:

These accounts are provided as creative references for the type of organic health and wellness content we intend to produce.

Your responsibility will be to research what makes content successful in this market and develop original scripts that can achieve comparable or better results.

We are looking for someone who can identify proven viral patterns and turn them into original, engaging, revenue-generating content—not simply copy or rewrite another creator's videos.

Responsibilities

  • Research viral content daily: Discover high-performing Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and other short-form videos in the health, wellness, longevity, and supplement markets.
  • Write high-converting scripts: Develop original short-form video scripts designed to generate strong hooks, watch time, engagement, shares, and supplement affiliate sales.
  • Develop compelling hooks: Write attention-grabbing openings that stop viewers from scrolling and make them want to watch the entire video.
  • Master short-form storytelling: Structure scripts with compelling introductions, curiosity, educational value, and natural transitions into product-related calls to action.
  • Research supplement products: Understand the supplements we promote, their ingredients, intended uses, consumer interests, and approved product positioning.
  • Write product-focused content: Develop educational and promotional content around health topics that naturally connects to relevant supplement products.
  • Optimize for revenue: Understand that our goal is not simply generating millions of views, but producing content that translates into clicks, qualified product interest, and affiliate commissions.
  • Collaborate with AI video editors: Work closely with our AI avatar production team to ensure scripts translate into compelling final videos.
  • Analyze performance: Review metrics including views, average watch time, engagement, clicks, and attributable sales to identify successful formats and improve future scripts.
  • Build repeatable content systems: Organize research, winning hooks, proven angles, and creative templates to help our team consistently produce high-performing content at scale.
  • Maintain compliance: Ensure health and supplement scripts avoid unsubstantiated medical claims, misleading representations, and prohibited claims while following applicable FTC guidance, affiliate disclosure rules, and platform policies.
  • Continuously improve: Test different hooks, messaging angles, storytelling structures, and calls to action based on performance feedback.

Must-Haves

  • Strong copywriting ability, particularly for short-form videos, direct-response marketing, or social media content.
  • Demonstrated ability to research viral content and understand why certain videos outperform others.
  • Excellent understanding of Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, and short-form content retention.
  • Ability to write engaging scripts that communicate complex topics in simple, compelling language.
  • Strong research skills and an ability to identify interesting health and wellness topics from credible sources.
  • Understanding of persuasive writing, consumer psychology, curiosity-driven hooks, and effective calls to action.
  • Ability to produce scripts consistently at high volume without sacrificing quality.
  • Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and writing while maintaining originality and accuracy.
  • Willingness to learn about supplements, affiliate marketing, and direct-response content monetization.
  • Strong attention to detail, ability to follow feedback, and willingness to iterate based on performance.
  • Excellent written English and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced remote environment.

Nice To Haves

  • Experience writing viral Instagram or Facebook Reels that have generated 1M+ views.
  • Experience writing direct-response copy specifically for supplements, health, wellness, nutrition, or longevity products.
  • Proven track record writing social content that has generated measurable clicks, conversions, or affiliate revenue.
  • Familiarity with AI avatar platforms, AI video generation, or faceless content production.
  • Experience with supplement affiliate programs, Amazon Associates, or similar performance-based marketing models.
  • Understanding of Facebook and Instagram algorithms, retention metrics, and organic content distribution.
  • Experience writing comment-to-DM calls to action or using ManyChat-style automation workflows.
  • Familiarity with supplement advertising compliance, health-related advertising restrictions, and affiliate disclosure standards.
  • Experience creating high volumes of original content across multiple social media accounts.

What Success Looks Like

We are not hiring someone to simply write scripts and check boxes.

We are hiring someone who is excited about the challenge of building a brand-new revenue division through viral content.

Success in this position means:

  • Consistently identifying promising viral content opportunities before they become oversaturated.
  • Producing original scripts that achieve strong watch time, engagement, and organic reach.
  • Developing repeatable winning formats that can be replicated across multiple accounts.
  • Collaborating effectively with our AI avatar production team to maintain a consistent content pipeline.
  • Creating content that generates meaningful affiliate clicks, supplement purchases, and attributable revenue.
  • Continuously improving creative performance through research, testing, and iteration.

Ultimately, we want a copywriter who thinks like both a creative strategist and a direct-response marketer.

You should care just as much about whether a video generates sales as you do about whether it generates views.

Our Core Values

We believe that an exceptional company is built by exceptional people.

Impact Clients has grown from zero to multiple eight figures without outside funding because our team operates with an entrepreneurial mindset, high standards, and a shared commitment to our customers.

Our three core values define how we work:

1. Client Success = Company Success

Everything we do, from marketing and sales to coaching and fulfillment, exists to create the best possible outcomes for our customers.

Client success always comes first.

2. 1% Better Every Day

We believe in constantly improving, both personally and professionally.

Whether that's working out, reading, learning new skills, or sharing valuable ideas, our team takes personal growth seriously.

We encourage continuous development—physically, mentally, and spiritually—and regularly share books, podcasts, lessons, and reflections with each other.

3. FIO — Figure It Out

We are an entrepreneurial, resourceful team of owners.

We believe in hiring people who can take initiative, solve problems independently, and operate with very little micromanagement.

Every team member is encouraged to treat their division like their own business, take full ownership of results, and find creative solutions to challenges.

We believe that if you want to go fast, you go alone; if you want to go far, you go together. That's why we all choose as individuals to grow with this team because we are committed to the vision of building a billion-dollar enterprise-value organization, and having a ton of fun along the way.

We work hard, set high standards, and genuinely enjoy building alongside talented, ambitious people.

Benefits & Opportunity

  • Competitive compensation: 2,000–3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and qualifications.
  • Build a new division: Join at the ground floor of an exciting new AI avatar and supplement affiliate marketing business.
  • Creative autonomy: Research viral content, test fresh angles, and develop your own creative approaches to generating organic growth.
  • High-growth environment: Work inside an established, multiple-eight-figure company launching a new revenue channel.
  • Work with AI technology: Collaborate with a team using AI avatars, video generation, and modern content production tools.
  • Growth opportunities: Potential to expand into senior copywriting, creative strategy, or content leadership responsibilities as the division grows.
  • Fully remote: Work remotely with a results-oriented team that values autonomy, ownership, and execution.
  • Entrepreneurial culture: Join a team of ambitious people committed to personal growth, excellence, and building something meaningful together.

How To Apply

If you're passionate about viral content, direct-response copywriting, AI technology, and health and wellness, we'd love to hear from you.

Please be prepared to share examples of your previous copywriting work, particularly short-form video scripts, along with any available performance metrics demonstrating results.

We are looking for someone who wants to do more than write content.

We want someone who can help us build a viral content engine that consistently generates millions of views and turns that attention into real, measurable revenue.

Apply below to join our team.

JOB SUMMARY

SullivanCotter's Benefits Practice is scaling quickly, and we need a senior consulting leader to join us at the Principal level. This role is built around three things we need at once: someone who can run the benefits aspects of our most complex client relationships as lead consultant, someone who can take ownership of a growth segment of the business and drive it forward, and someone who can manage and develop a team of senior, experienced consultants. Candidates with deep expertise in physician and executive benefits are of particular interest, including candidates with consulting and/or in-house experience as part of a health system, though we are also open to backgrounds in a variety of benefits-related fields and industries, depending on the strength of the fit.

PRIMARY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Lead Consultant on Complex Engagements

  • Own a portfolio of the largest and most complex health systems in the country as lead benefits consultant and serving as the client's trusted advisor across executive, physician, and employee benefits, as part of a broader client team.
  • Present directly to senior executives and boards/compensation committees on a range of benefits topics, with the presence and command of subject matter to answer questions with authority and guide the client to a decision.
  • Direct the analytical and delivery team supporting each engagement — setting the approach, reviewing work product, and ensuring alignment with business needs.
  • Manage the full engagement including project plans, budgets, and coordination with non-benefits colleagues on integrated client teams, while proactively identifying opportunities to expand the scope of value delivered.

Drive a Segment of the Business

This is not a delivery-only role. A core part of this position is taking ownership of a specific strategic growth segment for the Benefits Practice, acting as the person who evaluates where the market is headed, and builds personal and team expertise to respond to the market needs. Specifically, you will:

  • Evaluate market need — assess where health systems and physician enterprises have unmet needs, where the competitive landscape is moving, and where SullivanCotter is positioned to win.
  • Create the strategy and solutions — define the service offerings, identify the necessary investments and technologies, and develop positioning needed to compete in that segment.
  • Develop and execute the business plan — with limited oversight and a broad mandate, build a plan that defines success, estimates the financial and strategic impact to the firm, and identifies risks and barriers, then carry it through execution with clear steps and timelines.
  • Monitor success and course-correct — track whether the initiative is working, adjust as needed, and identify the next opportunity for improvement or expansion.

People Management

  • Manage a team of senior, experienced consultants — providing real performance management, career development, and workload oversight.

Motive is building to win the physical economy market. Our products help organizations make their operations safer, more productive, and more efficient. Marketing plays a critical role in connecting customer needs, product innovation, and measurable business growth.

About the role

Motive is looking for a Vice President of Product Marketing to define how we understand, position, launch, and grow our products across customer segments and markets. This leader will connect deep customer and market insight to product strategy and go-to-market execution—ensuring that customers understand the value of Motive’s portfolio and that our teams can bring that value to market with clarity and consistency.

You will lead and develop a high-performing product marketing organization and partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, and Marketing. You will shape portfolio and go-to-market strategy, build a compelling narrative for Motive’s solutions, and create the systems and feedback loops that turn market learning into better products and stronger business outcomes.

  • Set the product marketing vision, strategy, and operating priorities in alignment with company and go-to-market goals.
  • Own portfolio positioning, value propositions, messaging, and market narratives across products, customer segments, and industries; make complex capabilities clear, differentiated, and relevant to customers.
  • Build a deep, continuous understanding of customers, buyers, users, competitors, and market dynamics through research, customer conversations, win/loss insights, and field feedback.
  • Partner with Product and executive leadership to bring the voice of the customer into product strategy, roadmap decisions, packaging, and lifecycle planning.
  • Champion industry-leading, responsible use of AI to improve customer insight, content quality, and team productivity.
  • Lead go-to-market strategy for launches and major product releases, aligning product readiness, audience, positioning, pricing and packaging input, enablement, communications, and success measures.
  • Equip Sales and Customer Success with clear, useful tools—including playbooks, competitive guidance, talk tracks, demos, and customer-facing content—that improve customer conversations and adoption.

  • Simplify how work gets done: clarify priorities and decision rights, focus resources on the most important customer and business problems, and reduce unnecessary process and complexity.

What we’re looking for

  • 12+ years of experience in product marketing, with significant leadership experience in a B2B technology or SaaS company.
  • A track record of building and scaling product marketing teams and leading through influence across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing.
  • Experience positioning and launching a multi-product portfolio for varied customer segments, industries, or geographies.
  • Strong customer and market orientation, with the ability to turn qualitative and quantitative insight into clear strategy and differentiated messaging.

  • Solve the most important problems.
  • Stay absolutely obsessed with our customers.
  • Compress cycle time and learn quickly.
  • Fight complexity everywhere.
  • Know our markets inside and out.

jobs.excerpt: About Us We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.
jobs.description:
About Us

We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.

Our working culture is fast-moving, hands-on and shaped by short decision cycles, evolving priorities and limited resources. We need someone who enjoys this environment, takes initiative and remains composed and effective when deadlines are tight or plans change.

You will help shape the product, build the brand and bring the app to market. Initially, you will personally deliver much of the work across marketing, content, partnerships and automation. As the business develops, the role may expand to include building and leading a team.

Job Description

You will play a central role in deciding how the app is positioned, how the brand looks and communicates, which audiences we serve and how the product develops to meet their needs.

Working closely with the founding and development teams, you will turn market research, user insights and performance data into recommendations for product priorities, features, onboarding and the overall user experience. Your involvement starts before launch and continues through ongoing product development and growth.

You will also own the marketing strategy and its practical execution. This includes creating the content and systems needed across websites, social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, advertising, influencer campaigns and partnerships.

Exceptional practical expertise in AI is essential. You must be able to use AI to produce high-quality work independently and build reliable content pipelines and automations. n8n and similar tools should be part of your everyday workflow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape the product: Research user needs, competitors and market opportunities. Help define the product's value proposition, contribute to roadmap priorities and turn insights into clear feature proposals and briefs.
  • Improve the user experience: Work with the product and development teams on onboarding, activation, engagement, retention and monetization. Help define experiments and assess whether changes improve the experience.
  • Build the brand: Develop brand positioning, messaging, tone of voice, visual direction and storytelling. Translate these into a consistent identity across the app and all marketing channels.
  • Own go-to-market: Develop and execute the pre-launch, launch and growth strategy, including target audiences, market selection, channel priorities and campaign planning.
  • Create marketing content: Personally plan, produce, edit and publish the content the business needs, including websites, landing pages, social posts, advertising assets, graphics, email campaigns, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts and other short-form video.
  • Build content pipelines: Use AI and automation to support research, scripting, visual production, video editing, repurposing, publishing and performance analysis while maintaining creative quality.
  • Develop influencer marketing: Identify suitable creators, establish relationships, negotiate collaborations, develop campaign briefs and measure results.
  • Establish partnerships: Find and develop relevant brand, community, event and distribution partnerships that support awareness, trust and user acquisition.
  • Drive measurable growth: Run acquisition and lifecycle experiments across paid, organic, referral and community channels. Connect marketing activity to activation, retention and commercial outcomes.
  • Automate operations: Build and maintain n8n workflows and integrations that reduce repetitive work across marketing, content production, partnerships and reporting.
  • Support future team growth: As needs and resources develop, help identify hiring priorities, document effective workflows and onboard colleagues or external specialists.

Required Qualifications

  • Substantial hands-on experience launching and growing consumer mobile apps, with a demonstrable personal contribution to apps reaching six-, seven- or eight-figure download totals.
  • Evidence of your own impact: the decisions you owned, the work you delivered and the measurable results achieved.
  • Experience contributing directly to product development through user research, feature definition, prioritization, experimentation and collaboration with designers and developers.
  • Strong brand-building ability, including positioning, messaging, visual judgment and consistent execution across product and marketing.
  • Exceptional practical AI skills across research, writing, design, image generation, video production, editing and content workflows.
  • The ability to independently produce marketing content across multiple formats, including social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, websites and advertising creatives.
  • Hands-on experience with influencer marketing, creator collaborations and partnership development.
  • Strong practical knowledge of n8n or comparable automation platforms, including APIs, webhooks, integrations and reliable workflow operation.
  • A solid understanding of mobile acquisition, attribution, activation, retention, customer acquisition cost and lifetime value.
  • The judgment to prioritize the channels and activities that matter most, balancing quality, speed and limited startup resources.
  • A willingness to take ownership across disciplines and personally execute the work required at an early-stage business.
  • Resilience under pressure, strong prioritization skills and the ability to maintain quality and sound judgment during demanding launch phases.
  • Comfort working with uncertainty, changing priorities and limited startup resources, with the confidence to communicate trade-offs, flag constraints early and propose practical solutions.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Experience with dating apps, social discovery products or consumer platforms that depend on network effects.
  • Growing mobile apps to millions or tens of millions of downloads.
  • Taking a product from pre-launch through launch and subsequent growth.
  • Building local user density, communities and market-by-market launch strategies.
  • Developing a brand from the beginning and carrying it consistently into the product experience.
  • Building a YouTube presence, repeatable video formats or creator-led acquisition channels.
  • Establishing partnerships that delivered measurable distribution, engagement or revenue.
  • Growing from an individual contributor into a team leadership role within a startup.

What We Offer

  • A central role in shaping the product, brand and market launch of a new mobile dating app.
  • Broad responsibility across creative work, product decisions, marketing and growth.
  • The opportunity to build practical systems and workflows from the beginning.
  • The potential to help build and lead a team as the business grows.

How to Apply

Please share your CV and selected examples demonstrating:

  • Mobile apps you helped launch or scale, their download totals and your personal contribution.
  • Product decisions or improvements you helped shape, including the user insight behind them and the outcome.
  • Branding and marketing content you personally created, ideally covering multiple formats.
  • AI-powered content workflows or automations you built.
  • Influencer campaigns or partnerships you developed and the results they produced.

Public links and anonymized examples are welcome. Please respect the confidentiality of previous employers and clients.

An overview of this role

As a Principal Revenue Strategist, you'll help shape how GitLab brings its products to market as artificial intelligence changes how software is built and bought. Reporting to the VP of Revenue Strategy, you'll be a senior individual contributor connecting market, product, and field insights to clear recommendations and changes in how we sell. You'll take on complex, open-ended go-to-market questions with limited context, working directly with executive partners across Sales, Finance, and Product to decide where to invest, how to reach customers, and what needs to change.

What you'll do

  • Shape revenue strategy across customer segmentation, sales coverage, sales motions, and investment priorities.
  • Design multi-quarter changes in how we sell and monetize, defining the implications for the customer journey, metrics, roles, incentives, and operating model. Build agreement on the path forward and partner with Field Operations and Enablement on execution.

  • Build models, write decision memos, run analyses, and facilitate working sessions to turn recommendations into action with cross-functional partners.

What you'll bring

  • Experience owning complex go-to-market or revenue strategy work in a growing technology company, consulting, or a combination of both. Relevant experience and transferable skills matter more than a particular career path.
  • Direct experience solving business-to-business software go-to-market problems, such as segmentation, coverage, pipeline and conversion, sales capacity and productivity, incentives, or pricing and packaging.
  • A structured approach to testing assumptions and turning an unclear problem into a framework, a recommendation, and practical next steps.
  • Strong commercial and analytical judgment, including the ability to build models and recognize when the evidence is sufficient to make a decision.
  • The ability to work credibly with senior leaders, challenge decisions with evidence, and influence people without formal authority.
  • A collaborative, hands-on approach that treats execution as part of strategy, not a handoff after the recommendation.
  • Helpful, but not required: experience with usage-based or consumption models, international expansion, enterprise or platform sales, or a technical or scientific background. Interest in people management over time is welcome, but this is an individual contributor role.

About the team

The Revenue Strategy team tackles strategic questions about how GitLab reaches customers, sells, and monetizes its platform. You'll work with Sales, Finance, and Product leaders to connect strategy with commercial decisions, and with Field Operations and Enablement to put those decisions into practice. GitLab is an all-remote company with a public handbook and a transparent, low-ego culture. Our mission is to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.

You will play an important role in helping organizations get more from their Microsoft Dynamics 365 investment by introducing intelligent financial automation solutions that improve efficiency, reduce manual work and deliver measurable results.

  • Engage with customers through different channels, including workshops, webinars, events and LinkedIn social selling.

  • Track sales performance and market opportunities, sharing insights and contributing to the continuous improvement of our sales approach.

What you will bring

  • At least 5 years of experience in technology or SaaS sales, with a proven track record of achieving sales targets.

  • Experience managing complex B2B sales cycles, from opportunity identification through negotiation and closing.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to engage, influence and align senior stakeholders, including C-level decision-makers.

  • Experience working with Microsoft partners, ISVs or within the Microsoft ecosystem.

  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.

  • A consultative sales approach, with the ability to understand customer challenges and translate them into clear business value.

  • A structured and proactive approach to pipeline management, forecasting and business development.

  • Experience using LinkedIn for social selling and customer engagement.

Nice to have

It is an advantage if you have:

  • 3+ years of experience selling Microsoft Dynamics 365 ERP solutions.

  • Experience selling financial automation, AP Automation or other finance-related software solutions.

  • Industry experience within manufacturing, retail or consumer goods, particularly related to finance or business operations.

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology or a related field.

Who you are

You are a commercially driven and results-oriented sales professional who enjoys building relationships, understanding customer needs and turning opportunities into successful business outcomes.

You are confident engaging with senior stakeholders and comfortable navigating complex sales processes involving multiple decision-makers.

You take ownership of your work, stay focused on your goals and bring a proactive approach to identifying new opportunities.

At the same time, you believe that successful sales are built on trust and collaboration. You enjoy working with partners and colleagues, sharing knowledge and contributing to a team where people support each other and succeed together.

Most importantly, you have a growth mindset, a genuine interest in technology and the motivation to make a difference for both customers and the business.

At Truvio, you will join a global software company with a strong position in the Microsoft Dynamics 365 ecosystem.

Our AP Automation solution, powered by ExFlow, is embedded directly within Microsoft Dynamics 365 and helps organizations streamline and automate their accounts payable processes, from invoice capture to payment.

With ExFlow processing over 20 million invoices and 300,000 contracts annually across more than 65 countries, you will represent an established solution that delivers real value to finance teams worldwide.

You will work closely with experienced sales professionals, technical experts and strategic partners, giving you the opportunity to contribute directly to our continued growth in North America.

Other information

  • Employment type: Permanent, full time

  • Start date: Earliest January 2027

  • Location / work style: North America, fully remote

About Truvio

At Truvio, you will be part of a fast-growing modern SaaS environment that brings together established Microsoft Dynamics ISVs in one unified company, delivering a single, intelligent product portfolio built exclusively for Dynamics 365.

This way, we help customers and partners close the ERP Value Gap by unifying finance, operations and commerce within a Microsoft-native suite.

We are a team of more than 450 employees worldwide, with colleagues based across North America, Europe, Asia and Australia. Our core values, Take Ownership, Build Trust, Drive Innovation and Succeed Together, guide how we work and how we create value for our customers and partners.
