Senior Sales Executive, Employer Solutions

Location: Remote, United States | Central North Territory

Reports To: VP of Sales

Compensation Range: $150,000 - $330,000

About Private Health Management

Private Health Management guides patients and families through the chaos and complexity of serious medical care, for cancer and beyond. As an independent advocate and trusted partner during healthcare’s most challenging moments, our team of experts works alongside physicians to orchestrate the best treatment, advocacy, and support to deliver measurably better outcomes.

Everyone deserves great care. We make sure they get it.

About the Role

As a Senior Sales Executive, Employer Solutions, you will drive new business growth across PHM's mid-market employer segment, serving organizations with 1,000 to 10,000 employees. You will own the full sales cycle within your assigned territory, identifying opportunities, building relationships with benefits brokers and consultants, developing qualified pipeline, and closing complex, consultative sales opportunities.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an experienced seller who brings established relationships and credibility within the employer benefits ecosystem. You'll help employers address one of their most pressing challenges: rising healthcare costs associated with serious and complex conditions, including cancer.

At a rapidly growing company, you'll have the autonomy to build your territory, expand PHM's market presence, and contribute directly to commercial growth while advancing a meaningful healthcare mission.

What You'll Accomplish

  • Generate meaningful revenue growth by winning new employer clients, securing signed contracts, and achieving or exceeding sales targets.
  • Build a strong, sustainable pipeline of qualified mid-market employer opportunities through proactive prospecting, strategic outreach, and effective territory management.
  • Develop a productive broker and consultant network that consistently introduces PHM to employers and generates qualified sales opportunities.
  • Expand PHM's presence and credibility within your territory by establishing trusted relationships and positioning PHM as a differentiated solution for employers managing complex healthcare challenges.

How You'll Spend Your Days

Winning New Business

Own the sales process from initial outreach through contract execution. Lead consultative conversations with employers and their advisors, understand their healthcare challenges, and demonstrate how PHM delivers value.

Building Broker and Consultant Partnerships

Leverage existing relationships and develop new connections with benefits brokers, consultants, and other distribution partners. Build credibility through ongoing engagement, education, and collaboration that translates into employer introductions and new business opportunities.

Developing and Executing Territory Strategy

Create and execute a focused territory plan to identify high-potential employers, activate distribution relationships, and maximize growth opportunities.

Collaborate with PHM leadership and Enterprise Sales colleagues to coordinate market coverage and go-to-market efforts.

Managing Pipeline and Sales Performance

Build and maintain a healthy pipeline and manage opportunities through complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

Use Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and BenefitFlow to support prospecting, relationship development, pipeline visibility, and sales execution.

What You Bring to the Table

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated success in complex, consultative B2B sales within the employer benefits or healthcare point solution market, including a proven ability to generate pipeline and close new business.
  • Established relationships and credibility with employers, benefits brokers, and consultants, ideally within your assigned territory.
  • A passion for full-cycle sales, with demonstrated strengths in prospecting, qualification, consultative selling, negotiation, and closing.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, executive-level communication, and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with leadership and cross-functional teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with self-funded employers and an understanding of their healthcare cost management and benefits purchasing priorities.
  • Established relationships with national benefits consulting firms.
  • Experience selling solutions that address high-cost claims, complex medical conditions, or employer healthcare cost containment.

Compensation

The target base salary for this position is $150,000 - $330,000.

This base salary is only a part of a total compensation package that also includes: health/dental/vision benefits, annual cash incentive program, 401k with match, flexible PTO, PHM for PHM (our services for you and your dependents), and other benefits.

Individual pay may vary from the target range as a number of factors, including market forces, experience, location, disparities in market data, and other relevant business considerations, may all factor into final compensation.

Location

This is a remote role requiring that you live in and physically perform all work in the United States. Private Health Management is a remote company with employees across the United States.

Next Steps

If your application is selected for next steps, you’ll hear from a member of our recruiting team about the interview process, which may include conversations with the hiring manager, peers, and department leaders, conducted virtually by Zoom or phone.

PHM may use AI-enabled tools at certain points in the recruiting process to help us review candidates consistently and give more qualified applicants an opportunity to be considered beyond their resume. AI tools may support parts of the process, but they do not make hiring decisions. All hiring decisions are made by human reviewers.

Have a quick question about the role or our process? Email simply apply here.

$150,000—$330,000 USD

jobs.description:
Position Summary:

The Program Manager, New Initiatives & GTM role sits within the Global Travel Customer Operations & Success organization and owns the end to end delivery of go-to-market (GTM) programs and the non-technical work streams of the product life cycle for our B2B Travel payment products. This role is the driving force behind bringing major customer initiatives, strategic partnerships, and regional growth opportunities to market. Through flawless end-to-end cross functional execution this role will drive commercial outcomes, and regional expansion programs to capture revenue growth This position directly leads a dedicated team of Project Managers, establishing robust governance frameworks and process design to optimize launch readiness while managing cross-functional alignment across Product, Commercial, Technology, Operations, Risk and Finance. The Senior Program Manager will ensure milestone tracking, and delivery excellence across all in-flight travel initiatives.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities


Strategic GTM Project Delivery & Execution (30%):

  • Drive global go-to-market execution for complex B2B Travel payment initiatives, translating strategic growth objectives into actionable, cross-functional program roadmaps
  • Own the delivery governance framework for GTM and non-technical product lifecycle workstreams, engaging senior stakeholders and steering committees across Legal, Regulatory, Risk, Finance, Commercial, Operations, Tech, and Marketing to ensure organizational alignment and seamless delivery.
  • Partner with Product Management to translate roadmap milestones into actionable delivery and launch plans that maximize commercial adoption and revenue realization.
  • Track GTM readiness across markets, ensuring launch dependencies, risks, and stakeholder sign-offs are resolved ahead of go-live to protect revenue timelines and commercial commitments.

Product Lifecycle Delivery (25%):

  • Lead the non-technical workstreams of the product lifecycle - including operational readiness, documentation, training, communications, and compliance sign-off - for travel initiatives.
  • Act as the delivery point of contact between Product, Operations, Commercial, Finance, Regulatory and Risk teams, ensuring dependencies are tracked and risks escalated in a timely manner.
  • Maintain delivery plans, RAID logs, and status reporting for all in-flight product-related initiatives.

Operational Excellence & Process Optimization (20%):

  • Collaborate with Operations and cross-functional teams to drive operational excellence, targeting repetitive, low-value work and redesigning operating routines so AI and digital agents handle first-pass coordination and workflow automation.
  • Maintain close stakeholder alignment across the organization to streamline the end-to-end customer journey, accelerating delivery while preserving human accountability for risk.
  • Actively monitor post-launch performance to ensure delivered initiatives achieve their intended operational and commercial benefits.
  • Establish standardized GTM playbooks, program governance structures, risk/compliance review mechanisms, and launch readiness criteria across all global travel initiatives.

Insight-Driven Delivery (15%):

  • Partner with the Insights and Analytics team, leveraging travel transaction data, customer behavior, and market trends, to translate findings into practical delivery and coordination actions.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows to accelerate the synthesis of complex market and transaction data, ensuring teams treat AI outputs as inputs to interrogate and establishing clear guardrails for when human judgment must override automated recommendations.

Team Leadership & Program Governance (10%):

  • Directly manage, mentor, and develop a team of Project Managers - setting priorities, allocating work, and supporting career growth as the team scales.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for delivery risk, with authority to make trade-off calls on sequencing, resourcing, and prioritization within the delivery plan.
  • Present program status, commercial risk, and delivery trade-offs directly to senior leadership.
  • Ensure rigorous tracking of milestones, risk mitigation, and stakeholder reporting for all in-flight travel delivery initiatives under your remit.

How You'll Engage:

  • Strategic Mindset: Understand our corporate strategy, the competitive travel environment, and market trends to identify how our payment pathways can create unique commercial value, translating that understanding into delivery and coordination plans that keep initiatives on track.
  • Customer Obsessed: Deeply understand the needs of major Online Travel Agencies (OTAs), travel management companies, and global travel suppliers. Anticipate their requirements for reliability, reach, reconciliation, and risk protection, while ensuring delivery preserves an intuitive, high-quality, and frictionless end-user experience.
  • Results Focused: Successfully coordinate delivery of shared plans with top customers, maximize value from strategic partnerships, and scale our product offering into new geographies to achieve ambitious net revenue growth targets.
  • Insights Driven: Utilize qualitative and quantitative insights from customer interactions, transaction data, and performance reports to inform delivery prioritization and sequencing decisions.
  • Trusted Partner: Act as the trusted coordination point between the commercial market, Product, Operations, Finance, and Risk - orchestrating capabilities delivered by specialized internal teams, including Core Processing, Global Funding, Treasury Operations, and Fraud Mitigation, to deliver bespoke travel outcomes.
  • Change Enablement: Act as a catalyst for cross-functional change. Utilize delivery milestones, process re-engineering, and automation initiatives to actively guide internal teams through systemic or operational shifts, managing stakeholder impacts and minimizing friction to accelerate delivery.
  • Relevant Expertise: Bring domain expertise in B2B payments, virtual cards, commercial credit, international cross-border transactions, and program/project delivery.
  • People Leadership: Directly manage and develop a team of Project Managers, setting clear priorities and creating an environment for growth and strong delivery performance.
  • AI & Agentic Tooling: Actively embed AI into planning, coordination, and delivery workflows to replace low-level manual effort. Redesign workflows around human-plus-agent collaboration, ensuring accountability remains human.
  • Global Flexibility: Operate effectively across a global, multi-time-zone stakeholder base, adapting working hours day to day and week to week as needed to maintain alignment with regional teams and partners.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities:

Required Experience

  • 8–10+ years of professional experience in Program/Project Management, Delivery Coordination, Commercial Operations, or GTM Execution.
  • Proven people leadership experience, having directly managed and mentored a team (e.g., Project Managers).
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B Travel ecosystem (OTAs, TMCs, airlines, hotels) and associated commercial payment flows.
  • Proven capability in influencing and driving cross-functional teams (Product, Operations, Commercial, Finance, Risk, Legal) without direct hierarchical authority over those business units.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and senior executive presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate roadmaps and business strategies into actionable, delivery-focused milestones.

Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with virtual card networks (VCNs), closed-loop payments, and card scheme partnerships.
  • PMP, PgMP, or equivalent program/project management certification.
  • Experience implementing operational, regulatory, or risk-based process improvements across global regions.
  • Experience running or scaling a PMO function.

Travel/Overtime Requirements (Please check all that apply)

Travel - 10%

Overnight Travel - 10%

Overtime Frequency - Nights/out of Business Hours - 15%

Weekends 0%

Holidays 0%


Note: This is a global role supporting stakeholders, partners, and initiatives across multiple regions and time zones. As a result, working hours may vary day to day and week to week to accommodate global collaboration, and periodic early morning or evening meetings should be expected.

Job Title: MedTech Clinical Safety Manager

Job Location: Washington, District Of Columbia, United States of America

IQVIA MedTech brings together deep industry expertise, including the proven legacy of MCRA, to help medical device and diagnostics companies navigate the full product lifecycle. As a trusted CRO and strategic partner, we provide integrated solutions spanning regulatory strategy, clinical trial design and execution, market access, and post-market optimization. Our teams combine specialized MedTech expertise with IQVIA’s data, technology, and global capabilities to help clients make smarter decisions and bring innovations to patients and markets. Join IQVIA MedTech and help shape the future of MedTech.


Job Summary

The MedTech Clinical Safety Manager is a client-facing role that coordinates the delivery of assigned medical device and combination product safety projects across clinical and post-market programs. Working with guidance from senior Clinical Safety leadership, this role manages day-to-day project execution, including timelines, deliverables, safety review committee activities, documentation, client communications, and cross-functional follow-up. The position helps ensure contractual commitments are met through accurate tracking, timely escalation, regulatory compliance, and consistent delivery of high-quality client work.


Job Responsibilities

  • Manage day-to-day execution of assigned client safety projects across medical device clinical studies and post-market safety activities, with oversight from senior Clinical Safety leadership.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, deliverables, documentation requirements, meeting schedules, and action-item trackers for assigned safety projects and committee activities; proactively escalate risks, scope changes, resource needs, or potential delays.
  • Lead and coordinate Clinical Events Committee (CEC) and Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB) meetings, including scheduling meetings, preparing and distributing meeting materials, coordinating with committee members and internal/external stakeholders, facilitating meeting logistics, documenting meeting outcomes and decisions, and tracking action items through completion.
  • Collect, review, organize, and maintain safety documentation, including adverse event reports, product complaints, committee records, and safety tracking logs.
  • Support case intake, data entry, reconciliation, quality checks, and maintenance of safety records in accordance with internal procedures and regulatory requirements.
  • Prepare and maintain project status reports, utilization and delivery metrics, meeting materials, and presentations for internal and client-facing discussions.
  • Serve as a day-to-day contact for assigned project activities, participate in client meetings, communicate status and next steps, and support resolution of delivery issues under the guidance of senior Clinical Safety staff.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Medical Affairs, finance/resource partners, and project teams to coordinate resources, maintain delivery commitments, and support timely resolution of safety-related activities.
  • Support inspection and audit readiness by maintaining complete, accurate, and organized documentation and safety records.
  • Contribute to the implementation and refinement of safety processes, workflows, templates, and standard operating procedures.
  • Monitor project performance against scope, timelines, and quality expectations; identify routine operational issues and recommend practical improvements to enhance efficiency, client satisfaction, and compliance.
  • Maintain working knowledge of applicable FDA requirements, EU MDR, ISO 14155, medical device vigilance, and post-market surveillance requirements.
  • Participate in occasional early morning or evening meetings to support global teams and safety review committees, averaging approximately one meeting per week. Flexible scheduling may be used to accommodate these requirements.
  • Perform other duties and projects as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Life Sciences, Health Sciences, Public Health, Biology, Biomedical Sciences, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in clinical research, medical device safety, project coordination or management, healthcare, quality, regulatory affairs, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting CECs, DSMBs, or other independent safety review committees.
  • Experience coordinating client-facing projects, timelines, deliverables, meetings, and operational activities across multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present information clearly to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate, inspection-ready documentation.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a fast-paced, collaborative team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting medical device clinical trials, clinical safety, complaint handling, quality, or regulatory activities.
  • Familiarity with safety databases, clinical trial management systems (CTMS), electronic Trial Master Files (eTMF), or medical device complaint handling systems.
  • Familiarity with adverse event reporting, medical device vigilance, post-market surveillance, or product complaint processes.
  • Working knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), FDA medical device regulations, ISO 14155, EU MDR, or related requirements.
  • Experience preparing project metrics, status reports, meeting documentation, or client-facing materials.
  • Experience working in a billable consulting, CRO, or professional-services environment with responsibility for client deliverables and contractual timelines.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

BMO is establishing a dedicated AI Engineering function, and this role is its singular architectural authority. You will hold architectural oversight across the AI Platform capabilities including Developer Experience, Security, DevOps, and Data Analytics. You will set the architectural direction that keeps teams working on Enterprise AI initiatives aligned, prevent the fragmentation and rework, and serve as the standing architectural authority to the Microsoft AI Council, preparing decisions for ratification and escalating unresolved matters to Engineering leadership and Enterprise Architecture.

You bring the technical depth to earn credibility with principal engineers, the judgment to make defensible architectural decisions under ambiguity, and the influence to align senior leaders on architectural directions.

The Mandate

  • Singular architectural oversight across the AI Engineering function and across Cloud AI and Workspace Engineering for all AI surfaces.

  • Standing architectural authority to the Microsoft AI Council: prepare cross-organizational architecture decisions for Council ratification, adjudicate Microsoft AI boundary questions, and evaluate preview features against bank governance. Enterprise Architecture serves as formal arbiter for unresolved disputes.

  • Architectural coherence across planes and platforms: ensure the Control Plane, Domain Orchestration, and domain-owned execution fit together into one coherent, governed architecture.

  • Regulatory-defensible architecture: ensure architectural decisions produce model-risk and regulatory evidence (OSFI E-23, OCC) at runtime, by design.

What You'll Do

  • Define and maintain the target AI architecture for the enterprise: reference architectures, architectural standards, and the guardrails that governed platform capabilities and domain workloads must conform to.

  • Set architectural direction across the function's Directors and squads (Platform & Fabrics, Developer Experience) and across sibling disciplines (Security, DevOps, Data Engineering), resolving competing approaches into a coherent whole.

  • Provide architectural governance for major AI initiatives: reviewing designs for coherence, scalability, security, cost, residency, Responsible AI, and regulatory fit and represent them at Architecture Review Board.

  • Own the architectural coherence of BMO's Microsoft AI surface (Copilot, Copilot Studio, Fabric Copilot, Microsoft Agent 365) across the two operating organizations, including the Three-Zone citizen governance framework and federation with the AI Registry.

  • Lead assessment of emerging AI capabilities, foundation models, and architectural approaches; translating rapid market change into deliberate, defensible architectural positions for the bank.

  • Provide architectural mentorship and technical leadership to architects and principal engineers across the function, growing architectural capability and consistency.

Target incentive is 30% of base. At a C$140,000 base, that is C$42,000 at 100% of target, for on-target earnings of C$182,000.

  • Update transportation tracking systems, operational spreadsheets, and applicable records.

Required Qualifications

  • Fluent professional spoken and written English.

  • Reliable computer and stable high-speed internet connection.
  • Ability to follow established operating procedures and maintain accurate records.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable freight load boards.
  • Knowledge of Dry Van, Reefer, Flatbed, or Step Deck operations.

  • Familiarity with ELD systems and Hours-of-Service considerations.
  • Experience with transportation-management, dispatch, CRM, or similar operational systems.

Work Location and Arrangement

This is a full-time remote position based in the Philippines, with Manila, Metro Manila serving as the primary hiring market.

Applicants must currently be able to work from within the Philippines and maintain a professional remote-work environment with dependable internet and communication capability.

The position requires availability during assigned U.S. transportation operating hours.

Role: Senior MSP Engineer

Our Mission

Transforming lives through Service, Technology and Philanthropy

What We Are Up To

As part of our 'One Agiliant' vision, we are building a unified organization where business strategy, service delivery, engineering, and client success work together as a single team focused on delivering exceptional customer support.

We believe technology should be predictable, proactive, secure, and aligned to business objectives. Through collaboration, innovation, automation, and accountability, we help organizations leverage technology so they can focus on their business outcomes.

Agiliant specializes in serving mid-market organizations with approximately 100–500 employees, often operating across multiple locations and states with complex technology, network, security, cloud, and operational requirements.

Our Philosophy

Our organization is built on strong relationships. We are committed to family, trust, creativity, kindness, generosity, community, personal and professional balance. Our environment is built on growth and sustainable success through leadership and innovation. We support a culture that makes an impact in both business and community.

Our Engineering Model

Agiliant's engineering organization is designed around clear technical leadership, strong domain ownership, and strategic use of technology and delivery partners. The Senior MSP Engineer provides overall technical leadership, architecture, standards, complex escalation, and project/change leadership.

The team is supported by Agiliant's NOC, Microsoft CSP, SOC/MDR, and specialized implementation partners, allowing our internal engineers to focus on technical ownership, customer outcomes, complex engineering, and continuous improvement.

Role Summary

The Senior MSP Engineer (L4) serves as Agiliant's senior technical authority and highest level of engineering escalation. Reporting to the Director of IT, this role provides technical leadership across the engineering organization, establishes engineering standards, mentors engineering resources, and makes or guides complex technical decisions across Microsoft cloud, infrastructure, networking, and security.

The role is also a key technical leader for customer projects and change initiatives - providing architecture, solution design, technical scoping, BOM/SOW input, and implementation leadership while working closely with Agiliant's Network & Security Engineer, Systems Administrator Engineer, NOC, Microsoft CSP, SOC/MDR, and implementation partners. While the domain engineers focus primarily on the ongoing health and consistency of managed environments, the Senior MSP Engineer provides the senior technical leadership, architecture, and project expertise that moves those environments forward.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the highest level of technical escalation for complex customer issues and lead root-cause analysis and resolution of critical incidents.
  • Provide overall technical guidance across engineering; mentor engineers and Service Desk staff and help determine when work should remain internal versus escalate to the NOC, CSP, SOC/MDR, or other specialists.
  • Establish and maintain engineering standards, processes, documentation, and best practices.
  • Advise on customer Change Advisory Board (CAB), Security Committee, and AI Committee discussions as appropriate.
  • Participate in technical strategy, roadmap planning, and budgeting with the SAM/client leadership team.
  • Understand how Microsoft ecosystem, architecture, storage, licensing, and solution decisions affect customer budgets and operating outcomes.

Microsoft Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Architect and support Microsoft 365 environments, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, and related services.
  • Design and administer Microsoft Entra ID identity and access solutions, including Conditional Access, MFA, compliance, and Zero Trust controls.
  • Design, deploy, and optimize Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, and Microsoft Defender solutions.
  • Design and maintain Azure environments, including virtual machines, networking, storage, backups, migrations, integrations, governance, security, and cost optimization.
  • Support hybrid cloud/on-premises integrations, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions.
  • Assist customers with cloud transformation, migrations, modernization, and complex Microsoft troubleshooting.

Project & Change Leadership

  • Lead medium and large-scale customer projects from technical discovery and architecture through implementation and handoff.
  • Act as a broad technology generalist capable of coordinating technical work across internal engineers, partners, contractors, and vendors.
  • Build Bills of Materials (BOMs) and provide technical scoping and content for Statements of Work (SOWs).
  • Develop implementation plans, technical documentation, standards, and project deliverables.
  • Coordinate closely with the Project Manager, customer stakeholders, vendors, and implementation partners.
  • Participate in onboarding, infrastructure refreshes, migrations, modernization, and strategic technology initiatives.

Customer Engagement

  • Build trusted technical-advisor relationships with customers while supporting - not replacing - the SAM/client relationship.
  • Present technical recommendations, architecture, and solution designs to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Assist account/SAM teams with technical assessments, solution development, roadmaps, budgets, and business reviews.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of IT engineering experience; MSP, consulting, multi-location, or large endpoint environments strongly preferred.
  • 5+ years supporting Microsoft cloud and infrastructure technologies, with deep practical experience across Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, IAM, Conditional Access, MFA, endpoint security, Windows Server, virtualization, backup/DR, cybersecurity, and networking fundamentals.
  • Proven experience leading technical projects, complex implementations, escalations, and architecture decisions.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, written, verbal, presentation, mentoring, and customer-facing skills.
  • Ability to use AI, automation, PowerShell, and modern engineering practices to improve speed, consistency, and quality.

Preferred Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert or comparable Azure certification.
  • Microsoft security, identity, endpoint, or enterprise administration certifications.
  • Cisco CCNA/CCNP, Meraki ECMS, or equivalent networking certification.
  • CISSP, CCSP, Security+, or equivalent security certification.
  • ITIL Foundation or comparable service-management experience.

HR Information
  • Full-time, permanent role
  • Salary budget: $120,000-$140,000 annually depending on experience
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Fully remote role - U.S. only
  • Flexible hours

Staff Accountants at BELAY play a pivotal role in delivering exceptional service to our Financial Solutions clients. They support multiple client accounts, serve as primary points of contact for day-to-day accounting matters, and participate in regular client and internal meetings.

In addition to performing core accounting functions, Staff Accountants coordinate and oversee the day-to-day work of assigned Bookkeepers to ensure accounting tasks are completed accurately, timely, and in accordance with established processes and client expectations. They review bookkeeping work, monitor workflows and deadlines, resolve routine accounting matters, and escalate complex issues to the appropriate team members.

*This is a fully remote position with strong preference of candidates in the US Eastern or Central Time Zones*

*Due to employment and tax compliance considerations, we are currently unable to hire employees in the following states: California, New York, Illinois, Minnesota, Oregon and Washington*

Duties & Responsibilities

As a BELAY team member, you will professionally represent the company in all virtual and in-person interactions. You are expected to exemplify our mission, vision, and core values while fostering a collaborative and positive team environment.

Client Service & Accounting Operations

  • Manage day-to-day accounting activities across assigned client accounts, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, account reconciliations, sales tax, and cash flow management.
  • Complete recurring accounting tasks and support month-end close to ensure accurate, timely, and complete financial records.
  • Coordinate accounting deliverables and follow up on outstanding items to meet client deadlines and expectations.
  • Communicate with clients regarding routine accounting matters, outstanding information requests, and day-to-day financial operations.
  • Participate in client meetings and manage accounting-related email communications on behalf of clients.
  • Identify discrepancies and potential accounting issues, resolving routine matters independently and escalating complex issues appropriately.

Bookkeeper Management & Oversight

  • Provide day-to-day direction and oversight of assigned Bookkeepers to ensure accounting tasks are completed accurately, consistently, and on schedule.
  • Coordinate bookkeeping workflows, monitor deadlines, and follow up on incomplete or overdue deliverables.
  • Review bookkeeping work, including transaction coding, account reconciliations, and supporting documentation, to identify errors and items requiring correction.
  • Provide routine guidance and constructive feedback to Bookkeepers on accounting procedures, client-specific requirements, and quality standards.
  • Reinforce adherence to BELAY standard operating procedures, internal controls, and client-specific accounting processes.
  • Identify recurring errors, quality concerns, and workflow challenges, escalating technical issues or performance concerns to the appropriate Senior Accountant, Controller, or Accounting Manager.

Process Improvement & Collaboration

  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting workflows, accuracy, and efficiency.
  • Follow established procedures and contribute to consistent accounting practices across client accounts.
  • Partner with Senior Accountants, Controllers, and Accounting Managers to resolve issues and support quality service delivery.
  • Demonstrate accountability, adaptability, and professionalism in all client and internal interactions.

Minimum Qualifications

This role requires a motivated and trustworthy self-starter with strong accounting, communication, and organizational skills who thrives independently and as part of a team. Our ideal Staff Accountant is proactive, detail-oriented, and client-focused, with the ability to manage accounting activities and oversee bookkeeping workflows.

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 2–4 years of accounting experience, preferably in a client-service or outsourced accounting environment.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial statements, debits and credits, and account reconciliations.
  • Experience with recurring accounting activities and month-end close processes.
  • Proficiency with QuickBooks Online and familiarity with accounting, payroll, and business management platforms.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines.
  • Ability to review work for accuracy, coordinate workflows, and provide day-to-day direction to Bookkeepers.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and a professional, client-focused approach.
  • Demonstrated accountability, sound judgment, and ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience coordinating, reviewing, or providing day-to-day guidance to Bookkeepers or other accounting team members.
  • Experience supporting multiple clients in an outsourced accounting or professional services environment.
  • Experience with inventory, e-commerce, or project- and service-based businesses.
  • Experience with financial reporting, cash flow management, or variance analysis.
  • Experience with QuickBooks Online, BILL, Gusto, Shopify, Amazon, Cin7, or similar platforms.
  • Working toward or planning to pursue a Certified Public Accountant (CPA) license.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong foundational accounting knowledge and attention to detail.
  • Ability to review accounting work for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple client accounts, workflows, and deadlines.
  • Ability to provide day-to-day direction and constructive feedback to Bookkeepers.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment in resolving routine issues and recognizing when escalation is needed.
  • Strong client communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to follow established accounting procedures, internal controls, and client-specific requirements.
  • Demonstrated accountability, ownership, collaboration, and adaptability in a remote environment.

Working Conditions

BELAY offers full-time remote work, requiring a dedicated, distraction-free home office for standard Monday-Friday business hours, with occasional travel for some roles. As a full-time, exempt W-2 employee, you'll join a vibrant, award-winning company culture where you're a valued, engaged team player in a thriving organization.

Physical Requirements

This position does not have any physical requirements at this time.

Direct Reports

None

Disclaimer

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or qualifications. Responsibilities may change from time to time based on business needs, and team members may be assigned additional duties as needed.

Legal Disclosures

BELAY covers 70% of employee premiums and 65% of dependent premiums for medical, and 70% of employee premiums for dental and vision. jobs.excerpt: Company Overview At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S

Every day at Enlyte, our people focus on making the journey from incident to outcome smarter, simpler and brighter. We help those who help restore lives by making it easier to navigate the complex road to recovery through advanced technology, insight, and expertise. We mix wisdom with sparks of ingenuity to break through barriers, eliminate delays, and ease frustration. Our vision of meeting the unique needs of our clients with flexible thinking and responsive solutions means working together as one team fully dedicated to transforming today and navigating next.

Division Specific Information

The Core Services team is part of the Security team. Members of the team are charged with developing identity and access management solutions for the organization across the hybrid cloud landscape, which includes Directory Services in Active Directory, Identity services in Microsoft Azure Cloud, and AWS Identity support. The team also supports Microsoft O365, including Messaging services under Exchange and Teams, Intranet Services under SharePoint, and Personal cloud storage services under OneDrive, as well as federation and single sign-on services through Azure Entra ID. This position serves as the team's primary Identity Governance and Administration specialist, focused on access governance, lifecycle management, and role-based access controls.

How will you make an impact?

This position reports to the Manager of Core Services and is in support of the Core Services team in Corporate IT at Enlyte. Core Services includes the management of Active Directory, Microsoft Azure, Exchange O365, DNS, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Identity and Access Management for corporate colleagues and contractors.

What will you do?

  • Work with key stakeholders to identify improvements to maximize colleague experience
  • Maintain security requirements, compliance controls, risk reviews, and support associated objectives
  • Engage in integration projects for new acquisitions, consolidation projects to reduce complexity, as well as projects for divestitures
  • Support operational initiatives, incident management, and problem management in a timely manner

Identity Governance Administration (IGA) Specialization Responsibilities:

  • Lead administration and operational support of the enterprise Identity Governance and Administration platform
  • Design, implement, and maintain Joiner, Mover, and Leaver lifecycle processes
  • Develop and govern role-based access control frameworks
  • Manage birthright provisioning and entitlement policy administration
  • Coordinate user access certifications, group attestations, and periodic access reviews
  • Partner with Information Security, HR, Compliance, and business stakeholders on access governance initiatives

Qualifications

  • Bachelors in Science (Computer Science, Business, or other applicable degree), or equivalent working experience
  • Minimum of 2+ years of professional experience in progressive roles in Identity and Access Management
  • Minimum of 2+ years of professional experience with Identity and Access Management solutions (PAM, ILM, IGM, etc.)
  • Minimum of 2+ years of professional experience with Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID
  • Minimum of 2+ years of fundamental experience in DDI, networking, firewall, server, and cloud technologies
  • Minimum of 2+ years of hands-on experience in Windows PowerShell, with ability to develop scripts as needed
  • Experience in complex enterprises with a diverse array of unique authentication / authorization requirements

Tool & Technology Skills

  • IAM solutions such as Active Directory, VDS, SSO, SAML, oAuth, OpenID, MFA, and PAM
  • Identity Lifecycle Management and Governance tools (MIM, SailPoint, Saviynt, ForgeRock)
  • Cloud Identity technologies, including Microsoft Azure, Amazon AWS, and Google Cloud
  • Microsoft Mail Services (Exchange Server, as well as Microsoft O365)
  • SharePoint for O365, Microsoft Teams, and OneDrive administration
  • Automation, such as PowerShell, Perl, Python, or .NET development languages
  • AuthX Support for Windows Server, as well as Linux Server
  • Mergers & Acquisitions involving Active Directory and Azure
  • Working in GxP or other regulated environments
  • Documentation for systems management and compliance purposes

Preferred IGA Skills

  • Experience administering SailPoint, Saviynt, Microsoft Identity Manager, or ForgeRock
  • Experience implementing JML processes
  • Experience with RBAC, access certifications, entitlement governance, and birthright provisioning

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Must be able to translate technical issues into clear descriptions and explanations that are understandable and actionable for a broad audience of varying technical acumen, business function, and leadership levels.
  • Must be able to gather, organize, and present data demonstrating the state of services, including key performance indicators, program and project state, quarterly reviews, audit results, and proper data in support of budgetary investments.
  • Strong analytical skills; being able to work through symptoms and problems logically to timely resolution.
  • Ability to work in a distributed team via collaboration tools such as email, messaging, and conferencing
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision, and able to take ownership of tasks to conclusion
  • Ability to effectively prioritize work, and work with multiple projects of varying timelines and constraints
  • A proactive approach to work; analyzing and identifying ways to increase efficiency and reliability

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $30.85 - $43.75 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

ACCOUNTING SPECIALIST
Department: Finance
Reports To: Assistant Controller
Location: Remote - Denver, CO Preferred
Application Deadline: Apply at Vero.com/careers by 12/15/2026 to be considered

POSITION SUMMARY
Vero is seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Accounting Specialist to serve as the primary Finance owner of payroll while supporting payroll-related compliance, accounting, reporting, and process governance across our growing organization. Payroll will be the primary responsibility of this role.

This role will exercise discretion and independent judgment in directing Vero's multi-entity payroll processes, resolving significant payroll and compliance matters, establishing controls and procedures, and partnering with People Operations, Accounting, Operations, and business leaders to ensure payroll is accurate, timely, compliant, and scalable.

Vero operates across multiple legal entities and jurisdictions and continues to grow through both organic expansion and acquisitions. As a result, this position requires someone who can independently evaluate complex payroll and accounting issues, make sound decisions within established authority, strengthen governance and documentation, and adapt systems and processes as the organization evolves.

While payroll will be the primary responsibility of this position, the Accounting Specialist will also own and support payroll accounting, month-end close, accounts payable, reconciliations, audits, systems improvements, acquisition integrations, and other Accounting and Finance initiatives. The ideal candidate enjoys taking ownership, exercising judgment, solving complex problems, improving processes, and working cross-functionally in a fast-paced and growing organization.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Payroll Ownership, Governance & Administration
  • Direct and manage Vero's multi-entity bi-weekly payroll process, establishing processing standards, internal controls, governance workflows, and review procedures to ensure employees are paid accurately and on time.
  • Govern the review and validation of payroll inputs, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, commissions, deductions, benefits, timekeeping, reimbursements, and other payroll adjustments; determine appropriate treatment for exceptions and non-standard items.
  • Establish and enforce payroll validation standards for employee time and payroll data, independently assessing exceptions and determining required corrective action prior to payroll submission.
  • Partner with People Operations and business leaders to resolve significant payroll discrepancies, determine appropriate corrective actions, and establish approval requirements for non-standard matters.
  • Perform final analytical review of payroll registers and supporting reports and exercise judgment to authorize payroll readiness or require corrective action before submission.
  • Exercise independent judgment to resolve complex employee payroll questions and discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement corrective measures that reduce recurrence.
  • Evaluate and authorize off-cycle payrolls, corrections, and non-standard payroll adjustments in accordance with established controls and applicable requirements.
  • Establish documentation and record-retention standards for payroll records, controls, approvals, and supporting documentation.
  • Lead payroll workstreams for newly acquired businesses and employee transitions, determining integration requirements, control needs, timing, and alignment with Vero's payroll standards.
  • Establish, govern, and continuously improve standardized payroll procedures, controls, checklists, calendars, and documentation across Vero entities.
Payroll Compliance
  • Evaluate, interpret, and enforce payroll compliance strategies across federal, state, and local jurisdictions in which Vero operates.
  • Govern payroll tax registrations, filings, payments, and notice resolution in coordination with payroll providers and internal stakeholders, escalating only matters requiring executive, legal, or external specialist input.
  • Independently research and resolve payroll tax notices, discrepancies, and jurisdictional issues, determining corrective actions and process changes where appropriate.
  • Evaluate and apply wage and hour requirements, payroll deductions, garnishments, state-mandated leave programs, and other payroll-related regulations; establish procedures to maintain ongoing compliance.
  • Oversee quarterly and annual payroll reporting and reconciliations, including Forms 941, W-2s, and other required filings, and resolve material exceptions before filing.
  • Direct year-end payroll activities and employee tax reporting, establishing timelines, review standards, and issue-resolution procedures.
  • Establish and maintain payroll documentation and control evidence sufficient to support internal controls, external audits, and regulatory requirements.
  • Interpret payroll-related regulatory changes, assess business impact, and recommend or implement required policy, process, or system changes with Finance and People Operations.
Payroll Accounting & Month-End Close
  • Own payroll-related accounting entries and reconciliations, determining appropriate accounting treatment for routine and non-standard payroll matters.
  • Govern reconciliation of payroll registers to the general ledger, independently investigate differences, and determine corrective accounting or payroll actions.
  • Own payroll-related balance sheet reconciliations, including accrued payroll, payroll taxes, benefits, deductions, and other payroll liabilities, and resolve material or unusual reconciling items.
  • Determine and prepare payroll accruals and related month-end and quarter-end accounting, applying judgment to estimates, cut-off, and unusual items.
  • Establish and apply payroll accounting and allocation methodologies to ensure expenses are recorded accurately across departments, cost centers, markets, and legal entities.
  • Evaluate and govern payroll allocations and other accounting activities associated with Vero's multi-entity structure, recommending improvements to methodology and controls as needed.
  • Serve as the primary payroll accounting contact for external audit requests and payroll-related financial reporting, independently resolving questions and control matters within the role’s authority.
Systems & Process Improvement
  • Own the design and continuous improvement of Vero's payroll, timekeeping, and related Finance processes and control environment.
  • Architect and prioritize opportunities to automate payroll and accounting processes, strengthen controls, reduce manual risk, and improve efficiency.
  • Lead Finance requirements, testing, control design, and implementation decisions for payroll and timekeeping system integrations and enhancements.
  • Partner with People Operations, Finance Systems, Accounting, and Operations to establish scalable payroll data standards, system workflows, and ownership expectations.
  • Design and govern scalable payroll processes and controls that support Vero's continued organic growth and future acquisitions.
  • Formulate and lead the payroll integration strategy for newly acquired legal entities, establishing scalable systems, unified processes, control standards, and compliance alignment.
  • Establish process documentation standards and implement control improvements that reduce key-person dependency and strengthen business continuity.
Accounting & Finance Support
  • Support accounts payable function by working assigned inboxes and contributing as needed
  • Own assigned month-end close activities and independently manage general accounting projects within the role’s scope.
  • Prepare, review, and approve assigned account reconciliations, journal entries, and reporting; independently resolve unusual or complex items within established authority.
  • Own employee-related expense and benefit reconciliations and determine corrective action for material discrepancies.
  • Lead or independently manage assigned Finance initiatives, system implementations, acquisition workstreams, and special projects related to payroll and accounting.
  • Act as a cross-functional subject-matter owner for payroll and related accounting matters as priorities evolve and Vero continues to grow.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion and independent judgment on significant payroll, compliance, accounting, or systems matters, including resolving exceptions and recommending or implementing process and control improvements.
  • 2+ years of payroll, accounting, or related experience.
  • Experience owning payroll processes and exercising independent judgment over payroll exceptions, controls, compliance, or system workflows.
  • Understanding of payroll taxes, deductions, benefits, and payroll-related compliance requirements.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Ability to independently govern recurring, deadline-driven processes, prioritize competing matters, and make sound decisions with limited supervision.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to independently research complex discrepancies, identify root causes, determine corrective action, and drive issues through resolution.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to handle confidential employee and compensation information with appropriate discretion.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Experience owning and governing bi-weekly payroll, including review, exception resolution, controls, and final payroll readiness.
  • Experience supporting payroll across multiple states and legal entities.
  • Experience with Rippling or similar payroll and HRIS platforms.
  • Experience with timekeeping systems and payroll integrations.
  • NetSuite ERP experience.
  • Experience preparing payroll-related journal entries and account reconciliations.
  • Experience working in a growing, multi-entity organization.
  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, or payroll integrations.
  • Telecommunications, broadband, infrastructure, construction, or similar industry experience.
  • Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC), or interest in obtaining a payroll certification.
JOB DETAILS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  • This role may require limited travel to attend meetings, trainings, acquisitions or special projects.
  • This is a staff position.
  • This is an exempt, salaried position.
  • This is a Full-Time position.
  • This is a Remote position.
  • The schedule for this position is Monday through Friday.
  • This position requires the ability to sit and work at a desk for extended periods of time, using a computer and other office equipment.
  • This position requires the ability to perform fine motor tasks, such as typing or using a mouse, for extended period of time.
COMPENSATION, BENEFITS AND ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
  • The anticipated annual salary range for this position is $60,000 – $75,000. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as the candidate's experience, skills, and internal equity. For Colorado-based applicants, the pay range and benefits listed apply in accordance with the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act.
  • This position may be eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, based on individual performance and company profitability.
  • 4 Medical plan options, each with employer contributions for employees and dependents
  • Dental and Vision insurance
  • Life Insurance and AD&D
  • Voluntary Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan + employer match
  • 15 PTO days, 9 paid holidays + 2 floating holidays
ABOUT VERO
Vero Broadband was formed to fill a need in unserviceable and underserved communities where access to affordable, reliable broadband simply does not exist. Our goal is to bring the highest quality fiber optic-based broadband services to these communities. In addition, Vero strives to enhance communities by becoming an active partner in these communities by adding jobs, supporting local causes, and helping improve the connectivity of schools and rural healthcare as well.

NOTICES
Vero participates in E-Verify. Vero will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization. For more information about E-Verify, please visit:

This position requires the ability to pass a standard background check upon offer of position.
At least 2 professional references are required.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER
Vero Fiber is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact to request one.

jobs.description:
Join beqom - where Tech meets Impact

beqom is a high-growth B2B SaaS company that provides industry-leading tools for pay equity and transparency, compensation, and performance management. Trusted by some of the world’s most respected companies, beqom enables HR and business leaders to navigate global compliance and make smarter pay decisions that attract, retain, and motivate top talent.

Founded in Switzerland and serving clients worldwide, our powerful, enterprise-ready products are fueled by beqom pay intelligence.

The role

As a BDR, you’re the engine of our French pipeline. Every conversation you start with a Head of Reward, CHRO, or VP Total Rewards moves a deal closer to revenue. That is the job, and it’s measurable from day one.

Concretely, you’ll:

  • Run 50+ cold calls a day and build outbound sequences that actually get replies
  • Engage senior HR and Finance leaders at companies between 1,000 and 50,000 employees
  • Qualify inbound demand from marketing, events, and pay equity regulation triggers (EU Pay Transparency Directive, US state laws)
  • Build pipeline alongside Account Executives working complex Fortune 500 deals
  • Experiment. Test new sequences, new tools, new angles.

Every conversation you start moves us - and you - forward.

What are we looking for?

What you need to bring

  • 1 to 3 years in a sales, BDR, SDR, or customer-facing role (SaaS or B2B tech preferred, internships count)
  • Strong communication skills in English and French. Comfortable on the phone with senior leaders.
  • Self-starter who treats their pipeline like a business, not a checklist
  • Based in France you will be fully remote
  • Your application will be in English.

What sets the best candidates apart

  • You’ve already played with AI tools (Claude, Clay, Apollo, n8n) and you have opinions about what works
  • You write outbound copy that doesn’t sound like a template
  • You have a side project, a newsletter, a Substack, a GitHub, a TikTok, something that shows you build things
  • You know your way around HubSpot, Lemlist, Outreach, Nooks, Zoominfo or LinkedIn Sales Navigator

The stack you’ll use daily

HubSpot, Lemlist, Nooks (parallel dialer), LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, Slack, Google Workspace. Plus the AI tools you want to test. We give you a budget for that.

Why join us?

  • Real ownership. You won’t inherit a script and a list. You’ll co-build the US outbound motion with our team.
  • Real exposure. You engage senior leaders at Fortune 500 companies from your first month. The conversations you build are the foundation of an enterprise sales career.
  • Real impact. We sell pay compensation software. The work you do funds a fairer compensation system at scale.

  • Drives test time reduction through analysis of fallout data versus test time for various IPs to balance and drive overall product cost optimizations.

jobs.excerpt: Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers.
jobs.description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

Our people are united by a shared way of working: follow the science, challenge assumptions, act with urgency and hold ourselves to a high standard of rigor—all in service of patients.

The Opportunity:

This is an opportunity to help build the launch excellence capability that enables Revolution Medicines to prepare for and execute global product launches with consistency, visibility, and discipline. We are seeking an experienced and highly collaborative Associate Director, Launch Excellence to manage assigned launches while supporting the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the company’s global launch management approach.

This role sits within Global Commercialization Effectiveness & Operations. The Associate Director will serve as an operating partner in establishing launch standards, readiness processes, governance, tools, and reporting across the portfolio. In parallel, the role will provide hands-on project-management leadership for assigned global product launches.

For assigned launches, the Associate Director will support with the integrated launch plan from approximately T-24 months through six months post-launch, facilitate the Global Launch Strategy Team, and drive readiness, decisions, and execution across functions and regions. The role will work closely with Launch Excellence and Commercial Project Management leaders, and cross-functional teams to make launch-excellence capabilities practical, consistently used, and continuously improved.

Operating in a build-while-scaling environment, you will balance direct launch delivery with the development of scalable ways of planning, tracking, and managing launches across the portfolio.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead end-to-end project management for assigned global product launches, from approximately T-24 months through six months post-launch.

  • Support the Global Launch Strategy Team for assigned assets, establishing clear governance, operating rhythms, decision-making forums, and accountability across launch workstreams.

  • Build, maintain, and drive execution against integrated launch plans that bring together Commercial, Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, Supply, Legal, Finance, Development, and regional stakeholders.

  • Manage launch milestones, critical paths, workstream deliverables, interdependencies, risks, issues, and key decisions; develop practical mitigation plans and escalate issues as appropriate.

  • Create and maintain launch-readiness assessments, dashboards, timelines, and executive-level reporting that provide transparent, actionable views of assigned launch status and health.

  • Partner with the Launch Excellence team to design and implement the global launch-excellence framework, including launch lifecycle standards, readiness criteria, governance, templates, tools, and operating rhythms.

  • Lead defined launch-excellence workstreams and capability-building initiatives, from problem definition through implementation, adoption, and continuous improvement.

  • Support the development and maintenance of standardized launch-readiness processes, integrated milestone frameworks, dashboards, and reporting that enable consistent visibility across priority launches.

  • Coordinate portfolio-level launch status, health, risks, dependencies, and key decisions in partnership with the Launch Excellence and Commercial Project Management leaders.

  • Prepare and facilitate launch-readiness reviews, governance forums, and working sessions for assigned launches and portfolio-level priorities; document decisions, actions, risks, and follow-up needed to keep work moving.

  • Work with cross-functional teams across Commercial, Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, Supply, Legal, Finance, Development, and regions to embed launch-excellence standards into day-to-day planning and execution.

  • Partner with enterprise Project Managers to apply launch-management tools, readiness assessments, and best practices across assets and to share practical problem-solving approaches.

  • Identify recurring gaps, process friction, and risks across launches; develop practical recommendations and improvement plans with the relevant stakeholders.

  • Capture launch learnings and post-launch insights and translate them into updates to launch methodology, tools, and training materials.

  • Contribute to onboarding, training, and change-management activities that strengthen launch-management capability across global and regional teams.

  • Develop clear executive-ready materials that communicate launch portfolio status, emerging risks, readiness themes, and recommendations.

Who You Are:

  • You are a strong commercial launch, project, and program leader who can move comfortably between direct execution for an individual asset and portfolio-level capability building. You bring structure to ambiguity, create momentum across cross-functional teams, and turn launch lessons into practical, repeatable processes.

  • You build trusted partnerships, influence without authority, and communicate clearly with senior leaders and working teams. You are energized by the opportunity to manage high-stakes launches while helping build a new capability that supports the broader portfolio.

Required Skills, Experience and Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree with 8+ years of relevant experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or a related industry.

  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional commercialization, launch-readiness, operational-excellence, or business-critical initiatives.

  • Demonstrated experience managing or supporting product-launch planning, readiness, and execution within a global pharmaceutical or biotechnology organization.

  • Strong project-management skills, including integrated planning, milestone and dependency management, risk and issue management, governance, and executive communication.

  • Ability to develop practical processes, tools, and reporting that enable teams to plan, track, and execute work consistently.

  • Experience working across global and regional operating models and with geographically dispersed stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and drive alignment across diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear status updates, recommendations, and action plans.

  • Track record of thriving in a fast-paced, evolving environment with a proactive, collaborative, and solutions-oriented mindset.

  • Excellent facilitation, interpersonal, organizational, and attention-to-detail skills.

Preferred Skills:

  • Advanced degree such as an MBA, MS, PhD, or equivalent.

  • Oncology or specialty-pharma commercialization experience.

  • Experience contributing to the development of launch-excellence, commercial-operations, or project-management capabilities.

  • Experience supporting launches across multiple markets, regions, or indications.

  • Formal project-management training or certification, such as PMP.

About Us

We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.

Our working culture is fast-moving, hands-on and shaped by short decision cycles, evolving priorities and limited resources. We need someone who enjoys this environment, takes initiative and remains composed and effective when deadlines are tight or plans change.

You will help shape the product, build the brand and bring the app to market. Initially, you will personally deliver much of the work across marketing, content, partnerships and automation. As the business develops, the role may expand to include building and leading a team.

Job Description

You will play a central role in deciding how the app is positioned, how the brand looks and communicates, which audiences we serve and how the product develops to meet their needs.

Working closely with the founding and development teams, you will turn market research, user insights and performance data into recommendations for product priorities, features, onboarding and the overall user experience. Your involvement starts before launch and continues through ongoing product development and growth.

You will also own the marketing strategy and its practical execution. This includes creating the content and systems needed across websites, social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, advertising, influencer campaigns and partnerships.

Exceptional practical expertise in AI is essential. You must be able to use AI to produce high-quality work independently and build reliable content pipelines and automations. n8n and similar tools should be part of your everyday workflow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape the product: Research user needs, competitors and market opportunities. Help define the product's value proposition, contribute to roadmap priorities and turn insights into clear feature proposals and briefs.
  • Improve the user experience: Work with the product and development teams on onboarding, activation, engagement, retention and monetization. Help define experiments and assess whether changes improve the experience.
  • Build the brand: Develop brand positioning, messaging, tone of voice, visual direction and storytelling. Translate these into a consistent identity across the app and all marketing channels.
  • Own go-to-market: Develop and execute the pre-launch, launch and growth strategy, including target audiences, market selection, channel priorities and campaign planning.
  • Create marketing content: Personally plan, produce, edit and publish the content the business needs, including websites, landing pages, social posts, advertising assets, graphics, email campaigns, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts and other short-form video.
  • Build content pipelines: Use AI and automation to support research, scripting, visual production, video editing, repurposing, publishing and performance analysis while maintaining creative quality.
  • Develop influencer marketing: Identify suitable creators, establish relationships, negotiate collaborations, develop campaign briefs and measure results.
  • Establish partnerships: Find and develop relevant brand, community, event and distribution partnerships that support awareness, trust and user acquisition.
  • Drive measurable growth: Run acquisition and lifecycle experiments across paid, organic, referral and community channels. Connect marketing activity to activation, retention and commercial outcomes.
  • Automate operations: Build and maintain n8n workflows and integrations that reduce repetitive work across marketing, content production, partnerships and reporting.
  • Support future team growth: As needs and resources develop, help identify hiring priorities, document effective workflows and onboard colleagues or external specialists.

Required Qualifications

  • Substantial hands-on experience launching and growing consumer mobile apps, with a demonstrable personal contribution to apps reaching six-, seven- or eight-figure download totals.
  • Evidence of your own impact: the decisions you owned, the work you delivered and the measurable results achieved.
  • Experience contributing directly to product development through user research, feature definition, prioritization, experimentation and collaboration with designers and developers.

Wisdo is an evidence-based peer support and social health platform designed to reduce the devastating consequences of loneliness and social isolation on mental health outcomes, engagement rates, and overall costs. Learn more at www.wisdo.com.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.
