Freight Dispatcher — Transportation Experience Required

Full-Time | Remote — United States | U.S. Freight Operations

Bring Your Transportation Background Into Dispatch

We are hiring a Freight Dispatcher with prior hands-on transportation-industry experience to support U.S. freight operations.

Previous employment specifically as a freight dispatcher is not required, but applicants must already have practical experience in trucking, logistics, fleet operations, truck-driver recruiting, freight brokerage support, freight coordination, or a closely related transportation function.

This is not a no-experience position.

Applicants must understand U.S. trucking operations and have working knowledge of freight load boards.

Freight Evaluation and Load Boards

  • Use DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable freight load boards to search, filter, and compare available loads.
  • Evaluate freight based on lane, equipment type, pickup and delivery requirements, loaded miles, deadhead miles, appointments, and available driver hours.
  • Calculate loaded miles, deadhead miles, total trip miles, and rate per mile.
  • Evaluate whether available freight is operationally suitable for the assigned truck.
  • Identify excessive deadhead, unrealistic appointment schedules, equipment conflicts, or other operational concerns.
  • Compare freight options according to authorized operating requirements.
  • Present suitable freight options for authorized review and booking.

Trip Planning and Dispatch Operations

  • Plan realistic trips around pickup and delivery appointments, driver Hours of Service, routing, weather, and applicable restrictions.
  • Review rate confirmations and dispatch instructions for accuracy.
  • Coordinate pickup and delivery information with drivers.
  • Assist with appointment scheduling and shipment coordination.
  • Track pickup, transit, delivery, delays, and other load milestones.
  • Communicate operational changes and exceptions promptly.
  • Negotiate freight rates only when specifically authorized.
  • Coordinate the next appropriate operational action throughout the load lifecycle.

Driver, Broker, and Customer Communication

  • Communicate professionally with U.S. CDL-A drivers, freight brokers, shippers, receivers, and transportation personnel.
  • Confirm freight, pickup, delivery, appointment, and contact information.
  • Provide drivers with accurate load and shipment instructions.
  • Maintain professional telephone, email, and digital communication.
  • Escalate safety, compliance, broker-verification, documentation, or service concerns when appropriate.

Transportation Documentation

  • Maintain accurate dispatch and load records.
  • Organize rate confirmations, bills of lading, proof-of-delivery documents, and related freight paperwork.
  • Update operational spreadsheets, dispatch systems, and applicable records.
  • Document delays, detention, layover, TONU, and other applicable shipment exceptions.
  • Identify missing, incomplete, or inconsistent information.
  • Maintain accurate records throughout each assigned shipment.

Required Transportation Background

Applicants must have previous professional experience in at least one relevant transportation area, such as:

  • CDL-A truck driving
  • Truck-driver recruiting with practical trucking knowledge
  • Fleet operations or fleet support
  • Transportation or logistics coordination
  • Freight brokerage support
  • Carrier operations
  • Load planning
  • Freight coordination
  • Comparable U.S. trucking or transportation operations

Working knowledge of freight load boards and the ability to search and evaluate available freight are required.

Required Skills

  • Working knowledge of U.S. trucking and freight operations.
  • Familiarity with DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable freight load boards.
  • Understanding of common equipment types, including Dry Van, Reefer, Flatbed, and Step Deck.
  • Ability to calculate loaded mileage, deadhead mileage, total trip mileage, and rate per mile.
  • Understanding of U.S. freight lanes and basic trip planning.
  • Working knowledge of driver Hours-of-Service considerations.
  • Fluent professional spoken and written English.
  • Strong professional telephone and business communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate recordkeeping.
  • Computer proficiency and ability to work with spreadsheets and digital documents.
  • Reliable internet access and dependable communication capability.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Helpful Additional Experience

  • Transportation-management or dispatch-system experience.
  • Experience coordinating owner-operators.
  • Appointment scheduling and active-load tracking.
  • Familiarity with ELD systems.
  • Broker verification and freight-document review.
  • Experience handling detention, layover, TONU, and other transportation exceptions.

Work Arrangement and Schedule

This is a full-time remote position supporting U.S. freight operations.

The position requires availability during assigned U.S. transportation operating hours. Specific working days and schedules will be provided as part of the hiring process.

Applicants must maintain a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection, dependable communication capability, and a professional remote-work environment.

YouTube Community Specialist - Online Education

Study.com is the leading educational website with lessons, courses and practice for students, teachers, and adult learners.

Project Description

We are seeking a proactive Community Engagement Specialist (YouTube) to support Study.com's YouTube community engagement strategy. In this role, you will help build meaningful conversations, respond to viewer questions, and share helpful educational information across our handled YouTube channels. Your contributions should be informative, conversational, and genuinely useful to viewers, helping audiences discover relevant Study.com resources when appropriate.

This is a fully remote, online contractor position. All work is paid hourly, with a cap of 10 hours per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Participate in relevant YouTube discussions by sharing helpful insights, asking thoughtful questions, and contributing meaningful responses that encourage constructive conversations.
  • Respond to viewer questions, feedback, and existing comment threads with relevant and informative answers.
  • Follow weekly video priorities and communication guidelines established by the Channel Manager.
  • Identify recurring viewer questions, emerging discussion topics, audience concerns, and opportunities for additional engagement or future content.
  • Brand Safety and Escalation: Flag promotional/competitor mentions, misinformation, sensitive discussions, and potentially inappropriate comments to the Channel Manager for review.
  • Follow YouTube's Community Guidelines and company policies.

Requirements:

  • Strong written English communication skills, with the ability to write naturally, clearly, and conversationally.
  • Familiarity with YouTube's community features, comment sections, and general platform practices.
  • Experience in social media engagement and online community management.
  • Ability to communicate educational topics in an approachable and easy-to-understand manner.
  • Familiarity with, or willingness to learn, U.S. degree-transfer topics, including CLEP, DSST, credit-by-exam, competency-based education programs, and TOEFL test preparation.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to follow engagement schedules, content guidelines, and brand messaging standards.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment with asynchronous communication and activity reporting.
  • Good judgment when handling sensitive conversations, negative feedback, and questions requiring escalation.
  • Ability to represent a brand accurately and professionally without misrepresenting company policies, accreditation, or educational outcomes.

Additional Preferred Skills:

Not required, but prior social/community account management is a plus.

What We Offer:

  • Reliable Payments: You'll receive payments twice a month and automated invoicing for your work.
  • Remote Work: This is a fully online contracted work-from-home opportunity.
  • Flexibility: Work when you want, where you want, and select projects that most interest you.
  • Support: Our supportive staff is available answer your questions and help you get up and running.

The Contract Process

  1. Complete the application and submit with your resume.
  2. Applications are approved and contracts sent on Wednesdays.

You can view a step-by-step overview of the contract process here: How to Become a Freelancer with Study.com

About Study.com

The mission of Study.com is to make education accessible, and over the last two decades we’ve become the leading online education platform, delivering a personalized learning experience across a broad continuum of education for over 30 million students, instructors, and professionals every month.

We help empower millions of learners to achieve their education and career goals. We focus on increasing access to education because we know information is the ultimate equalizer and that education is key to upward mobility.

This is a high-impact role with significant visibility across the business and a direct line to career growth as the company expands.

The Role: (all the responsibilities we’ll trust you with, no pressure 😉):

  • Business Development: Source, recruit, and onboard new affiliate partners that align with our quality standards and growth objectives.
  • Portfolio Ownership: Own a portfolio of key partners generating $1M+ in monthly revenue, maintaining strong, loyal relationships, including outside standard business hours when needed.
  • Negotiation: Negotiate partnership terms that drive volume and profitability for both sides.
  • Traffic Strategy: Advise partners on traffic strategy across all channels, with an emphasis on Meta and geo-targeted campaigns.
  • Performance Analysis: Monitor lead volume, conversion rate, and lead quality to identify trends and act on them quickly.
  • Quality & Compliance: Ensure partners deliver compliant, high-quality traffic that supports long-term partnerships.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with internal teams to troubleshoot performance and identify new growth opportunities.
  • Industry Presence: Represent SuCo at industry conferences and events to strengthen relationships and source new partners.

Areas That Will Play to Your Strengths:

  • Solution-Based Mindset: You identify challenges early and always bring potential solutions with them.
  • Sales-Driven: You are outgoing, engaging, and build rapport easily. You represent our value with confidence and consistently look for opportunities to expand partnerships.
  • Strategic: You see opportunities to improve processes, partnerships, and campaigns, and you enjoy collaborating on better ways to get things done.
  • Highly Organized: You excel at time management and prioritize the work that drives the greatest impact.
  • A Skilled Communicator and Influencer: You communicate and negotiate effectively with affiliate partners, and you are just as effective internally, building alignment with team leads and securing the support your partners need to grow.

Experience That Will Put You Ahead:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in affiliate management, publisher development, or performance marketing.

About Silent Eight

We’ve been a trusted partner to the world’s largest financial institutions for over a decade, with AI running in production at global banks including HSBC and Standard Chartered. We automate the compliance decisions that stop money laundering and terrorism financing, at scale, in production, on real cases.

We’re headquartered in Singapore, and we’re hiring an AI Solutions Consultant based in Poland (anywhere in the country): someone our customers want to talk to about their problems, and who can then design and build the AI solution that actually solves them. We’re keeping a high bar for this hire and are looking for exceptional people who meet the full profile below.

The Role

This is a senior, hands-on role that combines two things in equal measure.

On the business side, you’re the consultant customers open up to. They tell you about their problems because they expect to leave the conversation with a good idea for solving them. You listen, ask the right questions, find the real problem behind the one they came in with, and come back with a creative, practical proposal.

On the technology side, you build. You’ve designed and shipped complex AI systems yourself, such as agentic systems, multi-step workflows or LLM-based applications, and you can turn an idea from a customer conversation into something that works.

We need both halves. Strong engineers without client experience, or strong consultants who don’t build, won’t be the right fit for this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead conversations with customers to understand their business problems, and dig deeper when the real problem turns out to be different from the one they started with

  • Translate those problems into concrete, creative AI solution ideas and present them clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Design and build AI-based solutions, from agentic systems and multi-step workflows to LLM-based applications

  • Prototype quickly to show customers what’s possible, then iterate based on what you learn

  • Work closely with our leadership, product and engineering teams to turn customer insight into working solutions

  • Keep us ahead of the curve: test new AI tools, models and techniques, and share what works

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience working directly with clients, for example in consulting, pre-sales, solutions engineering or client advisory

  • Substantial hands-on experience designing and building complex AI systems yourself, such as agentic systems, multi-step workflows or LLM-based applications. A simple app for a simple task isn’t enough

  • The ability to explain specifically what you built and decided yourself, not only what your team delivered, including what didn’t work the first time and what you learned

  • Strong discovery skills: you listen, ask good follow-up questions and get to the root of a problem

  • The ability to make sophisticated AI tangible for non-technical buyers

  • You live and breathe AI. Beyond your day job, you build your own apps and projects, test new tools and models, and keep up with the industry simply because it excites you

  • Fluent English

  • Based in Poland

  • Experience with financial institutions, AML/FinCrime or other regulated environments is a plus

What We Offer

  • A B2B contract with a competitive salary: PLN 25,000-35,000 net / month + VAT – to confirm

  • Paid time off to balance work and life in the way that suits you best

  • Fully remote work, forever

  • A quarterly wellness allowance added directly to your invoice

  • Real opportunities for development, including paid Development Days and in-house training

  • A product that already works, with AI in production at Tier 1 banks, so you’re solving real problems for real customers

  • Direct access to our leadership team and short decision paths

  • The chance to be an integral part of an award-winning, fast-growing RegTech company that values a friendly working atmosphere

How to Apply

Along with your CV, please include:

  • A short description (a few sentences) of the most complex AI system you’ve built: what problem it solved, what it was made of, and what your own part in it was

  • A link to your GitHub, portfolio or a working project, if you have one

Process

  1. Intro with People Ops — 20–30 min

  2. In-depth conversation with our COO, Julia

  3. Final conversation with our CEO

About the Role

Every hire we make shapes the company, and our hiring managers can't spend their weeks sourcing and scheduling. We're looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist who keeps our searches moving: finding strong candidates, running sharp first screens and coordinating a smooth process from first message to signed offer.

You'll report to Roald Harvey, Senior Director of People, and partner closely with hiring managers across the company. You'll take the sourcing, screening and logistics off their plates so they can spend their time on the conversations that matter. Rippling is our ATS, and we expect you to run it well while actively researching new sourcing tools and AI-driven ways to work faster and find people others miss.

What You'll Do

Source and build pipelines

  • Run proactive outbound sourcing for roles across the company using LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox, Boolean search, referrals and community channels.
  • Build and maintain diverse pipelines for open and upcoming roles so hiring managers see qualified candidates quickly.
  • Write clear, personal outreach that explains the role and why Athennian is worth a conversation.

Screen candidates

  • Run first-round People Team screens against a structured rubric, covering fit, drive, remote readiness, pay expectations and work eligibility.
  • Write concise screen notes in Rippling within 24 hours with a clear advance, pass or second-screen call, so hiring managers build on your work instead of repeating it.
  • Give hiring managers a short, well-reasoned shortlist rather than a pile of resumes.

Coordinate the process

  • Schedule interviews across time zones, prepare interviewers with the scorecard and keep every stage moving.
  • Keep candidates informed at every step and close the loop with everyone, including those we don't hire.
  • Support offer logistics, reference checks and handoff to onboarding.

Run Rippling and improve how we hire

  • Own data quality in Rippling, our ATS: job setup, pipeline stages, scorecards, notes and dispositions.
  • Track time-to-fill, pipeline conversion and source effectiveness, and flag bottlenecks to Roald and hiring managers.
  • Research and test new sourcing tools, AI workflows and channels, then share what works with the team.

Support employer brand

  • Draft job descriptions, interview guides and candidate communications that reflect Athennian's values and high bar.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2–3 years in recruiting or talent acquisition, ideally in a B2B SaaS, tech startup or agency environment, with hands-on sourcing and screening.
  • Sourcing: Proven outbound sourcing using LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search and AI sourcing tools, and you can show roles you filled through your own outreach.
  • Screening judgment: You can run a structured screen and tell a hiring manager clearly why a candidate should or shouldn't move forward.
  • Coordination: You keep many searches, calendars and candidates moving at once without dropping follow-ups.
  • Tools: Comfortable in an ATS (Rippling preferred; Lever, Greenhouse, Ashby or similar also count) and curious about new tools. You research, test and adopt better ways to work without being asked.
  • Communication: Clear, warm writing and a candidate experience people talk about for the right reasons.

Location

This role is open to candidates based in Canada only. Athennian is remote-first, and some roles may be near our Toronto, Calgary or Vancouver offices. You must be legally able to work full-time in Canada and able to cover North American business hours.

Our Culture

We thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where every team member plays a critical role in our success. We value ambitious, results-driven people who spot opportunities, take initiative and go the extra mile. Collaboration fuels our growth as we take on new challenges, learn constantly and move quickly. If you're a go-getter who thrives on impact, you'll fit right in. Our values are:

  • Outcome Driven: We focus on setting ambitious goals and achieving measurable results, valuing success by the outcomes we deliver.
  • Wide Responsibility: Our team is empowered to shape success, taking ownership from problem identification to solution implementation.
  • Learning Mindset: We embrace curiosity, rejecting the status quo and encouraging continuous learning and agility.
  • Strategic Speed: We make fast, effective decisions and embrace a bias for action to seize opportunities quickly.

Benefits at Athennian

We keep things simple and invest in the perks that matter — your wellbeing, growth and flexibility.

  • Compensation: Competitive salary, equity and performance-based bonus structure.
  • Work-Life Balance: A minimum of 3 weeks vacation, 5 sick days and 6 personal/flex days, plus a company-wide winter holiday shutdown.
  • Comprehensive Coverage: Health, dental, vision, long-term disability and a Health Spending Account (HSA).
  • Family Support: Flexible parental leave, including top-ups.

jobs.excerpt: Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI.
jobs.description:
Aerospike is the real-time database for mission-critical use cases and workloads, including machine learning, generative, and agentic AI. Aerospike powers millions of transactions per second with millisecond latency, at a fraction of the total cost of ownership compared to other databases.

Global leaders, including Adobe, Airtel, Barclays, Criteo, DBS Bank, Experian, Grab, HDFC Bank, PayPal, Sony Interactive Entertainment, The Trade Desk, and Wayfair, rely on Aerospike for customer 360, fraud detection, real-time bidding, profile stores, recommendation engines, and other use cases.

At Aerospike, we dream big and deliver even bigger. Our mission is to unleash the power of the world’s real-time data with a database built for infinite scale, speed, and sustainability.

If you're ready to shape the future of data, join us.

The Opportunity

As AI transitions from analysis into action, enterprises need an operational foundation that connects autonomous workflows to live data—backed by authoritative state, low-latency context, and strict runtime controls.

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Aerospike, you will embed directly with customer engineering teams to build and ship these real-time systems. You will bridge software engineering and customer operations: writing production-ready code, integrating Aerospike with enterprise data systems and AI frameworks, and validating performance under real production workloads.

In this role, you will take technical requirements from problem discovery through implementation and rollout. Beyond customer delivery, you will contribute directly to Aerospike’s core capabilities by turning engagement-specific solutions into reusable libraries, reference architectures, and tooling.

What You’ll Build

  • Authoritative State Foundations: Build and deploy real-time distributed data models for agent, session, and workflow state. Support high-concurrency reads and writes while meeting explicit requirements for freshness, consistency, and failover recovery.
  • Context Assembly Layers: Implement pipelines that join transactional data, streaming sources, vector search indexes, and graph relationships so agent workflows make decisions based on real-time, permission-aware context.
  • Execution Guardrails: Integrate policy checks, authentication/authorization boundaries, execution governors, and human-in-the-loop review steps into real-time application paths.
  • Auditing and Traceability: Build logging and tracing hooks that record context snapshots, decisions, tool execution, and state mutations to meet enterprise compliance and security standards.
  • Closed-Loop Execution Flows: Connect and automate the operational loop: State → Context → Action → Mutation → Updated State, ensuring downstream results reliably inform the next cycle.

What You’ll Do

  • Embed with Customer Teams: Work side-by-side with client engineers to translate operational challenges and specs into clean technical designs, integration plans, and verifiable delivery milestones.
  • Write and Integrate Production Code: Implement scalable services and integrations across Aerospike, enterprise data systems, vector engines, and agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Validate Production Readiness: Own technical validation through launch: debug distributed systems issues, profile bottlenecks, and ensure systems operate reliably under high traffic.
  • Benchmark and Test: Test real-world operational characteristics—including p99 latency, throughput, cache invalidation, context freshness, failure recovery, and policy enforcement—beyond basic model benchmarks.
  • Build Reusable Field Assets: Identify recurring customer requirements and feed them back into internal engineering to create reusable starter kits, SDK wrappers, test fixtures, and documentation.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner with Product, Core Engineering, and Solutions teams to resolve platform bugs, close functional gaps, and assist client teams with deployment best practices.

How You’ll Work with Customer & Internal Teams

Senior FDEs are the primary builders and integration engineers responsible for delivering working Operational AI implementations into production.

  • Professional Services manages baseline infrastructure provisioning, platform migrations, cluster sizing, and general configuration.
  • Technical Account Management (TAM) maintains the day-to-day account relationship and long-term operational health.
  • Your Focus: You lead the technical integration, custom data modeling, and application code. You are not responsible for routine account administration, ticket escalation, or generic maintenance support.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5–8+ years of hands-on software development experience building and deploying backend services, distributed systems, or high-throughput data platforms in production.
  • Strong Coding Proficiency: Fluency in at least one modern systems or backend language—Go, Java, Python, or C/C++—with solid fundamentals in concurrency, API design, and asynchronous patterns.
  • Data Modeling & Storage Foundations: Practical experience working with low-latency key-value stores, distributed databases, or streaming data platforms (e.g., Kafka, Redis, Cassandra, Aerospike).
  • Applied AI & Context Pipelines: Hands-on experience building services that interface with LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, vector databases, or agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Temporal).
  • Enterprise Integration & Security: Experience implementing authentication/authorization (OAuth, RBAC/ABAC), data validation, and auditable logging in sensitive environments.
  • Collaborative Problem-Solving: Ability to navigate ambiguous requirements, communicate technical trade-offs to customer engineers, and work independently with minimal oversight.

Helpful Experience

  • Hands-on experience with the Aerospike Real-time Data Platform, Aerospike Vector Search (AVS), or Aerospike Graph.
  • Experience with distributed task queues, checkpointing, or durable workflow engines (e.g., Temporal, Airflow).
  • Background with containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Familiarity with distributed tracing tools (OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Jaeger).

Compensation and Impact

  • Evaluation Metric: Success is evaluated on working production outcomes, robust software delivery, and the creation of reusable assets—not billable hours or professional services utilization.
  • Comprehensive US Benefits: Competitive base salary, equity options, 401(k) matching, comprehensive health/dental/vision coverage, and remote home office support.

AtriCure, Inc. provides innovative technologies for the treatment of Afib and related conditions. Afib affects more than 33 million people worldwide. Electrophysiologists and cardiothoracic surgeons around the globe use AtriCure technologies for the treatment of Afib and reduction of Afib related complications. AtriCure’s Isolator® Synergy™ Ablation System is the first medical device to receive FDA approval for the treatment of persistent Afib. AtriCure’s AtriClip® Left Atrial Appendage Exclusion System products are the most widely sold LAA management devices worldwide. AtriCure’s Hybrid AF™ Therapy is a minimally invasive procedure that provides a lasting solution for long-standing persistent Afib patients. AtriCure’s cryoICE cryoSPHERE® probe is cleared for temporary ablation of peripheral nerves to block pain, providing pain relief in cardiac and thoracic procedures. For more information, visit AtriCure.com or follow us on Twitter @AtriCure.

We foster a culture of inclusion by embracing diverse experiences and individuals where everyone’s authentic self is welcome. We offer supporting programs and resources that provide enriching and equitable opportunities for each person to contribute professionally and personally.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Clinical Research Associate II (CRA II) will be a key contributor to AtriCure’s clinical affairs department and primarily responsible for the site management of assigned clinical investigative sites. The CRA II will assist with the implementation and execution of study protocols and associated study documents for clinical trials, including clinical monitoring of AtriCure studies. This also includes the coordination of site activities from site start-up to site closure as needed. The CRA II will work closely with the Clinical Project Managers and Sr. CRAs to ensure the study is executed to meet project deliverables.

The CRA II will be responsible for the study start up process for AtriCure’s Clinical Investigational protocols, which includes and is not limited to the following: protocol review, Informed Consent Development, CRF design, EDC testing, preparation of site-specific logs/documentation and investigator study files. The CRA II will participate as needed, in study review meetings and attend scientific meetings and industry conferences as required. The CRA II will also conduct site visits including Site Qualification Visits, Site Initiation Visits, Interim Monitoring Visits, and Close Out Visits.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE POSITION:

  • Assist Clinical Project Managers and Sr. CRAs in the study development and start-up process development of the informed consent form and internal review prior to submission to the IRB/EC. Collection of startup documentation from clinical investigational site
  • Verify that the investigator and research staff follow the approved protocol and all GCP procedures
  • Conduct weekly maintenance and management of study sites to ensure site compliance with study protocol, GCP/ICH, and applicable regulations
  • Conduct initial and ongoing study training of site personnel throughout the clinical study
  • Monitor and report to ATRC site enrollment activities
  • Verify that all research staff and facilities have adequate resources and qualifications and are maintained throughout the course of the study
  • Assist with the preparation of clinical study devices and verify the accountability of investigational devices are properly received, tracked, and secured at the study site
  • Ensure adverse events, concomitant medications, and inter-current illnesses are reported in accordance with the protocol on the CRF.
  • Communicate deviations from the protocol, SOPs, GCP, and applicable regulatory requirements to the investigator and ensure corrective action is implemented.
  • Review queries and assist in the resolution of DCFs.
  • Participate in project team meetings.
  • Participate in departmental development initiatives (e.g. training, SOP development/updates, etc.)
  • Ability to work on multiple projects as departmental priorities change

ADDITIONAL ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS OF THE POSITION:

  • Regular and predictable work performance
  • Ability to work under fast-paced conditions
  • Ability to make decisions and use good judgement
  • Ability to prioritize various duties and multitask as required
  • Ability to successfully work with others
  • Additional duties as assigned

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a science or related technical field required or demonstrated equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Minimum two years of CRA experience
  • Comprehensive knowledge of ISO, GCP, ICH, FDA and other applicable regulations governing the conduct of clinical trials
  • Ability to manage role/responsibility independently.
  • Recognize problems, trends and react to resolve issue quickly and to bring effect resolution.
  • Experience working with electronic data capture systems
  • Strong attention to detail and an ability to prioritize and juggle multiple/competing issues.
  • Ability to create and manage key internal and external partnerships.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experienced user Microsoft Office software including WORD, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Ability to travel up to 50%

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with medical device clinical trials desired but not required.
  • Prior experience with cardiovascular clinical trials.
  • Understanding of basic anatomy and physiology, electrophysiology and arrhythmias
  • Registered Nurse with previous clinical research experience as either a CRA or Study Coordinator.
  • CCRA or CCRP Certification

OTHER REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to regularly walk, sit, or stand as needed
  • Ability to occasionally bend and push/pull as needed
  • Ability to pass pre-employment drug screen and background check

Job Summary:
We’re hiring a Senior Specialist in US Sales Tax and Corporate Compliance. In this role, you will own the company’s licensing, tax registration and corporate records across multiple US states and international jurisdictions. You will make sure every permit, filing and renewal stays active and in good standing.

The role needs someone who is organized and self-directed, and who can track hundreds of deadlines without missing one. You’ll work directly with Finance, outside counsel, state agencies and registered agents, and you’ll report monthly to leadership. It suits a part-qualified or qualified ACCA, CA, ICMA or ICSP professional who has worked in tax, compliance or company secretarial roles and is ready to take ownership of a full compliance function.

Key Responsibilities

Business Licenses & Registrations

  • Prepare, file and track new applications for state and local business licenses, foreign qualifications and DBAs.
  • Obtain and renew industry permits, including tobacco, cigarette, cigar and nicotine retailer, distributor, wholesaler and delivery-sale permits, along with any required bonds.
  • Keep entity records current with each Secretary of State, including annual reports and registered agent details.
  • Process changes of address, ownership, officers or business name with every affected agency.

Tax Registrations & Renewals

  • Register the company for sales and use tax, excise tax and other state tax accounts wherever there is nexus or taxable product sales.
  • Track renewal dates, file renewals on time and keep all permits active and in good standing.
  • Coordinate with Finance on filing frequency, account numbers and good-standing certificates.
  • Collect, issue and maintain resale and exemption certificates for customers and vendors.

Research & Compliance

  • Research licensing, tax and product regulations before the company enters a new state or launches a new product.
  • Monitor changes in law and agency rules, such as nicotine-pouch tax rulings, flavor bans, age-verification rules and PACT Act updates, and summarize what they mean for the business.
  • Maintain a state-by-state compliance matrix showing what’s required, what’s held and what’s outstanding.
  • Support audits, agency inquiries and investigations by gathering records under the direction of Finance and outside counsel.

Corporate Secretarial

  • Maintain corporate records, including formation documents, operating agreements, ownership records, and officer and member resolutions.
  • Prepare and track annual reports, beneficial ownership filings and good-standing certificates for each entity.
  • Draft routine resolutions, consents and minutes, and keep the corporate document repository organized.
  • Respond to KYC and due-diligence requests from banks, vendors and customers with accurate company documents.

Records & Process

  • Own a central license and tax register with permit numbers, effective and expiry dates, fees, contacts and copies.
  • Run a renewal calendar that sends reminders at least 90 days before each deadline.
  • Make sure physical permits are displayed where required and that old or voided permits are archived.
  • Manage relationships with state agencies, outside licensing vendors and registered agents.
  • Report monthly to leadership on status, risks and upcoming deadlines.

Finance & Accounting Support

  • Prepare and file sales and use tax and tobacco excise tax returns, and reconcile tax liabilities to the general ledger.

  • Assist with accounts payable and receivable, including vendor setup, invoice processing and payment runs.

jobs.excerpt: Lyric is the trusted leader in healthcare decision intelligence.
jobs.description:
Lyric is the trusted leader in healthcare decision intelligence. Built on more than 35 years of proven results, Lyric combines responsible AI with clinical, payment, regulatory, and policy expertise to deliver transparent, auditable insights in milliseconds across real-time claims workflows. Lyric augments human decision-making so health plans can make faster, more accurate payments while maintaining full control. Today, Lyric supports 200 million lives, with nine of the top 10 U.S. health plans relying on its platform to reduce waste, improve efficiency, and support accurate payments.

Applicants must already be legally authorized to work in the U.S. Visa sponsorship/sponsorship assumption and other immigration support are not available for this position.

The Senior Client Engagement Manager (Post-Pay) is the primary client-facing lead responsible for translating payer needs into clear, complete, and implementable requirements across the full implementation lifecycle. This role owns requirements discovery, implementation artifacts, client communications, decision tracking, and cross-functional alignment from initial design through testing, go-live, hypercare, and ongoing support.

The role requires expert-level knowledge of the post-payment payment integrity continuum, including Coordination of Benefits (COB), data mining, DRG and coding or clinical chart review, and Lyric's Replay product suite. The position connects client business objectives with Lyric's product, business analysis, data, engineering, configuration, quality assurance, and operations teams. This person must understand healthcare data domains, source data assets, data mapping, claim and member workflows, and product functionality well enough to ask the right questions, identify gaps, explain how the solution works, and ensure that requirements preserve the client's intent. Thjs person works closely with cross-functional teams—including Implementation, Go-to Market, Product, Engineering, Analytics and others —to configure, deploy, and drive adoption of products in alignment with client roadmaps.

The successful candidate is a trusted advisor and practical sounding board for the client. They bring structure to ambiguity, maintain disciplined governance through requirements, decisions, risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies, and remain engaged after go-live to support adoption, stabilization, and continuous improvement.

ESSENTIAL JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


Client Partnership and Implementation Leadership

  • Serve as the primary payment integrity implementation lead and day-to-day point of contact for assigned payer clients.
  • Lead discovery sessions, working meetings, demonstrations, status reviews, decision forums, and executive-ready updates.
  • Build trusted relationships with client leaders, SMEs, project managers, data and technology teams, and operational users.
  • Set clear expectations, confirm ownership and due dates, follow through on commitments, and communicate changes, barriers, and decisions promptly.
  • Advise clients on implementation choices, workflow design, and practical tradeoffs while keeping the solution aligned with contracted scope and business outcomes.

Requirements Ownership and Artifact Governance

  • Own the end-to-end requirements lifecycle, documentation, traceability, validation, change control, and formal approval.
  • Support client and Lyric teams to capture business, operational, product, reporting, data, integration, security, testing, and readiness requirements in clear language that both client and technical teams can use.
  • Partner with the Business Analyst to translate client needs into detailed requirements, process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, data specifications, and configuration decisions.
  • Complete an internal quality and feasibility review with the Business Analyst and accountable technical or product owners before requesting client approval.
  • Maintain the authoritative set of implementation artifacts, including requirements, workflow documentation, data dictionaries and mappings, decision logs, RAID logs, action trackers, meeting notes, test evidence, approvals, training materials, and transition documentation.
  • Control requirement changes by documenting the business need, impact, decision, owner, approval, and downstream effect on scope, timeline, configuration, testing, and operations.

Payment Integrity and Product Expertise

  • Serve as an expert resource across the post-payment continuum, including COB, data mining, DRG review, coding or clinical chart review, provider outreach, overpayment validation, recovery, appeals, reconciliation, and reporting.
  • Demonstrate strong working knowledge of Lyric Replay products and explain product capabilities, workflows, configuration options, dependencies, limitations, and expected user experience.
  • Answer client and internal questions about how the platform and implementation workflows function, and coordinate timely validation when a question requires product or technical confirmation.
  • Identify where client policy, reimbursement methodology, operating model, data availability, or contractual requirements may affect solution design and downstream results.
  • Ensure implementation decisions support accurate, defensible, scalable, and auditable payment integrity outcomes.

Data Discovery, Mapping, and Validation

  • Lead business-oriented discovery of claims, claim-line, member, eligibility, provider, group, benefit, contract, payment, clinical, recovery, and reference data required by the solution.
  • Understand data domains, source systems, file layouts, data lineage, key relationships, code sets, field definitions, timing, completeness, and known data limitations.
  • Partner with client data teams and Lyric technical teams to document source-to-target mappings, transformation rules, default values, exclusions, reconciliation logic, and data-quality expectations.
  • Confirm that data requirements reflect the intended payment integrity workflows and that gaps or assumptions are documented, resolved, and approved.
  • Support data profiling, mapping reviews, validation, defect triage, and readiness decisions using business and domain expertise.

Cross-Functional Delivery and Governance

  • Act as the communication bridge between the client and Lyric product, Business Analysis, engineering, data, configuration, quality assurance, security, operations, and customer success teams.
  • Maintain the RAID log and decision log; proactively identify, assess, assign, escalate, and drive risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies to resolution.
  • Coordinate implementation milestones and dependencies across discovery, design, configuration, integration, testing, training, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.
  • Facilitate timely decisions and prevent gaps in understanding by confirming requirements, owners, due dates, handoffs, and acceptance criteria.
  • Provide concise status reporting that distinguishes completed work, upcoming work, decisions needed, risks, and client or internal actions.

Testing, Readiness, Go-Live, and Post-Go-Live Support

  • Partner with quality assurance, the Business Analyst, technical teams, operations, and the client to define test scenarios and acceptance criteria that trace to approved requirements.
  • Support system testing, user acceptance testing, defect triage, validation of fixes, and documentation of client acceptance.
  • Assess business and operational readiness, including users, workflows, access, data, configuration, reporting, training, support, and escalation paths.
  • Coordinate cutover, go-live, and hypercare activities, including issue triage, clear communications, decision tracking, and stabilization reporting.
  • Direct Service Delivery teams and supporting teams to achieve high levels of customer satisfaction. Operate effectively within a matrixed project environment in Closed Loop Execution.
  • Ensure all requests, insights, and decisions are acknowledged, documented, and followed through to closure.
  • Collaborate transparently across internal teams and communicate externally only after confirming full internal alignment.
  • Lead or support escalations with structured discovery, solution proposals, and documented resolution paths
  • Remain a knowledgeable client and internal resource after go-live, support the ongoing account and operations teams, and help identify adoption, optimization, and expansion opportunities.

Key Performance Outcomes

  • Client requirements are complete, internally validated, traceable, approved, and implemented as intended.
  • Implementation artifacts remain current, accurate, organized, audit-ready, and accessible to authorized stakeholders.
  • Risks, decisions, issues, assumptions, dependencies, and changes are identified early and driven to timely resolution.
  • Client and internal teams have a shared understanding of scope, solution behavior, data requirements, responsibilities, and readiness.
  • Testing, go-live, and transition activities are completed with clear evidence, controlled handoffs, and minimal avoidable rework.
  • Clients view the role as a credible payment integrity and product advisor throughout implementation and stabilization.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in healthcare administration, business, information systems, data analytics, project management, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in healthcare payment integrity, payer claims operations, healthcare technology implementation, business analysis, consulting, or a closely related field.
  • Minimum of three (3) years leading complex, client-facing healthcare implementations or workstreams from discovery and requirements through testing, go-live, and post-go-live support.
  • Expert-level knowledge of post-payment payment integrity with demonstrated experience across multiple domains such as COB, data mining, DRG review, coding or clinical chart review, overpayment recovery, appeals, and reconciliation.
  • Demonstrated ability to elicit, analyze, document, validate, and obtain approval for complex business and technical requirements.
  • Experience partnering with Business Analysts and technical teams to develop process flows, user stories, acceptance criteria, data specifications, and traceability.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare claims and supporting data domains, data mapping, source-to-target logic, data validation, and common integration methods such as secure file transfer and APIs.
  • Experience maintaining RAID logs, decision logs, action trackers, change controls, requirements repositories, test evidence, and implementation documentation.
  • Ability to explain sophisticated payment integrity workflows and product behavior clearly to business, operational, technical, and executive audiences.
  • Excellent facilitation, written communication, presentation, relationship management, negotiation, and issue-resolution skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, organize complex information, operate with limited direction, and drive accountability across teams without direct authority.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and structured project or requirements management tools.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and comply with applicable healthcare privacy, security, and data-handling requirements.
  • Ability to travel approximately 20 percent, including client-site travel as needed.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience implementing payment integrity software or services for national or regional health plans across Commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, or Marketplace lines of business.
  • Direct experience with Lyric Replay or similar post-payment audit, recovery, workflow, or analytics platforms.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, relational data models, business intelligence tools, data profiling, and reconciliation techniques.
  • Experience with claim-adjudication platforms, payer data warehouses, eligibility systems, provider data, clinical records, and recovery systems.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments and with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience developing client-ready implementation playbooks, training materials, process documentation, and operational transition plans.
  • PMP, PMI-PBA, CBAP, Lean Six Sigma, Prosci, or Agile certification.
  • Payment integrity, coding, clinical, health information management, or claims-related credential appropriate to the candidate's domain background.

About Us

We are a Latvia-based startup building a finance function that combines accurate accounting, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and practical AI automation.

We are looking for a finance professional who can personally manage our accounting, configure the systems supporting it and use AI agents to carry out the work more efficiently.

Job Description

You will personally perform and take ownership of our accounting and financial operations, using AI agents to support your work. Your responsibilities will cover daily bookkeeping, reconciliations, closing, financial reporting, cash planning and applicable Latvian tax reporting.

You will personally carry out the complete migration from QuickBooks to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, using AI agents to support your work. You will be responsible for all implementation tasks, from planning and data preparation through configuration, import, validation and go-live. No external implementation partners will be involved. As part of preparing and importing the data, you will review the complete accounting records for the past five years, identify gaps and errors, and reconcile the migrated data to the source records. You must be comfortable both doing the accounting and setting up the accounting system.

AI agents will assist with document processing, transaction preparation, matching, reconciliation and reporting. You will define their tasks, supervise their execution, investigate exceptions and verify their outputs. You remain responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, expense accounting and bank reconciliations.
  • Complete month-end and year-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and supporting documentation.
  • Set up, configure and maintain Business Central, including the chart of accounts, posting groups, dimensions, VAT setup, bank accounts, accounting periods and relevant financial workflows.
  • Personally execute the complete migration from QuickBooks to Business Central, including data extraction, account and tax mapping, cleansing, system configuration, trial imports, reconciliation and go-live. Review all accounting records for the past five years during migration preparation and import, investigate missing or incorrect entries, document corrections and preserve supporting documents and a traceable audit trail.
  • Prepare and manage applicable Latvian tax and statutory reporting, including VAT, corporate income tax, payroll-related obligations and VID/EDS processes.
  • Handle international customers, suppliers, contractors, foreign currencies and cross-border transactions.
  • Manage cash-flow forecasts, budgets, runway monitoring and management reporting.
  • Prepare payments and administer payroll and contractor payments within agreed approval controls.
  • Configure, instruct and supervise AI agents supporting accounting workflows; improve their performance through clear instructions, reliable source data and systematic verification.
  • Maintain traceability from original documents to accounting entries, resolve exceptions and protect confidential financial information.
  • Identify practical opportunities to reduce costs, improve financial controls and apply lawful tax efficiencies.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience personally performing the full accounting cycle for companies in one or more European countries.
  • Practical experience with accounting, taxation and statutory reporting in one or more European countries, and the ability to apply and verify Latvian requirements. Direct Latvian accounting and VID/EDS experience is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience independently setting up and configuring Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for real accounting operations, with the ability to personally execute a complete accounting-system migration.
  • The ability to translate business requirements into appropriate accounting configuration and verify that postings, reconciliations and reports work correctly.
  • Practical experience using AI agents or AI-supported automation in finance or accounting, including supervising outputs and handling errors.
  • Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate incomplete records and reconcile inconsistent data.
  • Independent working habits, ownership of deadlines and clear communication with the founder.
  • Professional working proficiency in English and the ability to work effectively with Latvian-language financial documents and reporting requirements.
  • A relevant accounting or finance qualification, or equivalent substantial practical experience.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building or improving the accounting function of a startup or small international business.
  • QuickBooks to Business Central migrations, Business Central implementations and comprehensive reviews and correction of historical accounting records.
  • Configuring integrations with banks, payment platforms, document systems and Microsoft 365.
  • Power Automate, Power BI, APIs or comparable tools used in practical finance workflows.
  • Accounting for digital services, subscriptions and international contractor relationships.
  • Preparing financial information for funding discussions or due diligence.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote role with direct collaboration with the founder.
  • Responsibility for both the accounting work and the systems supporting it.
  • The opportunity to shape how Business Central and AI agents work together in a startup.
  • A practical environment where reliable execution, sensible automation and cost awareness matter.

Remote Working Arrangement

You will organize your work independently, communicate progress clearly and meet agreed accounting and reporting deadlines. Financial systems and confidential information must be handled securely.

This is a full-time role with flexible working hours. You will organize your schedule around agreed accounting and reporting deadlines.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and briefly describe:

  • The European countries in which you have personally handled accounting and tax reporting, and your specific responsibilities.
  • A Business Central implementation or accounting-system migration you personally executed, including the setup, data migration and validation you performed yourself, and any experience with QuickBooks or historical accounting reviews.
  • How you have used AI agents or automation to perform accounting work and verify its accuracy.

Use anonymized examples and clearly distinguish your own work from work delivered by others.

About Rebound

Rebound’s mission is to make recovery from trauma the norm, not the exception.

We are a specialized telehealth provider that helps people heal from the lasting impact of trauma and PTSD. PTSD affects millions of people, yet many struggle to find therapists trained in evidence-based trauma treatments. Through Rebound, members can access live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Prolonged Exposure Therapy (PE), a "gold standard" in PTSD treatment. Our work is grounded in rigorous psychological science and a survivor-centered approach. We help members get out of survival mode after trauma, break intergenerational cycles, and reclaim their lives.

Rebound was founded by a team of trauma survivors and clinicians, and that perspective shapes how we build: serious about outcomes, rigorous about science, and uncompromising about integrity. We’re looking for people who are deeply motivated by the mission to offer clinically proven treatment and remove barriers to care.

About The Role

At Rebound, we believe therapists should be able to focus on what matters most: providing meaningful care to the people who need it.

Rebound is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists to join our network.

As a Rebound Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources. Providers will collaborate with our network of psychiatrists and therapists to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced trauma and PTSD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

About 8 West Consulting

8 West Consulting provides consultancy services and software solutions to clients across the US, Europe and the UK. We work in sectors including insurance, healthcare and retail, helping organisations tackle complex technology challenges and modernise critical platforms.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a senior, client-facing Data Architect / Consultant with deep production experience in either Snowflake or Databricks. You will help enterprise clients modernise data estates, define target architectures and deliver migrations and data engineering solutions that create measurable business value.

This is a long-term role across multiple client engagements. You will combine hands-on technical judgement with clear advice to business and technology leaders, help teams make informed platform decisions and identify further opportunities in data sharing, analytics, AI and data products.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Advise business and technology leaders. Lead discovery workshops, clarify priorities and explain architectural options, risks and investment choices in language that supports executive decisions.
  • Shape enterprise data architecture. Assess legacy estates and design appropriate warehouse or lakehouse platforms, integration patterns, migration stages and target operating arrangements.
  • Lead data migration and integration. Guide ETL/ELT, batch and incremental ingestion, change data capture, orchestration, reconciliation, testing and production cutover.
  • Stay close to technical delivery. Review and troubleshoot SQL, pipelines, data models and integrations; address reliability, performance and cost rather than stopping at high-level recommendations.
  • Design trustworthy data layers. Apply sound data modelling and medallion (Bronze / Silver / Gold) patterns where appropriate, with clear data quality, lineage, security and lifecycle controls.
  • Enable secure sharing and data products. Design governed exchange between organisations; assess sharing, private exchange and Marketplace options and commercially viable data offerings.
  • Deliver with enterprise discipline. Own roadmaps, dependencies, architecture decisions and stakeholder updates, keeping complex programmes on track and documenting risks and trade-offs.
  • Develop long-term client value. Transfer knowledge, mentor delivery teams and identify further consulting opportunities in platform engineering, governance, analytics and AI.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Platform expertise: Snowflake OR Databricks. Significant hands-on experience designing, implementing or migrating production enterprise workloads on at least ONE of these platforms is essential. Expertise in both is not required.
  • Snowflake pathway (one option). For Snowflake specialists: strong experience with platform architecture, data loading and ELT, warehouse performance and cost, security and relevant capabilities such as Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, secure sharing or Marketplace listings.
  • Databricks pathway (alternative option). For Databricks specialists: strong experience with lakehouse architecture, Delta Lake, Spark/PySpark or Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, and relevant ingestion/orchestration capabilities such as Lakeflow, Auto Loader, Delta Sharing or Marketplace.
  • Enterprise data migration and engineering. Proven delivery across complex sources, source-to-target mapping, ETL/ELT, pipeline orchestration, data quality, reconciliation and controlled production transition.
  • Advanced SQL and modelling. Strong SQL expertise across relational platforms such as SQL Server, Oracle or PostgreSQL; experience with dimensional and layered/medallion data models, query tuning and transformation logic.
  • Governance and data products. Practical understanding of access control, lineage, auditability and sensitive data, plus governed sharing and the business opportunities created by reusable data products.
  • Senior client advisory. Able to lead workshops, challenge assumptions constructively and present technical strategy and delivery recommendations to business executives and engineering leaders.
  • Enterprise delivery ownership. Demonstrable experience leading significant data initiatives through discovery, architecture, planning and implementation, managing dependencies, milestones and stakeholder expectations.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience across both platforms. Familiarity with Snowflake and Databricks, or experience transferring data workloads between modern cloud data platforms, would be an advantage.
  • Wider cloud migration. AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud migration experience; relevant cloud certifications or experience with structured migration programmes.
  • Analytics and business intelligence. Data analysis, semantic models, dashboards or tools such as Power BI and Tableau; translating business questions into trusted datasets.
  • AI, data science and regulated industries. Enabling governed data for ML/LLM applications or evaluations, and/or experience with insurance, healthcare or other regulated organisations.
  • Supporting tools and qualifications. Python, dbt, Airflow or equivalent orchestration tools; relevant SnowPro, Databricks, AWS, Azure or other cloud/data credentials.

Personal Profile

You are a structured, credible and pragmatic consultant who enjoys solving difficult data problems. You can work from strategic discovery through technical delivery, communicate clearly with senior stakeholders and build confidence in engineering teams. You take ownership of plans and risks, adapt to different client environments and recognise opportunities to create longer-term value.

What Success Looks Like

Clients gain clear architecture decisions, achievable migration roadmaps and reliable production data platforms. Well-governed pipelines, data models and sharing solutions support analytics and future AI use cases. 8 West builds trusted client relationships, delivers predictably and develops repeatable data consulting capability across Snowflake and Databricks engagements.

  • Drive high-impact insights that directly influence product strategy, prioritization, and roadmap decisions, with measurable effects on engagement, retention, and monetization.
  • Improve experimentation quality within assigned product areas through sound test design, statistical analysis, and clear post-test interpretation.
  • Ensure analyses and experiments follow established methodologies and best practices.
  • Act as the analytical counterpart to product, proactively identifying risks and opportunities aligned with Feeld’s strategic goals.

Requirements

About you:

  • You have experience designing and running experiments in a two-sided marketplace
  • You can build and analyze causal inference models and deploy advanced statistical methodologies when needed
  • You can implement efficient tracking and instrumentation to measure member’s behavior in the app

  • You are experienced with Amplitude, Snowflake, DBT, with one or more programming language under your belt (R, Python)
  • You have advanced analytical reasoning

Benefits

About us:

Feeld is an independent, experimental and fully remote organisation reshaping the dialogue on dating and sexuality. The company was founded in 2014 and has evolved since to become the open, distributed structure it is now. We have a naturally agile and fluid culture. The whole team is fully remote, which means you work where and when helps you perform at your best. We regard autonomy highly and treat our organisation as a product – we iterate, improve and test things internally to see what works best for everyone.

Our culture:

We believe in creating a safe work environment through humanity, fluidity, safety, transparency and progressiveness. When hiring, we look for culture add rather than culture fit.

Because we are a fully remote team, it’s especially important that we create an environment where our colleagues feel included and connected as humans.

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging at Feeld:

Feeld promotes open-mindedness, inclusion, diversity and kindness, both in the world and among our own workforce.

We encourage and welcome applications from people with a history of marginalisation, whether because of race, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, neurodivergence, national origin, disability (seen or unseen) or any confluence of intersectional identities.

Our goal is a barrier-free application process and working environment. If you require further details or assistance or have any questions about this process, please let us know at .

Compensation and perks:

We are conscious of how our work and decisions impact other humans and the environment. We design our product and organisation with consideration for the wellbeing of our Members and colleagues. Feeld’s way of working is designed to proactively prevent burnout and an “always on” culture. We believe in technology and working environments that enable people to live a meaningful, fulfilled life.

Therefore, we offer our staff:

  • Flexible working hours
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • A fully remote working situation
  • Home office budget
  • Learning & development budget
  • On demand therapy sessions and mental health support via Spill
  • In-person meet ups

Our compensation system is one of the ways we work to uphold equity and inclusion at Feeld. Just as we strive to enable honest expression on our platform, we strive for openness of information within the organization. Internally, we keep decision-making transparent to keep each other accountable and make sure all voices are heard. That is why we offer a compensation system that is transparent, honest, and equitable. Additionally, we believe all humans deserve to earn a competitive wage, so we offer a Baseline Freedom Salary of £60,000 GBP per year for any role that indexes below £60,000 GBP per year.

Estimated compensation for this role:

  • Total cash compensation for this role varies by geographic location. We estimate the market-competitive compensation range for this position to be between £90,000 - £115,000 GBP

Our interview process:

  • Your first conversation with Feeld will be a screening call with our recruiter, where you’ll be able to ask - and receive answers - regarding any general questions you have and to confirm the role is a fit for what you’re seeking.

  • Your third conversation allows you the opportunity to meet the team members you might be working with on a daily basis. Here, you’ll be able to ask questions about team processes, workflow, and the employee experience at Feeld.
  • We generally make an offer within 2 weeks of our final call, and offer a flexible start date that can begin as early as the next Monday after you sign our offer documentation.
  • Of note: all of our interviews are conducted remotely, and our interviewers will work with you to find an agreeable interview time based on mutual availability.

We understand we're asking you to invest your time and best efforts in our process, and are appreciative of getting the chance to better know who you are as a person and candidate. In return, we’re committed to offering transparent communication and prompt feedback as you navigate this application with us.
