jobs.title: Specialized Account Executive Intelligence Center X - ESIB
jobs.excerpt: Intelligence Center X is Siemens' platform for the agentic enterpriseThe next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own.
jobs.description:
Intelligence Center X is Siemens' platform for the agentic enterprise

The next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own. Intelligence Center X delivers that today, through five capabilities — an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, AI/ML, agentic application development, orchestration, and governance — that together move enterprises from static software to intelligent, autonomous systems.

For the customers we serve, that shift shows up in very concrete ways: engineers and data leaders who can finally find and trust the data buried across decades of enterprise systems; teams that go from idea to working application in days instead of quarters; and AI initiatives that move out of pilot purgatory and into production because the underlying data and governance can actually support them. Whether you're building this platform, proving its value to customers, or bringing it to market through our partner ecosystem, your work directly drives those outcomes for some of the most complex organizations in the world.

This is one of the most ambitious enterprise AI platforms in the market — built on decades of deep domain expertise across industries as varied as manufacturing, banking, insurance, financial services, and healthcare, and already running in production at real scale for organizations with some of the most demanding data and compliance requirements in the world. If you want to work at the intersection of enterprise AI, knowledge graphs, and agentic applications — with real customers and real production stakes, across nearly every major industry — this is where that work is happening.

Specialty Account Executive Intelligence Center X

Industry aligned enterprise sales

Industry LCE

Territory Industry focused – US based

Organization Siemens Digital Industries Software

Location Remote

Role type Individual contributor enterprise sales

Travel As needed, minimum expectation 25%

Help customers move from digital enterprise to agentic enterprise

The next era of enterprise AI will not be won by adding another disconnected model, dashboard or pilot. It will be won by connecting trusted enterprise context to intelligence and then turning that intelligence into governed action across the systems and workflows that run the business.

That is the opportunity behind Siemens Intelligence Center X, and it is the mission of this role.

About Siemens Intelligence Center X

Siemens Intelligence Center X, or ICX, is an enterprise platform for building and scaling industrial AI solutions. It brings together Graph Studio, AI Studio and Agent Builder, App Studio powered by Mendix, process orchestration and governance so customers can move from Context to Intelligence to Action in one governed environment.

ICX complements the systems customers already rely on, including PLM, ERP, MES, CRM and data platforms. It connects information across those systems, gives AI the context needed to reason, and enables people and agents to take measurable action through applications and orchestrated workflows.

The opportunity

We are looking for an accomplished enterprise seller to build and lead the ICX business across Electronics and Semiconductor. You will own a net-new ACV target and pursue consequential, multi-year platform opportunities that begin with a high-value business problem and expand across functions, use cases and geographies.

This is a role for a seller who creates demand, earns access to senior executives and leads from first insight through signature. You will combine the pace and ownership of a growth business with Siemens' industry credibility, customer relationships, technology portfolio and global reach.

Across Life Sciences, Energy and Utilities, and CPG organizations must improve speed, quality and resilience while managing complex operations, evolving demand and regulatory obligations. Their priorities span accelerating validated innovation, improving asset reliability and field productivity, and strengthening supply chain responsiveness and customer experience. ICX connects governed context across research, engineering, quality, manufacturing, assets, supply chains and commercial operations. This enables teams to apply AI, make informed decisions and coordinate action across the value chain while preserving the validation, traceability, safety and auditability their industries require.

Your industry mandate

Machinery and heavy equipment companies need to accelerate configuration and engineering, improve factory performance and create more value across the installed base. ICX connects product, production and service context so teams can automate complex decisions and move from issue detection to coordinated action.

What you will own

  • Create the market. Build a focused territory and account strategy, identify high-consequence business problems and generate qualified pipeline through insight-led prospecting, Siemens relationships, partners and executive networks.
  • Lead the value conversation. Engage CIOs, CDOs, COOs and line-of-business executives around measurable business outcomes, not features. Translate operational pain into an executive value case with clear metrics, urgency and sponsorship.
  • Run the full pursuit. Own the opportunity from qualification through discovery, tailored experience, commercial strategy, security and procurement, paper process and signature. Maintain momentum, create the next action and escalate blockers early.
  • Orchestrate the winning team. Lead a matrixed pursuit team that may include Siemens Account Orchestrators, Solution Architects, Value Engineering, Technical Account Managers, Expert Services, product leaders and industry specialists.
  • Make the customer experience count. Partner with the Solution Architect to convert discovery into a tailored ICX story and experience that proves how context, intelligence, action and governance come together against one consequential decision.
  • Build executive alignment. Multi-thread the account, develop a credible champion and secure access to the economic buyer. Create shared clarity on decision criteria, decision process, paper process and the cost of inaction.
  • Win with an ecosystem. Activate Siemens, hyperscaler and global systems integrator relationships where they create access, credibility, delivery confidence or scale.
  • Operate with discipline. Apply rigorous opportunity qualification, maintain an accurate forecast and create a healthy pipeline that supports sustained target attainment.

Industry priorities

    • Configure-to-order and engineering automation
    • Factory performance and predictive maintenance
    • Installed-base service intelligence
    • Quality root cause and corrective action
    • Supply and production disruption orchestration

What success looks like

  • A prioritized territory plan built around the accounts, executive relationships and use cases most likely to produce material ICX opportunities.
  • A qualified pipeline with measurable customer pain, executive sponsorship, a compelling event and a defined path to decision.
  • Strategic ICX lands with a credible roadmap to expand across additional use cases, business units and platform capabilities.
  • Customer-backed value cases that connect ICX investment to financial, operational or risk outcomes.
  • Reliable forecast performance and consistent progression across complex, multi-stakeholder pursuits.
  • Strong operating relationships across Siemens and the partner ecosystem, with clear ownership and accountability throughout the customer journey.

What you bring

Required experience and capabilities

  • A sustained record of meeting or exceeding enterprise software sales targets in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Experience creating and closing strategic platform opportunities, including multi-year agreements with executive visibility and seven-figure potential.
  • Executive presence and business acumen: you can earn credibility with C-suite and operating leaders, diagnose a business problem and build a financially grounded case for change.
  • Fluency in at least two of the following: enterprise AI and machine learning, knowledge graphs or data platforms, application development, process automation, cloud platforms or industrial software.
  • Command of a rigorous enterprise sales methodology and the judgment to qualify out, advance decisively and forecast accurately.
  • The ability to lead a diverse pursuit team without relying on formal authority, while maintaining pace and accountability across handoffs.
  • A willingness to learn the customer's industry, Siemens' portfolio and the evolving AI competitive landscape at depth.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred experience

  • Experience selling enterprise AI, data, automation, low-code or industry software platforms into Energy, Life Sciences and CPG.
  • Existing relationships with CIO and CTO; VP Manufacturing Operations, Research and Development and or Supply Chain, Safety Risk and Regulatory Affairs within the Energy, Life Sciences and or CPG Industries.
  • Familiarity with knowledge graphs, agentic workflows, model governance, digital twins or cross-system orchestration.
  • Experience co-selling with global account teams, hyperscalers or systems integrators.
  • A track record competing against established platform providers and reframing customer decisions around differentiated business value.

Why join the ICX team

  • Build a category-defining business. Help shape how the world's most consequential enterprises operationalize AI with context, governance and action.
  • Sell where Siemens already matters. Enter strategic accounts with the credibility, relationships and industrial domain depth of one of the world's most trusted technology companies.
  • Own meaningful outcomes. Pursue enterprise platform opportunities tied to operational performance, resilience, quality, speed and growth.
  • Work with a serious technical bench. Partner with Solution Architects, AI and data specialists, value engineers, industry experts and services leaders who can turn a strong discovery into a differentiated customer experience.
  • Grow with the market. Develop at the intersection of industrial software, enterprise AI, agentic systems, applications and process orchestration.

How we work

We expect ownership, curiosity, direct communication and a bias for action. The strongest people on this team create the next step, challenge assumptions with evidence, escalate barriers early and stay accountable across every handoff. They are comfortable with the uncomfortable because consequential outcomes rarely come from passive selling.

Closing

    United States Pay Transparency Statement

    The base salary range for this position is $146,700 - $293,400 USD. This is a 50/50 split. The actual compensation offered will be based on factors such as experience, skills, education, certifications, work location, and business needs.

    In addition to base salary, this position may be eligible for an annual incentive bonus and participation in the company's benefits programs, which may include medical, dental, vision, retirement savings plans, paid time off, and other employee benefits.

    We are committed to providing equitable compensation and making hiring decisions based on qualifications, experience, and business requirements.

jobs.title: Head of X-Sell
jobs.excerpt: At NOVACARD, we’re redefining how people use credit.
jobs.description:
At NOVACARD, we’re redefining how people use credit. We are the first interest-free and no-annual-fee credit card in Mexico, designed to simplify personal finances and give users complete control - all from a mobile app. With NOVACARD, users can access up to $200,000 MXN in credit, only pay when they use it, and manage everything digitally in under 5 minutes. Our mission is to empower people to make smarter financial decisions by offering flexibility, transparency, and the freedom they need to reach their goals. Simple finances, big goals.

About the Role:
We are looking for a strong Product Manager to lead cross-sell strategy and execution for our cash loans and credit lines portfolio in the Near Prime segment. You will be fully responsible for driving incremental product adoption among our existing customer base, maximizing share of wallet, and designing seamless multi-product journeys. This role demands the ability to balance customer lifetime value, data-driven offer design, and business profitability. The role is mostly remote, with business trips when required.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and own the cross-sell strategy and roadmap for Cash Loans and Credit Lines, identifying high-potential customer segments for multi-product adoption.

  • Design targeted cross-sell value propositions that sit at the intersection of customer needs, product eligibility, tech feasibility, and financial return.

  • Own the cross-sell P&L and track core metrics: cross-sell take-up rate, products-per-customer ratio, time-to-second-product, incremental revenue per customer, activation and usage of the second product, and overall LTV uplift.

  • Architect end-to-end cross-sell customer journeys — from in-app triggers and pre-approved offers to seamless onboarding for a second product — ensuring a frictionless experience that deepens engagement.

  • Identify and build partnership integrations (online/offline retailers, ecosystems) that serve as cross-sell channels or co-branded triggers for existing customers.

  • Continuously analyze and optimize unit economics (UE) of cross-sell initiatives, balancing acquisition-like incentives with long-term portfolio profitability.

  • Build and manage the cross-sell product management process, define a success matrix for cross-sell initiatives, and run a prioritized experimentation roadmap.

  • Work cross-functionally with risk, marketing (CRM, lifecycle), IT, finance, and legal teams to align cross-sell campaigns with credit policies, communication governance, and tech delivery (both locally and with HQ).

  • Drive continuous improvement of the cross-sell customer journey (CJM), ensuring that every touchpoint reinforces trust and value, and that new features meet cost, quality, and performance targets.

Requirements

Key Requirements:

  • Solid experience in consumer lending (Cash Loans, Credit Lines, Credit Cards, PDL, or other unsecured credit) on the business or risk management side — mandatory.

  • Proven track record of driving cross-sell, up-sell, or multi-product adoption in a financial services or fintech environment is a strong advantage.

  • Deep understanding of adjacent functions: risk management, lifecycle marketing, and IT.

  • Strong upper-intermediate English (both spoken and written) — required for regular communication with international teams and HQ.

  • Powerful analytical skills, ability to frame cross-sell as a product discipline, out-of-the-box thinking, and flexibility. Comfortable managing multiple experiments and initiatives simultaneously.

  • Genuine curiosity about customer behavior, openness to new ideas, and advanced communication and stakeholder management skills.

What We Offer

  • Remote work format, with office/on-site options when needed.

  • Official employment under local labor law; contractor arrangements available for candidates from other countries.

  • The opportunity to define and scale the cross-sell function in a high-growth Near Prime lending business.

  • A data-driven, experimental culture where your hypotheses directly translate into measurable revenue and customer satisfaction gains.

  • Autonomy to build cross-sell processes from scratch and collaborate with an international team shaping the future of credit in Mexico.

The Assignment
LaMP is seeking a project consultant to build a financial model for a labor mobility project between Colombia and Spain. The model will show how workers’ migration costs are financed through income share agreements (ISAs) or loans, and how those costs are repaid. Our goal is a long-term relationship with a consultant who can pitch in on LaMP projects as needs arise; this project is the first.

Scope of Work
The consultant will design and build a portfolio model for 5 to 50 borrowers financed through an ISA or a loan. The model should show repayment dynamics for each borrower and IRR at the portfolio level.

Deliverables

  1. A first version of the financial model (Excel) with a clear assumptions tab and dynamic scenario planning tools, plus a short methodology note (2–3 pages)

  1. A walkthrough and Q&A session for the LaMP team to review the model

  1. A revised version of the model incorporating LaMP’s feedback

  1. Ongoing support at an hourly rate after delivery, as needed

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

  • Proven experience building financial models (cash flow, scenario analysis, IRR)

  • Experience with income share agreements and student or microfinance lending

  • Experience building models with multiple currencies

  • Ability to explain model and scenario analysis functionalities clearly to non-specialists

  • A modeler who knows what every cell of their spreadsheet is doing and stands behind the formulas (use of AI is not prohibited, but it may not take the place of a firm understanding of how every cell is related to the others)

  • Working knowledge of Spanish is a plus

  • Location: Remote

  • Duration: First project November–December 2026, with potential for ongoing project-based work

  • Compensation: Hourly or daily rate, based on the applicant’s proposal

How to Apply

Submit your CV and a short cover letter through the SmartRecruiters portal. Please include your daily and hourly rates, an estimate of the hours this project would take, and references from clients you have built financial models for. Address the cover letter to Kim Geronimo, Associate Director over Global Programs. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and a decision will be made in the second half of November 2026.

Labor Mobility Partnerships (LaMP) is a Washington, D.C.-based nonprofit that builds sustainable, fair ecosystems for cross-border labor migration. We work with governments, employers, financiers, and workers to make safe, well-paid international work accessible to more people.

jobs.title: Human Centered Design Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Company OverviewVoted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Human-Centered Design (HCD) Engineer to bridge the gap between user needs and technical execution. You will lead qualitative research, map user journeys, build interactive prototypes, and run usability tests to ensure our products are intuitive, accessible, and impactful for the physicians, clinical staff, billers, front-desk teams, and patients who rely on them every day. In a clinical setting, a confusing screen costs a provider time, adds to burnout, and can affect patient safety, so this role carries real weight. You will thrive here if you love sitting with users in their actual workflows, can turn messy observations into clear direction, and can defend design decisions with evidence.

Key Responsibilities

User Research

  • Conduct contextual inquiries, interviews, field observations, and surveys with physicians, clinical staff, billers, and patients to uncover explicit and latent needs.
  • Partner with account managers and support teams to surface usability pain points from client feedback and support tickets.

Synthesis & Strategy

  • Translate research into personas, journey maps, service blueprints, and system workflows across clinical, operational, and billing processes.
  • Present insights to product and executive leadership to shape roadmap priorities.

Ideation & Prototyping

  • Facilitate cross-functional design workshops and build low- to high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
  • Design AI-powered features (AI charting, AI agents) that keep clinicians in control and make AI output easy to review and correct.

Usability Testing

  • Plan, moderate, and analyze formative and summative usability tests to iterate on designs before and during development.
  • Evaluate safety-critical workflows such as medication management and e-prescribing, and support ONC Safety-Enhanced Design testing.

Collaboration & Governance

  • Partner with product managers, business analysts, and engineers in Agile/Scrum teams to maintain design integrity from concept through release.
  • Uphold accessibility standards (WCAG, Section 508) and HIPAA-safe research practices across all products.

Leadership

  • Build and scale WRS Health's HCD practice, including research operations, templates, and standards.
  • Mentor designers and researchers, and coach teammates on human-centered methods.

Qualifications

Required

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human-Centered Design, Human-Factors Engineering, Interaction Design, Cognitive Psychology, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3 to 6+ years of professional experience in HCD, UX design, or user research, including enterprise or regulated-industry experience.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in prototyping software (Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD), qualitative research methodologies, usability testing frameworks, and Agile/Scrum delivery flows.
  • Accessibility: Working knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG standards and how to apply them in practice.
  • Core Competencies: Strong empathy, verbal storytelling, analytical problem-solving, and the ability to defend design decisions with data.
  • A portfolio or case studies demonstrating end-to-end research, synthesis, prototyping, and measurable impact.

Preferred

  • Experience designing for EHR, practice management, revenue cycle, telehealth, or other health IT products.
  • Familiarity with clinical workflows and terminology across ambulatory specialties.
  • Knowledge of ONC Safety-Enhanced Design (user-centered design and summative testing) requirements, NISTIR 7804, or ISO 9241-210.
  • Experience designing AI-assisted or automation features, including human-in-the-loop review patterns.
  • Prior experience leading or mentoring designers/researchers, or building a design function from the ground up.
  • Experience with remote research and unmoderated testing tools and product analytics platforms.
  • Clinical background or prior work in a medical practice setting.

A Day in the Life

Your days move between the field, the whiteboard, and the prototype. You might start by joining the product team's stand-up to flag a research insight affecting an upcoming sprint, then sit in (virtually or on-site) with a specialty practice to watch how the front desk, medical assistants, and physicians actually work, noting the workarounds they've built and where the screens slow them down. Later, you could be synthesizing those observations into an updated journey map, facilitating a workshop with product managers, engineers, and billing specialists to sketch solutions, or moderating a usability test of a new AI charting feature to see how a clinician reviews and trusts AI-drafted notes. Before the day ends, you refine prototypes in Figma based on what you learned, check designs against accessibility standards, share prioritized recommendations with product leadership, and make time to coach the designers and researchers on your team.

Success Metrics

  • Measurable usability gains: Improved task success rates, time-on-task, error rates, and System Usability Scale (SUS) scores for redesigned workflows, including fewer clicks and less documentation time for key clinical tasks.
  • Research-driven roadmap: Consistent monthly contact with users across specialties, with a clear, visible share of roadmap items originating from or validated by HCD research.
  • Fewer usability issues post-release: Decline in usability-related support tickets, rework, and post-launch design defects.
  • Accessibility and certification compliance: New and updated features meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards at release, and ONC Safety-Enhanced Design documentation is completed on time.
  • Adoption and satisfaction: Higher feature adoption (including AI features) and improved client satisfaction or NPS for redesigned areas.

Job Details

  • Job Type: Full-time | Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

Compensation will be based on location, experience, and qualifications.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are: At Wagepoint, we're good people.  It's easy to feel that way when you're surrounded by folks doing the best work of their careers, building great payroll software for small businesses across Canada.
jobs.description:
Who we are:
At Wagepoint, we're good people. It's easy to feel that way when you're surrounded by folks doing the best work of their careers, building great payroll software for small businesses across Canada.

Our team brings together diverse backgrounds, perspectives, experiences, and ideas to make payroll the easiest part of running a business.

We're remote-first, growing, and looking for passionate people who don't settle for the first solution or the way it's been done before. We care deeply about our customers and each other, and understand that when it comes to payroll, getting it right matters.

Our values guide how we work and what we expect from one another:

  • Cultivate Impact by focusing on what matters most and delivering meaningful outcomes for our customers.

  • Unify as One Team by collaborating openly, communicating clearly, and rallying around shared goals.

  • Stay Curious and Kind by challenging assumptions, learning quickly, and leading with empathy.

If you want to build the future of payroll in a place where your ideas are welcomed and your contributions matter, look no further!

The role at high level:

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Analyst who can take a messy business question and come back with an answer people can act on. You'll be the analytical engine of our Revenue Operations team, owning the reporting, models, and definitions that Marketing, Sales, and Customer Support rely on to decide where to spend their time. This seat leans toward data. You'll write SQL against our data warehouse (Databricks) to connect product, billing, and CRM data, and bring the RevOps judgment to know which question the data should answer.

This isn't a report-request role. You'll connect data from across our GTM stack, dig into why the numbers moved, and bring recommendations to team leads before they ask. You'll work hands-on in those systems where configuration or troubleshooting is needed to keep the data accurate, and you'll use AI to get from question to answer faster. You'll report directly to the Director of Revenue Operations.

What you'll be expected to own:

  • Design, build, and maintain reporting and dashboards that provide meaningful insights across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Support.

  • Analyze GTM performance, identify trends, and translate complex data into actionable recommendations for business leaders.

  • Build and maintain SQL queries and spreadsheet models that support commission tracking, pipeline analysis, forecasting, capacity planning, and CRM data reconciliation.

  • Pull and connect data from across our GTM tech stack, including our data warehouse (Databricks), HubSpot, Zendesk, and Gong, into reporting that gives one reliable view of the business, working hands-on in those systems to keep the data accurate.

  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through automation and AI, while helping the broader GTM organization adopt new capabilities.

  • Lead cross-functional Revenue Operations initiatives, including CRM improvements, reporting enhancements, process redesigns, and system implementations.

  • Create and maintain clear documentation, standard operating procedures, and knowledge resources that improve consistency and scalability across the business.

  • Partner closely with Marketing, Sales, Customer Support, and leadership to improve data quality, streamline processes, and enable better decision-making.

What you bring to the table:

  • 4+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, or a data or business analyst role supporting go-to-market teams, within a SaaS or high-growth company.

  • Strong working SQL: multi-table joins, CTEs, window functions, and checking your results against the source system.

  • Experience independently managing projects across multiple business systems with minimal supervision.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to solve ambiguous business problems using data.

  • Working knowledge of CRM data structures (objects, associations, lifecycle stages). HubSpot experience is a strong asset, and exposure to Zendesk and Gong is a plus.

  • Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills for modeling and reconciliation work.

  • Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or embedded platform AI to improve workflows and productivity.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts and data insights to a variety of stakeholders.

  • A continuous improvement mindset with strong attention to detail and a passion for building scalable processes.

  • Post-secondary education in Business, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Bonus points if:

  • You have experience with a cloud data warehouse (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery) or a BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).

  • You use Python for data work.

  • You have experience building lead scoring models, lifecycle management, or marketing attribution reporting.

  • You hold HubSpot certifications or have deep CRM administration experience.

  • You've designed and implemented AI-enabled operational workflows that improved team efficiency.

  • You're passionate about improving how teams work through automation, documentation, and operational excellence.

What we bring to the table:

  • Impact:Dig in and directly contribute to Wagepoint’s growth and success.

  • Culture:Work alongside a team that genuinely enjoys solving problems together, celebrates wins, supports one another through challenges, and still finds time for the occasional terrible joke.

  • Growth:We believe learning is part of the job. We’re committed to helping you Get Better Every Day (a representation of our Stay Curious and Kind value!) by offering professional development, new experiences, and career growth as we continue to evolve.

  • Innovation:Curiosity and experimentation encouraged! Bring ideas, challenge assumptions, responsibly utilize AI, and help shape better ways of working.

  • Remote:Work from wherever you do your best work. Wagepoint has always been remote-first, giving you flexibility, autonomy, and hopefully a little extra time with the people (and pets) you love.

Ready to join the team? Apply now and help us continue making payroll the easiest part of running a business.

Next steps:

If this sounds like the right fit, we’d love to hear from you! No need for a formal cover letter, just send us your resume and if you’d like, a few lines about what excites you about the opportunity.

If we agree it's a great match, someone from our team will reach out to schedule a call.

Psssst!

In 2026, we were recognized as one of Canada's Best Workplaces for Mental Wellness and Inclusion. That commitment extends to our hiring process, where we strive to create an experience that is welcoming, respectful, and inclusive from day one.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and perspectives, and we're committed to building a workplace where everyone can thrive.

As a remote company, all interviews are conducted virtually. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to support you!

As part of our hiring process, AI-based tools are used to support the initial review of applications. Rest assured, our People Ops team carefully reviews all applications and makes the final decisions on candidate progression.

Analyste principal ou principale, Opérations de revenus

Qui sommes-nous :

Chez Wagepoint, nous sommes du bon monde. Et c'est facile à ressentir quand on est entouré de personnes qui réalisent le meilleur travail de leur carrière, à créer un logiciel de paie remarquable pour les petites entreprises de partout au Canada.

Notre équipe réunit des parcours, des perspectives, des expériences et des idées variés pour faire de la paie la partie la plus simple de la gestion d'une entreprise.

Le télétravail est notre norme, nous sommes en pleine croissance et nous cherchons des personnes passionnées qui ne se contentent pas de la première solution venue ni de la façon dont les choses ont toujours été faites. Nous tenons profondément à nos clients comme les uns aux autres, et nous savons qu'en matière de paie, l'exactitude compte.

Nos valeurs orientent notre façon de travailler et ce que nous attendons les uns des autres :

  • Cultiver l'impact en nous concentrant sur l'essentiel et en offrant des résultats concrets à nos clients.

  • Ne faire qu'une équipe en collaborant ouvertement, en communiquant clairement et en nous ralliant autour d'objectifs communs.

  • Faire preuve de curiosité et de bienveillance en remettant en question les idées reçues, en apprenant rapidement et en agissant avec empathie.

Si vous voulez bâtir l'avenir de la paie dans un milieu où vos idées sont accueillies et où votre contribution compte, ne cherchez pas plus loin !

Le rôle :

Nous cherchons une personne au poste d'analyste principal ou principale des opérations de revenus, capable de prendre une question d'affaires floue et d'en rapporter une réponse sur laquelle on peut agir. Vous serez le moteur analytique de notre équipe des opérations de revenus : vous aurez la responsabilité des rapports, des modèles et des définitions sur lesquels le Marketing, les Ventes et le Soutien à la clientèle s'appuient pour décider où investir leur temps. Ce poste est davantage axé sur les données. Vous rédigerez des requêtes SQL dans notre entrepôt de données (Databricks) pour relier les données sur les produits, la facturation et le CRM, et vous mettrez à profit votre jugement en opérations de revenus pour savoir à quelle question les données doivent répondre.

Ce n'est pas un poste où l'on se contente d'exécuter des demandes de rapports. Vous relierez les données provenant de l'ensemble de notre pile de mise en marché (GTM), vous chercherez à comprendre pourquoi les chiffres ont bougé et vous présenterez des recommandations aux responsables d'équipe avant même qu'ils les demandent. Vous interviendrez concrètement dans ces systèmes lorsqu'une configuration ou un dépannage s'impose pour préserver l'exactitude des données, et vous utiliserez l'IA pour passer plus vite de la question à la réponse. Vous relèverez directement de la direction des opérations de revenus.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Concevoir, créer et maintenir des rapports et des tableaux de bord qui fournissent des renseignements utiles au Marketing, aux Ventes et au Soutien à la clientèle.

  • Analyser la performance de mise en marché (GTM), dégager les tendances et transformer des données complexes en recommandations concrètes pour les responsables d'affaires.

  • Créer et maintenir des requêtes SQL et des modèles de feuilles de calcul pour le suivi des commissions, l'analyse du pipeline, les prévisions, la planification de la capacité et le rapprochement des données du CRM.

  • Extraire et relier les données de notre pile technologique de mise en marché (GTM) — notamment notre entrepôt de données (Databricks), HubSpot, Zendesk et Gong — dans des rapports qui offrent une vue fiable et unifiée de l'entreprise, en intervenant concrètement dans ces systèmes pour préserver l'exactitude des données.

  • Repérer les occasions d'améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle grâce à l'automatisation et à l'IA, tout en aidant l'ensemble de l'organisation de mise en marché à adopter de nouvelles capacités.

  • Piloter des initiatives interéquipes en opérations de revenus : améliorations du CRM, bonification des rapports, refonte de processus et implantation de systèmes.

  • Créer et maintenir une documentation claire, des procédures normalisées et des ressources de connaissances qui améliorent la cohérence et l'évolutivité dans toute l'entreprise.

  • Collaborer étroitement avec le Marketing, les Ventes, le Soutien à la clientèle et la direction pour améliorer la qualité des données, simplifier les processus et favoriser de meilleures prises de décision.

Ce que vous apportez :

  • Plus de 4 ans d'expérience en opérations de revenus, en opérations de vente, en opérations marketing ou dans un rôle d'analyste de données ou d'analyste d'affaires au service des équipes de mise en marché, au sein d'une entreprise SaaS ou à forte croissance.

  • De solides compétences pratiques en SQL : jointures multitables, CTE, fonctions de fenêtrage et vérification de vos résultats par rapport au système source.

  • De l'expérience dans la gestion autonome de projets touchant plusieurs systèmes d'affaires, avec une supervision minimale.

  • De solides compétences analytiques et la capacité de résoudre des problèmes d'affaires ambigus à l'aide des données.

  • Une connaissance pratique des structures de données d'un CRM (objets, associations, étapes du cycle de vie). Une expérience de HubSpot est un atout important, et une familiarité avec Zendesk et Gong est un plus.

  • De solides compétences dans Google Sheets ou Excel pour la modélisation et le rapprochement de données.

  • De l'aisance avec des outils d'IA comme ChatGPT, Claude ou l'IA intégrée aux plateformes pour améliorer les flux de travail et la productivité.

  • D'excellentes aptitudes en communication et la capacité d'expliquer des concepts techniques et des analyses de données à des parties prenantes variées.

  • Un état d'esprit axé sur l'amélioration continue, un grand souci du détail et une passion pour la création de processus évolutifs.

  • Une formation postsecondaire en administration, en analytique ou dans un domaine connexe, ou une expérience pratique équivalente.

En prime :

  • Vous avez de l'expérience avec un entrepôt de données infonuagique (Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery) ou un outil de BI (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).

  • Vous utilisez Python pour le travail sur les données.

  • Vous avez de l'expérience dans la création de modèles de notation des prospects, la gestion du cycle de vie ou les rapports d'attribution marketing.

  • Vous détenez des certifications HubSpot ou possédez une solide expérience de l'administration de CRM.

  • Vous avez conçu et mis en place des flux de travail opérationnels alimentés par l'IA qui ont amélioré l'efficacité de l'équipe.

  • Vous avez à cœur d'améliorer le travail des équipes par l'automatisation, la documentation et l'excellence opérationnelle.

Ce que nous vous offrons :

Impact :Mettez la main à la pâte et contribuez directement à la croissance et au succès de Wagepoint.

Culture :Travaillez aux côtés d'une équipe qui aime vraiment résoudre des problèmes ensemble, qui célèbre ses réussites, qui se soutient dans les moments difficiles et qui trouve toujours le temps pour une mauvaise blague à l'occasion.

Croissance :Pour nous, apprendre fait partie du travail. Nous nous engageons à vous aider à vous améliorer chaque jour (un clin d'œil à notre valeur Faire preuve de curiosité et de bienveillance !) en vous offrant du perfectionnement professionnel, de nouvelles expériences et des perspectives d'évolution de carrière au fil de notre croissance.

Innovation :La curiosité et l'expérimentation sont encouragées ! Apportez vos idées, remettez en question les idées reçues, utilisez l'IA de façon responsable et contribuez à inventer de meilleures façons de travailler.

Télétravail :Travaillez d'où vous êtes le plus productif. Le télétravail a toujours été la norme chez Wagepoint : vous y gagnez en souplesse, en autonomie et, on l'espère, un peu plus de temps avec les personnes (et les animaux) que vous aimez.

Job Description:

DXC Technology is expanding its global cybersecurity program to further strengthen cyber governance, risk management, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience across its business operations. We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager – Business Information Security Officer (BISO) to support key business units and service lines.


Representing the Global Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), the BISO is responsible for embedding cybersecurity strategy, governance, and risk management practices into business unit operations, strategic initiatives, and service delivery.


As a trusted strategic advisor to business unit leadership, this role provides oversight and direction on the organization's security posture, risk exposure, control effectiveness, and cybersecurity priorities. The BISO partners closely with business and technology leaders to strengthen security maturity, support informed risk-based decision-making, and ensure that cybersecurity remains an integral part of business operations while protecting clients, data, services, and DXC's reputation.


Key Responsibilities

Strategic Cybersecurity Leadership & Governance

  • Serve as a trusted cybersecurity advisor to business unit leadership, providing strategic guidance on emerging cyber threats, security posture, control effectiveness, and operational resilience.
  • Partner with Global Cybersecurity leadership to ensure alignment with enterprise security strategies, policies, standards, and emerging threat intelligence.
  • Establish and lead business unit cybersecurity governance, including security health reporting, risk reviews, and executive-level updates.
  • Promote cybersecurity as a business enabler, supporting secure growth, innovation, operational resilience, and client trust.

Cyber Risk & Control Management

  • Oversee the business unit cybersecurity risk register, ensuring that material risks, control gaps, vulnerabilities, and emerging threats are identified, assessed, prioritized, and effectively managed.
  • Drive remediation of high-priority cybersecurity risks and control deficiencies in collaboration with technology, engineering, architecture, and operational stakeholders.
  • Oversee the implementation and effectiveness of cybersecurity hygiene controls, ensuring alignment with enterprise requirements and business operations.
  • Translate technical security findings, threat intelligence, and control weaknesses into clear business impacts, risk assessments, and actionable recommendations for leadership.
  • Partner with security architecture and cyber engineering teams to embed baseline security controls into products, services, technology changes, and transformation initiatives.
  • Engage early in business strategy, transformation, and delivery initiatives to proactively identify cybersecurity requirements and address potential risks.

Audit, Compliance & External Engagement

  • Serve as the senior point of contact for cybersecurity-related audits, regulatory examinations, corporate security reviews, and control assessments.
  • Ensure audit readiness through effective oversight of supporting evidence, management responses, and timely remediation of security findings.
  • Monitor compliance with enterprise cybersecurity standards, regulatory requirements, and applicable control frameworks.
  • Engage with clients and external stakeholders, as required, to communicate DXC's cybersecurity posture, control environment, resilience capabilities, and risk management practices.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Education & Professional Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Minimum of 12 years of experience in information security, cybersecurity, cyber risk management, or related technology disciplines.
  • Significant experience in senior cybersecurity leadership and risk management roles within complex, global, and highly regulated environments.

Technical & Professional Expertise

  • Deep knowledge of cybersecurity threats and security domains, including security controls, vulnerability management, identity and access management, incident response, security architecture, and operational resilience.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity governance, enterprise risk management, regulatory requirements, audit processes, issue management, and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience with cybersecurity maturity models, risk management methodologies, and industry-recognized frameworks, including NIST, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
  • Experience developing and managing metrics-driven cybersecurity programs, including security performance indicators, risk reporting, and control effectiveness assessments.
  • Proven ability to influence and advise senior business stakeholders on complex cybersecurity and risk matters, translating technical issues into business impact and practical, risk-based recommendations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, presentation, and executive reporting skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, complex, matrixed environments, collaborating across multiple business functions, technology teams, and geographies.
  • Experience building, scaling, or maturing cybersecurity programs across multiple business units or global regions is highly desirable.
Compensation at DXC is influenced by an array of factors, including but not limited to the experience, job-related knowledge, skills, competencies, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. A reasonable estimate of the current compensation range for this position is $165,500 - $307,300.

DXC offers a comprehensive, flexible, and competitive benefits program which includes, but is not limited to, health, dental, and vision insurance coverage; employee wellness; life and disability insurance; a retirement savings plan, paid holidays, paid time off.

Job Title: Research Marketing Lead

Job Type: Full-time

The Role

You’ll work closely with our research team to turn technical work into high-impact launches that earn attention, adoption, and citations. You’ll develop a deep understanding of our research and methodology, shape positioning and narratives, establish a high quality bar for publication, and build go-to-market strategies that put our work in front of the right researchers, developers, AI labs, and technical audiences.

What You'll Do

  1. Own research GTM end-to-end, developing launch and distribution strategies for research, benchmarks, evaluations, and other technical work.
  2. Establish the publication-readiness bar for research and benchmarks, partnering with researchers to ensure methodology, claims, results, and supporting materials are rigorous, clear, and defensible before launch.
  3. Develop positioning and narratives that translate complex technical findings into clear, differentiated stories without sacrificing technical accuracy or depth.
  4. Identify high-impact research opportunities by understanding emerging AI trends, open questions, competitive research, and what matters to researchers and practitioners.
  5. Shape research packaging and distribution, including research pages, benchmark releases, technical content, launch materials, and other assets that drive discovery and usage.
  6. Build relationships across the AI research ecosystem, including researchers, AI labs, developers, technical communities, and influential practitioners.
  7. Drive adoption of our research and benchmarks, identifying the audiences, communities, and channels most likely to use, reference, and build on our work.
  8. Measure research impact, tracking adoption, citations, engagement, usage, and qualitative feedback to understand what resonates and where our work is creating value.
  9. Create feedback loops between the market and research, bringing ecosystem insights back to the research team to inform future benchmarks, evaluations, and research priorities.

What We're Looking For

  1. Experience marketing, launching, or driving adoption of technical research, AI/ML products, developer products, benchmarks, evaluations, or similarly complex technical work.
  2. Strong track record developing and executing go-to-market strategies for technical audiences.
  3. Ability to deeply understand technical work and translate it into clear, credible, differentiated positioning and narratives.
  4. Strong understanding of the AI/ML research ecosystem, including major labs, research trends, benchmarks, evaluations, and technical communities.
  5. Exceptional written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with both highly technical and broader audiences.
  6. Strong analytical judgment and the ability to evaluate whether technical claims, supporting evidence, and research materials are ready for external publication.
  7. Experience building relationships with researchers, technical leaders, developers, or AI communities.
  8. High ownership and the ability to take ambiguous initiatives from strategy through execution.
  9. Strong cross-functional skills and the ability to work closely with researchers while maintaining a high bar for technical accuracy and quality.

Preferred

  1. Background in AI, machine learning, computer science, or another technical field.
  2. Experience at an AI lab, AI-native company, research organization, developer-focused company, or highly technical startup.
  3. Experience working directly with research teams and technical leadership.
  4. Familiarity with academic publishing, AI benchmarks, evaluations, citations, and research dissemination.
  5. Experience launching technical content or research that achieved meaningful adoption, citations, community engagement, or industry impact.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

jobs.excerpt: At Workiva, we build and scale an enterprise platform that powers complex financial reporting, compliance, and collaboration for some of the world’s largest organizations.
jobs.description:
At Workiva, we build and scale an enterprise platform that powers complex financial reporting, compliance, and collaboration for some of the world’s largest organizations. We solve for high-throughput data, strict consistency, and architectural scale while exploring what AI can do to transform how engineering teams work.


We are not simply adding AI to existing workflows. We are redesigning how engineering gets done. As agents take on more of the work, the human review steps that once caught problems are going away. AI failures often happen when nothing breaks: the model does exactly what it was asked, and the result is still wrong. That makes safety a control problem, not a prediction problem.


We are hiring a Principal Software Engineer to lead quality and safety for AI-native delivery. Our standard is quality through systems, not heroics, so the safe path is the easy path and higher velocity never means higher production risk. This is a hands-on role for someone who can define strategy, propose original solutions, and raise the technical bar for the teams around them.


What You’ll Do

Deliver outcomes

  • Partner with engineering, platform, InfoSec, SRE, and Compliance teams to build layered safety controls, so systems stay safe even when multiple safeguards fail.
  • Build pre-production verification, including evals, invariant tests, and risk-based test selection under a non-skippable invariant floor.
  • Build automated safety valves into development and delivery, so safety does not depend on slow human review.

Define and drive technical strategy

  • Lead the “Ratify Continuously, Expose Deliberately” model: continuous shadow soak, ratified releases, and deliberate per-tenant exposure.
  • Define the invariants our systems must never violate, and design controls that make those states unreachable.
  • Build Agentic Systems to remove CI bottlenecks by quarantining flaky tests and moving full suites to nightly runs.
  • Frame ambiguous safety problems and propose original approaches to solve them.
  • Increase agent autonomy only as verification improves.
  • Risk based evaluation approval of PRs

Design AI-driven systems

  • Enforce integrity-protected channels, where authorization comes only from signed sources and permission brokers, and all agent inputs and tool outputs are treated as data.
  • Ensure agents have zero authority over the guardrails that constrain them, such as CI gates, branch protection, and audit loggers.
  • Require privileged actuators to independently verify an agent’s claims about environment, approvals, and test status before acting.
  • Test, monitor, and observe AI models in real environments, with containment and rollback when behavior is unsafe.

Influence and lead

  • Raise the technical bar by making quality the default rather than the result of heroics.
  • Mentor and challenge Staff+ engineers to expand their scope, judgment, and impact.
  • Partner with engineering and product leadership to balance velocity with production risk.
  • Create durable artifacts such as runbooks, decision logs, and tests that can be handed off and evolved by others.
  • Contribute across product domains, bringing context from one area to solve problems in another.

What You’ll Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience building and scaling complex software systems.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field; or 6+ years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 4+ years of experience; or equivalent practical experience
  • Demonstrated experience using AI as a primary development collaborator.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing safety-critical, high-assurance, or redundant systems.
  • Experience building CI/CD and test infrastructure that improves engineering velocity and quality at scale.
  • Experience designing evals for LLMs or AI agents.
  • Experience with observability and monitoring for production systems.
  • Experience with security controls such as least-privilege access, signed provenance, and policy-as-code.
  • Experience with progressive delivery, including canary releases, traffic mirroring, and automated rollback.
  • Experience improving testing standards through approaches such as TDD, BDD, load, stress, chaos, invariant, or mutation testing.
  • Experience working in a highly regulated industry, such as financial services.
  • Proven success leading large, cross-pillar technical initiatives.
  • Strong written communication skills and a habit of creating durable, useful artifacts.
  • A leadership style that empowers others rather than creating dependency.
  • A strong quality bar for AI-generated output.

Travel Requirements & Working Conditions

  • Up to 10% travel for team jams and internal developer conference
  • Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely, not in a Workiva office

How You’ll Be Rewarded

✅ Salary range in the US: $177,000.00 - $290,000.00

✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually

✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire

✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package

The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.

Why Join Workiva

Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.

At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.

Combining strong writing and creativity with excellent project management and organization, the Donor Communications Specialist manages and writes communications to support Principal Gifts fundraising, including factsheets, reports, proposals, presentations, website copy and scripts. They help coordinate cross-functional teams, provide guidance and serve as a resource for communicating TNC’s 2030 goals and global priorities. The Donor Communications Specialist helps achieve the strategic priorities of the Donor Communications Team by collaborating closely with other team members, especially the Associate Director and Director. This role will help respond strategically and flexibly to emerging organizational fundraising needs and opportunities, including supporting evolving communications across TNC’s global markets and corporate teams. They assist in developing and disseminating key organizational messages among other teams and program staff. They work in close cooperation with any or all of the following: Donor Communications Team and Donor Relations Team members, Fundraisers, Global Conservation program staff, senior leaders, legal and finance staff, donors, and designers, vendors and others as needed.

This role will have and maintain knowledge of donor communications tools and practices and apply that knowledge to the organization’s fundraising goals. They maintain relationships with closely aligned teams in Marketing, Development, Communications and Conservation to ensure consistency of organizational messaging and materials and to foster greater organizational collaboration.


Please submit a cover letter and resume. Only applications with cover letters will be considered.


This position is currently funded through September 29, 2027, but may be extended up to eight weeks.


We’re Looking for You:


Are you looking for work you can believe in? The Nature Conservancy (TNC) is a global conservation leader and one of the top fundraising charities in the United States. At TNC we strive to embody a work environment where you feel like you are making a difference every day.

By joining the Donor Communications Team, you will work with a talented team of communications professionals who help connect donors with TNC’s work in support of people and nature across the globe. We value emotional intelligence, flexibility and collaboration. We pride ourselves on being thought partners to the fundraisers and program staff we work with every day.

We’re looking for someone with exceptional writing, communication, collaboration and project management skills. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the mission of conservation by joining our team!


What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 3 years related experience or equivalent combination.
  • Experience writing or editing newsletters, magazines, annual reports, website stories, donor profiles, presidential acknowledgment letters, campaign brochures, funding proposals, fact sheets, presentations and/or equivalent.
  • Experience generating reports and analyzing and interpreting data.
  • Experience managing multiple tasks with organization, accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Experience working across departments.
  • Experience, coursework or other training in principles and practices of relevant field.

Salary Information:


The starting pay range for a candidate selected for this position is generally within the range of $68,900 - $100,400. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. Where a successful candidate’s actual pay will fall within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including, for example, the candidate's location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. Please note countries outside the USA would have a different pay range in the local currency based on the local labor market, and not tied to USA pay or ranges. This position is currently funded through September 29, 2027, but may be extended up to eight weeks.

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with an 8% employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

jobs.description:
About ZAVA

We believe healthcare should be accessible, dependable and affordable for everyone. Now part of Hims & Hers Health, Inc., one of the fastest-growing digital health companies in the world, we’re entering an exciting new chapter as we expand our reach and accelerate our impact.

Our team of Doctors, Engineers, Patient Care Advisors, Pharmacists, Marketers, Product Managers, UX Designers, Commercial, and Operations Specialists work together to build digital healthcare that truly fits around our patients’ lives.

The pandemic changed how people access care, and we’ve led the way by providing over 14 million consultations across the UK, Germany, France, Spain, and Ireland. More patients than ever turn to us for help with weight loss and other conditions that can be safely treated online. We’re evolving our service to make care even more personal, supportive and effective.

We’re doing more than providing healthcare. We’re empowering people to take control of their health, and with the support of Hims & Hers, we’re scaling our vision to become a global leader in digital healthcare.

About the role

This role primarily focuses on supporting patients accessing weight management treatment, including assessing suitability for GLP-1 medications, reviewing ongoing treatment and prescribing safely in line with national guidance and ZAVA's clinical protocols.

Alongside weight management, you'll also provide care across a range of other conditions that can be safely managed online through our asynchronous platform.

This is an opportunity to practise medicine differently. Rather than conducting scheduled telephone or video consultations, you'll review structured online consultations, communicate with patients through secure messaging and make autonomous, evidence-based clinical decisions. Synchronous consultations are only required where clinically appropriate.

Beyond patient care, you'll work collaboratively with colleagues across Clinical, Product, Engineering, Operations, Patient Care and Commercial teams to improve clinical pathways, develop new services and enhance the patient experience.

Key accountabilities

Deliver safe, evidence-based patient care

  • Review and assess asynchronous patient consultations, primarily relating to weight management, alongside other digital healthcare services.

  • Assess patient suitability for GLP-1 therapies and other treatments in accordance with clinical guidelines and prescribing protocols.

  • Request additional clinical information where required to support safe prescribing decisions.

  • Prescribe medication safely and appropriately in line with GMC guidance, UK legislation and ZAVA clinical protocols.

  • Monitor ongoing treatment through follow-up consultations and support patients throughout their treatment journey.

Maintain clinical excellence

  • Apply evidence-based medicine and sound clinical judgement consistently.

  • Participate in clinical governance, audit and quality improvement activities.

  • Contribute to the review and development of clinical guidelines and prescribing pathways.

  • Support the delivery of safe, high-quality digital healthcare.

Help shape the future of digital healthcare

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Patient Care and Operational teams to improve the patient experience.

  • Provide clinical input into the development of new treatments, services and digital products.

  • Identify opportunities to improve clinical pathways and service delivery while maintaining the highest standards of patient safety.

Learn and collaborate

  • Participate in regular clinical meetings, teaching sessions and peer learning.

  • Engage in continuing professional development and digital healthcare training.

  • Share knowledge, expertise and best practice across the wider clinical team.

What we're looking for

Essential

  • Fluent German & English, written & verbal.

  • Based in the UK or selected EU countries with the right to work in the country based.

  • GMC and/or IMC registration with a licence to practise.

  • Qualified GP or Medical Doctor with post-qualification working experience.

  • Excellent understanding of evidence-based medicine and safe prescribing.

  • Excellent written communication skills and the ability to communicate clearly and compassionately with patients.

  • Comfortable making autonomous clinical decisions within a remote, digital environment.

  • Highly organised, detail-oriented, and able to manage workload efficiently.

  • Confident using digital platforms and electronic clinical systems.

  • A genuine interest in innovation and improving healthcare through technology.

Desirable

  • MRCGP, ICGP membership, or membership of a recognised College of General Practitioners.

  • Up-to-date training on safeguarding of vulnerable adults and children.

  • Experience supporting patients with obesity or weight management.

  • Familiarity with GLP-1 therapies and obesity management guidance.

  • Experience working in digital healthcare or telemedicine.

  • Experience managing asynchronous consultations.

  • Experience working within protocol-driven prescribing pathways.

  • Experience contributing to clinical governance or guideline development.

  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and MacOS.

  • Fluency in French or Spanish.

Life at ZAVA

At ZAVA, you'll enjoy the flexibility of remote-first working while remaining part of a collaborative, supportive clinical team. We invest in your development through regular teaching sessions, protected learning opportunities, and ongoing clinical collaboration. You'll have the autonomy to practise medicine differently, with the technology, tools, and support needed to deliver exceptional patient care from wherever you work best.

jobs.excerpt: About InvestEngineWe're a London-based fintech on a mission to make ETF investing simple and accessible.
jobs.description:
About InvestEngine

We're a London-based fintech on a mission to make ETF investing simple and accessible. Over 150,000 clients have trusted us with over £3.5 billion in assets — and we're just getting started.
We've been featured by MoneyWeek, Finder and Forbes, and we're growing fast with big ambitions.

About the role

InvestEngine is growing fast, and so is our engineering team. That means more infrastructure to run, more services to keep healthy and more requests from the people who build on top of it. We're adding a Middle SRE / DevOps Engineer to the DevOps team to keep our cloud platform safe, observable and reliable day to day, and to make it a little better every week.

You'll join a small, senior team, report to the DevOps Team Lead and get hands-on onboarding from experienced engineers. Our platform runs mainly on AWS, with some GCP. This is a hands-on role with no people management. It suits someone who cares what happens to a system after the change is shipped, not just whether the ticket is closed.

What you'll do

  • Run and maintain our cloud infrastructure, mainly on AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, Route 53, CloudFront), with some GCP.

  • Carry out planned maintenance: OS patching, updates and upgrades, backup checks and audit checks.

  • Verify that MySQL backups actually restore and that failover works — safely, without putting production at risk.

  • Look after monitoring and logging in Grafana and ELK: tune alerts, cut noise and turn signals into action.

  • Handle requests from developers, Operations and our managed service partner, including access and permissions.

  • Automate repetitive work with Python and Bash, and manage configuration with Ansible and Terraform.

  • Take part in incident response and follow-ups, and help prevent the same issue from happening twice.

  • Grow into owning a defined part of our infrastructure end to end.

Roughly 60% of your time goes to planned maintenance and improvements, and up to 40% to incoming requests. Coding is limited to infrastructure as code and automation scripts.

Your first 3 months

  • Weeks 1–2: onboarding, access and security training, runbook review, your first supervised low-risk change and shadowing incident response.

  • Month 1: handle routine maintenance on your own and fix at least one documented operational gap.

  • Months 2–3: own an agreed area of the infrastructure and ship at least one meaningful reliability, visibility or automation improvement.

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with cloud and Linux infrastructure in production (web products or similar).

  • Practical AWS experience: you can operate and troubleshoot core services, networking and permissions.

  • Confident with Docker: runtime, resources, logs and health checks.

  • Experience with Ansible for repeatable, idempotent configuration.

  • Monitoring and logging with Grafana and ELK — you know the difference between a signal and noise.

  • Scripting in Python and/or Bash to automate operational work, with safety checks built in.

  • MySQL in high-availability setups: backups, restores, replication and failover.

  • A safety-first approach to production changes: plan, validate, roll back and escalate when needed.

  • Ownership of what you run after it ships, plus clear written and spoken communication.

  • English at B2 level or higher and fluent Russian.

  • Availability during UK working hours, and readiness to help with rare out-of-hours incidents.

You don't need an "SRE" job title. Strong Linux/UNIX administrators who meet these requirements are very welcome to apply.

Nice to have

  • Terraform (working with existing modules is enough; you won't need to build them from scratch).

  • Kubernetes.

  • GCP or other cloud providers.

  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines.

  • Cloud security best practices.

  • Zabbix.

  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry (not required).

Our stack

Cloud: AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, Route 53, CloudFront), some GCP

Containers: Docker

Config & IaC: Ansible, Terraform

Observability: Grafana, ELK, Zabbix

Data: MySQL (HA setups)

Automation: Python, Bash

What we offer

  • Real impact early on: you'll own part of the platform that thousands of investors rely on.

  • Room to grow towards Senior SRE, with support from experienced DevOps engineers.

  • A say in how we run and improve our infrastructure.

  • A modern cloud stack and time set aside for improvements, not just firefighting.

  • Fully remote work with UK-hours overlap.

  • Unlimited vacation.

  • A friendly, supportive engineering team.

Hiring process

  1. HR interview with the Talent team

  2. Gamified cognitive assessment

  3. Technical interview with the DevOps team

  4. Final conversation with the CTO
