jobs.excerpt: Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better.
jobs.description:
Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. As Principal, Marketing Measurement, you'll lead the evolution of how HubSpot measures and optimizes its marketing measurement and investments — building the measurement infrastructure and decision-making framework that enables confident capital allocation decisions across organic, paid, owned, and earned channels.

HubSpot operates a significant and growing marketing presence across organic channels, paid media, a robust content and media network, and earned and owned activations. As we scale through brand-led, multi-channel demand creation, we're building the capability to understand what drives incremental growth across all marketing levers and translate those insights into smarter investment decisions. This role leads that work, working closely with cross functional teams across Marketing, Finance, Data Science, Engineering, and Product — combining marketing mix modeling, incrementality testing, multi-touch and modernized attribution, and predictive forecasting into a unified measurement capability that serves Marketing and Finance alike.

This is a high-visibility role for someone who combines deep measurement expertise with the strategic instincts to connect analytical rigor to the decisions that matter most.

What You'll Do

Measurement Strategy & Attribution

  • Deep understanding of full funnel Marketing strategy and techniques.
  • Own and evolve the marketing measurement framework across organic, paid, owned, Brand, LLM/AEO, media/creators, and earned channels — establishing a single, consistent view of how marketing investment drives revenue.
  • Own and develop how marketing tracks full funnel attribution across the buyer journey across all channels and touchpoints.
  • Modernize attribution methodology — moving beyond last-click toward view-based, multi-touch, and buying-group-aware models that capture the full influence of marketing activity on the path to revenue.
  • Develop executive-ready reporting and performance narratives that connect marketing investment to revenue outcomes, enabling capital allocation decisions with confidence.

Marketing Mix Modeling & Incrementality

  • Build and operate Marketing Mix Models that quantify the marginal ROI of investment across channels — enabling evidence-based scenario planning and capital allocation between paid, owned, and earned.
  • Establish and scale an incrementality testing program — designing holdout methodology, running causal experiments, and translating results into investment recommendations.
  • Partner with Marketing and Finance leadership to move budget conversations from channel-by-channel negotiation toward joint, evidence-based investment planning.

Predictive Analytics & Forecasting

  • Build and operationalize predictive LTV models that connect upstream marketing signals to downstream revenue outcomes — enabling spend decisions grounded in expected long-term customer value.
  • Develop multi-horizon revenue forecasting capabilities that translate real-time marketing indicators into expected ARR outcomes, giving Marketing and Finance a continuously updated view of performance.
  • Drive the build vs. buy roadmap for predictive tooling — evaluating vendor solutions, managing external partnerships, and defining where proprietary models create lasting advantage.

Data Science Leadership

  • Lead and direct data science execution toward measurement priorities — maintaining the technical depth to design experiments, validate methodology, and hold quality bar on outputs.
  • Advance AI and machine learning applications across measurement, attribution, targeting, and forecasting to improve the speed and accuracy of marketing decision-making.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years in marketing analytics or marketing data science.
  • Deep understanding of Marketing strategy and how it’s developed and executed on to inform and build build the right measurement approach behind it.
  • Deep expertise in Marketing Mix Modeling and incrementality testing — hands-on experience building or operationalizing these capabilities and connecting outputs to capital allocation decisions.
  • Experience building predictive LTV models and multi-horizon revenue forecasting — connecting leading marketing indicators to expected downstream revenue outcomes.
  • Experience building or implementing multi-touch attribution models to measure impact across a B2B SaaS buyer’s journey.
  • Track record of building a trusted Finance partnership — developing shared measurement frameworks that drive budget decisions, not just reporting.
  • Strong technical fluency — able to design experiments, validate data science outputs, and direct execution teams effectively.
  • Experience with modern, multi-touch attribution approaches across paid, owned, and earned channels, including view-based and buying-group-level measurement.
  • Excellent executive communication skills — able to translate complex causal findings into clear investment recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Marketing measurement and leadership experience at a B2B SaaS or high-growth technology company.
  • Data science background
  • Experience with Brand and LLM/AEO/GEO measurement techniques and attribution.
  • Background in or close partnership with paid media strategy and bidding optimization.
  • Experience evaluating and managing external measurement vendors — MMM platforms, incrementality tools, or LTV providers.
  • Familiarity with B2B buying-group measurement across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

Key Qualities We'll Test For

  1. Measurement depth and methodology rigor
  2. Finance partnership and decision-making impact
  3. Predictive analytics and forecasting capability
  4. Strategic operating model and build vs. buy judgment
  5. Technical fluency and data science collaboration
  6. Executive communication and strategic storytelling

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

$152,200—$243,500 USD

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

Nos segments d’activité complémentaires, Technologies, Produits et Services (TPS) et Livraison de Projet, transforment les innovations en réalité industrielle à grande échelle.

Animés par des valeurs de collaboration et d’excellence dans l’exécution, plus de 17 000 collaborateurs dans 34 pays s'engagent pour allier prospérité et durabilité en faveur d’un monde conçu pour durer.

Missions proposées :

Les unités flottantes offshore sont constituées de plusieurs modules.
Chacun de ces modules est un ensemble de Poutres, Colonnes tubulaires et Bracons horizontaux et verticaux tubulaires.

L’objectif de ces Bracons est d’assurer la stabilité de la charpente durant les différentes phases de la vie de la plate-forme.

L’objectif du stage est de faire une étude comparative d’un module, avec et sans les Bracons verticaux :

  • Impact sur la stabilité et les deflections
  • Impact sur le dimensionnement (tenue a la charge et fatigue)
  • Impact sur la constructabilité
  • Impact sur le poids et le centre de gravité

L’étude devra souligner les éventuels limitations et/ou champ d’application

Mjolnir Security is a Toronto-based Canadian cybersecurity firm founded in 2017, specializing in digital forensics and incident response (DFIR) and managed security services (MSSP). We have completed nearly 600 investigations for clients across financial services, critical infrastructure, automotive, and government. Our work spans breach response, threat intelligence, security operations, and a growing portfolio of proprietary security tooling. We are a lean, technically deep team, and we are expanding our commercial reach.

The Role

We are hiring a Business Development professional to open doors and grow our pipeline of cybersecurity engagements. You will be the first commercial point of contact for prospective clients and partners, qualifying opportunities, building relationships, and moving deals forward alongside our technical leadership. This is a fully remote role. You can work from anywhere you are legally eligible to work, and we offer a base pay plus commission structure for candidates who want upside tied to results. You will need to speak the language of both buyers and engineers, so a working grasp of the cybersecurity and broader technology landscape is essential.

What You'll Do

  • Identify and research prospective clients across our target sectors and build a qualified pipeline
  • Run outbound outreach by email, phone, and LinkedIn, and respond to inbound inquiries
  • Qualify opportunities, understand client security needs, and map them to our DFIR, MSSP, and tooling offerings
  • Book and lead discovery conversations, bringing in technical leadership when deals warrant it
  • Maintain accurate records of activity and pipeline in our CRM
  • Help shape proposals, quotes, and follow-ups, and move deals through to close
  • Represent Mjolnir clearly and credibly in writing and conversation, including with technical buyers
  • Feed market and competitor insight back to leadership to sharpen our positioning

What You Bring

  • Excellent written and spoken English, with clear, professional, and persuasive communication
  • A solid understanding of the cybersecurity and technology landscape: common threats, services like DFIR and managed detection, and how security buyers think
  • Proven experience in business development, sales, or a comparable client-facing commercial role
  • The ability to run outreach independently, stay organized, and manage a pipeline without close supervision
  • Comfort working remotely and overlapping with core hours of 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Toronto time (Eastern), regardless of where you are based
  • Strong listening skills and genuine curiosity about client problems
  • Legal eligibility to work in your location and to be engaged by a Canadian company

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience selling cybersecurity, IT, or professional services
  • An existing network in financial services, critical infrastructure, automotive, or government
  • Familiarity with CRM and sales tooling, and with structured outbound campaigns
  • A relevant technical or security certification, or a background that lets you go deeper with technical buyers
  • Additional languages useful for reaching target markets

Compensation and Logistics

  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere you are legally eligible to work. Our ideal candidate is based in North America, South America or Europe, which aligns well with our core hours.
  • Base pay plus commission. We offer a base salary with uncapped commission tied to results, and we are open to discussing the mix that fits your situation.
  • Core hours: you must be available and overlapping from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM Toronto time (Eastern), so plan for that overlap wherever you are based.
  • Engagement type and currency will be confirmed based on your location and eligibility.

The opportunity:

The best events feel effortless. Making them that way is where you come in. As Events & Conventions Coordinator, Corwin, you'll bring Corwin Institutes, conferences, conventions, and webinars to life for educators, school leaders, and district partners. You'll keep in-person, virtual, and hybrid events on track, from registration and travel to vendors, materials, and onsite support. And you'll team up with Marketing, Sales, Editorial, and Operations to turn every event into new connections, visibility for Corwin's books and professional learning, and real opportunities for Sales. If you love turning a long checklist into a memorable experience, we'd love to hear from you, whatever path brought you here.

What you will help achieve:

  • Events that feel organized, welcoming, and worth attending, from the first invite to the final follow-up.

  • More educators discovering Corwin books, authors, and professional learning services.

  • Leads and insights that turn into timely sales conversations.

  • Better events every time, shaped by attendee feedback and results.

What you will do:

  • Coordinate logistics for in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, including venues, registration, travel, catering, audiovisual needs, and vendors.

  • Keep calendars, timelines, checklists, schedules, and run-of-show documents current.

  • Partner with the Director of Events to manage details and communications for authors, speakers, presenters, and facilitators.

  • Create event materials, signage, and attendee communications with Marketing and Design, and promote events through email, social, web, and Cvent.

  • Plan trade show and convention booths, shipping, materials, product orders, staffing schedules, and author signings.

  • Help weave Corwin books and professional learning services into conference programming and customer engagement.

  • Capture leads, keep attendee and prospect data accurate in the CRM, and prepare event briefs and attendee lists that help Sales follow up fast.

  • Track expenses and invoices, and manage book shipments and supplies with Warehouse, Customer Service, and Operations.

  • Provide onsite support at major events, solving issues so attendees, presenters, and colleagues have a great experience.

  • Share registrations, attendance, feedback, and results in post-event reports, and keep partners updated on progress and open items.

What you will bring:

  • 1–3 years of experience supporting events, conferences, webinars, trade shows, or marketing programs, in any industry.

  • Strong organization, attention to detail, and reliable follow-through.

  • Experience with event logistics such as registrations, vendors, travel, or expense tracking.

  • The ability to juggle multiple projects, meet deadlines, and adapt when priorities shift.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, plus a collaborative, customer-focused approach.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and comfort learning registration, CRM, email marketing, or project management tools.

Helpful, but not essential:

  • Experience in K-12 education, educational publishing, education technology, or professional learning.

  • Familiarity with conferences for educators, school administrators, and district leaders.

  • Experience with event promotion, lead capture, CRM updates, or sales follow-up.

  • A degree in marketing, communications, event management, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • An interest in events that share books, educational resources, or professional learning.

Work and travel:

Expect to travel about 4–6 weeks a year for conventions, Corwin Institutes, and other company events. Some events may include evening or weekend work.

Why join Sage?

  • Work with colleagues who care about education, evidence, and helping ideas reach the people who need them.

  • Contribute in a collaborative, international organization with room to learn, grow, and shape how we work.

  • Access a comprehensive benefits package.

An inclusive opportunity

We know that strong candidates do not always meet every preferred qualification. If this role interests you and you can demonstrate many of the capabilities described, we encourage you to apply. We value transferable experience, different career paths, and the perspectives people bring from varied backgrounds and communities.

Sage is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the process, please let the Talent Acquisition team know.

Sage is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on role-related qualifications, skills, experience, and business needs.

How to apply

Ready to create events educators remember? Apply through Sage Careers and share a resume that highlights the events and programs you've helped bring to life. Not sure you meet every requirement? Apply anyway. We'd love to learn what you'd bring.

If you have a disability and you need any support during the application process, please contact All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

Pay Transparency & Benefits Package:

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect. Sage is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer.

Compensation at Sage is influenced by several factors, including but not limited to skill set, nature and level of experience, qualifications, and other relevant considerations. Please note that the compensation details listed in U.S. role postings reflect the base salary only and do not include bonuses or benefits. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range and additional aspects of the compensation/benefits package for this position during the hiring process. If your desired salary falls outside of this range, we hope you'll still apply as there may be other positions that better align.

In addition to compensation, Sage offers a highly competitive and comprehensive PPO medical, dental, and vision care benefits package with SAGE covering most of the premium costs. Unique program benefits that support a healthy life, a company-sponsored anniversary trip every 5 years, a 401(k)-matching program of 100% up to 5% of pay, and other significant meaningful benefits. In alignment with our value for education, Sage offers financial support for bachelor's and graduate-level degree programs as well as learning for personal interest.

Sage offers freedom and autonomy in your day-to-day with hybrid or remote work, depending on the role. Join the nearly 2,000 Sage employees worldwide who deliver products and services that serve to fulfill our noble goal of education and dissemination of knowledge globally. We’d love to meet you!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Sage Publishing is committed to being an inclusive employer where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect, regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marriage and partnership status, pregnancy and parental responsibilities, race, religion and belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

We believe that diversity is a cornerstone of a vibrant culture. We want Sage to be an organization where the most talented staff and high-potential staff are recruited, have the opportunity to grow, and want to work. We strive to achieve a better representation of diverse talent at all levels, including leadership, across our workforce.

jobs.excerpt: About the Company In the coming decades, demand for critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt will continue to grow.
jobs.description:
About the Company

In the coming decades, demand for critical minerals such as copper, lithium, and cobalt will continue to grow. These minerals are needed to build electric infrastructure, vehicles, data centers, and electronics. However, the mining industry is making 10x fewer discoveries per dollar spent on exploration compared to 30 years ago because the easy-to-find, near surface deposits have largely been discovered.

KoBold was founded to be the first AI native mineral exploration, mine development, and technology development company. Our goal is to turn mineral exploration into a repeatable science to discover the minerals the world needs—by integrating artificial intelligence, human intelligence, and new technology. Our multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, engineers, and geologists work together to build data systems, design new sensors, and establish industry-leading workflows to develop and test subsurface predictions on our exploration projects.

Our first discovery, Mingomba, is a high-grade copper deposit in Zambia, found after spending materially less than industry average. We are developing Mingomba with the same technical rigor that we apply to exploration. The Mingomba team brings together mine and processing engineers, geologists, data scientists, software engineers, and community, health & safety, construction, and operations specialists. By combining industry knowledge and cutting edge technology, we are developing Mingomba into a world class project that has safer and more predictable outcomes for ourselves, partners, and communities. It is expected to create thousands of good jobs for generations.

KoBold runs exploration programs in eight countries, all with the potential for another discovery.

KoBold is privately held; investors include institutional asset managers T. Rowe Price and Canada Pension Plan Investments; technology venture capitalists Andreessen Horowitz, Breakthrough Energy Ventures, BOND Capital, Durable Capital, StepStone, and Standard Investments; and strategic natural resources companies BHP and Mitsubishi.

About the Role

In the role of Field Operations Lead, you will plan and execute our field activities in Sweden to meet our business objectives without causing harm to our people, our contractors and partners, or the communities and environments where we operate. You will report to our Field Operations Director North America & Europe and other members of the operations and exploration team. Your primary responsibility will be to serve as the leader of field operations for 1–3 projects per year across Sweden and potentially other Nordic or European jurisdictions.

Responsibilities

Plan

  • Lead planning of complex exploration projects and moderate-scale development programs in Sweden, including drilling campaigns, electromagnetic surveys, and reconnaissance programs
  • Lead 1–3 concurrent projects of varying size, complexity, and jurisdiction, with accountability for planning and execution
  • Lead procurement strategies: contractor selection, bid evaluation, benchmarking, and contract administration for Sweden-based programs
  • Develop detailed project-level risk and hazard identification, risk assessments, mitigation plans, and critical control implementation, with particular attention to Swedish winter construction conditions
  • Lead project kick-offs with integrated teams and contractors, covering scope, execution strategy, and risk management
  • Contribute collaboratively to data collection planning during Phase 4a of the Exploration Project Lifecycle
  • Generate creative field operations scenarios outside conventional boundaries that lead to efficient programs

Execute

  • Lead end-to-end execution of assigned projects from mobilization through demobilization and closure
  • Provide strong leadership during changing field conditions, including Arctic and sub-Arctic weather events
  • Track and forecast production rates, spend profiles, and resource requirements
  • Manage and direct all field activities: lead contractor performance evaluation, feedback, and improvement
  • Maintain daily contact with and monitor the status of KoBold personnel and contractors while in the field; maintain close communication with the Project Geologist, Project Data Scientist, and the Senior Project Planner

Close

  • Lead site remediation and rehabilitation activities per Swedish regulatory standards
  • Lead contractor performance reviews and lessons learned to drive continuous improvement

Compliance and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Lead execution within regulatory compliance, monitoring, and reporting in accordance with Swedish mining and environmental legislation (including the Mining Act 621/2011 and Environmental Protection Act), EU regulations, and the practices of our joint venture partners
  • Ensure execution is done within Swedish permitting processes, land access agreements, community relations, third-party agreements, and any joint venture requirements
  • With leadership direction and support, represent KoBold Metals with local Swedish stakeholders, including communities, landowners, municipal authorities, and environmental bodies

Process Improvement and Mentoring

  • Create ways of working that allow us to continue to work more effectively and to be nimble so that we can support machine-learning-driven dynamic field programs, where we adapt our plan based on the data we collect at each stage
  • Mentor Field Operations Supervisors: ensure field operations follows KoBold’s systems, practices, and leading industry standards

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 12 years of experience conducting field operations in mineral exploration and mining, oil and gas, or a related industry, with demonstrated progression in complexity and responsibility
  • Advanced knowledge of construction methodology, including winter and frozen-ground construction (tracks, pads, ice roads) relevant to Nordic operating environments
  • Advanced understanding of helicopter-supported exploration, including utilization optimization and emergency response considerations
  • Strong understanding of procurement processes: RFP development, bid evaluation, and contract administration
  • Strong understanding of rehabilitation and closure planning
  • Demonstrated commitment to health and safety standards, including incident management, root cause analysis, and corrective action implementation and verification
  • Strong conceptual knowledge of all HSE, Land and Permitting, Legal, and Business Development systems as applied to exploration projects
  • Ability to manage and supervise KoBold staff and contractors on all aspects of field activities, including complex and higher-risk field programs
  • Ability to design complex field programs including scope, cost estimates, risk assessments, procurement, and project execution plans
  • Ability to prepare complete and accurate deliverables based on the Exploration Project Lifecycle and synthesize findings for integrated project teams and leadership
  • Ability to work in remote and isolated locations for extended periods of time, including Swedish Norrbotten and other Nordic environments
  • A high degree of independence and the ability to work effectively with limited supervision
  • Must speak, read, and write in Swedish and English; additional language skills are of benefit
  • Valid First Aid Certification (Level 3 or Wilderness First Aid preferred)

Preferred

  • Recognized internally or externally as a subject matter expert in field operations across at least two operation types (e.g., drilling, EM surveys, civil works)
  • Material understanding of data science products (e.g., catchment analyses) and their appropriate uses in exploration
  • Experience with Swedish and/or Nordic regulatory frameworks governing exploration operations
  • Experience working on projects with dedicated exploration teams including both Geologists and Data Scientists, demonstrating sustained partnership and effective interdisciplinary collaboration
  • Familiarity with project management principles and managing projects remotely across multiple jurisdictions
  • Experience with logistics tied to complex remote operations in cold-weather environments, including helicopter, weather, camps, chartered flights, and drilling operations
  • Finnish or other Nordic language skills are an asset

What We Value

  • Sustained partnership with exploration teams, including both Geologists and Data Scientists, on one or more exploration projects
  • Effective communication with team members across Geology, Data Science, HSE, Aviation, Legal, Community Relations, and Land and Permitting
  • Perpetuating KoBold’s ethical standards through your own actions and in communicating with others
  • Leading constructive field operational dialogue with colleagues; offering ideas freely and being willing to be wrong
  • Receiving constructive and critical feedback well and providing constructive input and guidance to others
  • Recognizing and elevating the team’s contributions, both in the field and to leadership, reinforcing a culture where strong work is visible and valued
  • Interest in contributing broadly to the success of the company and eagerness to pitch in where needed

What to Expect

Joining KoBold means getting the opportunity for hands-on exposure to our exploration projects around the world. All employees are expected to travel to project sites, with a minimum of one week per year. Field-facing and technical roles spend significantly more time in the field.

KoBold Metals is an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunities for people of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

This position is a Full-time Contract role.

Location: KoBold is a remote-first workplace. All candidates should be legally authorized to work in one of the following countries: Sweden or Finland.

Compensation ranges are listed in USD. If you are based outside the US, the range may not translate directly: US pay reflects a different market with different competitive dynamics, so we benchmark roles against the local market rather than converting the listed figure.

Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking an Incident Commander (Tier 3) to join our rapidly growing team!

Named one of the Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Location: This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Eligibility Requirements: U.S. Citizenship is required due to federal contract obligations, along with the ability to successfully pass a federal background investigation. Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.

*MUST HAVE one of the following ACTIVE certifications: CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional) certification from ISC2, plus GCIH (GIAC Certified Incident Handler) or an equivalent relevant incident response, digital forensics, or cybersecurity certification.

As cybersecurity incidents exceed the capabilities and scope of Tier 2 operations, the Tier 3 Incident Commander serves as the senior operational lead responsible for coordinating advanced incident response, driving resolution, and ensuring effective communication across stakeholders. The Tier 3 Incident Commander leads a 24x7x365 incident coordination function, responding to escalated alerts, notifications, and incident reports. Responsibilities include establishing and maintaining incident situational awareness, tracking incident progression, coordinating response and remediation activities, facilitating recovery efforts, communicating with stakeholders, and delivering timely, accurate incident reporting.

The role requires the ability to assess complex cybersecurity events, analyze adversary motives, capabilities, and opportunities, and determine the potential impact, scope, and severity of an incident. The Incident Commander ensures that incident reports are accurately documented in the incident tracking system, coordinates with reporting entities to validate information and establish a comprehensive understanding of the event, and identifies additional investigative, containment, remediation, or recovery actions required to achieve resolution.

The Tier 3 Incident Commander must possess extensive knowledge of cybersecurity incident response, anomaly detection and analysis, security log analysis, digital forensics, threat vectors, and adversary tactics and techniques. The individual must be able to interpret technical findings, assess incident reports, exercise sound judgment, and direct or coordinate appropriate response activities based on established procedures and incident requirements. The role also requires strict adherence to standard operating procedures (SOPs), organizational policies, and established escalation, notification, and reporting protocols, including the timely notification and communication of incidents to Federal leadership.

Required technical expertise includes a strong working knowledge of Splunk Security Information and Event Management (SIEM), Microsoft Defender Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR), Palo Alto Networks Cortex XSOAR, and supporting digital forensic and incident response tools.

Required Experience:

  • Minimum of 7 years of relevant professional experience, or a bachelor’s degree with at least 3 years of relevant experience.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen and able to complete a federal background investigation for a High-Risk Public Trust position, including applicable credit checks.
  • Must hold CISSP certification from ISC2, plus GCIH (GIAC Certified Incident Handler) or an equivalent relevant incident response, digital forensics, or cybersecurity certification.
  • Extensive experience managing cybersecurity incidents, performing advanced incident triage, coordinating response activities, and driving investigations through resolution.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Security Operations Center (SOC) operations, threat hunting, intrusion detection and prevention, security event monitoring, and incident detection and response.
  • Expert knowledge of TCP/IP protocols, network traffic analysis, intrusion detection and prevention systems (IDS/IPS), and security log analysis, including the ability to distinguish genuine threats from false positives.
  • Experience with endpoint security, antivirus, endpoint detection and response (EDR), host-based intrusion detection, firewalls, proxies, web application firewalls (WAF), and other enterprise security solutions, including FireEye products.

We are seeking a Cardiac Rehabilitation Group Educator to lead engaging virtual education sessions for patients participating in our cardiac rehabilitation program. The ideal candidate has a clinical or health education background, experience teaching or presenting to groups, and the ability to create an interactive and supportive learning environment for patients with varying learning styles.

  • Incorporate light guided stretches or simple exercises when appropriate to reinforce educational concepts.
  • Create a supportive and inclusive learning environment that encourages patient engagement and questions.
  • Monitor class participation and patient engagement.
  • Communicate any patient concerns or questions to the care team as needed.
  • Maintain professionalism and follow program guidelines for virtual class facilitation.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience teaching, facilitating, or presenting clinical educational content to groups
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Comfortable speaking to and engaging groups in a virtual environment
  • Ability to explain health concepts in clear, patient-friendly language
  • Comfortable leading light stretches or basic exercises during education sessions
  • Ability to engage patients with different learning styles

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in one of the following fields:
    • Exercise Physiology
    • Cardiac Rehabilitation
    • Nursing
    • Health Coaching
    • Nutrition / Dietetics
    • Health Education
    • Kinesiology
  • Experience working with cardiac patients or chronic disease populations
  • Familiarity with cardiac rehabilitation or preventive health programs
  • Experience teaching virtual or online classes

Skills and Competencies:

Successful candidates will demonstrate:

  • Excellent public speaking and teaching ability
  • Strong patient engagement skills
  • Ability to simplify complex medical concepts
  • Comfort leading interactive group discussions
  • Ability to guide simple stretches or exercises safely
  • Strong virtual communication skills

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys teaching, motivating patients, and creating engaging learning experiences while helping individuals improve their heart health and recovery after cardiac events.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Protocol Engineer to join our Rollup team. This is a hands-on, full-time engineering role focused on building and scaling our Bitcoin-secured Layer 2 rollup on Rootstock. This is a protocol role: you’ll work directly on the chain on topics such as sequencing, block derivation, consensus and finality, bridge and proof system. You will join a small team of senior engineers with high ownership. You will design, build, test and operate core components, and you will take part in the technical decisions of the project.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, build and maintain core protocol components: execution and consensus clients, sequencer, block derivation and batch submission to the parent chain.
  • Work on the bridge and the proof system: deposits, withdrawals, cross-layer messages and state validation.
  • Maintain a large open source codebase: learn how its parts work together, make changes that are safe for a live network, and keep the code easy to evolve.
  • Review code, write design docs and RFCs, and take part in architecture decisions.
  • Test and debug a distributed system: unit to adversarial tests, local devnets, reorgs, node desync and performance problems.
  • Deliver and operate releases on public chains: upgrades, hard forks, monitoring and incidents, etc.
  • Collaborate with Product, DevOps and Security to plan and ship each release.

WHAT YOU BRING

Must have

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering, with at least 2 years in blockchain core or protocol development (node clients, consensus, etc.).
  • Solid production experience in mainstream languages (for example Go, Rust or Java).
  • Deep knowledge of blockchain internals and the EVM: consensus, P2P networking, state and storage, transaction lifecycle, JSON-RPC, etc.
  • Experience working effectively in large codebases you did not write.
  • AI-assisted development is a core part of your work, while owning what you deliver.
  • Autonomy and ownership: you help define the work, not only execute assigned tasks.
  • Good English, spoken and written, since the team is international and remote.

Nice to have

  • Professional experience with Go and/or Rust.
  • Hands-on experience with Ethereum Layer 2 rollups (optimistic or ZK).
  • Understanding of rollup design: sequencing, data availability, derivation, finality, etc.
  • Contributions to open source blockchain clients or rollup stacks.
  • Experience with fault proof systems or validity proofs.
  • Knowledge of Bitcoin and EVM compatible chains.
  • Experience with Docker, cloud providers, Prometheus and Grafana.
  • Able to read and review Solidity (bridge and system contracts).

ROOTIES BENEFITS

At RootstockLabs, we don’t just offer a job, we offer a community. Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

  • Competitive compensation package and unique benefits designed to support your growth and well-being.
  • 100% Remote Work from Europe & Latin America, with access to global CoWorking spaces.
  • Work-Life Balance: Paid vacation and sick leave days
  • Continuous Learning: Access to training programs, language courses, and learning sponsorship annually.
  • Unique Projects: Work with cutting-edge blockchain technology in a global, diverse team.

ABOUT ROOTSTOCKLABS

RootstockLabs is a key contributor to Rootstock, Bitcoin's Financial Infrastructure for lending, yield, and onchain capital markets. We build and commercialize the institutional infrastructure that turns Bitcoin into productive capital.

  • What we do: Develop and commercialize Bitcoin-backed lending, tokenized real-world assets, and onchain financial strategies
  • Who we work with: Leading custodians, asset managers, and financial institutions
  • Why it matters: Rootstock is secured by 80%+ of Bitcoin's hash power and has run with 100% uptime since 2018 (bringing Ethereum-style programmability to the world's hardest money).

jobs.title: Collections and AR Specialist
jobs.excerpt: Collections is the core of this job.  You will own a portfolio of aging commercial accounts, find out why each one hasn't paid, and work it through to a verified resolution.
jobs.description:
Collections is the core of this job. You will own a portfolio of aging commercial accounts, find out why each one hasn't paid, and work it through to a verified resolution. You'll also answer live Finance calls and support routine AR work such as invoicing, payment application and payment plans.

We're looking for someone who takes initiative. Rather than just working through a call list, you'll dig into invoice histories, track down the right Accounts Payable contact, secure firm payment commitments, and coordinate with Sales, Customer Service and Customer Success to clear whatever is blocking payment. When a case needs escalation, you bring a recommendation with it.

Requirements

Collections and account management

  • Work a daily queue of calls, emails, voicemails and payment reminders, prioritizing by balance, aging, recoverability and promised-payment dates.
  • Investigate nonpayment using invoice histories, payment records, account notes and prior communication.
  • Find alternate AP contacts, billing departments and decision-makers when the first contact goes quiet.
  • Secure specific payment commitments (amounts and dates), follow up on missed promises, and negotiate within approval limits. You won't offer unauthorized discounts, credits, write-offs or terms.
  • Handle difficult accounts, multiple disputed invoices and conflicting records, and prepare documentation for third-party collection referrals.
  • Keep accurate Salesforce notes on every commitment, contact, deadline and next step.

Incoming calls and customer communication

  • Answer Finance and collections calls in English or Spanish, covering balances, invoices, billing questions and payment options.
  • Stay polite, patient, and professional, especially in tough conversations.
  • Verify recipients and account details before sharing financial information, and follow approved payment-handling procedures.
  • Return voicemails and emails on time and document every conversation.

Case ownership and collaboration

  • Own disputes, payment issues, suspensions and cancellations from investigation through verified resolution. A closed case or a sent follow-up doesn't count as resolved.
  • Work with Sales, Customer Service, Customer Success and Finance to remove payment barriers.
  • Escalate when needed with a recommended next step, and keep ownership until the issue is resolved or formally transferred.

Accounts Receivable support

  • Prepare, verify and send invoices with accurate customer data and payment terms.
  • Apply payments, research unapplied payments and invoice discrepancies, and assist with approved adjustments.
  • Set up and maintain payment plans.
  • Review daily AR, aging, payment-plan and suspended-account reports, flag exceptions and document follow-up.

What you bring

  • Proven commercial (B2B) collections experience, including account investigations, alternate-contact research, payment follow-up and dispute resolution. Experience collecting from US businesses is a strong plus.
  • Professional spoken and written English and Spanish, which we'll assess live.
  • Hands-on work with invoices, payments, balances, billing disputes and confidential customer financial information.
  • Strong active listening, customer service and tactful negotiation skills.
  • Resourcefulness and persistence: you look for the root cause and the right next step instead of just completing a list.
  • The ability to manage competing deadlines, document accurately and follow instructions without repeated reminders.
  • Ownership through to verified resolution, and good judgment about when to escalate.
  • Availability during US business hours, a reliable phone and internet connection, and a quiet, professional space for live calls.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce, Sage Intacct or Stripe
  • Subscription or service-based invoicing
  • Payment plans and AR reconciliation
  • Third-party collections referrals

Client-specific systems and processes will be trained.

Benefits

  • Join Our Dynamic Team: Experience our fun, inclusive, innovative culture that values your unique contributions and supports your professional growth.
  • Embrace the Opportunities: Seize daily chances to learn, innovate, and excel. Make a real impact in your field.
  • Limitless Career Growth: Unlock a world of possibilities and resources to propel your career forward.
  • Fast-Paced Thrills: Thrive in a high-energy, engaging atmosphere. Embrace challenges and reap stimulating rewards.
  • Flexibility, Your Way: Embrace the freedom to work from home or any location of your choice. Create your ideal work environment.
  • Work-Life Balance at Its Best: Say goodbye to stressful commutes and hello to quality time with loved ones. Achieve a healthy work-life integration to perform at your best.

About Shippo

At Shippo, our vision is bold and clear: we are the shipping layer of the internet. Our mission is to make every merchant successful through excellent shipping, delivering world-class logistics technology and infrastructure. We’re building the backbone of global e-commerce — connecting merchants to carriers worldwide through a single API and intuitive dashboard.

As a remote-first and globally distributed team, we believe flexibility fuels trust, autonomy, and performance. Our diverse perspectives — across continents, cultures, and time zones — drive our innovation and enable us to build solutions used by businesses everywhere. We invest in modern, scalable technology so our teams can build, ship, and iterate with confidence.

Your impact starts here: every person at Shippo plays a direct role in shaping the infrastructure that powers global commerce and makes shipping simpler for businesses around the world.

How we will deliver success together:

We are looking for a Strategic Partnerships Manager to join our dynamic and entrepreneurial team. You will own and lead some of our most strategic partnerships, in which you will lead all executive-level partner management, drive complex programs cross-functionally, establish and run partnership governance, and develop new initiatives to achieve strong commercial outcomes for Shippo . Your experience in e-commerce/marketplace platforms or fulfillment will set you up for success at Shippo and we would love to share the opportunity with you.

  • Analyze performance and present findings to clients, highlighting opportunities or introducing incremental programs. Contribute data-driven insights to support recommendations.
  • Leverage cross-functional support teams to ensure partners have access to the product experts and resources they need.
  • Develop renewal and product cross-sell/up-sell strategies and negotiate business terms on renewals and new agreements.

Your shipping requirements

  • Experience working with technology partners through integrations, product management, program management, and business development engagements

  • You are well-versed in advanced Excel (or SQL), Looker, or other Business Intelligence tools

What is in the Shippo Package?

  • Take-as-much-as-you-need vacation policy & flexible working hours

  • Fun team in person time through our Shippos Everywhere program which includes regular team and company off-sites throughout the year as well as local Shippos gatherings

Compensation

Our Compensation Shippolicy:

We believe compensation is a custom experience and are commited to fair and equitable compensation practices. The standard base pay range for this role is min is $130,000 to a max $175,900 annual salary (we tend to anchor our offers at the mid point $153,000). Since we are focused on hiring Shippos Everywhere, we have 2 US pay ranges, a standard compensation range for the majority of the US and a standard +1 compensation range for those who live in areas where the cost of labor is higher, such as NYC and California.

The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: financial budgets, work experience, training, transferable skills, business needs, and market value. The base pay salary ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future. Total compensation for this role will include, equity, medical, dental, vision and other benefits noted in our Shippos “package” section.

Sail through the process:

Here at Shippo, we celebrate inclusivity and are committed to creating equal access to opportunities for people from all backgrounds, perspectives and geographies. These values define who we are and everything we do. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. If you need assistance, or a reasonable accommodation during the application and recruiting process, please contact us at

jobs.description:
Not all heroes wear capes — but plenty of them use toilet paper

Want to challenge yourself at a purpose-led scale up AND make a difference in the world? Come join the revolootion!

Funny name, serious business

We are a leading eco-friendly household essentials business and we donate 50% of our profits to help everyone gain access to clean water and a toilet. As of June 2024, we’ve contributed over $20 million AUD to this mission. Basically, we’re really good at making it easy to do good.

We operate scaling businesses the UK, US, Australia and Canada. Our amazing team is based in Australia, the UK, the Philippines, China, and the US. Our 250+ people aim to make the biggest possible impact for people and the planet. Over the next 5-10 years, we’re hoping to increase our annual donation tenfold to get us closer to our dream of everyone in the world having access to clean water and sanitation services.

A bit about the role

As our AR & AP Lead, you’ll be the eyes and ears of our Number Scrunchers accounting function — driving accounts receivable and accounts payable operations day to day, in close partnership with your two direct reports (our AR Expert and AP Coordinator) and the wider Financial Operations team. You’ll keep our books accurate, our customers paying on time, and our suppliers paid on time, all so we can maximise the donations we’re able to make.

If you worked here this past month here are some things you might have been involved in

  • Pulled together the monthly AR ageing report for the CFO and exec team, with a clear plan to chase down aged amounts
  • Reviewed the weekly payments file (including the Tipalti funding summary) before it went out for approval
  • Flagged an “at risk” customer account early and looped in the customer-facing team for support
  • Helped close the books accurately and on time at month-end, escalating one risk early to the Head of Financial Operations
  • Worked with the AP Coordinator to tidy up a clunky step in the AP process

Let’s talk about you

Detail is your love language

You get real satisfaction from a reconciliation that ties out perfectly and a report that lands on the CFO’s desk without a single follow-up question. You’re equally comfortable rolling your sleeves up in the detail of a customer account and stepping back to build the KPIs and reporting that keep the whole team honest.

Calm under a closing calendar

Month-end doesn’t rattle you. You know how to keep AR and AP on track to a deadline, spot a risk early enough to actually do something about it, and communicate clearly with stakeholders when something needs to change.

A coach as much as a doer

You lead a small, tight-knit team and genuinely enjoy it — you give clear, kind feedback, help your people grow, and aren’t afraid of a difficult conversation when a process or a stakeholder relationship needs a repair job.

You give a crap.

Do you want your work to make the world a better place? Do you want to work with other people who feel the same way? What a coincidence — us too!

Why should you work with us?

First off, as a certified B Corp™, we work to make a difference every day while maintaining the high standards of social and environmental impact. We’re in very good company with other exceptional B Corps around the world.

We also believe that helping to make the world a better place should be rewarded accordingly – that’s why we offer competitive, market informed salaries, meaningful support towards healthcare for our team around the world, generous paid leave, tailored learning and development opportunities, and free toilet paper (yes, you read that right).

Our engagement surveys (thanks Culture Amp!) tell us that our team is really proud (over 90%) to work for Who Gives A Crap and, well, we couldn’t be more proud of that.

Have you made it this far?

If you’re still reading, we think there’s a strong chance you might be our kind of person. Here’s the thing, though — research suggests that 60% of women and underrepresented folks might have already talked themselves out of applying. Even if you don’t check every box above, we want to encourage you to introduce yourself. We believe a diversity of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger — and the stronger our team, the closer we are to delivering toilets and clean water for all.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

At Panopto, we are the most customer-centric learning technology company in the world. As the leader in visual and audio-based learning, we empower organizations to share knowledge effortlessly in a capture and post-capture world. We don’t just build software; we obsess over our users’ goals to deliver solutions that truly matter. Our mission is simple: to attract the brightest talent, people like you, to Elevate the Craft and do the most impactful work of your career.

To enhance our team, we are seeking an experienced Manager, Sales Operations who combines strong people leadership with a passion for operational excellence and continuous improvement. In this role, you will lead the team responsible for supporting our global sales organization throughout the quote-to-close lifecycle, including frontline sales support, deal desk, contracting, and order processing. You’ll play a key role in ensuring efficient day-to-day execution while proactively identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve the seller experience, and drive scalable operational improvements in partnership with Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams.

Position Summary

In this role, you will have the opportunity to do meaningful work in your career, elevating your craft while contributing to a team that values lifelong learning.

As a Manager, Sales Operations, you will lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for the day-to-day operational support of our sales organization. You'll oversee critical processes spanning sales inquiries, quoting, commercial approvals, contracting, and order processing, ensuring accurate and timely execution while maintaining appropriate commercial controls.

Beyond managing daily operations, you'll serve as a proactive partner to Sales Leadership, Business Systems, Finance, Legal, and Product, identifying operational bottlenecks, evaluating existing workflows, and driving improvements that enable our sales teams to work more effectively. You'll combine a hands-on understanding of sales operations with an analytical, solutions-oriented mindset to help build efficient, scalable processes that support revenue growth.

You will also have opportunities to contribute to other initiatives that directly advance our core values and support you in elevating your craft.

How You’ll Contribute

In this role, you will have the opportunity to…

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Sales Operations Managers and Specialists responsible for frontline sales support, deal desk, contracting, and order processing. Establish clear expectations, manage workload distribution, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • Oversee daily sales support operations, ensuring timely and effective resolution of sales representative inquiries related to quoting, Salesforce processes, commercial policies, and other operational needs. Establish clear escalation paths and SLAs to ensure consistent, high-quality support.

  • Manage deal desk operations and commercial approval workflows, ensuring adherence to established pricing policies, discounting guidelines, and approval matrices.

  • Partner with Sales Leadership and senior stakeholders to maintain and refine approval processes that balance deal velocity with appropriate governance.

  • Serve as the primary operational escalation point for non-standard commercial terms, discounting approvals, and order processing exceptions, collaborating with Finance, Legal, and Sales leadership.

  • Ensure accurate and timely sales order processing, including validation of executed agreements, opportunity, and order data, and required documentation. Partner with Finance and Accounting to support data flow for accurate invoicing, reporting, and downstream financial processes.

  • Proactively evaluate sales operations workflows, identify recurring bottlenecks, manual processes and sources of friction, and develop actionable recommendations to improve efficiency, accuracy, and the overall seller experience.

  • Establish, track, and maintain operational performance metrics, including request volumes, turnaround times, processing accuracy, and recurring issue trends. Regularly report operational insights, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities to Revenue Operations leadership.

  • Identify opportunities to leverage automation, AI, and existing technology capabilities to reduce administrative burden, streamline repetitive tasks, and improve the scalability of sales operations.

  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures, process documentation, and internal knowledge resources to promote consistency, enable team development, and support efficient onboarding and execution.

  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement and Sales Leadership to identify recurring knowledge gaps and opportunities for improved training, communication, or self-service resources that reduce unnecessary operational requests and improve sales team effectiveness.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 Months: Build strong relationships with your team, Sales Leadership, and cross-functional partners; develop a thorough understanding of existing quote-to-close processes and operational challenges; establish visibility into team performance and workload; and identify initial opportunities to improve efficiency and the seller experience.

Demonstrate progress in reducing unnecessary manual effort and improving the consistency and quality of sales support.

Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Panopto AI Use Policy:

Panopto’s AI Use Policy is committed to a hiring process that is thoughtful, fair, and centered on human connection. As artificial intelligence (AI) becomes more prevalent in the workplace, we believe that it is important to describe our use of AI in the hiring process, as well as outline to candidates what use of AI is and is not allowed. While AI can be a valuable tool, it cannot replace genuine human interaction or an individual’s unique perspective, experience, and voice.

Company Use of AI:

Panopto may utilize tools to enhance the efficiency, objectivity, and quality of our recruitment and evaluation process. These tools assist our team throughout the hiring lifecycle by focusing on four key areas:

  • Content Creation: Providing a starting point for crafting job descriptions and assisting in building tailored interview questions.

  • Resume Parsing: Analyzing candidate skillsets and resume alignment to efficiently identify qualified candidates.

  • Interview & Assessment Insights: Providing interview transcription, summarization, and identifying key insights from candidate assessments in relation to specific role requirements.

  • Data Organization: Organizing and storing information gathered during assessments to help our team make informed, data-driven decisions.

Ultimately, these tools are used to support—not replace—our team in assessing skills, generating insights, and identifying the best talent for Panopto.

To ensure fairness and transparency:

Human-Centric Decisions: Please be assured that AI tools are used to support our team, and all final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers. Panopto hiring teams will thoroughly review your application and assessment results. AI is not used to make final decisions regarding your candidacy.

Bias Mitigation: We are committed to algorithmic fairness. Our AI-assisted tools undergo regular independent audits to detect and mitigate bias, with the goal of keeping our processes equitable and inclusive. Our methodology aligns with global best practices and regional digital ethics standards to provide every candidate with a fair and merit-based evaluation.

Your Rights & Accommodations: We provide inclusive access for all applicants. If you require a reasonable adjustment due to a disability, or if you prefer a non-automated review of your application, please contact Panopto Talent Attraction. We respect your right to request human intervention; please note that opting for a manual review may impact the standard processing timeline.

Data Privacy and Security:

Your personal data and recordings are processed securely in compliance with global privacy and employment regulations (including EEOC, GDPR, and other local or regional privacy laws, as applicable).

To facilitate our recruitment and evaluation process, limited candidate data may be shared securely with trusted third-party vendors and service providers acting on our behalf. We retain candidate data only as long as necessary to fulfill the recruitment purpose or as required by applicable statutory retention periods. Once this purpose is met, or the retention period expires, your data is securely deleted or anonymized in accordance with our data governance policy.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

Use of AI:

Statement of Transparency:

At Panopto, we embrace the transformative power of AI to enhance productivity and learning. We believe in providing a level playing field where candidates can use modern tools to put their best foot forward, provided those tools support, rather than replace, their authentic voice and expertise. While we encourage the use of AI as a tool for growth and preparation, we require transparency and authenticity to ensure a fair evaluation for all.

Acceptable Use:

  • AI-Assisted Preparation: You are encouraged to use Generative AI (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini) as a mock interviewer or coach to refine your speaking points.

  • Research & Knowledge Gathering: Using AI to synthesize industry trends or company background is permitted and viewed as proactive preparation.

  • Career Guidance Tools: Simulation tools that help you practice the STAR method or identify skill gaps are acceptable.

Prohibited Use:

  • Live Interview Assistance: The use of real-time AI "teleprompters," live answer-generators, or deepfake audio/video during Panopto recordings or live sessions is strictly prohibited.

  • Plagiarized Work Samples: Any take-home assignments or portfolios must be your original work. While AI can assist in formatting or brainstorming, the core logic and execution must be yours.

Panopto has a zero-tolerance policy toward the misrepresentation of job-related skills. Consequences of using prohibited tools may result in my immediate disqualification from the hiring process, the withdrawal of any pending offer, or termination of employment if discovered after hire.

Verification of Experience:

To ensure the integrity of our hiring process and validate the skills demonstrated during your Panopto submission, Panopto may require the following "Proof of Experience":

  • Work Samples & Portfolios: Candidates may be asked to provide original work samples (e.g., code repositories, design portfolios, case studies) that pre-date the current application.

  • Digital Footprint & Professional Links: We may request links to professional profiles (e.g., LinkedIn, GitHub, Behance) to verify career trajectory and industry contributions.

Disclosures:

  • Live Validation: Any technical skill demonstrated in an asynchronous Panopto recording is subject to a live, "Human-in-the-Loop" technical assessment or deep-dive discussion.

  • Fraud Detection: Please be aware that we utilize metadata analysis and fraud detection tools to ensure the authenticity of all video submissions.

By submitting your application and participating in the recruitment process, you acknowledge and consent to Panopto's use of AI, as well as the acceptable and prohibited uses of AI as a candidate, as described above.

Panopto is dedicated to a fair and equitable hiring process for all candidates.

jobs.title: Sales Technology Enablement Specialist
jobs.excerpt: When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.
jobs.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Home Based, US


About the role

Sales Operations is looking for a commercially minded, technology savvy, hands-on teammate to help the Commercial Sales organization get more value from its technology, particularly AI-enabled tools. This role will focus on understanding how sales teams work, identifying practical ways technology can improve their effectiveness, and helping users confidently adopt those solutions.


A key area of focus will be the use Enterprise AI tools (Copilot, Claude, Glean, etc.): helping shape useful skills, agents, workflows, and data-access artifacts that make relevant information easier to find and insights easier to act on. The role will also support effective use of other approved commercial applications. The Analyst will own the business need, user experience, requirements, testing, and adoption; they will partner with Parexel Data & Technology (D&T) for citizen development as well as any custom work, integrations, or other effort requiring technical engineering.


Reporting to the Executive Director, Sales Operations, this person will translate ideas from the Commercial team into practical, supported ways of working. They will combine curiosity about AI with strong communication, follow-through, and a service mindset.

What you’ll do

  • Improve commercial effectiveness with technology. Spend time with Sales and Commercial users to understand their priorities and friction points, then recommend practical ways to improve preparation, research, account work, communication, and other sales activities.
  • Enable AI adoption. Help users apply Enterprise AI and other approved AI-enabled tools to real sales tasks. Develop examples, prompt guidance, short trainings, demonstrations, and office hours that make the tools approachable and useful.
  • Shape Enterprise AI experiences. Create and maintain Enterprise AI skills, agents, workflows, and artifacts using available tools’ capabilities. Help Sales users and managers access approved data, find relevant information, and surface useful trends, exceptions, or insights—with clear source context and appropriate access controls.
  • Coordinate with D&T when development is needed. Serve as the Sales Operations business partner for requests requiring custom development, integrations, or deeper technical changes. Provide clear requirements, represent the user perspective, coordinate decisions, and support business testing and rollout. This role does not own software engineering or custom technical development.
  • Support day-to-day use of Sales Technology. Provide first-line guidance for assigned commercial applications; help users navigate features, resolve common issues, and identify when a request should be routed to a platform owner, vendor, or D&T.
  • Coordinate business-side administration. Support appropriate user onboarding, access requests, license and usage coordination, documentation, and communications for assigned tools, working with platform owners and D&T as needed.
  • Test and improve user-facing solutions. Check workflows and outputs against realistic sales scenarios, gather feedback, identify gaps, and coordinate refinements. Make sure users understand an AI tool’s limitations and when to verify its output.
  • Promote responsible use. Follow company policies and requirements for data access, privacy, security, and approved use. Help users understand safe practices and escalate concerns through the right channels.
  • Measure adoption and value. Track user feedback, adoption, and practical outcomes where possible. Share what is working and recommend where to invest, improve, or stop.
  • Keep enablement materials current. Maintain clear, reusable guidance and examples so the Commercial team can find help and apply successful practices consistently.

What success looks like

  • Commercial users understand which enterprise approved AI-enabled tools and workflows can help them, and how to use them effectively in their work.
  • Enterprise AI experiences make approved information easier to access and help Sales users and managers surface relevant insights with clear source context.
  • High-value ideas are translated into defined business requirements and delivered through the appropriate platform capabilities or, when needed, in partnership with D&T.
  • New and improved capabilities are tested with users, supported with practical guidance, and adopted beyond one-off demonstrations.
  • Users receive timely, approachable support, and common questions are addressed through reusable enablement materials.
  • AI is used responsibly, with appropriate permissions, human judgment, and awareness of limitations.Improvements are prioritized based on user needs and evidence of adoption or business value.

What you bring

  • Typically 3–6 years of professional experience after completing formal education, ideally in sales support, Sales Operations, commercial enablement, business applications, or a related role.
  • A strong service orientation and the ability to build trust with sales users, understand how they work, and explain technology in clear, practical terms.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI and commercial technology, paired with persistence: you enjoy trying new approaches, learning from what does not work, and helping others find useful applications.
  • Experience supporting technology adoption, user training, business processes, or day-to-day use of commercial applications.
  • Strong communication, organization, and follow-through; able to manage several initiatives, keep stakeholders aligned, and close the loop with users.
  • Good judgment around data sensitivity, permissions, accuracy, and when AI-generated information needs human review.
  • Comfort translating business needs into clear requirements and collaborating with technical teams, without needing to be a software developer.

Especially relevant experience

  • Supporting a sales, commercial, or business team in adopting new tools or improving existing processes.
  • Using Enterprise AI or other AI tools to solve practical work or personal problems; creating useful skills, agents, workflows, or examples with available tools.
  • Building personal projects, experimenting with AI, or tinkering with tools because you are curious about what they can do. Home-automation projects are one possible example—not a requirement.
  • Training colleagues, writing user-friendly guidance, facilitating office hours, or providing front-line application support.
  • Partnering with technical teams to clarify business needs, test changes, and support rollout.

How you work

You are curious, persistent, and focused on the user. You enjoy exploring what technology can do, but you start with the business problem and care most about whether the solution helps the Commercial team. You communicate clearly, make technology approachable using real-world use cases, and follow through from idea to adoption.

Role details

  • Function: Sales Operations / Commercial Enablement
  • Reports to: Executive Director, Sales Operations
  • Experience level: Analyst / Associate; typically, 3–6 years of relevant professional experience; college degree
  • Primary focus: Commercial technology adoption and enablement, especially AI-driven capabilities in approved applications to be added

Benefits and Compensation

  • Health, Vision & Dental Insurance
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Vacation/Holiday/Sick Time
  • Flexible Spending & Health Savings Accounts
  • Work/Life Balance
  • 401(k) with Company match
  • Pet Insurance

For a complete list of benefits, please visit www.parexel.com/us-benefits.
