jobs.description:
Intelligence Center X is Siemens' platform for the agentic enterprise

The next wave of enterprise software isn't about writing more code — it's about giving organizations the tools to combine trusted data, AI, and applications into systems that can reason and act on their own. Intelligence Center X delivers that today, through five capabilities — an Enterprise Knowledge Graph, AI/ML, agentic application development, orchestration, and governance — that together move enterprises from static software to intelligent, autonomous systems.

For the customers we serve, that shift shows up in very concrete ways: engineers and data leaders who can finally find and trust the data buried across decades of enterprise systems; teams that go from idea to working application in days instead of quarters; and AI initiatives that move out of pilot purgatory and into production because the underlying data and governance can actually support them. Whether you're building this platform, proving its value to customers, or bringing it to market through our partner ecosystem, your work directly drives those outcomes for some of the most complex organizations in the world.

This is one of the most ambitious enterprise AI platforms in the market — built on decades of deep domain expertise across industries as varied as manufacturing, banking, insurance, financial services, and healthcare, and already running in production at real scale for organizations with some of the most demanding data and compliance requirements in the world. If you want to work at the intersection of enterprise AI, knowledge graphs, and agentic applications — with real customers and real production stakes, across nearly every major industry — this is where that work is happening.

Enterprise Account Executive, Heavy Equipment & Automotive

Siemens Digital Industries Software | Intelligence Center X (ICX)

Location: Remote, United States

Territory: Select Heavy Equipment & Automotive (HEAT) Accounts
Role Type: Individual Contributor, Enterprise Sales

Travel: Approximately 25% or as required

Help Industry Leaders Move from the Digital Enterprise to the Agentic Enterprise

The next era of enterprise AI will not be won by adding another disconnected model, dashboard, or pilot. It will be won by connecting trusted enterprise context to intelligence and transforming that intelligence into governed action across the systems and workflows that run the business.

At Siemens, we are helping leading industrial organizations make that transition through Intelligence Center X (ICX), our enterprise platform for building, deploying, and scaling industrial AI solutions.

About Siemens Intelligence Center X (ICX)

Siemens Intelligence Center X (ICX) is an enterprise platform designed to help organizations move from Context to Intelligence to Action in a secure, governed environment.

ICX combines:

  • Graph Studio to connect and contextualize enterprise data
  • AI Studio and Agent Builder to develop intelligent AI-powered experiences
  • App Studio, powered by Mendix, to rapidly build enterprise applications
  • Process orchestration and governance capabilities to automate and manage business operations at scale

ICX complements the systems customers already rely on, including PLM, ERP, MES, CRM, and enterprise data platforms. By connecting information across these environments, ICX provides AI with the business context needed to reason effectively and enables people and AI agents to drive measurable outcomes through applications and orchestrated workflows.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an accomplished Enterprise Account Executive to build and grow a portfolio of strategic Heavy Equipment and Automotive accounts across the United States.

This is a high-impact role focused on identifying, creating, and closing transformational platform opportunities. You will pursue net-new software and services revenue by helping customers solve mission-critical business challenges through industrial AI, enterprise knowledge graphs, intelligent applications, and agent-driven business processes.

Success requires a consultative seller who can create demand, engage senior executives, navigate complex organizations, and lead opportunities from initial insight through contract signature.

You will combine the agility of a growth business with Siemens' unmatched industry expertise, global customer relationships, and market-leading technology portfolio.

Why This Matters

Heavy Equipment and Automotive companies face increasing pressure to:

  • Accelerate product development and manufacturing cycles
  • Improve quality and issue resolution
  • Enhance operational efficiency
  • Coordinate decisions across engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, and service teams
  • Leverage AI responsibly while maintaining governance and business control

ICX helps customers connect fragmented product and operational data, enabling both people and AI agents to assess impact, coordinate action, and drive decisions across the enterprise lifecycle.

What You'll Do

Create and Develop the Market

  • Build and execute a strategic territory and account plan focused on high-value target accounts
  • Identify consequential business challenges and cultivate new opportunities through executive outreach, industry insight, partner relationships, and Siemens networks
  • Generate qualified pipeline aligned to annual revenue objectives

Lead Executive Value-Based Conversations

  • Engage CIOs, CDOs, COOs, Digital Transformation leaders, and business executives
  • Focus discussions on measurable business outcomes rather than product features
  • Translate operational challenges into compelling business cases with clear ROI, urgency, and executive sponsorship

Own the End-to-End Sales Process

  • Lead opportunities from qualification through close
  • Manage discovery, solution alignment, commercial negotiations, procurement processes, and contract execution
  • Maintain momentum and proactively remove obstacles throughout the buying journey

Orchestrate Cross-Functional Teams

  • Lead matrixed pursuit teams across Siemens
  • Collaborate with Account Orchestrators, Solution Architects, Value Engineering, Technical Account Managers, Professional Services, Product Leaders, and Industry Specialists
  • Align resources around customer outcomes and account strategy

Deliver Meaningful Customer Experiences

  • Partner closely with Solution Architects to develop tailored demonstrations, workshops, and executive engagements
  • Illustrate how ICX connects context, intelligence, governance, and action to address mission-critical business challenges

Build Executive Alignment

  • Develop and expand relationships across multiple stakeholders
  • Establish strong champions and gain access to economic buyers
  • Create clarity around decision criteria, business priorities, procurement requirements, and implementation roadmaps

Leverage the Ecosystem

  • Collaborate with strategic partners, hyperscalers, and global systems integrators
  • Utilize the broader Siemens portfolio and ecosystem to increase customer value and accelerate opportunity progression

Operate with Excellence

  • Apply disciplined opportunity qualification and account management practices
  • Maintain forecast accuracy and pipeline health
  • Consistently deliver against quarterly and annual targets

What Success Looks Like

  • A focused territory strategy centered on the accounts, executive relationships, and business initiatives most likely to generate significant ICX opportunities
  • A qualified pipeline supported by measurable customer pain, executive sponsorship, compelling business events, and defined decision processes
  • Strategic platform wins that establish ICX as a foundational capability and create opportunities for expansion across additional business functions and geographies
  • Customer-backed value cases that tie ICX investments to financial, operational, and risk-management outcomes
  • Accurate forecasting and strong progression of complex, multi-stakeholder sales pursuits
  • Trusted partnerships across Siemens and the broader ecosystem that drive successful customer outcomes

Required Qualifications

  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding enterprise software sales quotas
  • Experience creating and closing complex, strategic platform opportunities within large enterprises
  • Demonstrated success selling transformational business solutions to executive stakeholders, including CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, COOs, and business leaders
  • Experience leading multi-year enterprise agreements with seven-figure revenue potential
  • Ability to navigate complex organizations and build consensus across technical, operational, and executive audiences
  • Strong consultative and value-selling capabilities
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams through complex sales cycles
  • Excellent executive communication, negotiation, and presentation skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling AI, analytics, enterprise platform, cloud, data, application development, automation, or digital transformation solutions
  • Knowledge of Heavy Equipment, Automotive, Manufacturing, Industrial Technology, or related sectors
  • Familiarity with enterprise systems such as PLM, ERP, MES, CRM, or industrial data platforms
  • Experience selling through partner ecosystems, global systems integrators, or hyperscaler alliances
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience

Why Siemens

At Siemens Digital Industries Software, you'll help some of the world's most recognized industrial brands transform how they operate, innovate, and compete. You'll have the opportunity to shape a new category of enterprise AI while leveraging Siemens' industry expertise, customer relationships, and global scale.

If you're passionate about helping customers apply AI to real-world operational challenges and want to drive transformational outcomes across the manufacturing landscape, we'd love to hear from you.

Closing

    Siemens is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation practices. The annual base salary range for this position is $150,000 to $294,500 USD, this is a 50/50 split. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and business needs. This position is also eligible for a variable incentive compensation plan and Siemens' comprehensive benefits package.

jobs.description:
This posting is for an existing vacancy.

At Counterpart Health, we are transforming healthcare and improving patient care with our innovative primary care tool, Counterpart Assistant. By supporting Primary Care Physicians (PCPs), we are able to deliver improved outcomes to our patients at a lower cost through early diagnosis and longitudinal care management of chronic conditions.

We are looking for a Senior Software Developer with expertise in full-stack engineering. In this role, you will collaborate with our operators, clinicians, and product managers to build tools that drive real change in healthcare. You won't just write code to spec — you'll understand the business problem, engage with stakeholders, and shape the solution.

As a Senior Software Developer, you will:

  • Simplify the complexities of healthcare by building systems that enhance human efforts. Understand the business context behind what you build — why it matters, who it serves, and how it connects to outcomes.
  • Exercise agency: make informed technical and product decisions on your own to advance outcomes. Take ownership of your work from problem understanding through delivery and measurement.
  • Stay up-to-date with new tools and technologies to solve challenges and advance our goals.
  • Adopt and evangelize AI both in your own work and in the solutions you build.
  • Help define and maintain development practices that enable fast iteration while ensuring quality, including writing tests and documenting key implementations.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers and operational teams to conceptualize and develop new features. Engage directly with users and stakeholders to understand their needs — don't wait for requirements to be handed to you.

You should get in touch if:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software with proficiency in one or more common languages, and are also familiar with various databases and web frontend technology.
  • You know how to build systems with AI agents as your partners and team members, and are passionate about the impact AI can have in technology.
  • You approach building and maintaining systems with maturity, rigor, and attention to scalability.
  • You are comfortable working across different technical systems and concerns.
  • You have experience building and refactoring complex (often distributed) systems.
  • You care about outcomes, not just output. You want to understand the "why" behind what you build and can connect your work to business and user impact.

We're hiring Software Developers across multiple teams at Clover and Counterpart Health— our recruiting team will assess your background and connect you with the best-fit opportunity. You'll learn more about the specific team and interview process as you move through the process.

Benefits Overview:

  • Financial Well-Being: Our commitment to attracting and retaining top talent begins with a competitive base salary and equity opportunities. Additionally, we offer a performance-based bonus program and regular compensation reviews to recognize and reward exceptional contributions.
  • Physical Well-Being: We prioritize the health and well-being of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive group medical coverage that include coverage for hospitalization, outpatient care, optical services, and dental benefits.
  • Mental Well-Being: We understand the importance of mental health in fostering productivity and maintaining work-life balance. To support this, we offer initiatives such as No-Meeting Fridays, company holidays, access to mental health resources, and a generous annual leave policy. Additionally, we embrace a remote-first culture that supports collaboration and flexibility, allowing our team members to thrive from any location.
  • Professional Development: We are committed to developing our talent professionally. We offer learning programs, mentorship, professional development funding, and regular performance feedback and reviews.

Additional Perks:

  • Reimbursement for office setup expenses
  • Flexibility to work from home, enabling collaboration with global teams
  • Paid parental leave for all new parents
  • And much more!

About Counterpart Health: In 2018, Clover Health set out to do something unprecedented: build a clinically intuitive, AI-enabled solution that fits within physicians' workflows to help support the earlier diagnosis and management of chronic conditions.

Years later, that vision is a reality, with thousands of practitioners using Counterpart Assistant during patient visits to improve disease management, reduce medical expenses, and drive success in value-based care.

With an exceptional team of value-based care and technology experts, Counterpart Health is driving value-based care at the speed of software.

Counterpart Health is a subsidiary of Clover Health. From Clover’s inception, Diversity & Inclusion have always been key to our success. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, perspectives, opinions, and backgrounds, who share a passion for improving people's lives. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employee’s points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We are anE-Verify company.

Final pay is based on several factors including but not limited to internal equity, market data, and the applicant’s education, work experience, certifications, etc. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is: CAD 134,000 - 175,000.

jobs.title: CRM Strategist
jobs.excerpt: SmartBug Media is one of the most respected names in the HubSpot ecosystem — and we've earned it.
jobs.description:
SmartBug Media is one of the most respected names in the HubSpot ecosystem — and we've earned it.

We didn't get here by accident. SmartBug has built a reputation that most agencies only aspire to: HubSpot North American Partner of the Year, a fully remote team of specialists who punch well above their weight, and a client base that doesn't just hire us — they stay with us. That last part is the one we're most proud of.

Remote by design and strategic by nature, we've never believed that great work requires a corner office or a campus cafeteria. What it requires is the right people, deeply aligned on outcomes, working with clients who trust them to deliver. That's the culture we've built — one where expertise travels, relationships run deep, and the work speaks for itself.

We're obsessed with client outcomes. Not vanity metrics. Not feel-good reports. Real, measurable growth that makes our clients look like heroes inside their own organizations. When SmartBug is in your corner, your team wins — and that's exactly why our clients keep coming back.

We're growing, our client portfolio is expanding, and the relationships we've built are stronger than ever. What we need next is a leader who understands that the hardest part of this business isn't winning clients — it's becoming so embedded in their success that leaving simply isn't an option. If you've built that kind of loyalty before, if you know what it takes to transform a good client relationship into a decade-long partnership, and if you're energized by the idea of architecting that function at scale — we want to meet you.

About the role

The CRM Strategist reports to the Sr. Director, Strategy and is the primary architect responsible for leading high-complexity HubSpot implementations. This is a highly technical role focused on the intersection of Revenue Operations (RevOps), HubSpot systems architecture, and native integrations. You are the face of SmartBug and the first impression of the company to our customers — you should be adept at building relationships and trust with senior-level clients.

To succeed in this role, you must be an engaged professional with unwavering commitment to providing an incredible customer experience, including strong client communication and impactful client results. You will translate complex business requirements into scalable technical workflows and native integrations that drive measurable revenue growth.

As a CRM Strategist, you will be measured on delivering the following:

● Client satisfaction (results, retention, awards, reviews, referenceable clients)

● Customer growth and profitability

● Client effective billing rates (EBRs)

● Out-of-scope revenue attainment

● Setting and achieving SMART client goals

● Timely strategy delivery

● Individual utilization rates that meet company goals

What you'll do

Client Success

  • Lead large-scale, high-complexity HubSpot implementation projects, ensuring alignment with strategic and tactical business goals.
  • Identify and recommend complementary services to expand scope; provide scoping, quotes, and direction for implementation.
  • Stay informed on industry trends and HubSpot’s competitive position to keep client strategies cutting-edge.

HubSpot Implementation & Configuration

  • Translate client and internal strategies into comprehensive HubSpot solutions supporting marketing, sales, customer success, and operational workflows.
  • Provide intermediate to advanced configuration of HubSpot Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Content Hub, Data Hub, and HubSpot AI.
  • Own the strategy and configuration of native HubSpot integrations (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, NetSuite) with expertise in sync rules, field mapping, and conflict resolution.
  • Revenue Engine Optimization: Design and implement data schema, custom objects, and property mapping aligned to the client’s RevOps strategy.
  • Build and optimize revenue engine components including lead scoring, advanced attribution, and automated marketing-to-sales-to-service hand-off sequences. Build complex RevOps dashboards that demonstrate clear ROI to stakeholders.
  • Data Governance: Implement data governance best practices including deduplication logic and hygiene standards to maintain HubSpot as a reliable single source of truth.
  • AI implementation: Lead AI strategy and implementation engagements, including AEO Readiness Audits, AI Strategy Playbooks, and the design, deployment, and ongoing optimization of HubSpot AI agents
  • Provide training to clients and internal teams on how to use their customized HubSpot instance effectively; offer ongoing support and troubleshooting assistance.
  • Obtain your HubSpot Trainer Certification and help onboard clients to the platform.
  • Configure HubSpot instances from the ground up, including custom objects, property mapping, and data schema aligned to client specifications
  • Translate business requirements into scalable HubSpot configurations that support the full customer lifecycle
  • Business Process Mapping: Conduct technical discovery to map "Current State" vs. "Future State" processes, identifying technical bottlenecks in the revenue funnel.

Informal Leadership

  • Guide and mentor CRM Specialists and support Marketing Strategists on complex projects.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to align CRM solutions with broader business objectives.
  • Champion knowledge sharing and process optimization within the team.

Delivery Process

  • Monitor and manage project budgets and scope; track and meet effective billing rate (EBR) goals.
  • Work with the internal SmartBug team to ensure quality work is delivered to clients.
  • Create and follow processes that result in differentiated client results and quality.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
  • Technical Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience building complex solutions within the HubSpot platform.
  • Proven experience with the HubSpot software suite and a deep understanding of the HubSpot ecosystem.
  • RevOps Expertise: Proven ability to design systems around revenue-driving processes (lead-to-cash, forecasting, and attribution).
  • Integration Fluency: Deep understanding of how HubSpot integrates natively with external tech stacks and the ability to manage complex data syncs.
  • AI and AEO expertise: Hands-on experience deploying HubSpot AI agents in production, and a working knowledge of AEO, including how AI engines select and cite sources
  • Understanding of complementary technologies clients may use within the HubSpot ecosystem.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to navigate complex business challenges and translate them into automated technical solutions.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • High level of organization, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to ensure high client satisfaction while adhering to SmartBug values.
  • High level of integrity, work ethic, and professionalism; passion for client success.
  • Experience working remotely in a similar role strongly preferred.
  • HubSpot Trainer Certification: HubSpot Marketing Software, Sales Software, Service Hub, and Revenue Operations Certifications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Additional HubSpot certifications (e.g., HubSpot Solutions Architect, Revenue Operations, or Marketing Hub Implementation).
  • Experience working within a HubSpot Partner agency environment.
  • Familiarity with CRM migration projects, including data mapping and clean data transfer from legacy systems.
  • Exposure to complementary RevOps tools such as Gong, Outreach, Zapier, or data enrichment platforms like Clearbit or ZoomInfo.
  • Experience with project management methodologies and tools (e.g., Agile, Scrum, or platforms like Teamwork or Asana).
  • Ability to create technical documentation including SOPs, data dictionaries, and system architecture diagrams.

jobs.excerpt: What Do We Do? Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern commerce.
jobs.description:
What Do We Do?

Triple Whale is the AI operating system built for modern commerce. We help you see what's actually working in your business, what's not, and what to do next. Then we take action for you — pausing the underperforming ad, generating the next batch of creative, flagging the inventory risk before it hurts your bottom line.

We pull every signal in your business into one place, and put it on the most trusted measurement foundation in the industry. And on top of that, we give you the only AI harness in commerce — Moby — letting you tap any LLM you want, grounded in the full context of your business. Moby doesn't just surface insights, it executes decisions for you, with automations that make the rest of your stack smarter.

The result: more than 65,000 brands like Kitsch, OUAI, and True Classic turn mountains of complex data into actions that actually grow profit, at a speed and scale that is not humanly possible.

What You’re Applying For

We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to join our team, reporting to our Director of Talent Acquisition. You’ll own hiring across the West Coast and APAC, along with other US-based GTM roles as needed.

This role is remote and must be based in the Pacific Time zone, with flexibility to align portions of your schedule with APAC business hours, particularly Australia.

You’ll own full-cycle recruiting across functions and build strong partnerships with hiring managers, understanding what their teams need and anticipating what’s coming next. You’ll bring a white-glove approach to both candidate and hiring manager experience: thoughtful preparation, proactive communication, and consistent follow-through.

We’re looking for someone who understands that speed and quality both matter, and that candidate experience is paramount. You know how to create urgency, give hiring managers clear recommendations, and keep candidates engaged through a well-run, thoughtful process.

What You’ll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting across APAC and the US, from kickoff and sourcing through interviews, offer negotiations, and a thoughtful transition into onboarding.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand their teams, and build a hiring approach that reflects their priorities and local market realities.
  • Anticipate needs, flag challenges early, and bring recommendations that help hiring teams move forward.
  • Deliver an exceptional candidate experience from first conversation to onboarding, with personal communication, clear expectations, thoughtful preparation, and timely updates.
  • Build targeted pipelines through sourcing, referrals, and creative outreach that gives active and passive candidates a compelling reason to consider Triple Whale.
  • Screen resumes, conduct initial interviews, and assess how candidates’ experience, strengths, and motivations align with each opportunity.
  • Use pipeline and funnel data to keep hiring managers informed, surface bottlenecks, and recommend meaningful improvements.
  • Bring an AI-forward approach to research, sourcing, and recruiting workflows, using tools thoughtfully to create more time for relationship-building.
  • Maintain accurate ATS records and clear reporting, with the same attention to detail you bring to every candidate interaction.

What You’ll Bring

  • 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, in-house, at an agency, or a combination of both.
  • Experience managing global hiring across multiple regions and time zones; experience recruiting in Australia is a plus.
  • A home base in the Pacific Time zone, with flexibility to support APAC hiring managers and candidates during their business hours.
  • The ability to become a trusted partner to hiring managers and help them make confident, informed hiring decisions.
  • Experience balancing higher-volume hiring with specialized searches for niche roles.
  • A high bar for candidate experience. You anticipate questions, remember the details, and close the loop without needing a reminder.
  • Strong sourcing skills, including experience using LinkedIn Recruiter to engage both active and passive candidates.
  • Strong ATS proficiency; Greenhouse and/or Ashby experience is a plus.
  • Experience using AI to improve sourcing, research, and recruiting workflows, with sound judgment about where it adds value.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple open roles and competing priorities across time zones.
  • High standards, low ego, and a people-first approach to helping Triple Whale grow.

Come make waves with us.

The expected base salary for this role is $120,000-$140,000 per year. Eligible employees receive medical coverage; a 401(k) with a company match of up to 3%; 30 days of paid time off accrued monthly after the first 30 days of employment; five sick days; and nine paid company holidays. Triple Whale also offers paid parental leave for eligible employees.

Our compensation ranges are set using benchmarks from growth-stage companies and factor in function, level, and location—so everything stays balanced and competitive. The range listed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target salary across all U.S. locations.

Triple Whale is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Join Us in Making Waves

If you’re looking for more than just a job and want to be part of a movement reshaping the future of Ecommerce, Triple Whale is the place for you. We’re on the lookout for driven, curious, and creative individuals ready to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Referred? Got here thanks to a friend? Splash some gratitude their way! They'll need to submit your application through our referral system to make it official.

jobs.description:
Career Category

College Job

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

INTERN/Global Patient Safety (Summer 2027)

What You Will Do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. During this program, you will work with the Late-Stage Oncology Clinical Science team to support the execution of oncology clinical trials. You will gain hands-on experience in clinical data review, study conduct, and cross-functional collaboration while contributing to activities that support the development of innovative therapies for patients with cancer. The key responsibilities:

· Support clinical development of oncology compounds and assist with day-to-day execution of clinical trials, focusing on data quality.

· Participate in cross-functional discussions involving clinical, statistics, operations, and data management teams.

· Support clinical trial operations by preparing documents such as literature reviews, slide decks, and tracking study progress.

· Learn about and maintain study data quality by performing data review and identifying clinical findings.

· Conduct background research on oncology disease states, treatments, or trial methodologies to support clinical projects.

· Contribute to scientific communication by assisting in preparation of internal presentations and literature summaries.

· Learn about the clinical scientist role in oncology clinical development through meetings, mentorship, and guided projects.


Program Eligibility Requirements

  • Must be available to work a full-time schedule.
  • Expected continued enrollment in an accredited college or university following the internship program / co-op
  • Student must be located in the United States for the duration of the internship program

What We Expect of You

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.The highly motivated individual we seek is a collaborative and intellectually curious professional with these qualifications::

Basic Qualifications:

Amgen requires that all individuals applying for a grad internship or a co-op assignment at Amgen must meet the following criteria:

The incumbent provides expert guidance throughout planning, design, construction, and long-term facility development while ensuring engineering solutions comply with applicable codes, standards, environmental requirements, and life-cycle performance objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and review foundation recommendations based on geotechnical investigations.
  • Coordinate site grading, earthwork, excavation, retaining structures, drainage systems, and stormwater management designs.

  • Review construction change orders, claims, and field conditions involving site development and geotechnical issues.
  • Monitor construction activities to verify compliance with approved geotechnical recommendations and design requirements.
  • Coordinate environmental studies, site investigations, and mitigation planning.
  • Assist with procurement of utility service contracts and engineering consulting services.
  • Develop construction cost estimates and analyze project costs related to earthwork, foundations, utilities, and site improvements.

Qualifications

  • Knowledge of Federal and agency regulations and the policies related to environmental concerns and the preparation of environmental impact statements and including those related to wetlands, endangered species, historical and archaeological preservation, and hazardous or toxic materials.

  • Skill in written and verbal communication and in organizing reports and correspondence.
  • Skill in meeting with others and eliciting information.
  • Skill in organizing and conducting conferences, meetings and contract negotiations.

The Financial Controller is a senior, hands-on finance leader responsible for managing and overseeing the financial operations of the Company and its two sister companies (one in the United States and one in the United Kingdom). This role ensures accurate financial reporting, strong internal controls, regulatory compliance, and effective financial processes to support the organization’s continued growth.

This is a remote position, requiring strong self-direction, cross-time-zone collaboration, and the ability to operate effectively in a distributed environment.

Financial Management & Reporting

Budgeting, Forecasting & Financial Planning

  • Develop and manage annual budgets in collaboration with leadership and department heads.
  • Prepare rolling forecasts and variance analyses to support business planning and decision-making.

Cash Flow & Working Capital Management

ERP & Financial Systems

Internal Controls, Compliance & Risk Management

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with operations, supply chain, HR, and leadership teams to align financial practices with business objectives.
  • Foster a culture of accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Remote Operations & Cross-Border Coordination

  • Establish effective remote finance operations, including close calendars, reporting cadence, and standardized workflows.
  • Coordinate across time zones to ensure smooth collaboration with US- and UK-based teams.

About Team

Flow by ServiceNow is a standalone conversational AI service desk, with its own product and its own codebase. Employees ask for help wherever they already work — Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, or the browser. Flow answers from connected knowledge, handles the request, and runs automations the team publishes. AI is how the product works, and a person stays in control when the action is sensitive.

Flow is a new company inside ServiceNow, reimagining every function from first principles. We hire builders with agency and curiosity who use AI as the default way to design, review, and operate. They challenge inherited ways of working and treat their work as craft.

On AI-Native Engineering, you’ll set technical direction for the systems that make Flow intelligent: the agent runtime, the tool surface a model sees, the prompt and context layers, the retrieval that grounds every answer, and the evaluation discipline that tells us whether a change made the product better. This is a hands-on role with broad influence — you’ll make architectural calls, raise the engineering bar, and help the team move from AI-assisted development to AI-native delivery.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the design and delivery of complex, cross-functional features across the product, from architecture through production operations.
  • Build AI-native capabilities: agent loops and the tools they call, prompt and context design, retrieval that grounds and cites its answers, and the eval harnesses that tell us whether a change actually made the product better — with reliability and governance built in.
  • Define and drive how the team uses AI across the development lifecycle: code generation, test automation, review, triage, and documentation. Agentic coding is central to how this team ships. Measure the impact and share what works.
  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers and set standards for code quality, observability, and safe AI usage.
  • Partner with product, UX, and other engineering leads to turn ambiguous problems into scoped, shippable plans.

What we’re looking for

We don’t expect anyone to match every line below. Depth matters more to us than a match on any particular toolchain — be excellent in a modern typed stack and quick to pick up a new one.

  • Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This includes current, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development, and an opinion on where those tools help and where they don’t.

The agent runtime is the product. The patterns you set — how an agent decides, which tools it may call, what it must prove before it acts, and how we measure whether it got better — are what customers experience as intelligent workflows.

jobs.description:
Robots & Pencils is an applied AI engineering firm building the next frontier of business architecture. We design and ship AI co-workers that integrate into enterprise operations and deliver measurable results for our clients. We're all in on AWS, combining deep UX capability with senior engineering talent to get AI into production fast and keep it there.
We’ve earned the trust of leaders across Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, and Manufacturing and more, and earned a reputation as the nimble alternative to traditional global systems integrators. Founded in 2009, with delivery centers in Canada, the United States, Eastern Europe, and Latin America, we are smaller, faster, and more senior by design. Our teams average 15+ years of experience. We move fast, sweat the details, and build things that actually ship.

Position Overview

As a Senior Delivery Manager, you are the senior delivery authority on a cross-functional engagement: owning execution from kickoff through release, leading distributed onshore-and-offshore teams, and serving as the primary delivery partner to the client. You bring the judgment to navigate ambiguity, the discipline to keep complex programs on track, and the instinct to make every engagement a foundation for the next one.

Why This Role Matters

Senior Delivery Managers are where Robots and Pencils’ promise of “production-ready AI in 30 to 45 days” actually has to hold. On the engagements you run, you set the pace of delivery, the discipline behind it, and the trust that decides whether the client comes back for more. The work moves only as fast as someone is willing to own the plan, surface trade-offs early, and keep distributed teams pulling in the same direction.

What You’ll Do

Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-phase engagements, ensuring alignment across scope, budget, timeline, and quality to meet delivery commitments and achieve successful outcomes
  • Facilitate sprint planning, backlog refinement, and delivery execution across one or more cross-functional teams
  • Manage phased releases, production readiness, and transitions into operations and maintenance models
  • Identify and proactively manage dependencies, risks, scope changes, and escalations before they become blockers
  • Define, track, and report delivery KPIs, using data to guide decisions, manage delivery health, and inform tradeoffs across scope, timeline, and budget
  • Support QA and UAT efforts, ensuring quality is validated and outcomes meet agreed acceptance criteria
  • Bring an AI-forward mindset to your daily work, using tools like Claude to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and stakeholder communications

AI Enablement

  • Help implement the AI Development Life Cycle (AIDLC) across your engagements, and set the standard other delivery managers follow for standing it up
  • Use AI yourself day-to-day, and set the standard for how your engagements run an AI-augmented delivery process — modeling and coaching the delivery managers you mentor on how planning, building, and review change when agents are doing part of the work
  • Know observability for agentic and AI-driven work well enough to partner credibly with an AI product manager and AI engineers across your engagements — judge whether their approach is actually solid, catch risks early, and drive them to resolution — and hold the delivery managers you mentor to the same bar. You’re not the one building the instrumentation, but none of it should be a black box to you.
  • Define what “success” looks like for an AI-augmented delivery process and set the metrics standard across your engagements — quality, rework, review overhead, and velocity, not just tests passed
  • Build — or direct the building of — status-visibility tooling for complex AI-driven pipelines, using AI yourself, and expect the delivery managers you mentor to do the same
  • Understand context management and latency trade-offs deeply enough to make the call on when an agentic approach is the wrong tool for a client’s needs, and defend that call to the client
  • Set the standard for what infrastructure an agentic delivery pipeline needs — compute, orchestration, logging, guardrails — and know enough to hold engineering accountable for it, even though you’re not the one building it
  • Own the delivery approach for AI-native and agentic engagements: partner with AI/ML engineering leads on model risk, data readiness, and evaluation strategy, and translate technical uncertainty into a delivery plan and risk register the client can act on
  • Work with AI product managers and AI engineers to set the standard, across your engagements, for what a “definition of done” looks like for probabilistic or AI-driven features — evaluation thresholds, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, post-launch monitoring — well enough to judge whether it’s actually good, and hold the team to it
  • Coach delivery managers and delivery coordinators you mentor on the difference between shipping an AI product, using AI to accelerate a traditional delivery, and running an agentic development process to build the work itself — and help them adapt scope, staffing, and risk management accordingly
  • Serve as a credible voice with clients and internal leadership on what “production-ready AI” actually requires — setting realistic expectations for iteration, evaluation, and drift over time

Collaboration & Communication

  • Serve as the primary delivery contact for clients, building trusted relationships through transparency, consistency, and clear communication while identifying opportunities to expand value within the engagement
  • Lead stakeholder working sessions, roadmap alignment discussions, and delivery forums with confidence
  • Communicate progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to executive and non-technical audiences
  • Partner with Client Partners to spot expansion opportunities inside the engagement (scope, follow-on work, new use cases) and help shape the case for what’s next
  • Translate delivery progress into business impact for client stakeholders (ROI, milestones, decisions) so executives see ongoing value, not just status

Leadership & Influence

  • Lead distributed delivery teams across onshore and offshore locations, fostering accountability, collaboration, and delivery excellence
  • Coach junior delivery managers with concrete feedback and stretch opportunities, contributing to their development plans
  • Foster a culture of transparency, continuous improvement, and high performance across the engagement
  • Contribute to improving delivery practices, tools, and frameworks across engagements
  • Assess team strengths and gaps on your engagements, and partner with Client Partners to flag staffing needs and high-potential talent for the firm
  • Conduct executive interviews for engineers, designers, and other roles joining your engagements, and serve as an essential voice in go/no-go hiring decisions across the firm

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in software delivery, technical project management, or engineering leadership
  • Strong understanding of agile delivery practices across complex, multi-team engagements (e.g., Scrum, SAFe, Kanban)
  • Experience managing distributed teams across onshore and offshore locations
  • Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-platform digital systems in agile environments
  • Strong client-facing communication and relationship management skills
  • Experience with delivery tooling (e.g., Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines)
  • Familiarity with cloud-native architectures and AI-enabled platforms
  • Demonstrable usage of AI tools to enhance delivery planning, reporting, and documentation (e.g., Claude)
  • Track record leading at least one engagement where AI/ML or agentic capability was core to the solution — including how you managed model risk, evaluation, and client expectations, not just how you used AI tools to work faster
  • Able to set delivery standards for AI-native work across an engagement or practice — evaluation criteria, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, monitoring — and coach other delivery managers on them
  • Track record leading a team through an agentic development/delivery process yourself — not just using AI tools personally — including how you approached observability, success metrics, and status visibility for a process that isn’t fully deterministic
  • Comfortable setting the standard, across engagements, for the infrastructure, context-management, and latency trade-offs an agentic delivery pipeline needs — enough to hold engineering and delivery managers accountable, even though you’re not the one implementing it
  • PMP, Scrum Master, SAFe, or equivalent certification preferred
  • Instinct for spotting where an engagement can grow, and the credibility with clients to bring those conversations forward with Client Partners

Helpful Extras and Unique Skills

  • Vertical depth in one or more of Consumer Products and Retail, Education, Energy, Financial Services, Healthcare, or Manufacturing
  • Experience delivering agentic, AI co-worker, or applied-AI initiatives in enterprise
  • Prior career experience in client-facing roles (engagement management, consulting, account leadership) that informs growth conversations

You’ll Do Well Here if You Are

  • A doer. You see something broken and fix it. You'd rather move on clarity than wait for certainty.
  • A fast learner who knows you don't know everything. The AI landscape changes weekly. You're senior enough to know better and curious enough to keep learning anyway.
  • Direct in a way that makes the work better. You give honest feedback. You'd rather have the hard conversation than blow smoke.
  • Obsessed with craft. You know genius is in the details. You ship exceptional, not perfect, and you don't put your name on work you wouldn't stand behind.
  • Built for ownership. You honor commitments, admit mistakes fast, and back your teammates when a decision costs something. No handoffs, no finger-pointing.
  • All in. You treat clients' businesses like your own. You take the work seriously without taking yourself seriously.
  • Resourceful when the budget, timeline, or team is tight. Constraints don't slow you down. They sharpen you.
  • Calm when it gets hot. When scope, timeline, and stakeholders pull in three directions, you slow the room down enough to make the right call. You’d rather raise the hard trade-off in week two than absorb it in week eight.
  • Glad to be in the room with people who care as much as you do. Our teams average fifteen-plus years of experience. We hire people who push each other to do better work.

jobs.title: Dynamics 365 Functional Consultant (UK home based)
jobs.excerpt: About UsTechLabs London is a fast-growing Microsoft Premium Partner and the team behind iProperty Cloud- a comprehensive Housing Management Solution (HMS) built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE/CRM and the Power Platform.
jobs.description:
About Us

TechLabs London is a fast-growing Microsoft Premium Partner and the team behind iProperty Cloud- a comprehensive Housing Management Solution (HMS) built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE/CRM and the Power Platform. We work with housing providers across the UK to digitally transform the way they manage their homes, tenants, and services.

We're an engaged and collaborative team, and we're looking for someone who shares that spirit.

The Role

This is a client-facing consultancy role at the heart of our delivery practice. You'll become a product expert in iProperty Cloud and act as the primary bridge between our clients and our technical team- leading workshops, uncovering requirements, and helping clients get the most from our solution.

You won't be writing code, but will have plenty of hands- on opportunity to configure and customise solutions. Your craft is understanding client needs by facilitating structured conversations, asking the right questions, and translating those needs into clear, actionable requirements for clients and colleagues.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Leading client workshops to demonstrate iProperty Cloud, walk clients through existing functionality, and facilitate structured conversations that uncover how the product fits their needs.

  • Identifying gaps between what the product currently does and what a client needs, and clearly documenting those findings for the wider team.

  • Eliciting and capturing requirements through confident, inquisitive engagement- challenging assumptions, digging beneath the surface, and ensuring nothing important gets missed.

  • Collaborating with our technical team to define and scope small changes and configurations, translating business needs into clear, well-structured briefs that developers can act on.

  • Configuring Dynamics 365 CE/CRM using low-code/no-code tools to tailor solutions to client needs- this is functional configuration work, not pro-code development.

  • Supporting clients through onboarding, including functional training, data preparation guidance, testing development and client specific requirements to make sure they fulfil the project brief, and being a trusted point of contact during delivery.

  • Working autonomously on projects, managing your own time and priorities whilst staying aligned with your Project Manager and broader delivery team.

  • Keeping up to date with the latest Dynamics 365 CE/CRM features and Power Platform capabilities relevant to our product and clients.

What you need to succeed

Essential

  • Strong, proven knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE/CRM: you understand the platform deeply and can configure it confidently without needing a developer's help for routine customisation.

  • Excellent consultancy and communication skills: lead workshops with confidence, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Curiosity and willingness to learn: you proactively seek out answers, ask considered questions and validate your understanding rather than making assumptions.

  • Proactive and autonomous: you take ownership of your work, manage your time well, and use your initiative to move things forward.

  • Strong analytical thinking: you can listen, synthesise, identify issues, and recommend practical solutions.

  • Clear written communication: you can produce well-structured requirement documents, gap analyses, and briefs that others can act on with confidence.

Highly Desirable

  • Experience in the UK housing sector: whether that's working within a housing association, local authority, or for a supplier serving the sector. If you understand the day-to-day realities of housing management, that's a real advantage.

  • Familiarity with Power Platform tools: Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI- and how they integrate within a Dynamics 365 solution.

  • Experience with Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

  • Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g. MB-210 or equivalent).

A Note on Housing Experience

We recognise that not every great consultant will come with a housing background and that's absolutely fine. What matters most is how quickly you can build understanding in a new domain by asking thoughtful questions, listening carefully to clients, and respecting their expertise. We’ll support you in learning iProperty Cloud and developing your knowledge.

Working Arrangements

  • Full-time, permanent

  • UK Remote — with occasional travel to client sites as required

  • You'll be set up to work effectively as part of a distributed team, using tools like Microsoft Teams, and collaborative platforms for project delivery

Why Join Us?

You'll be joining a growing, forward-looking team that makes a real impact in the housing sector. You will have real ownership of client relationships and delivery, while supported by an experienced project and technical team around you, with plenty of opportunities to develop your skills and expertise.

If you are ready to become an expert in a product that makes a real difference to how housing organisations work- we'd love to hear from you!

jobs.description:
We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure. Intersect develops, constructs, and operates the most ambitious power and data center infrastructure in the country by co-locating industrial demand with dedicated gas and renewable power generation.

Intersect was acquired by Google in March 2026 and operates as an independent subsidiary. We are developing and constructing multiple gigawatts of energy and data center projects in the U.S., enabling more data center and generation capacity to come online faster. We’re on an aggressive growth trajectory and looking for people hungry to tackle the largest energy challenges on the planet.

Location & Team Gatherings

Intersect has been a fully flexible workplace since its founding in 2016. We’ve been very intentional about the way we do things. We are not work-from-home, hybrid, or in-office - we are any and all of those options! Deepening social connections and offering shared experiences is a cornerstone of the way we work. We connect as a team at our Team Week experiences four times a year and at our recently established Hub locations - SF Bay Area, NYC Metro Area, NY; Denver, CO; Austin, TX; Calgary, AB; and Toronto, ON.

We are currently looking for candidates located within 60 miles of any of the listed hubs to foster more in-person connections while maintaining our flexible remote culture.

About this role

As a Project Manager, Wind Construction on Intersect's Construction Team, you'll lead the execution of utility-scale wind facilities exceeding 300 MW from pre-construction through commissioning and substantial completion.You'll own complex, cross-functional execution from detailed design and procurement through construction, commissioning, and commercial closeout, ensuring our storage assets are delivered safely, on schedule, and within budget.

You'll partner closely with Development, Finance, Engineering, Procurement, Legal, and Operations as well as EPC contractors, utilities, and Owner's Engineers to deliver safe, high-quality power infrastructure on time and on budget. By combining rigorous project controls with modern platforms like Terabase and AI Clearing, you'll drive predictable execution and build assets that create long-run value.

Team overview

This team plays a critical role in advancing Intersect's mission to accelerate the clean energy transition. The Construction Team turns ambitious development plans into operating utility-scale wind and power infrastructure, working across disciplines to uphold the highest standards of safety, quality, and commercial discipline. Joining this team means taking ownership of complex, high-impact builds while mentoring Associate Project Managers and growing alongside collaborative experts.

What you'll do

Lead Full Lifecycle Wind Project Execution

  • Manage the full lifecycle of utility-scale wind projects, from engineering and procurement through construction, commissioning, and project closeout.

  • Drive project performance against safety, quality, schedule, budget, and operational readiness objectives while providing clear, actionable updates to executive leadership.

  • Track daily and weekly field progress, productivity rates, and schedule adherence using the Terabase Platform, AI Clearing, and project scheduling platforms, proactively mitigating bottlenecks before they impact COD.

  • Monitor and align master schedules across contractors and stakeholders, tracking critical path milestones, schedule updates, and owner-supplied material deliveries tied to milestone payments and contractual notices.

Manage EPC and External Partnerships

  • Manage owner, contractor, and third-party deliverables across EPC and land contracts, representing Intersect in meetings with contractors, utilities, and grid operators.

  • Lead the administration of construction and equipment supply contracts, including change orders, RFIs, submittals, and document control.

  • Review and approve construction strategies, procurement plans, and execution methodologies while maintaining productive alignment across stakeholder groups.

  • Conduct regular on-site reviews with EPC leadership, utilities, and owner’s engineers to maintain clear communication, resolve field challenges, and uphold Intersect's construction standards.

Drive Financial and Commercial Discipline

  • Prepare comprehensive executive and stakeholder reporting covering schedule performance, financial health, risk registers, and mitigation strategies.

  • Lead weekly and monthly budget reviews and reporting, including cash flow forecasts, actuals, accruals, invoice validation, and lien waiver reviews to maintain strict alignment with approved targets.

  • Build and maintain project trackers to govern quality assurance, commissioning workflows, and performance testing through substantial completion.

  • Ensure full compliance with contractual obligations, interconnection agreements, permitting stipulations, and commercial requirements.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in wind construction with deep grounding in project management, EPC contract management, budget ownership, invoice tracking, and schedule monitoring.

  • 2-3+ years of experience as a Project Manager (or equivalent) leading at least two utility-scale wind projects (including 300+ MW facilities) from start of construction to substantial completion.

  • Advanced proficiency with Excel, Microsoft Project, Bluebeam, Google Workspace (G Suite), Slack, Terabase Platform, and AI Clearing.

  • Demonstrated mastery of wind construction methods, site logistics, OSHA/site safety protocols, and project controls, backed by an established network of EPCs, subcontractors, and inspectors.

  • Composed, proactive, and highly organized when juggling multiple fast-moving projects, with the communication and negotiation skills to translate complex findings for executive review.

  • Commitment to accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement, aligned with Intersect's core values of Equity, Humility, Authenticity, Long-run Value, and People Come First.

Equity: Beyond your salary, you’ll receive an Equity Grant, giving you a meaningful stake in our parent company.

Health & wellness: Medical, dental, and vision insurance available for employees and dependents

Family support: Up to 18 weeks of fully paid parental leave; access to family planning and family care support through Maven

Financial support: Generous 401(k) and RRSP retirement plans

Intersect maintains a work environment free from discrimination, one where all employees are treated with dignity and respect. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling Intersect's commitment to equal employment opportunity. Keeper Security is hiring a proactive and detail-oriented Partner Enablement Specialist to support the development and execution of enablement initiatives that drive readiness, productivity, and performance across the Channel and MSP ecosystem. This role ensures partners are equipped with the knowledge, tools, and certifications needed to effectively sell, implement, and support the company’s solutions. Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and play a pivotal role in shaping Keeper’s go-to-market effectiveness, ensuring Keeper’s partner ecosystem scales successfully.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Role

Reporting to the Sr. Director of GTM Enablement & Programs, the Partner Enablement Specialist will support the execution of training, content, and tools that enable our Channel and MSP ecosystem to perform at a high level.

This is a hands-on, project-focused role. You will organize content, coordinate contributors, maintain learning resources, and keep deliverables moving from assignment through completion. Success requires strong attention to detail, reliable follow-through, and the ability to deliver quality work on short timelines.

This role is ideal for someone early in their career looking to grow in GTM operations or enablement within a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environment.

Responsibilities

  • Support the end-to-end design, execution, and continuous evolution of partner enablement programs across Channel, MSP, and MSSP audiences
  • Gather partner feedback through surveys and check-ins, summarize the results, and propose action plans to enhance the overall Keeper experience
  • Maintain and organize enablement materials such as playbooks, messaging decks, onboarding guides, and certification tracks
  • Assist in the creation and delivery of ongoing enablement initiatives such as product training, methodology sessions, and sales skill workshops
  • Manage scheduling, communications, and follow-up activities for all training programs
  • Maintain and support the enablement platform (Magentrix LMS), ensuring content is current, accessible, and well-organized
  • Track and report on enablement program participation and impact metrics (e.g., onboarding progress, tool adoption, training completions)
  • Collaborate with Channel, Marketing, and Sales colleagues to keep partner materials current when products or offerings change
  • Serve as a liaison between Revenue Operations and partner teams to gather feedback, identify needs, and implement improvements
  • Stay current on Keeper’s platform and GTM strategies to ensure enablement materials stay relevant and aligned

Requirements

  • 1+ years of experience in enablement, sales operations, or a related support function within a B2B SaaS environment
  • Familiarity with GTM motions across Sales and Partner-focused teams
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously; while having demonstrated attention to detail
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to work cross-functionally with different stakeholder groups
  • Experience with enablement tools, Partner Relationship Management tools (e.g. Magentrix), CRMs like Salesforce, and content management platforms preferred
  • Preferred working knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM) and Privileged Access Management (PAM), including core cybersecurity concepts and real-world application
  • Self-starter mindset with the ability to operate in a fast-paced, evolving environment
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (Inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401k (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)
  • Above market annual bonuses

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal

E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

1. Data We Collect

  • Application responses and uploaded documents

Information We generate:

  • Interview notes, assessments, communications
  • Scheduling information

Information From Others:

  • Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile

Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information

  • We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements

2. How We Use Your Data

  • Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified)
  • Comply with employment law obligations

3. Legal Basis

  • Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process)

Third Parties:

Service providers who assist with:

Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.

5. International Transfers

If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law.

Learn more about our division, areas, and cross-functional teams here!

aufgaben

Your tasks – this is what awaits you in detail

Building, developing and enabling high performing teams who build awesome products is the main responsibility for our Engineering Managers. It’s the entry position in our Engineering Management career path and reports to a Head of Product Engineering.

As an Engineering Manager joining our team, you will initially focus on hands-on technical tasks like an individual contributor allowing you to gain a deep understanding of our mobile infrastructure and systems so that you know the code inside and out before adding managerial responsibilities to your plate. This approach enables you to understand the technical challenges your team encounters deeply, setting you and the team up for future wins.
  • You have found your passion in software development, but you enjoy building the right team, removing roadblocks, helping others, creating transparency, and alignment even more than being an individual contributor
  • Based on your experience, you will start by leading the engineers of one mobile product team in a you-build-it-you-run-it environment, with a clear perspective to expand to multiple teams as responsibility and impact grow

  • You are going to help our engineers grow personally and professionally - not only by advancing their skills, but also by inspiring them through purpose
  • You make sure that we leverage (new) technology within our product teams to build mobile products customers love, collaborating closely with product managers and designers to shape data-driven product experiences

profil

  • You have worked in cross-functional product teams and bring a vast experience in core mobile engineering (Swift, Kotlin) and a strong understanding of modern mobile development practices

This includes a deep understanding of clean code (SOLID/DRY, TDD/BDD) and the ability to navigate complex codebases

  • You are a natural go-to-person within your organization by mentoring other engineers, fostering a culture of learning, and helping them grow and succeed
  • You have a DevOps and customer-focused mindset, taking shared responsibility for operating, monitoring, and maintaining high-quality software
  • You are willing to go the extra mile to make your team successful, you give honest feedback, and you are able to discuss, commit and execute
  • You are fluent in English (C1) and enjoy working in an international, dynamic environment

benefits

  • This is who we are: Our dynamic culture combines flat hierarchies, a start-up mentality, an international team of over 65 nationalities, and the strength of the Schwarz Group to provide you an agile and secure working environment.
  • We are team players: From day one, you will connect not only with your team but also with others through our digital onboarding journey, the buddy program, and regular team and company events, all-hands meetings, powerful mornings, and much more!

jobs.description:
About Dakotomy

Dakotomy is a strategy, creative, and development agency for venture capital firms and the technology companies they back. We work with founders and investors at the moments that define a company: formation, coming out of stealth, repositioning, and announcing a raise. Our clients range from early-stage AI and enterprise software companies to the VC firms that fund them.

We treat language as infrastructure. The words a company uses to describe itself decide whether the market understands it, believes it, and remembers it. Our work starts with the headline: what is the one thing this company needs the market to know? Then we build out from there, making the story legible and credible to the people who matter most.

The Role

We are looking for a Strategic Copywriter to work directly with our Managing Partner & Strategy Director who leads the messaging function. You will translate high-level positioning into compelling brand messaging and precise, tangible product language for enterprise buyers, limited partners, and investors.

Brand voices change from client to client. Some are playful, some are restrained. But the audience is consistent. We speak to serious business professionals who make large decisions carefully. You will know how to bring energy and personality at the brand level while staying rigorous, technical, and clear where it counts.

The role is a contract, project-based position start with the potential to grow into a consistent, 3/4 time contract role that acts as an integral part of our team.

What You Will Do

  • Turn positioning strategy into messaging frameworks, website copy, pitch decks, launch announcements, and fundraise narratives.
  • Learn complex AI and technical products quickly, then articulate what matters most to an enterprise buyer.
  • Write PR-driven language for key moments such as stealth launches, rebrands, and Series A announcements, starting from the headline and working down.
  • Research how competitors and the broader market are speaking, and make sure our clients sound distinct.
  • Contribute to strategy sessions and bring your own point of view to the work.
  • Present your work to our clients articulately and with authority.
  • Propose new ways to support clients beyond the brief.
  • Manage your own deadlines and workload across 3-5 engagements at once.
  • Collaborate with design to communicate product benefits and features in product interface mockups.

Who You Are

  • A strategic thinker who can move between big-picture positioning and line-level copy.
  • Technically curious. You enjoy understanding how a product works and why it matters.
  • Optimistic. You bring a positive outlook to the work and to the people around you.
  • Professional and pragmatic, but genuinely excited by the work and able to have fun with it.
  • Entrepreneurial and self-starting. You spot opportunities and act on them. We have a management team, but we hire people who own their work and deliver without being chased.
  • Efficient. You respect time and budgets, and you find the shortest path to great work.
  • Driven by founders. You care about helping founders get into the market and succeed there.
  • Inquisitive. You dig for human insights about the audience, the ones that make the language land and the product connect.
  • Ego-free. None of us have one, and we value that deeply.
  • Flexible. Early-stage companies pivot, and so do we. You can move quickly when things change.
  • Open to feedback from every direction. We are an egalitarian team. Good ideas come from everyone, and every perspective here adds value.

Experience

  • 5+ years of relevant writing experience, ideally at a senior level.
  • Enterprise experience (strongly preferred): writing for enterprise software, selling to enterprise buyers, or working inside an enterprise tech company.
  • Bonus: familiarity with venture capital and early-stage startups, from formation through early rounds.
  • A strategic portfolio that shows reasoning, not just polished copy.
  • Any background welcome. We care more about how you think and write than where you came from. Career changers are encouraged to apply.
