If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

This opening is for our Medical Research & Development team.
Responsible for the application of biostatistical methods to support clinical trials and data management, including statistical planning, design, analysis, and reporting throughout the project life cycle in accordance with project, organizational and regulatory standards. Act as subject matter expert, providing statistical support to project teams, quality/study auditors, and external stakeholders. Analysis Services

Academic and Project Research Support

  • Working in conjunction with the Director of Academic Research, convert and present new and novel biometrical trial technologies, processes and findings into publishable and promotable scientific processes and results.

Statistical Analysis/Data Collection Planning and Study Report Support

You'll work across Paid Media, SEO, Analytics, Lifecycle, and Product Marketing to bring one cohesive growth strategy to life. You'll spend as much time thinking about where we should invest next quarter as you will digging into funnel performance, reviewing experiments, and solving growth challenges with the team.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys owning outcomes, thrives in a data-rich environment, and wants to have a meaningful impact on the direction of a growing SaaS business.

We're looking for someone who has personally built growth engines—not someone who has simply managed marketing programs.

Growth Strategy

Measurement & Forecasting

  • Partner closely with Analytics to ensure we have the right measurement, dashboards, and attribution in place.
  • Use data to identify trends, explain performance, and inform future investment decisions.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Provide strategic direction for SEO and Growth Analytics as they support Invoice Simple.
  • Work closely with Product Marketing and Lifecycle Marketing to ensure acquisition efforts align with broader go-to-market priorities.
  • Bring teams together around shared goals and keep everyone focused on the work that will have the biggest business impact.

  • Executive Communication

  • Present growth performance, forecasts, and recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Translate complex data into clear business insights.

  • Experience managing significant paid media investments ($10M+ preferred).

This role can be based anywhere in Canada – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. jobs.title: Senior iOS Developer - Swift, Kotlin Multiplatform & AI Coding
jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote
Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve our engineering workflows, and build practical knowledge across the team.

We are looking for a senior developer who can take ownership of iOS development, deliver reliable software, and help our team become more effective at building applications with AI.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior iOS App Developer with an excellent background in native iOS development using Swift and SwiftUI, together with practical experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into iOS applications.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will develop and improve our iOS application, integrate shared application logic, solve complex technical problems, and establish effective workflows for AI-assisted and agentic development.

Experience with GPS, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), Ultra-Wideband (UWB), or related location and proximity technologies would be particularly valuable.

You will also share your knowledge with our internal team, including mentoring a junior team member who is learning to build mobile applications through AI-assisted development, often referred to as “vibe coding.”

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve our native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI.
  • Integrate Kotlin Multiplatform modules into the iOS application and collaborate on shared business logic.
  • Implement platform-specific functionality while maintaining consistent behavior across iOS and Android.
  • Implement and troubleshoot location and proximity features involving GPS, BLE, UWB, and related device capabilities.
  • Address practical iOS challenges such as permissions, application lifecycle, background execution, battery consumption, and device compatibility.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents extensively to implement features, investigate defects, refactor code, and support testing.
  • Set up and improve agentic development workflows, including task decomposition, project context, automated checks, and review processes.
  • Review and validate AI-generated code, taking responsibility for its correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
  • Test relevant functionality on real devices and investigate issues that automated tests alone may not reveal.
  • Mentor our junior team member through practical demonstrations, pair programming, and clear explanations.
  • Support application signing, release preparation, and distribution through TestFlight and the App Store.
  • Document important technical decisions and share reusable knowledge with the internal team.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production iOS applications.
  • Excellent practical knowledge of Swift, SwiftUI, and the iOS development ecosystem.
  • Practical experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and its integration into native iOS applications.
  • Solid understanding of application architecture, asynchronous programming, lifecycle management, and state management.
  • Strong debugging skills across application code, shared modules, APIs, and device behavior.
  • Substantial hands-on experience using AI coding tools to deliver working software.
  • A strong interest in agentic coding and the ability to establish effective development workflows around coding agents.
  • The ability to assess AI-generated solutions critically and explain technical decisions.
  • Willingness and ability to teach less experienced team members patiently and clearly.
  • The ability to work independently, communicate progress clearly, and take ownership of results in a remote team.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • GPS positioning, location accuracy, geofencing, and sensor data.
  • BLE discovery, advertising, connections, and proximity detection.
  • UWB ranging, distance measurement, direction estimation, and hardware compatibility.
  • NFC and other device-to-device interactions.
  • Interoperability between Swift and Kotlin Multiplatform, including asynchronous operations and error handling.
  • Building automated development and testing workflows that combine human oversight with coding agents.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • Ownership of meaningful iOS development work.
  • The opportunity to shape how our team uses AI and coding agents.
  • Close collaboration with an internal team that wants to learn from your experience.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your role in developing and releasing iOS applications.
  • Your experience integrating Kotlin Multiplatform into native iOS projects.
  • Any practical experience with GPS, BLE, UWB, or similar technologies.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with an example of how they helped you deliver a working application or feature.
  • Your experience mentoring junior developers or colleagues learning AI-assisted development.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, App Store references, or GitHub links are welcome where available.

jobs.title: Competition Analyst
jobs.excerpt: The Competition Analyst is responsible for delivering best-in-class competitive intelligence, case design strategies, and sales support focused on the Fixed Indexed Annuity (FIA) market.
jobs.description:
The Competition Analyst is responsible for delivering best-in-class competitive intelligence, case design strategies, and sales support focused on the Fixed Indexed Annuity (FIA) market. This role serves as a key partner to Product Management, Marketing, and Sales & Distribution teams by analyzing competitor products, identifying market trends, and developing winning sales strategies that help John Hancock increase FIA sales and market share.


The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in FIA product design, illustrations, indexing strategies, crediting methods, caps, participation rates, spreads, bonuses, riders, and income solutions. Leveraging this expertise, the Competition Analyst will proactively support distribution partners, optimize competitive positioning, and provide actionable insights that help John Hancock win business in the independent marketing organization (IMO) channel.


The role is a remote opportunity open to anyone in the continental US.


Key Accountabilities


  • Serve as the subject matter expert for competitive positioning within the FIA marketplace.
  • Proactively engage with sales and distribution partners to identify high-potential FIA opportunities and develop customized competitive strategies to improve placement rates.
  • Analyze application pipelines, sales trends, and competitive data to identify opportunities to win business from competing carriers.
  • Create and deliver competitive FIA illustrations, case design recommendations, and product positioning support for wholesalers and sales teams.
  • Monitor competitor product launches, pricing actions, crediting strategy changes, rate adjustments, rider enhancements, and promotional programs.
  • Develop competitive intelligence reports and market commentary for leadership, Product Management, and Distribution teams.
  • Lead the development of competitive content, sales concepts, comparison materials, and "Competition Corner" resources that clearly articulate John Hancock's value proposition.
  • Partner with Product Management throughout product development cycles to ensure competitor insights and market intelligence inform strategic decisions.
  • Conduct training sessions for wholesalers, sales desk associates, and distribution partners on FIA product positioning and competitive sales strategies.
  • Build and maintain expertise across major FIA competitors, their product portfolios, and their distribution strategies within the IMO marketplace.

Responsibilities


  • Provide daily case consultation and illustration support for FIA opportunities.
  • Monitor competitive illustration requests and respond with timely recommendations and sales strategies.
  • Support internal and external wholesalers with complex FIA case design scenarios.
  • Evaluate competitor FIA products including: Crediting strategies, Index allocations, Participation rates, Cap rates, Spread methodologies, Premium bonuses, Income riders, Death benefit riders, Liquidity features, Surrender schedules
  • Identify opportunities where John Hancock products can be positioned competitively against specific carriers.
  • Present competitive findings and market updates during distribution calls and sales meetings.
  • Develop actionable sales concepts that simplify complex FIA product comparisons.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to create competitive sales materials and educational content.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of regulatory, product, and market developments affecting the FIA industry.
  • Support management with ongoing analysis of competitive threats, emerging trends, and distribution opportunities.

Job Requirements


  • 3 to 7 years of experience in Fixed Indexed Annuities (FIA) within Product Management, Competitive Intelligence, Competitive Services, Sales Support, Advanced Markets, or Distribution.
  • Direct experience supporting IMO distribution channels.
  • Demonstrated expertise in FIA product mechanics and competitive positioning.
  • Deep understanding of: Crediting strategies, Indexed account structures, Caps, spreads, and participation rates, Income riders, Bonus strategies, Product illustrations
  • Experience analyzing and interpreting competitor illustrations and sales concepts across carriers.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex product information into clear recommendations.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills.
  • Proven ability to work effectively with Product, Marketing, and Sales teams.

Preferred Job Requirements


  • Experience working for a life insurance or annuity carrier with a meaningful FIA presence.
  • Experience supporting independent agents, IMOs, BGAs, or brokerage distribution.
  • FINRA Series 6, 63, or securities background.
  • Familiarity with major FIA competitors and market leaders.
  • Experience using FIA illustration and competitive intelligence tools.

How will you create impact?

This role sits within the Product organization and serves as a critical connection between Product Management and Sales & Distribution. You will directly influence our ability to compete and win in the growing FIA marketplace by translating competitive intelligence into actionable sales strategies.


Your expertise in fixed indexed annuities, case design, and competitive analysis will help wholesalers, IMOs, and distribution partners confidently position John Hancock solutions against industry-leading carriers. jobs.description:
Senior Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Manager
Remote | Construction & Remodeling
Great design gets attention. Great marketing brings in the right customers. We’re looking for someone who can do both.
About the Opportunity
We’re a small construction and remodeling company with a great team and ambitious growth goals. We’re hiring an experienced, hands-on marketing professional to lead our marketing strategy, create compelling content, manage advertising, grow our online communities, and generate a consistent flow of high-quality leads.
This is more than a social media posting position. We need someone who can develop the plan, execute it, track the numbers, and explain how marketing contributes to real business opportunities.
You should be creative, analytical, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership. You enjoy working remotely, collaborating with a team, and finding better ways to reach the right customers.
Your mission: Turn our work, reputation, and marketing investment into qualified inquiries, booked consultations, and opportunities for profitable projects.
What You’ll Own
Marketing Strategy & Lead Generation
Develop and execute an integrated marketing plan across paid advertising, organic social media, community groups, local search, referral initiatives, and follow-up campaigns.
Identify the audiences, service areas, project types, and messages most likely to produce worthwhile opportunities. Bring fresh ideas, prioritize the strongest opportunities, and adjust campaigns to support our sales goals and production capacity.
We want an ambitious marketer who pursues growth with urgency—not someone who waits to be told what to post.
Google Ads & Paid Social Advertising
Hands-on Google Ads experience is required. You must be comfortable building, managing, troubleshooting, and improving campaigns—not simply reviewing reports from an outside agency.
Manage Google Ads and paid campaigns on Facebook and Instagram, including campaign structure, keyword research, negative keywords, geographic targeting, audiences, ad copy, creative testing, conversion tracking, and budget allocation.
Monitor ad spend, budget pacing, campaign health, analytics, and lead quality daily. Identify wasted spend and tracking problems quickly. Make purposeful, data-backed adjustments while giving tests enough time and evidence to evaluate fairly.
Operate within approved budgets and clearly explain where additional investment is—or is not—justified.
Graphic Design, Content & Social Media
Create professional, engaging graphics, advertisements, short-form videos, reels, project spotlights, and other marketing materials.
Build and manage an organized content calendar with consistent organic posts, strong messaging, and clear calls to action. Turn real project photos, before-and-after images, customer stories, and team expertise into content that builds trust.
Coordinate with our field team to obtain useful photos and video footage. Manage publishing, comments, messages, and timely handoffs of customer inquiries.
A strong design portfolio and excellent writing skills are essential.
Community Groups & Audience Growth
Manage and grow company-owned groups and expand our participation in relevant local, homeowner, neighborhood, and community groups.
Maintain an active posting and engagement plan for each group, tailored to its audience and rules. Build relationships, contribute useful information, respond to remodeling questions, and identify opportunities for genuine conversations with potential customers.
We want meaningful community engagement and qualified inquiries—not repetitive promotional posts, spam, or follower counts without business value.
Tracking, Analytics & Lead Quality
Maintain reliable tracking from the first marketing interaction through inquiry, qualification, booked appointment, and—working with sales—sold project.
Use our customer relationship management system, advertising platforms, and analytics tools to show which activities are producing real opportunities. Monitor calls, forms, and lead routing, and help identify where good inquiries are getting lost.
Provide clear weekly reporting that answers:
  • What did we spend, and what did it produce?
  • Which sources delivered qualified leads and booked appointments?
  • What are we changing next, and why?
Work closely with the sales team to understand lead quality, appointment outcomes, and lost opportunities. Do not stop at reporting clicks or form submissions.
AI-Assisted Marketing & Advertising
Use AI tools thoughtfully to support research, creative development, ad variations, video editing, reporting, and marketing automation.
Understand AI-assisted advertising features and how to evaluate their performance, set appropriate controls, and recognize when human judgment is needed.
We’re looking for practical experience—not just familiarity with AI-generated captions. Be ready to explain where you have used AI, what you personally managed, and what improved.
Review AI-assisted work for accuracy, protect customer information, and never present fabricated testimonials or AI-generated projects as our completed work.
Local Visibility, Website Conversion & Brand Standards
Manage or coordinate local search visibility, Google Business Profile activity, review-request initiatives, and improvements to approved website content, landing pages, and lead forms.
Develop appropriate follow-up and re-engagement campaigns in coordination with sales. Support referral partnerships and other promising lead-generation opportunities.
Keep messaging consistent, respect approved service territories, and follow applicable brand, franchise, platform, and company requirements. Maintain organized company-controlled accounts, creative files, tracking tools, and access records.
What You Bring
  • A proven record of generating quality leads. Experience in construction, remodeling, home services, or another high-consideration local-service business is strongly preferred.
  • Direct Google Ads and paid social experience. You have personally managed campaigns and can explain the budgets, decisions, and results.
  • Strong graphic design and content skills. You can create polished work using Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva, or comparable tools, including basic short-form video editing.
  • Strong measurement skills. You are comfortable with Google Analytics 4, conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager or equivalent tools, CRM reporting, and connecting marketing activity to business outcomes.
  • Community-building experience. You know how to grow and engage relevant groups without relying on spam or empty activity.
  • Remote-work ownership. You communicate clearly, meet deadlines, organize your priorities, and collaborate well without needing constant direction.
A degree is not a substitute for demonstrated results. Show us what you have built, what you have improved, and what you personally contributed.
What Success Looks Like
We care about the right leads—not simply more leads.
For us, a qualified lead is a real homeowner or authorized decision-maker in our service area, seeking a service we offer, with a project that reasonably fits our scope, budget expectations, and timing.
Together, we will establish realistic performance targets based on our advertising budget, baseline results, service areas, and capacity. Your scorecard will emphasize qualified lead volume, cost per qualified lead, booked consultations, appointment quality, and attributable sales outcomes—not just reach, likes, or inexpensive form fills.
You will own marketing performance and work closely with sales on follow-up and conversion. We expect clear visibility into both what marketing is producing and what happens after a lead arrives.
With the right person, we will all be celebrating together! We love having talented rainmakers on our team. We have developed an incentive plan for sold leads that you generate.
Serious and qualified inquires only please!

jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

The Utilization Management Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting Clinical Operations by managing the intake, prior authorization, and clinical coordination workflows. This role ensures timely case intake, accurate authorization set-up, and effective coordination with members, providers, and internal clinical teams to support care transitions and authorization processes. The coordinator will be an important part of building strong relationships with health care providers through proactive communication, managing key operational processes to enable efficient, high-quality clinical decisions. This is a fast-paced environment that requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, and a natural talent for customer service. We often require management of several tasks at once, so enthusiasm and organization are key.

Utilization Management is a heavily regulated space, so you’ll work through unexpected situations and evolving guidance — including periodic CMS audits where the whole team pitches in on research and root cause.

Schedule:

This is a full-time, remote position working five 8-hour days per week. Shifts are scheduled between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM ET, with staggered schedules across the team to ensure seven-day coverage. We are hiring for:

  • Monday – Friday

  • Tuesday – Saturday

  • Sunday – Thursday

Your specific start time is assigned within the 8:00 AM – 8:00 PM ET window. We’ll ask about your schedule preference during the process and will do our best to match it. Because we’re filling a limited number of openings on each schedule, availability changes as roles are filled — so we ask that candidates be open to more than one schedule where possible.

Your responsibilities and impact will include:

Intake Management

  • Monitor intake queues, including daily census validation checks

  • Manage inbound and outbound correspondence

  • Ensure referrals and cases are accurately entered into our system or re-routed to delegates as applicable

Prior Authorization Support

  • Perform authorization set-up and case creation in our systems

  • Manage and resolve authorization-related inquiries across multiple case types

  • Review member inpatient status and clinical documentation to support episode updates

  • Ensure required documentation is present for clinical review and determination, including request for information (RFI) work and electronic health record (EHR) access

Clinical Coordination & Communication

  • Conduct outbound calls to members and providers to obtain clinical information and communicate UM decisions

  • Schedule and coordinate peer-to-peer (P2P) reviews between providers and Medical Directors

  • Manage Medical Director case assignments and tracking

  • Retrieve medical records via hospital EHR portals and external systems

  • Support the clinical team with case coordination and documentation needs

Post-Discharge & Transitional Care Coordination

  • Contact inpatient and post-acute facilities to confirm admission and discharge details

  • Complete daily census checks and assist with discharge planning coordination activities

  • Support care transition workflows and case follow-up

Operational & Reporting Support

  • Download and review operational reports (e.g., Looker, Snowflake)

  • Support RFIs and case tracking in inpatient and UM tools

  • Maintain accurate case status and documentation in our system

  • Provide operational and administrative support to the assigned team and manager

Required skills and experience:

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • Experience in healthcare operations, utilization management, care coordination, or prior authorization

  • Proficiency with healthcare systems, EHRs, and reporting tools

  • Effective communication skills with providers and members

  • Strong organizational and multitasking skills in a high-volume environment

  • Attention to detail, follow-through, and time management in a frequently changing environment

Desired skills and experience:

  • Prior experience in Medicare Advantage or managed care

  • Intake, authorization, or clinical coordination experience

  • Familiarity with UM or case management workflows

  • 1–3 years of administrative or medical office experience

  • Proficiency with Google Sheets and the Google Workspace suite

  • Bilingual



Salary Range: $21.70 - $27.00/ hour

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

Com 30 anos de experiência em transformação tecnológica, aceleramos inovação com expertise em agentic SDLC, application modernization, Data & AI, martech e business strategy.

Somos 8.000 CI&Ters em mais de 25 países, colaborando para construir soluções com impacto real. AI já faz parte da forma como trabalhamos, evoluímos e inovamos todos os dias.

Importante: se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.

Buscamos uma pessoa SoftwareArchitecture Manager com forte profundidade técnica, visão sistêmica e perfil hands-on para liderar a arquitetura do portfólio CI&T Flow e de soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial.

Responsabilidades:
1. Visão Sistêmica e Estratégia de Arquitetura:
- Definir e evoluir a arquitetura do portfólio CI&T Flow, considerando produtos, plataformas, agentes de IA, dados, integrações e infraestrutura.
- Compreender sistemas end-to-end, identificando dependências, riscos, gargalos e oportunidades de simplificação e reutilização.
- Estabelecer arquiteturas de referência, padrões técnicos e guardrails que acelerem a engenharia sem comprometer qualidade e escalabilidade.
- Garantir coerência arquitetural entre as soluções, equilibrando necessidades específicas dos clientes e evolução da plataforma.

2. Gestão de Portfólio e Priorização:

  • Liderar a priorização técnica das iniciativas, considerando impacto de negócio, esforço, capacidade disponível, dependências e riscos.
    - Trabalhar com as lideranças de Pré-Venda, Pós-Venda, Produto e Engenharia para alinhar prioridades e direcionar investimentos técnicos.
    - Gerenciar trade-offs entre demandas imediatas, evolução arquitetural e sustentabilidade das soluções.
    - Identificar oportunidades de reutilização de componentes, aceleradores e capacidades da plataforma.
    - Garantir foco nas iniciativas que geram maior valor para o negócio e para os clientes.
    3. Liderança Técnica Hands-on:
    - Atuar diretamente em decisões arquiteturais complexas, code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting e resolução de problemas críticos.
    - Desenvolver PoCs, protótipos e implementações de referência para validar hipóteses e reduzir incertezas técnicas.
    - Trabalhar próximo aos times de engenharia, contribuindo diretamente com código e decisões de implementação quando necessário.
    - Avaliar novas tecnologias e abordagens por meio de experimentação prática.
    - Promover excelência em engenharia, automação, CI/CD, DevSecOps, testes e observabilidade.
    4. Arquitetura de Soluções AI-Based:
    - Liderar o desenho e a evolução de soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes de IA e automação inteligente.
    - Definir padrões de orquestração, integração, gerenciamento de contexto, memória, observabilidade e governança de agentes.
    - Promover arquiteturas que favoreçam produtividade, autonomia, segurança, escalabilidade e eficiência de custos.
    - Trabalhar com Produto e Engenharia na evolução contínua das capacidades do CI&T Flow.
    5. Pré-Venda, Pós-Venda e Engenharia de Valor:
    - Atuar como referência técnica em oportunidades comerciais, discoveries, propostas e discussões arquiteturais com clientes.
    - Garantir consistência entre o que é proposto, vendido, entregue e operado.
    - Apoiar projetos estratégicos, implantação de soluções e resolução de desafios técnicos complexos.
    - Estruturar blueprints, aceleradores e playbooks que facilitem a adoção e escalabilidade das soluções.
    - Utilizar métricas e Value Stream Mapping para identificar gargalos, orientar prioridades e maximizar resultados.
    6. Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Pessoas:
    - Liderar e desenvolver arquitetos(as), tech leads e engenheiros(as) seniores.
    - Promover autonomia, ownership, colaboração e excelência técnica.
    - Apoiar decisões de contratação, composição de equipes e desenvolvimento de competências.
    - Equilibrar liderança, delegação e atuação hands-on nos desafios mais relevantes.


    Requisitos para este desafio:- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software e liderança técnica, atuando como Architecture Manager, Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Lead Architect ou equivalente;
    - Forte capacidade de Systems Thinking, compreendendo arquiteturas complexas e impactos de decisões entre diferentes sistemas;
    - Experiência em gestão de prioridades técnicas, dependências, riscos e trade-offs em ambientes com múltiplas iniciativas;
    - Experiência prática em desenvolvimento de software, com capacidade atual de programar, revisar código e investigar problemas complexos;
    - Proficiência em Python e/ou TypeScript;
    - Conhecimento sólido de sistemas distribuídos, APIs, microsserviços, arquitetura cloud-native e integração de sistemas;
    - Experiência com AWS, Azure ou GCP, containers, CI/CD e observabilidade;
    - Experiência com LLMs, GenAI, RAG e arquiteturas baseadas em agentes de IA;
    - Capacidade de conectar decisões arquiteturais a impacto de negócio, produtividade, custo e qualidade;
    - Experiência em liderança e desenvolvimento de profissionais técnicos;
    - Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos, executivos e clientes.


    Diferenciais:
    - Experiência com sistemas multiagentes, MCP, AI Coding Agents e Agentic Software Engineering;
    - Conhecimento de LangChain, LangGraph, Langfuse, LiteLLM e OpenTelemetry;
    - Experiência com plataformas de engenharia, developer platforms ou produtos SaaS;
    - Vivência com Solution Architecture, Pre-Sales Engineering e Technical Consulting;
    - Experiência em modernização de sistemas legados utilizando IA;
    - Conhecimento de Value Stream Mapping, engenharia de valor e métricas de produtividade;
    - Experiência com CI&T Flow ou plataformas corporativas de agentes de IA.

jobs.excerpt: About Integrated Specialty CoveragesIntegrated Specialty Coverages, LLC (ISC) is a growth stage technology and data-driven commercial MGA and insurance wholesaler leading innovation in the market.
jobs.description:
About Integrated Specialty Coverages

Integrated Specialty Coverages, LLC (ISC) is a growth stage technology and data-driven commercial MGA and insurance wholesaler leading innovation in the market.

Backed by one of the leading private equity firms, Onex Partners, and led by a forward-thinking management team, ISC is combining the worlds of insurance and technology to create an Insurtech powerhouse. As a leading online distributor of insurance products for a range of industries and “Main Street USA”, we are looking for the right people to help us in our mission of achieving exponential growth. We strive to be the number one place to go for brokers and agents to source insurance. To accomplish this, we’re building a digitally focused team that deeply understands the intersection between user experience, data, and AI/ML to optimize the way we engage with our customers and partners.

Job Summary

ISC International is seeking an accomplished Senior Vice President to lead its Product Recall & Contamination Business Unit. This executive will own the strategy, growth, profitability, and operating performance of the portfolio while building a scalable platform across underwriting, product, distribution, operations, claims, analytics, and talent.

The ideal candidate is a recognized product recall leader with deep carrier or specialty insurance experience, a strong record of profitable portfolio management, and the ability to translate market insight into disciplined underwriting and sustainable growth.

Position Responsibilities

  • Lead a product recall and contamination business for companies in the larger middle market and corporates segment across the cosmetics, food & beverage industry and the automobile sectors. Establish a clear market position, underwriting appetite, and distribution strategy aligned with the company’s broader specialty insurance platform.
  • Own profit-and-loss performance and deliver sustainable growth, underwriting profitability, risk appetite, premium growth and portfolio diversification.
  • Risk Assessment & Underwriting: Evaluate product recall exposures, manufacturing processes, quality control systems, and product safety protocols to determine insurability and appropriate coverage terms.
  • Pricing & Policy Structuring: Develop and apply underwriting strategies, pricing models, deductibles, limits, exclusions, and policy conditions tailored to individual client exposure
  • Client & Broker Relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with brokers, insureds, and key industry stakeholders to support profitable business development and retention.
  • Risk Engineering & Loss Prevention: Collaborate with risk engineers and technical specialists to identify potential product failure scenarios and recommend measures to reduce recall frequency and severity.
  • Claims & Loss Analysis: Partner with claims leadership on complex matters, review historical claims, loss trends, and emerging product safety issues to inform underwriting decisions and improve risk selection.
  • Industry & Regulatory Monitoring: Monitor developments in product safety regulations, recall trends, manufacturing practices, and emerging risks across relevant industries.
  • Underwriting Governance: Ensure compliance with underwriting guidelines, delegated authorities, internal controls, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with claims, actuarial, risk engineering, legal, and reinsurance teams to support sound underwriting decisions and portfolio performance.
  • Business Development: Identify new market opportunities, develop sector-specific underwriting strategies, and contribute to the achievement of premium and profitability targets.
  • Recruit, organize, develop, and retain a high-performing team of underwriting and business-unit professionals.
  • Define operating requirements and collaborate with technology, operations, finance, and analytics teams to improve workflow, data quality, reporting, and scalability.
  • Represent the business unit with executive leadership and provide clear reporting on performance, opportunities, risks, and strategic priorities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Extensive progressive leadership experience in product recall and contamination underwriting within a carrier, specialty insurer, MGA, or comparable platform.
  • Demonstrated success leading a business unit or substantial portfolio with direct accountability for growth, profitability, and underwriting performance.
  • Deep technical expertise across product recall and contamination products, exposures, policy forms, pricing considerations, and claims trends.
  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to balance market opportunity with disciplined risk selection and portfolio management.
  • Proven ability to develop strategy, translate it into an operating plan, and deliver measurable results.
  • Established relationships and credibility with brokers, clients, reinsurers, and industry partners.
  • Executive-level communication, negotiation, and influencing skills, including experience presenting to senior leadership and external stakeholders.
  • Strong financial and analytical capabilities, with fluency in portfolio metrics, forecasting, planning, and performance reporting.
  • Ability to lead effectively in an entrepreneurial, collaborative, and evolving environment.

This role also offers bonus pay. Your ISC Talent Acquisition representative will share more details about the bonus component should you advance in the interview process.

The starting annual pay scale for this position is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on factors such as skills, qualifications, training, and experience. In addition, the company offers comprehensive benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k) plan with match, paid time off, and other benefits.

ISC's salary ranges are determined by role and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

National Pay Range
$232,000—$290,000 USD

Benefits of Working at ISC

  • Employee Ownership Program - every eligible employee shares in the financial rewards that grow when the company grows
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Owner Referral Program
  • Work from home reimbursement for remote/hybrid roles
  • Canary emergency financial assistance program
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision
  • Life/AD&D Insurance
  • Confidential, Employee Assistance Program
  • Health Savings Account, includes company contribution
  • Short-term disability
  • Voluntary benefits - supplemental accident, critical illness, hospital insurance
  • Employee discounts
  • 401(k) Plan with company match contribution
  • Addition Wealth Financial Wellness Program
  • Various Time Off Programs
  • 11 company paid holidays

Applicants may contact the ISC HR department via e-mail or phone to request and arrange for an accommodation that will allow the applicant to successfully complete the application process. Applicants needing assistance may request accommodation at any time. Please contact ISC at or 760-599-7242.

ISC believes in creating long-term relationships by being responsive and relevant and by consistently delivering value to our community of customers. Specifically, we focus on attracting, developing, and retaining the best talent for our business, challenging our people, demonstrating a “can-do” attitude, and fostering a collaborative and mutually supportive environment.

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, mental or physical disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or Federal law.

**Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.**

jobs.excerpt: einleitungZur Verstärkung unseres SRE-Teams suchen wir einen Site Reliability Engineer (m/w/d), der die Weiterentwicklung von GameFabric aktiv mitgestalten möchte.
jobs.description:
einleitung

Zur Verstärkung unseres SRE-Teams suchen wir einen Site Reliability Engineer (m/w/d), der die Weiterentwicklung von GameFabric aktiv mitgestalten möchte. GameFabric ist führend in der Innovation als Orchestrierungsplattform für Gamingserver, während SteelShield fortschrittlichen DDoS-Schutz speziell für Gamingdatenverkehr bietet.
Du brennst für die Zukunft der Gamingbranche? Dann komm in unser Team und gestalte den Fortschritt aktiv mit!

deine aufgaben

Du überwachst den Betrieb mehrerer GameFabric-Umgebungen, die mehr als 50 Kubernetes-Cluster sowie einen zentralen Observability-Stack umfassen.
Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Entwicklern zusammen, um skalierbare Lösungen von der Konzeption bis hin zum Deployment zu entwickeln.
Du automatisierst Infrastruktur und Betrieb mithilfe von Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Ansible), GitOps-Praktiken (FluxCD) und unseren proprietären Kubernetes-Operatoren.
Du verbesserst und optimierst unseren Core-Tech-Stack über Cloud- und Bare-Metal-Umgebungen hinweg.
Du übernimmst gemeinsam mit dem restlichen Team die Rufbereitschaft, um einen reibungslosen Plattformbetrieb sicherzustellen (sobald du vollständig eingearbeitet bist und dich sicher fühlst).
Our Tech Stack: Linux | Kubernetes (GKE, RKE2, EKS, AKS, TKE) | Google Cloud | Agones | Terraform | FluxCD | GitHub Actions | Helm | Ansible | Go | PostgreSQL | VictoriaMetrics | Loki | Grafana | Tempo | Pyroscope

dein profil

Du besitzt einen Hochschulabschluss im IT-Bereich oder eine IT-Ausbildung bzw. über einschlägige Berufserfahrung.
Du besitzt solide Linux-Kenntnisse und verfügst über solide Grundlagen, die für eine effektive Fehlersuche und -behebung unerlässlich sind.
Du hast Erfahrung in der Implementierung von Infrastructure-as-Code (z. B. Terraform, Ansible oder Tools aus dem gleichen Bereich).
Du hast ein solides Grundwissen über die Prinzipien der Containerisierung und ein gutes Verständnis für Container-Verwaltungskonzepte.
Du hast eine Leidenschaft für Automatisierung und suchst immer nach Möglichkeiten, Prozesse reibungsloser zu gestalten und sich wiederholende Aufgaben zu reduzieren.
Du solltest praktische Erfahrung mit Skripting und Programmiersprachen wie Go, Python oder anderen haben.
Du bist ein kooperativer Teamplayer, der sich nicht scheut, seine Ansichten durchzusetzen, aber auch offen für Kompromisse ist, wenn es nötig ist.
Du verfügst über fließende Englischkenntnisse.

deine benefits

Gaming im Herzen: Wir bieten kostenlose Nitrado Game Server für Gamer und eine einladende Community für alle, die sich wohlfühlen möchten, selbst wenn du kein/e Gamer:in bist. Entdecke, wie Nitrado mehr ist als nur Gaming - eine offene Community für Technologie und Kreativität.
Vertrauensarbeitszeit: Passe deine Arbeitszeiten an deine persönlichen Bedürfnisse an, um eine bessere Work-Life-Balance zu erreichen.
Remote Work: Unsere agilen Teams arbeiten Hand in Hand von ihrem bevorzugten Standort aus zusammen, sei es in unseren modernen Büros in Karlsruhe oder Berlin oder vollständig remote.
Work from Abroad: Erweitere deinen Arbeitsbereich über die nationalen Grenzen hinaus mit unserer Remote-Work-Lösung aus dem Ausland. Wir ermöglichen es dir, zeitweise von deinem bevorzugten internationalen Standort aus zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig mit deinem Team in Kontakt zu bleiben.
Mentale Gesundheit: Wir unterstützen deine mentale Gesundheit durch unseren jährlichen Mental Health Day.
Physische Gesundheit: Unsere Büroinfrastruktur bietet modernste Arbeitsplätze mit ergonomischem Design, um deine Gesundheit und Produktivität zu fördern, während du auf dem Arbeitsweg mit deinem JobRad fit bleibst.
Weiterbildung: Nutze Fort- und Weiterbildungen, um Deine Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln und auf dem neuesten Stand zu bleiben.
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Wir unterstützen Deine finanzielle Sicherheit für die Zukunft mit einem attraktiven Zuschuss.
Arbeitsumfeld: Bei uns erlebst du ein respektvolles und freundliches Arbeitsumfeld, geprägt von Transparenz und einer familiären Unternehmenskultur.
Urlaub und bezahlte Freizeit: Genieße 30 Tage Urlaub und bezahlten Sonderurlaub zu besonderen Anlässen.
Internationale Zusammenarbeit: Als internationales Unternehmen überwinden wir erfolgreich Zeitzonen und Sprachbarrieren und bieten dir eine internationale Arbeitsatmosphäre.
Soziale Aktivitäten: Stärke Dein Engagement und den Teamzusammenhalt durch Team-Building-Events, der Teilnahme an Sportevents und sozialen Aktivitäten.

jobs.excerpt: ClientAn ICG client in the food and nutrition industry is seeking an experienced executive coach to work with its two senior executives as they lead the organisation through its next phase of international growth.
jobs.description:
Client

An ICG client in the food and nutrition industry is seeking an experienced executive coach to work with its two senior executives as they lead the organisation through its next phase of international growth.

The business has developed its intellectual property and a proven model in its home market, and is now working to find product-market fit in Europe. Its two senior executives are based in different regions (New Zealand and Europe), and the organisation is focused on operating more effectively and efficiently as a global business.
The client’s hypothesis is that better integration of its regions and their different market cultures – and, by extension, of the leaders of those regions – will drive stronger growth in France, Belgium and Switzerland.

Role

This role is ideal for a senior coach who has personally lived the challenge of taking a business into France and wider European markets, and who can combine executive partnership coaching with credible, practical market insight.

You will coach the two senior executives as a leadership partnership, strengthening how they work together across regions, time zones and cultures. You will also help them build a better basis for deciding what to localise for European markets and what to retain from the home-market model – even where that differs from the traditional approach in a given market.

KEY FOCUS AREAS

  • Strengthening the senior executive partnership – alignment, shared decision-making, roles and accountabilities, and effective collaboration across two regions.
  • Integrating the regions and their market cultures, so that regional leadership and teams operate as one global organisation rather than parallel businesses.
  • Building a robust, shared approach to “localise vs. retain” decisions as the business pursues product-market fit in France, Belgium and Switzerland.
  • Deepening the executives’ understanding of European markets, customers and ways of working.
  • Jointly developing the organisation’s own “standard” – culture, leadership and ways of working that hold across all markets.

KEY DELIVERABLE

A stronger, more effective senior executive partnership and a clearer, shared basis for international market decisions. Success will be reflected in a steeper growth curve in the European markets, a better understanding of those markets and how to operate in them, and a shared, articulated organisational standard for culture, leadership and ways of working.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

Direct, hands-on experience of expanding a business into France and/or other EU markets is the most important requirement for this engagement. The client is looking for someone who has been accountable for (or worked closely alongside leaders accountable for) European market entry and growth – not solely an adviser or generalist coach.

This should be combined with a strong track record of coaching senior executives, ideally including leadership pairs, co-leaders or founder teams.


Logistics

Start Date:As agreed.

Duration:3-6 months, as agreed.

Location:New Zealand and Europe – delivery can be fully remote

Delivery:Via video conferencing (e.g. Zoom / Microsoft Teams), with sessions scheduled across New Zealand and European time zones

Working Arrangements:Coaching engagement – joint partnership sessions with both executives, plus individual sessions as required, cadence to be agreed.

Rate:To be agreed with the client.

Close Date: No later than Thursday 12th, 5pm [NZDT]

APPLICATION PROCESS

Interested consultants should submit:

  • CV highlighting European market expansion and executive coaching experience

● Brief cover note addressing:

o Specific, direct experience of expanding a business into France and/or the EU

o Examples of coaching senior leadership partnerships or executive teams

o Availability and day rate expectations

This is an excellent opportunity to work with two senior executives of a growing food business at a pivotal point in its international expansion, applying your European market experience and coaching expertise to help shape how the organisation leads and grows across regions.

THE POSITION:

The Conversational AI Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and supporting intelligent virtual agents using NICE Cognigy, with a focus on digital chat and conversational experiences. This role partners with business, IT, and experience design teams to create scalable, reliable chatbot and virtual assistant solutions that deflect contacts, streamline customer journeys, and integrate seamlessly with the broader contact center ecosystem. Our employees are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of their teams. These results are achieved by:

  • Analyze business requirements and understand conversation flows, including flow diagrams, dialog logic, and acceptance criteria.
  • Design, build, test, and maintain NICE virtual agents, with a primary focus on digital chat and self‑service use cases.
  • Develop and manage conversation flows, intents, entities, dialog logic, and handoff scenarios to live agents across voice and digital channels.
  • Configure and tune natural language understanding (NLU) models to improve intent recognition, accuracy, and customer experience.
  • Implement and maintain integrations between Cognigy and backend systems, including CRM, knowledge bases, APIs, and automation services.

  • Maintain detailed technical documentation for conversation designs, configurations, and integrations.
  • Ensure all conversational AI solutions comply with security, privacy, accessibility, and compliance standards.

RPT Senior Medical Science Liaison

The company is focused on improving survival of people with cancer by harnessing the power of targeted radioisotopes. RayzeBio is developing innovative drugs against targets of solid tumors. Led by a successful and experienced entrepreneurial team, RayzeBio aims to be the global leader in radiopharmaceuticals

We are seeking a Radiopharmaceutical Senior Medical Science Liaison (RPT-Senior MSL) for RayzeBio to be trusted agile partner to the Thought Leader community. The role will engage in authentic, peer-to-peer scientific dialogue with leading RPT Thought Leaders and HCPs to strengthen RayzeBio’s scientific leadership, accelerate patient impact and shape the future of care. Your insights will inform clinical strategy, evidence generation and launch, ensuring that our innovative medicines reach patients in need. Led by a successful and experienced team, RayzeBio aims to be the global leader in radiopharmaceuticals.

  • Therapeutic Area Enablement: Educate internal stakeholders on evolving trends, real-world data and competitive landscape.

jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

Advise an early-stage women's health venture on sensor selection and hardware feasibility for a wearable device, helping the founding team make sound technical decisions before committing to a prototype build.

Organization: Confidential — early-stage women's health venture
Location: Remote, open to candidates across the SWANA region; Palestinian talent is welcome
Role Type: Flexible, part-time advisory contract, initially month-to-month
Reports to: The venture's founders

The opportunity

Our client, an early-stage women's health venture, has a defined concept and written description for a sensor-based wearable and is seeking experienced technical guidance before moving into hardware development. The founders — whose team includes a midwife — will continue to drive the research and day-to-day development themselves; they need an advisor who can stress-test the concept, flag feasibility gaps, and help translate a promising idea into a realistic, buildable hardware specification. This is a flexible, part-time advisory role: discussions, reviews and occasional focused technical contributions, with the possibility of a larger role as the venture and the relationship develop.

About the organization

Our client is an early-stage, founder-funded venture building products for women's health, working on several in parallel. The founding team includes a midwife, which grounds the venture's clinical thinking in direct frontline experience. For the sensor-based wearable at the center of this role, the founders have already worked out a concept and a written description of how it could work, and are now looking for the technical judgement to pressure-test that thinking before resources go into building hardware.

What you will do
  • Review the wearable concept and proposed measurement methods, assess technical feasibility, and flag gaps or incorrect assumptions
  • Recommend suitable sensors and components, and explain alternative approaches to achieving the required measurements
  • Advise on design choices that could make the wearable smaller, simpler, or more effective
  • Help translate the concept into clear technical specifications, including small pieces of documentation or other focused technical work when agreed
  • Discuss progress, help guide development milestones, and help prioritize useful research or exploratory work
  • Explain recommendations and trade-offs clearly to founders who do not have an engineering background
  • Identify questions that need deeper specialist input and suggest where to seek that expertise

What you bring
  • Practical experience in hardware engineering and sensors, with enough technical depth to provide useful, well-founded advice
  • Understanding of sensor selection, component choices, and how sensing hardware fits into a complete device
  • Broad awareness of what is involved in building a wearable, and the judgement to recognize when additional specialist input is needed
  • Clear communication in English, with the ability to explain technical ideas, discuss assumptions, and collaborate constructively with non-technical founders
  • Availability for the agreed advisory hours, with some overlap around European lunchtime or evening

Senior experience is helpful, but earlier-career engineers who can demonstrate strong, directly relevant experience and the ability to advise within their area of expertise are also welcome — there is no fixed requirement for a particular number of years.

Helpful, but not essential
  • Experience developing wearables or compact sensor-based devices (transferable experience from other hardware products is also welcome)
  • Relevant experience with optical sensing, including infrared or blue light, or with flow, temperature, pressure, or density measurement
  • Experience in health technology, or an interest in women's health and the problems the venture is working to address

How the engagement works

Compensation is an hourly rate, with the initial allocation agreed based on relevant expertise and scope. This is initially a small, flexible advisory engagement that can fit alongside other work; the monthly allocation, or use of an agreed block of hours, will be arranged with the selected advisor. With mutual interest and as the venture develops, there may be scope for a larger commitment or future discussions about a technical co-founder or CTO role; any expansion would be agreed separately. You will need your own laptop, reliable connectivity, a secure work environment and two-factor authentication where required.

About Apricot

Apricot is a nonprofit sourcing firm connecting displaced and underserved professionals from Palestine and the wider MENA region with global employment opportunities. We combine a clear social-impact mission with fast, high-quality recruitment delivery for international clients.

jobs.description:
About PLEJ

The Partnership for Large Election Jurisdictions (PLEJ) is a national, nonpartisan community of support, best practices, and peer engagement among election offices serving the largest and most diverse populations in the U.S. PLEJ empowers election leaders to address operational challenges, communicate with clarity and transparency, and drive innovation. Through collaborative problem-solving and practical innovation, PLEJ helps build more resilient, efficient, and voter-focused election systems that improve the experience and confidence of millions of Americans. PLEJ is entering a critical phase of growth and impact—expanding its capacity, strengthening its institutional role, and positioning large jurisdictions as national leaders in election administration.

Position Summary

Reporting to the Executive Director and serving on PLEJ’s senior leadership team, the Senior Director of Operations and Finance (SD-O&F) serves as the Chief Operating Officer and the Executive Director’s principal operating partner. The SD-O&F translates organizational priorities into annual operating plans, budgets, clear ownership, timelines, and measures of progress.

The SD-O&F leads PLEJ’s financial management and internal operations, including people operations, compliance, risk management, systems, data, and core infrastructure. In partnership with the Executive Director, staff, and Board, the SD-O&F maintains the systems and management practices needed for reliable execution and responsible growth. This role gives leadership timely visibility into financial performance, organizational capacity, and operational risk; supervises staff responsible for financial administration and operational systems; and ensures teams have clear processes, appropriate resources, and accountability to deliver their work.

Working closely with the Executive Director, staff, and Board, the SD-O&F establishes operating practices and approval controls, resolves cross-functional barriers, and drives follow-through on organizational commitments within the Board-approved budget and delegated authority.

Requirements

Core Responsibilities

The SD-O&F leads PLEJ’s financial stewardship and internal operations, turning organizational priorities into clear systems, accountable ownership, and reliable execution:

Organizational Leadership and Execution

  • Partner with the Executive Director and senior leadership team to translate strategy into an annual operating plan with clear priorities, owners, milestones, resource assumptions, and measures of progress.
  • Establish a regular operating review cadence to monitor progress, surface delays and dependencies, make decisions, and ensure corrective actions have an owner and deadline.
  • Coordinate cross-functional planning so staffing, budgets, program schedules, convenings, partnerships, and operational capacity are aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Provide clear recommendations and timely decisions on operational matters within delegated authority; elevate significant tradeoffs, risks, and resource needs to the Executive Director promptly.
  • Build a culture of ownership, clear communication, sound judgment, and continuous improvement across internal operations.

Financial Strategy and Stewardship

  • Lead the annual budgeting process and maintain multi-year financial plans, rolling forecasts, and cash-flow projections in partnership with the Executive Director and program leaders.
  • Deliver timely monthly financial reporting, including budget-to-actual results, cash position, forecast changes, grant spending, and concise explanations of material variances with recommended actions.
  • Monitor revenue, expenses, staffing commitments, restricted funds, and organizational reserves; identify emerging financial pressures early and help leadership develop practical responses and scenarios.
  • Oversee financial administration and accounting processes, including monthly close, accounts payable and receivable, payroll, purchasing, expense controls, and accurate financial records.
  • Maintain appropriate financial policies, internal controls, delegated approval thresholds, and separation of duties. Ensure transactions are reviewed and approved by the appropriate people in a timely manner.
  • Oversee grant budgets, fund restrictions, cost allocation, financial reports, and documentation to ensure funds are used as authorized and reporting obligations are met on time.
  • Coordinate annual audit and tax preparation, address findings, and manage relationships with accounting, audit, banking, insurance, compliance, and other service providers.
  • Prepare clear financial analysis and recommendations for the Executive Director and Board, and present financial information to the Board as requested.

Operations, Systems, and Infrastructure

  • Design, document, and improve organizational workflows, policies, tools, and systems so responsibilities and handoffs are clear and work is completed accurately and efficiently.
  • Lead operational planning for core organizational processes and ensure systems support PLEJ’s programs, member engagement, convenings, and partnerships.
  • Oversee vendor selection and management, contracts, insurance, procurement, and administrative processes.
  • Strengthen data governance, records management, privacy, access controls, and secure handling of sensitive organizational and member information.
  • Maintain business continuity and operational resilience plans, including cybersecurity readiness and clear procedures for responding to disruptions.
  • Use appropriate performance measures and management tools to give leaders a practical view of organizational workload, progress, risks, and capacity.
  • Ensure resilient, scalable systems that support PLEJ’s growth and evolving role without operational strain.

People Operations and Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop the Operations & Finance team, setting clear roles, priorities, performance expectations, and professional development goals.
  • Oversee people operations in partnership with the Executive Director and external HR providers, for workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, performance management, staff policies, and compensation processes.
  • Support managers in setting expectations, addressing performance or workload concerns, and maintaining a respectful, accountable, and collaborative workplace.
  • Assess staffing and operational capacity as PLEJ grows, and recommend practical approaches to sequencing work, assigning responsibility, and building needed capabilities.
  • Support broader organizational efforts and collaborate across teams to meet evolving priorities, including taking on additional responsibilities as needed that contribute to PLEJ’s mission and impact.

Governance, Compliance, and Risk Management

  • Maintain a coordinated compliance calendar and systems for tracking legal, regulatory, grant, tax, insurance, and Board policy obligations.
  • Ensure records, approvals, contracts, financial documentation, and grant files are complete, accessible to authorized staff, and ready for audits or funder reviews.
  • Maintain an organization-wide risk management process covering financial, operational, legal, reputational, people, data, and cybersecurity risks; assign owners and track mitigation actions.
  • Coordinate with the Executive Director, Board leadership, counsel, auditors, insurers, and other advisers on governance, compliance, and material risk matters.
  • Provide the Board with accurate, timely operational and financial information that supports oversight and sound decision-making.

Qualifications

Candidate should demonstrate the following experience, skills, and capabilities:

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business administration, public administration, or a related field required; a master’s degree or CPA is preferred.
  • At least 10 years of progressively responsible experience in finance, operations, organizational management, or a related field, including at least five years in senior leadership.
  • Substantial responsibility for organizational budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, internal controls, and the stewardship of restricted or grant-funded resources.
  • A record of improving financial and operating systems and using them to support organizational decisions, accountability, and reliable execution.
  • Experience translating strategy into operating plans with clear ownership, timelines, measures, and regular follow-up on results.
  • Experience leading, supervising, and developing staff, including setting priorities and performance expectations in a lean or changing organization.
  • Strong financial analysis skills and the ability to explain financial information clearly to non-financial colleagues and Board members.
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder work, external vendors or professional service providers, and competing organizational priorities.
  • Sound judgment, integrity, discretion, and the ability to manage confidential financial, personnel, and organizational information.
  • Ability to work effectively in diverse, high-visibility environments while maintaining PLEJ’s commitment to nonpartisanship.

Preferred

  • Experience in a nonprofit, association, public interest, or other grant-funded organization.
  • Experience supporting organizational growth, building infrastructure, or leading a period of institutional change.
  • Familiarity with nonprofit accounting, fund accounting, grant compliance, audit processes, and Board practices.

O que é nosso time de Tech Backoffice Franquias?

A Diretoria de Backoffice Franquias tem como missão alavancar a excelência operacional e os resultados da rede de franquias por meio de viabilização de produtos digitais que influenciem no fortalecimento do futuro e evolução das franquias. We're looking for a Personal Injury Protection Resolution (PIP) Adjuster to join our growing team. You'll investigate and evaluate PIP/MP claims and coverage while managing your own inventory of claims. If you bring strong analytical skills, excellent communication, and a passion for exceptional customer service—we want to hear from you!

Who You Are
  • Excited about building a tech-driven claims organization
  • Passionate about the customer experience
  • You're empathetic and patient with everyone you interact with
  • Driven by a sense of urgency (without working around the clock)
  • Creative in finding the right resolution that serves the insured's best interest
  • You're comfortable with conflict—see it as conversational, not adversarial
  • Curious about the whole story so you can make the right decisions early
  • Anti-status quo—you don't just wish things were different, you make them different
  • A strong communicator
  • You have a sense of humor (claims are hard enough as it is!
What You'll Do
  • Provide high-quality customer service by handling calls, filing claims, and resolving requests
  • You'll investigate PIP/MP claims to determine coverage, injury extent, and evaluate medical billing
  • Gather documentation, interview parties, explain coverage, and resolve medical expenses
  • Assess claim validity and determine appropriate settlement amounts or next steps
  • You'll manage claim inventory and establish/adjust reserves throughout the claim lifecycle
  • Ensure compliance with state regulations, policy provisions, and SOPs
  • Communicate regularly with claimants, policyholders, attorneys, and medical providers
  • You'll prepare thorough claim reports with investigation findings and decision rationale
  • Provide input for continuous improvement of claims guidelines and processes
  • Oversee outside service providers and work with client counsel to resolve claims
  • Engage in learning opportunities to build your claims expertise
What You Bring
  • 3+ years of experience in Personal Injury Protection (don't let a lack of a degree stop you from applying if you have the experience!)
  • Experience handling NJ (required) and at least one other state to include MI, FL, NY, TX and/or KY
  • Preferred: Commercial, rideshare, or trucking policy experience
  • You understand subrogation referrals
  • Knowledge of Bodily Injury and coordination of benefits between PIP and UM/UIM
  • Arbitration and/or formal PIP/MP litigation experience
  • You must have an active adjuster license in your home state or designated home state (if your state does not offer one) and be willing to obtain all required licenses within 60 days
  • Strong knowledge of state regulations and policy provisions
  • Eager for continuous learning and professional development
  • Willing to travel for client and claims needs

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy after 8 months of continuous work
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!
Additionally, we will
  • Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role
  • Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from an adjuster role
  • Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

  • Analyze contracts, financial ledgers, lease agreements, and addenda to determine claim validity and obligations.
  • Ensure compliance with state regulations, policy provisions, and internal procedures.
  • Communicate with all involved parties and issue payments within the set authority.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of claims guidelines, best practices, and workflows.
  • Oversee and direct investigative service providers, working closely with clients, counsel, and other stakeholders.

Qualifications
