jobs.description:
About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike.

We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can’t wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

As a Team Lead at Reserv, you will be a working leader providing support to a Claims manager with leadership and claim technical responsibilities. Leadership responsibilities will include overseeing work done within the Commercial Transportation Claims (trucking) adjusting staff. We want your background and experience to deliver operational effectiveness, particularly in leveraging technology and analytics to drive better efficiencies and performance. You will serve a critical role with the team, the customers, and the client. This role will balance management responsibilities and individual contributor responsibilities when volume dictates the need for assistance with a claim.

Who you are

  • Highly motivated and growth-oriented, impactful and influential
  • Claims professional - you are knowledgeable and have a track record of success in commercial transportation claims adjudication.
  • Strong leader - through formal management experience or a proven track record of peer and project leadership, you have demonstrated the ability to motivate, support, and teach a team to help them excel in their roles.
  • Tech-oriented - You are excited by the prospect of building a tech-driven claims organization while delivering an excellent service and have proven results leveraging technology and analytics.
  • Passionate - Claims professional who cares about their team, the customer, and their experience
  • Empathetic leader - You exercise empathy and patience towards everyone you interact with
  • Sense of urgency - at all times. That does not mean working at all hours
  • Creative - You challenge existing assumptions and find ways of leveraging technology and the talents of your team to address problems
  • Curious - You want to know the whole story so you can make the right decisions early and be decisive when it counts.
  • Problem solver - You have the ability to take a ‘deep dive’ into the details of the business while staying focused on the big picture.
  • Anti-status quo - You don’t just wish things were done differently; you act on it
  • Communicative - You are comfortable with and understand the importance of phone communications throughout the claims process.
  • And did we mention a sense of humor? Claims are hard enough as it is!

What we need

We need you to do all the things typical to the role:

  • Flexibility - you will need to be able to switch from claims handling to coaching and feedback
  • Agility- you must have an agile mindset and the ability to pivot from focus to focus in a moment’s notice
  • Be consistently dependable in achieving or exceeding goals and overcoming obstacles
  • Implement and maintain best practices for claims handling, including claim intake, investigation, evaluation, settlement, and recovery
  • Align team with client and customer expectations of the claims process
  • Serve as a resource for escalated claims
  • Foster a positive work environment, promote teamwork, and encourage professional growth and development
  • Attract, hire, retain, and provide a high level of training with the support of the rest of the leadership team
  • Prepare and present comprehensive claims reports, metrics, and analyses to clients and customers; advise clients on claim trends and loss mitigation

Job Duties:

  • Serve as backup/leader when the Manager is out of office
  • Responsible for having direct reports
  • Responsible for initial onboarding tasks/ access and new hire cultural immersion
  • SME for first-line questions, escalations, roundtable discussions
  • Increased reserve and payment authority with the ability to assist with moderate reviews
  • Identify topics and trends to discuss in team Huddles and Elevated Claims Experience Workshops lead/ co-lead by Team Leads, Managers, and other Reserv employees
  • Customer Obsession Champions- Active advocates who help leadership cultivate a customer-centric mindset

Requirements

  • 5+ years of insurance claims experience in multiple lines of business, preference for an transportation (trucking) with some bodily injury experience
  • Active adjuster license required: resident state license if available, otherwise a Designated Home State (DHS) license
  • 3+ years of leadership experience with a preference for experience managing in a remote environment
  • Comfortable with technology and the ability to evolve the claims systems and processes to drive better efficiencies and outcomes
  • Demonstrated commitment to quality, accuracy, and attention to detail
  • Integrity, ethics, and a strong sense of accountability in handling confidential and sensitive information

Benefits

  • Generous health-insurance package with nationwide coverage, vision, & dental
  • 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching
  • Competitive PTO policy – we want our employees fresh, healthy, happy, and energized!
  • Generous family leave policy
  • Work from anywhere to facilitate your work life balance paired with frequent, regular corporate retreats to build team cohesion, reinforce culture, and have fun
  • Apple laptop, large second monitor, and other quality-of-life equipment you may want. Technology is something that should make your life easier, not harder!

Additionally, we will

  • Listen to your feedback to enhance and improve upon the long-standing challenges of an adjuster and the claims role
  • Work toward reducing and eliminating all the administrative work from an adjuster role
  • Foster a culture of empathy, transparency, and empowerment in a remote-first environment

At Reserv, we value diversity and believe that a variety of perspectives leads to innovation and success. We are actively seeking candidates who will bring unique perspectives and experiences to our team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from underrepresented groups to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Senior Estimator, Wireline
jobs.excerpt: To be a team member at ADB Companies, or as we call it, part of the A-Team, you must be ALL IN to support the company's mission, vision, and values.
jobs.description:
To be a team member at ADB Companies, or as we call it, part of the A-Team, you must be ALL IN to support the company's mission, vision, and values.

OUR MISSION: We are a customer-centric partner providing innovative solutions. The safety, well-being, and career growth of our team members are the benchmarks of our success.

POSITION TITLE: Senior Estimator, Wireline

CLASSIFICATION: Exempt

POSITION OVERVIEW:

ADB is a Nationwide full turnkey provider of technology infrastructure solutions including Wireline, Wireless, ISP, AV, and Engineering. Our customer centric approach has ensured long term relationships with commercial clients, service providers, local, state, and federal government organizations. We recognize our team members as our greatest asset ensuring that their safety, well-being, and career growth are always our number one priority. Our ALL IN culture includes a focus on Safety, Wellness, Learning, Diversity and Inclusion, and giving back to our Communities.

ADB is seeking a Senior Estimator with deep, hands-on experience in telecommunications OSP estimating, wireline preferred. This role will lead the estimating process within the company's estimating software and cost database. The Senior Estimator will build and maintain the standardized cost libraries, crew structures, and item templates that estimators across our OSP divisions Nationwide will rely on. The ideal candidate is a builder of both estimates and estimating systems. They turn RFPs, rate cards, and bid packages into well-documented, near-final estimates under tight deadlines, and bring an ALL IN attitude to achieving results.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Estimate Development

  • Builds unit prices from the ground up using crew makeup, production rates, equipment costs, and material costs for wireline and OSP utility construction projects.
  • Prices both discrete bids and MSA rate cards, keeping the logic consistent and defensible across pricing formats.
  • Takes an RFP, rate card, or bid package to a 90% complete estimate. Each estimate includes documented assumptions, exclusions, and risks, so that Operations review focuses on judgment calls rather than rebuilding the numbers.
  • Reads and interprets construction drawings, engineering designs, and blueprints to determine quantities, methods, and labor and equipment needs.
  • Prepares estimates for use in subcontractor and vendor selection, and evaluates subcontractor and vendor pricing against internal cost benchmarks.

Estimating System and Cost Database Leadership

  • Leads the setup, structure, and ongoing maintenance of the company's estimating software and cost database.
  • Uses historical cost and production data to build and refine standardized cost libraries, crew definitions, item templates, and regional rate structures for other estimators to reuse.
  • Establishes and enforces estimating standards, workflows, and quality checks so that estimates are consistent, auditable, and comparable across regions and divisions.
  • Maintains cost data accuracy by regularly incorporating actual job performance, labor rates, equipment rates, and material pricing.
  • Trains, mentors, and supports estimators and other users on the estimating system, standards, and best practices.

Process, Collaboration, and Bid Support

  • Follows and champions company naming conventions and the Opportunity-to-SO-to-Job process so that estimates connect cleanly to downstream systems.
  • Partners with Business Development, Proposal Management, and Operations to align estimates with bid strategy, customer requirements, and execution plans.
  • Participates in and contributes to bid strategy meetings, and presents estimate findings, risks, and pricing recommendations to leadership.
  • Manages multiple concurrent bids under tight deadlines while maintaining accuracy and documentation standards.
  • Communicates regularly with support staff on future project requirements that would impact payroll, HR, Fleet, etc.
  • Has full understanding of underground construction operations, including equipment used, labor skills, safe digging operations, OSHA requirements, etc.
  • Adheres to and upholds ADB's safety culture, and ensures safety requirements are reflected in estimates and project planning.
  • Is able to support a fast paced, demanding work schedule, which could include early mornings, evenings, weekends, etc.
  • Performs other tasks as assigned by leadership.

SUCCESS FACTORS:

  • Travel Ability Nationwide
  • A strong belief in ZERO: Being Safe 100% of the time is the expectation
  • Alignment with company mission, vision, and values
  • A high level of customer centricity
  • Strong work ethic with an ALL IN attitude
  • Highly detail oriented and process minded, with a commitment to consistency, documentation, and data integrity
  • Systems thinker who can design repeatable estimating structures others can use
  • Ability to lead and influence across BD, Proposal Management, and Operations without slowing down the bid
  • Ability to perform in a fast paced/high volume environment under tight bid deadlines
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including clearly documenting assumptions and risks
  • Exceptional critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • A high level of time management, accountability, and prioritization skills
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and strong knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project)

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Must be able to work in a variety of physical positions, like sitting, squatting, standing, walking and driving.
  • Must endure regular exposure to all weather conditions, especially hot, humid and/or rainy spring, summer and fall weather, combined with regular work time indoors in environmentally controlled conditions.
  • May be exposed to uncomfortable or distracting sounds or noise levels on sites of projects being managed or coordinated.
  • Must wear common protective safety equipment, such as safety glasses, hard hat, steel toed boots, safety vests, etc.

EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION:

  • 5+ years' experience estimating OSP utility construction projects within the telecommunications industry required; wireline estimating strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience building unit prices from crew, production, equipment, and material inputs, and pricing both discrete bids and MSA rate cards
  • Experience implementing or administering estimating software and building structured cost libraries, crews, and templates
  • Prior OSP field experience preferred
  • Valid Driver License required
  • High School Diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field preferred

ADB Companies, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. All candidates agree to complete a selection assessment and pre-employment drug screen.

Microsoft Azure certification sponsorship: Nerdio covers exam fees for relevant Azure certifications (including AZ-104, AZ-140, MD-102, and others) as you grow in the role. The AZ-104 is expected to be completed within your first 90 days, fully funded.

The Supply Engineering Team Lead will report directly to the Chief Technical Officer and lead a team of four Supply Engineers.

Approximately 80% of the role focuses on team leadership, coordination, process improvement, and cross-functional collaboration, while 20% involves hands-on supply engineering activities to support the team during peak workload, employee absences, or complex projects.

  • Track engineering documentation and procurement changes throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Negotiate pricing, payment terms, and delivery schedules.

jobs.excerpt: About Us: At Reusables, we’re driven by a vision of a waste-free world and recognize the urgent need to address the environmental impact of our current systems and habits.
jobs.description:
About Us:

At Reusables, we’re driven by a vision of a waste-free world and recognize the urgent need to address the environmental impact of our current systems and habits. We believe that meaningful change requires institutions to offer frictionless systems that make sustainability effortless and tangible.

What began as a grassroots initiative offering reusable takeout containers to restaurants and cafes in Vancouver, has since grown into an enterprise technology platform reaching institutions across North America. Today, Reusables is helping to eliminate thousands of tonnes of single-use waste each year, empowering businesses to join the journey toward a cleaner, more sustainable future.

As a venture-backed and mission-driven company, we are passionate about making impact at scale. We are a young, weirdly talented group of ‘high-octane’ individuals that are relentlessly focused on the planet, people, and profit – in that order.

About the Role:

You’ll own the client relationship from contract signature through to renewal. You’re the connective tissue between our clients and every internal team: the person who keeps everyone accountable to the onboarding checklist, communicates with confidence when things go sideways, and knows your accounts well enough to spot an opportunity before the client does.

Your contribution is client satisfaction, retention and expansion: making sure clients get real value from Reusables, watching for the signals that point to churn, and finding the opportunities to grow each account.

You’ll sit in our Client Delivery team, which gets clients live and keeps them successful.

Most of our clients are universities, so the year follows the academic calendar: launches cluster ahead of each fall semester, and most renewals follow the end of the academic year. Some travel is required, especially during launch season from August to October, when you’ll be on campus with higher tier clients for their launches.

This is a full-time, permanent, remote position, open to candidates anywhere in the United States. The working hours for this role will be EST or CST.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be the primary point of contact for your accounts, from kickoff through renewal
  • Know each client’s goals, operations and challenges well enough to offer solutions before they ask
  • Customise and run the external kickoff, developed alongside our Hardware and Software teams
  • Build and maintain the onboarding checklist as the living record of what we’ve committed to, validate it with internal teams, and agree it with the client, including risks and timelines
  • Follow up on progress, escalate blockers, and manage client communication through to launch
  • Own the post-launch check-in cadence and keep a current view of every account’s health
  • Catch risks early and fix them before they reach the client
  • Find upsell and expansion opportunities, and own renewals and contract extensions end to end
  • Share feedback, friction points and patterns with Product and leadership
  • Own client communication on high-severity issues, working with Product on timeline and resolution
  • Flag scope creep to Product, and use the onboarding history to find root causes when issues arise

How Your Year Looks:

  • May to July: Kickoffs and onboarding for fall launches, and renewal conversations as the academic year closes
  • August to October: Launches (some on client site), early check-ins and fixing anything that slows adoption
  • November to February: Regular check-ins, account health reviews and the smaller off-cycle renewals
  • March to April: End-of-semester reviews, some launches, and renewal and expansion work for the next academic year

What You’ll Bring To The Team:

  • Account management or customer success experience with B2B clients, from onboarding through renewal
  • You’ve owned renewals and expansion conversations
  • You’ve run onboarding or implementation projects that involve several internal teams
  • Clear, plain-language communication, including when things go wrong
  • Follow-through: you close loops without being chased
  • Based in and eligible to work in the United States, and working EST or CST hours
  • Able and happy to travel to client campuses across the US, especially during launch season (August to October)
  • A positive, go-getter attitude: you’re excited by a new challenge every day, and you’ll figure out what you don’t know yet
  • Self-motivated and high ownership: give you a problem and you’ll own it through to the end, without waiting to be told how
  • No ego: we’re focused on the mission and check our egos at the door

Nice to have:

  • Experience with university, campus dining or food-service clients
  • Experience with hardware and software (IoT) products
  • Experience with ClickUp and HubSpot
  • Startup experience

If your background doesn’t perfectly align with the qualifications listed, but you’re confident in your ability to excel in this role, we still want to hear from you! At Reusables, we value diverse experiences and unique perspectives, so don’t hesitate to apply if you believe you can make a meaningful impact. We hire for attitude first. Skills can be taught, so we’d rather meet someone who takes on any task with excitement and figures it out, than someone held back by what they’ve done before.

We sincerely appreciate the time and effort of all applicants who express interest in joining our team. While we carefully review each application, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Thank you for considering Reusables as your next career opportunity!

Compensation & Key Criteria:

  • This is a remote position, open to candidates in the United States, working EST or CST hours
  • Some travel to client campuses is required, especially during launch season (August to October)
  • Compensation: $84,000–$101,000 USD per year, plus a variable pay compensation model
  • Reports to: Customer Delivery Lead

Why You’ll Love Working At Reusables:

  • Standard benefits package
  • A small, fun, low-ego team that loves the work we do together and the impact we have
  • Annual offsite with the entire Reusables team
  • Work that ships: You deliver impactful programs to campuses where people use them every day

Our Values:

  • Strive for excellence
  • Assume you have something to learn from everyone
  • Play bigger
  • Check your ego at the door
  • See the path forward, not the trees in the way

Why Join Us:

The ocean already contains 165 million tonnes of plastic, and by 2050, plastic waste could outweigh fish. While recycling is often touted as the solution, only 5% of plastic is actually recycled in the U.S. (9% in Canada). Governments and businesses worldwide are banning single-use plastics and committing to zero-waste solutions by 2030.

Reusable packaging is the most sustainable alternative, but adoption has been hindered by cost and operational complexity. Reusables removes these barriers, offering a scalable, tech-enabled solution for food businesses and the institutions that serve them.

DEI Statement:

At Reusables, we are building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do that successfully. We strongly encourage applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

Accessibility Statement:

Reusables provides an accessible candidate experience. If you need any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond, please let us know, and we will work with you to provide the necessary support and make reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation.

Our goal is a company that runs a secure development lifecycle on every project, has its own house in order, is well on the way to ISO/IEC 27001 certification, and has an internal Security Lead who can work with you and gradually take over day-to-day ownership. This is a part-time role.

Responsibilities

Assessment and governance

  • Run the security maturity assessment yourself (for example OWASP SAMM), review our repositories, pipelines and cloud setup, and turn the findings into a prioritized roadmap.
  • Write our core security policies and procedures: access control, acceptable use, secure development, incident response, vendor and AI tool usage.
  • Set up and maintain the security backlog, risk register and progress metrics, and report progress to management monthly.

Company security ("secure the house")

  • Configure and enforce SSO and MFA across email, Git hosting, cloud consoles, CI/CD and Passbolt.
  • Review and fix access rights, and set up onboarding and offboarding checklists.
  • Harden our Passbolt setup and implement a secrets manager for applications and pipelines, including migrating existing secrets out of code and CI variables.
  • Implement baseline hardening for laptops, cloud accounts, backups and logging.
  • Write the incident response plan and run tabletop exercises with the team.

Secure software development

  • Build our standard Secure SDLC, based on OWASP ASVS and OWASP SAMM, and roll it out on real client projects.
  • Configure and tune our SecOps platform: reduce false positives, set up pipeline quality gates and triage findings together with the teams.
  • Add the missing scanning to our CI/CD pipelines yourself: SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, IaC and container scanning, DAST and SBOM generation.
  • Run threat modeling sessions on active projects and document the results.
  • Do security code reviews of high-risk changes and help developers fix vulnerabilities.
  • Perform internal security testing of our applications before releases, and scope and coordinate external penetration tests.

Regulation and compliance

  • Map how the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2 and relevant local regulations affect us and our clients.
  • Write and implement our vulnerability handling and disclosure process, including support for clients' CRA reporting obligations.
  • Do the hands-on ISO/IEC 27001 preparation work: scope, risk assessment, Statement of Applicability, policies and evidence, and work with the certification body.

Client offering

  • Help define security service tiers we can include in client proposals.
  • Fill in client security questionnaires and build a reusable answer set.
  • Join selected client meetings or calls as a senior security voice when needed.

People and knowledge

  • Work side by side with our internal Security Lead so they learn by doing.
  • Run short internal workshops on key topics (for example OWASP Top 10, threat modeling, secure CI/CD).
  • Recommend training and certification paths for developers, Security Champions and DevOps engineers.

Requirements

Must have

  • 8+ years of experience in information security, with recent hands-on work in application security, DevSecOps or cloud security.
  • Comfortable doing the work yourself: configuring security tools, writing pipeline configuration, reviewing code, testing applications and writing policies.
  • Practical experience setting up a secure development lifecycle and integrating security tools into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Good knowledge of cloud security in at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure or GCP).
  • Ability to explain security risks in plain language to both engineers and management.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.
  • Kubernetes and container security experience.
  • Knowledge of security risks in AI and LLM-based applications.

Nice to have

  • Experience with the EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2 and GDPR in a software vendor or supplier context.
  • Experience building security offerings for clients in an agency or outsourcing environment.
  • Experience implementing or auditing ISO/IEC 27001 (or a comparable framework such as SOC 2).

Certifications (one or more preferred)

  • Hands-on certifications such as OSCP, BSCP, CDP or CKS
  • ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor
  • Cloud security certification (AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500 or Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer)
  • CISSP, CISM or CSSLP

The Secret Ingredients That Make Us Special:

jobs.excerpt: The Client Experience Representative (CER) plays a key role in delivering a proactive, empathetic, and consistent client experience throughout the legal case journey.
jobs.description:
The Client Experience Representative (CER) plays a key role in delivering a proactive, empathetic, and consistent client experience throughout the legal case journey. The CER serves as a central point of contact for client inquiries, provides timely case information within approved guidelines, resolves concerns whenever possible during the first interaction, and coordinates with case teams to ensure appropriate follow-up and escalation. This role supports client satisfaction while allowing production departments to focus on advancing cases.

This is a Virtual Assistant position as an independent contractor. Paid time off and healthcare benefits are not provided.

Full-time availability is required for a 40-hour workweek with two days off. Depending on business needs, one weekend day may be included in your schedule.

Preferred Schedule Time: Monday - Friday 9:00 AM EST - 5:30 PM EST

Responsibilities

  • Professionally and warmly assist clients through inbound and outbound calls and other approved communication channels.
  • Conduct welcome, courtesy, and proactive follow-up calls based on case stage, client needs, and established contact timelines.
  • Provide accurate case-status information, process explanations, and answers to frequently asked questions using approved department SOPs, training materials, and authorized case information.
  • Work toward First Contact Resolution (FCR) by addressing inquiries and concerns during the initial interaction whenever the matter is within CER authority.
  • Listen empathetically, identify client dissatisfaction, apply de-escalation techniques, and follow established protocols for urgent matters, repeat contacts, and escalations.
  • Coordinate with assigned case owners, specialists, POD leaders, and managers when a question requires legal judgment, a case decision, or department-specific action.
  • Accurately document client interactions, requested updates, follow-up commitments, and escalations in Litify and other approved systems.
  • Follow up on open client concerns and assigned tasks to help ensure timely responses and clear communication.
  • Assist with client-experience workflows, including low-sentiment calls, voicemail follow-up, and courtesy-call outreach as assigned.
  • Protect client confidentiality, maintain professional communication, and avoid providing unauthorized legal advice or making commitments outside approved procedures.
  • Participate in Train the Trainer sessions, department discovery training, coaching, and ongoing updates to firm processes and case-stage workflows.
  • Collaborate with team members and leadership to identify recurring client concerns, opportunities to improve communication, and process improvements.

Qualifications

  • Professional fluency in both English and Spanish, including strong written and verbal communication skills, is required for this role.
  • Availability to work at least 30 hours per week
  • Prior law firm or legal industry experience is preferred but not required.
  • Previous customer service experience required; call center, client relations, or administrative experience preferred.
  • Strong communication, active listening, empathy, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple client requests, document information accurately, and follow established escalation procedures.
  • Comfort using case-management systems and learning new technology and department workflows.
  • Virtual assistant roles supporting U.S. businesses
  • CRM or case management systems (Litify, Filevine, SmartAdvocate, Clio, etc.)

Contractor Terms

  • This is an independent contractor engagement, not employment.
  • No paid time off, healthcare, retirement, or other employee benefits are provided.
  • You will supply your own equipment, software, internet connection, and workspace.

The Ward Law Group does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

The Ward Law Group is not accepting unsolicited assistance from search firms for this employment opportunity. All resumes submitted by search firms to any employee at The Ward Law Group via-email, the Internet or in any form and/or method without a valid written Statement of Work in place for this position from The Ward Law Group HR/Recruitment will be deemed the sole property of The Ward Law Group. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by The Ward Law Group as a result of the referral or through other means.

Join an Award-Winning Personal Injury Law Firm

At The Ward Law Group, our mission is simple:

Changing Lives. One Client at a Time

Recognized as one of the Best Places to Work for consecutive years, we are committed to delivering exceptional legal representation while creating an environment where talented professionals can grow, lead, and make a meaningful impact every day.

We believe our people are our greatest asset. We foster a collaborative, innovative, and high-accountability culture where every team member is empowered to make informed decisions, continuously improve, and deliver exceptional results for our clients. Every role contributes directly to helping injured individuals navigate one of the most challenging times in their lives while supporting the continued growth and success of our firm.

Our Core Values

Faith – We act with integrity, honesty, and purpose in everything we do.

Accountability – We take ownership of our work, our commitments, and the results we deliver.

Leadership – We lead by example, inspire others, embrace continuous improvement, and develop high-performing teams.

Loyalty – We build lasting relationships through trust, respect, and dedication to our clients, teammates, and community.

Service to Our Clients – We are committed to delivering compassionate, responsive, and exceptional service that maximizes every client's opportunity for success.

Service to Our Teammates – We foster a culture of collaboration, respect, support, and shared success where every team member has the opportunity to grow and thrive.

Service to Our Community – We believe in making a positive impact beyond the workplace by serving and strengthening the communities where we live and work.

If you are passionate about helping injured clients, thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven environment, and are committed to delivering exceptional client service while continuously growing your career, we invite you to join The Ward Law Group and help us change lives—one client at a time.

Actively get in touch with clinical, vocational, employer, financial, and other internal and external sources for relevant information. Review this data against the applicable contracts and procedural documents. Analyze findings and involve peers and management as appropriate. Communicate effectively through both spoken and written methods. Employ the claim system with detailed and precise information. Keep performance meeting or exceeding departmental metrics. Remain agile and responsive.

What you will do

Compare this data to contract terms, limitations, conditions, and applicable procedural documents. Render the claim decision as quickly as possible. Document claim systems accurately and comprehensively while maintaining high efficiency. Prepare and share clear written and verbal communications with various internal and external parties. Prepare, update, and use a claim management plan to achieve the most appropriate outcome. Remain fully compliant with regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrate an above average level of proficiency in STD, SDI, and AM product and claim administration techniques. Remain fully aligned with operational standards. Meet or exceed claim team operational metrics.

  • Work as a team to support one another by being flexible and collaborating. Create a positive work environment and maintain professionalism and integrity. Actively foster high morale and show dedication to excellence.

Here’s what some of our employees share about why they choose to work at Symetra:

Symetra truly cares about its employees. The relaxed atmosphere and opportunities to learn and grow—both within your role and beyond—make it a great place to build your career.” - Alicia L., Claims Examiner

  • Give back to your community and double your impact through our company matching.
  • Want more details? Check out our Symetra Benefits Overview.

Compensation

Hourly Range: $22.38 - $37.32plus eligibility for annual bonus program.

Who You Are

  • High school diploma or equivalent work experience, college degree a plus.

Please review Symetra’s Remote Network Minimum Requirements

As a remote-first organization with a cameras-on culture, reliable internet connectivity is important to how we connect, collaborate, and serve our customers. To support a positive experience for both employees and customers, Symetra has the following standards for employees’ internet connection:

When applying to jobs at Symetra, you will be asked to test your internet speed. You must confirm that your internet connection meets or exceeds Symetra’s standard as outlined above.

Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

We’re looking for a Senior Technical Support Engineer who’s equal parts problem-solver, translator, and customer hero. You’ll be the go-to person when customers hit snags with Chainguard Images, digging into technical mysteries, keeping folks informed, and partnering with Engineering to squash bugs before they cause chaos. This isn’t just “reset the password and move on” support: you’ll work on real, complex issues with modern tools (Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub, Helm charts, Terraform, etc.), make customers feel like superheroes themselves, and help shape how Chainguard delivers world-class support. jobs.title: VP, Digital Experience & AI Service Operations
jobs.excerpt: About NymbusNymbus is a high-growth fintech company, ‘Built to Move,’ empowering banks and financial institutions to transform faster, compete smarter, and deliver greater value in today’s digital marketplace.
jobs.description:
About Nymbus

Nymbus is a high-growth fintech company, ‘Built to Move,’ empowering banks and financial institutions to transform faster, compete smarter, and deliver greater value in today’s digital marketplace. At Nymbus, we’re revolutionizing banking technology. Our award-winning modern core platform and cloud-based solutions help financial institutions modernize, scale, and succeed. As part of our team, you won’t just be part of a tech revolution; you’ll be at the forefront of it, driving innovation and delivering exceptional client experiences.

Nymbus is building the next generation of fintech platforms, and that takes people who are ready to challenge convention, move with purpose, and reimagine what’s possible. We operate with an AI-first mindset across our business, continuously improving how we work, and the value we deliver to our clients.

We want our partners to be thrilled about the possibilities we are creating together and the lasting impact our collaboration will bring to the industry and consumers. The journey to growth begins with doing something different. And that journey starts with the great people who make Nymbus.

We challenge the status quo, question assumptions, and work together to turn bold ideas into meaningful progress.

The Opportunity

Banks and credit unions are rebuilding what members and customers expect from service, and Nymbus is rebuilding how we deliver it. This role sits at the center of that shift.

We are seeking a Vice President, Digital Experience & AI Service Operations to define and lead the multi-year strategy for how Nymbus supports its financial institution clients and their end users. You will own the end-to-end support experience delivered through our hybrid Digital Experience Center (DXC) across phone, email, secure messaging, and chat (agentic), in a multi-tenant environment serving regulated institutions. You will lead the DXC organization and the human and AI workforce that operates alongside it.

This is a mandate to reimagine support, not just optimize it. You will build a model where our people focus on the complex, high-value interactions that need real banking expertise, judgment, and relationship depth, while AI resolves routine work at scale. You will set the operating standard for service quality, own the economics of how we deliver it, find new service offerings that create value for clients and revenue for Nymbus, and make support a durable advantage and a reason clients grow with us.

You will report to the SVP, Banking Operations. You will partner directly with Product, Engineering, Client Partners, Risk & Compliance, and Fraud on decisions that shape the client experience, and you will present results and strategy to executive leadership.

Who You Are

You are a seasoned support or CX leader who has built and scaled service organizations in banking, financial services, or fintech, and who is comfortable leading teams through AI adoption. You have led managers, owned a meaningful budget, and balanced service quality, cost to serve, and growth without treating any of the three as optional. You are a compassionate leader with a deep passion for developing talent, and you create an environment where strong performers thrive and everyone has a clear path to grow.

You think in systems and see the whole board. You are energized by ambiguity and by building what doesn't exist yet. You have a general understanding of AI-enabled support and are a hobbyist or practitioner of AI/ML, curious about where it is heading. You can explain AI and operational concepts in plain terms to an executive, and to a frontline agent on the same day.

What You Will Own

Set Vision and Multi-Year Strategy

  • Define and execute the multi-year DXC strategy, including the operating model, service architecture, and AI roadmap.
  • Own the economics of support: cost per resolution, cost to serve, and capacity. Make deliberate trade-offs between cost, quality, and growth, and defend them with executive leadership.
  • Represent the voice of the client and end user to senior leadership, and set the standard for what world-class service means at Nymbus.

Build and Scale the DXC Organization

  • Lead, develop, and inspire the DXC organization, building a bench of leaders who can scale it well beyond its current size, and guide it through significant role and workflow change with credibility and care.
  • Recruit managers and specialists with a lens on AI-fluent professionals who want to redefine their roles alongside technology, and build a culture of continuous improvement, psychological safety, and AI curiosity.
  • Design career paths, competency frameworks, and enablement for a workforce whose work is changing, including new roles such as knowledge engineers, AI quality reviewers, and escalation specialists.
  • Oversee hiring, training, onboarding, and coaching across the DXC, partnering with the Senior Director, DXC on occupancy, capacity, and headcount. Move quality and coaching from procedural compliance to resolution effectiveness, using AI-assisted review.

Own the AI-First Support Architecture

  • Own the strategy and execution to evolve the DXC into an AI-first model: specialists handle complex, high-judgment work while AI handles routine inquiries at scale.
  • Evaluate, select, and drive adoption of AI support platforms, and own build-versus-buy decisions and vendor relationships.
  • Deploy AI voice and chat agents for multi-step banking workflows, and set the governance for escalation logic, confidence thresholds, knowledge curation, and human-in-the-loop design.
  • Define when AI resolves, when it assists, and when it hands off, with handoffs that carry full context so clients and end users never repeat themselves. Build agent assist tooling (real-time suggestions, auto-summaries) that measurably improves time to resolution and first contact resolution.
  • Establish the accuracy, compliance, and quality standards AI-delivered support must meet in a regulated industry, including hallucination controls and auditability.
  • Build feedback loops that turn resolution failures, repeat contacts, and escalation patterns into fixes to AI behavior, workflows, and knowledge content.

Lead Segment-Calibrated Service Excellence

  • Build service models matched to client segment, size, and complexity, balancing efficient AI-first support with high-touch expertise for larger and more complex institutions.
  • Design specialized routing and escalation frameworks for complex questions, and run a multi-channel environment (voice, chat, email, secure messaging, AI chat) with consistent service levels across all of it.
  • Serve as the executive authority for high-sensitivity client escalations and critical client moments, owning resolution and the durability of the relationship afterward, and represent DXC performance in client business reviews.

Drive Retention and Service Growth

  • Own support's contribution to client retention and expansion. Use predictive analytics and operational telemetry to spot emerging support needs and client risk early, and resolve issues before a contact is made.
  • Identify and size service growth opportunities (financial and revenue), including optimal or additional service offerings, and build the business case with Client Partners, Product, and executive leadership. Tie new offerings to the cost model so growth and staffing needs are funded.
  • Make support a measurable input to client retention and growth, working with Client Partners.

Drive Cross-Functional and Product Alignment

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to build a rigorous feedback loop powered by support signal, bringing production-scale evidence into AI capability, configuration, governance, and roadmap priorities.
  • Partner with Risk & Compliance and Fraud to build regulatory, complaint-handling, and fraud-prevention requirements into support workflows, AI behavior, and quality standards.
  • Build proactive partnerships across Implementation, Professional Services, and Client Partners to deliver a seamless experience across the client lifecycle.
  • Lead new platform and channel implementations (for example a new CCaaS platform, procedure tool vendor, or service channel) and support new client implementations, forecasting headcount, support levels, and training.

Build Scalable Systems and Operational Rigor

  • Set and own the support KPI framework, including AI-era measures that lack industry standards: deflection quality, containment, AI resolution accuracy, cost per resolution, and outcome-based CSAT, alongside SLA performance and first contact resolution.
  • Own the DXC systems architecture across CCaaS, IVR/IVA, CRM, knowledge management, workforce management, and AI support tooling.
  • Lead workforce management that forecasts demand across human and AI channels and supports intelligent staffing and intraday decisions as volume mix shifts.
  • Maintain the Operations efficiency log to reduce manual workarounds, and establish the operating cadence, data, and reporting that let support performance be understood and trusted across the company.
  • Support the broader Operations team in delivering its strategic initiatives.
  • Other duties as assigned

What You Will Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business or a technical discipline, or equivalent experience in a related field.
  • Minimum of 10+ years of progressive customer support management experience, ideally overseeing a diverse portfolio of clients, with a minimum of 5 years in a SaaS specific industry.
  • 5-7 years of experience leading call/contact center operations (CCaaS) with direct people leadership experience.
  • 5+ years of experience managing remote teams.
  • Proven track record of leading and scaling support and CX teams of 50+ people.
  • Prior banking or broader financial services experience, including fintech.
  • Prior oversight of onshore contact center teams, with experience operating CCaaS technology for chat, chatbot, voice, and email support.
  • Prior experience implementing and integrating systems to build a cohesive support experience.
  • Prior experience with IVR/IVA systems and SIP/VOIP integrations.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify service growth opportunities (financial and revenue) and build the business case for optimal or additional service offerings.
  • General understanding of how AI agents work in support, including how they escalate to people and how they depend on quality knowledge content
  • Working knowledge of the regulatory context for financial institution servicing, such as complaint handling, consumer protection, and data privacy expectations.
  • Strong command of support operations metrics, with the analytical rigor to defend the model to executive leadership.
  • Well-developed written and oral communication skills, a collaborative management and coaching style, and the ability to communicate effectively with people at every level of the organization, including client executives.
  • Flexibility with work schedule and willingness to travel as necessary.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading significant operational transformation, particularly AI adoption or process modernization at scale.
  • AI fluency, with hands-on experience deploying and improving AI or automation in a live support environment (virtual agents, agent assist, intelligent routing or triage) and living with the results.
  • Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent process improvement experience, and/or a data science qualification or background.
  • Banking compliance and fraud experience.
  • Experience building or running specialist-tier or enterprise escalation teams.
  • Experience scaling a multi-tenant support operation while headcount grows more slowly than the business.
  • A record of building feedback loops between support signal and product roadmap that changed priorities, not only reported issues.
  • Experience with call center workforce planning and cost-to-serve modeling.

How We Work

Nymbus is a remote-first company. Success in our remote environment requires self-motivation, initiative, and strong personal accountability. jobs.title: Financial Accountant
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a hands-on, detail-oriented Financial Accountant who will play a critical role in driving operational financial excellence, compliance, and insight across our global operations.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a hands-on, detail-oriented Financial Accountant who will play a critical role in driving operational financial excellence, compliance, and insight across our global operations. This role is ideal for a proactive, systems-savvy finance professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment takes pride in accurate, audit-ready numbers, is confident navigating modern finance systems, and is committed to continuous improvement in accounting processes.

The Financial Accountant will own Tydeco's transactional accounting and month-end balance sheet integrity across our South African and US entities, with a particular focus on consulting services revenue: client retainers, deferred and unbilled revenue, timesheet billing and revenue recognition under IFRS 15 and ASC 606. The role works closely with project, sales and operations teams to make sure that what is delivered is billed, and that what is billed is recognised and reconciled correctly.

The ideal candidate is highly analytical, a strong communicator, and thrives when given ownership and autonomy. If this is you, we invite you to apply.

As a platinum Sage partner, Tydeco and our partner entity Tydeco U specialize in delivering cutting-edge ERP solutions such as Sage Intacct and Sage 300 Cloud, and HRP solutions such as Sage VIP and SBCPP. We also offer Outsourced Accounting solutions to help clients streamline financial operations and scale with confidence. Our dedication to innovation, excellence, and client success ensures businesses not only adopt our solutions but thrive in competitive markets. If you're ready to make an impact in a fast-paced, high-impact environment, we invite you to be part of our journey.

This position will report to the Finance Manager. This is a fully remote, South Africa-based position, with occasional travel as business needs require.

Key Responsibilities

Global Support

  • Operate within a global framework, ensuring adaptability to support teams, meet deadlines and participate in virtual meetings across multiple time zones based in South Africa and the U.S., as needed.
  • Collaborate with international stakeholders, adjusting to varying schedules and priorities as needed.
  • Maintain flexibility in scheduling to accommodate time-sensitive tasks and cross-regional collaboration.

Core Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Manage general ledger activities including journal entries, account reconciliations, accruals, and adjustments, applying the correct Sage Intacct dimensions (entity, location, department, class and project).
  • Perform monthly and year-end close procedures and ensure deadlines are met across financial cycles.
  • Maintain the fixed asset register, record depreciation entries, and support asset audits as needed.
  • Process customer invoices and receipts, maintain the debtors ledger, allocate payments accurately, and follow up overdue accounts with client-facing teams.
  • Manage client retainers by reviewing contract terms, preparing invoices, tracking receipts and amounts applied to services, and reconciling unused balances to client records and the general ledger. Investigate discrepancies and follow up outstanding balances.
  • Track implementation billing milestones (upfront, milestone and final-execution invoices) against project delivery, make sure milestone invoices are raised on time, and recognise and reconcile unbilled revenue (contract assets) where services have been delivered but not yet invoiced. Identify over-utilised retainers and reclassify debit balances appropriately.
  • Maintain revenue deferral schedules by client and contract across Tydeco's revenue streams: fixed-fee and hourly implementations, SLA and RSA support contracts recognised over the contract term, software subscriptions and licences, andoutsourced accounting services. Prepare monthly revenue recognition journals in line with IFRS 15 / ASC 606 and company policy, reconcile opening balances, additions, releases and closing balances to the general ledger, and retain supporting documentation.
  • Manage timesheet billing by checking completeness, approvals and client or project allocation. Validate billable hours against agreed rates, budgets and contract terms, prepare invoices, and resolve missing time, rate discrepancies and billing queries with project teams.
  • Make sure customer invoices are coded correctly in Sage Intacct, including the correct client and service project, revenue type and Deal Type (e.g. new sale, renewal, SLA, add-on, outsourced), so that revenue and project profitability reporting is accurate.
  • Calculate rebates on eligible vendor invoices using supplier agreements, qualifying spend, exclusions, thresholds and agreed rates. Maintain calculation schedules, record approved accruals, track claims and credit notes, and reconcile receipts to expected rebates.
  • Process supplier invoices through Ramp, validating supporting documents, account coding, project allocation and approvals. Resolve duplicate or disputed invoices, follow up outstanding approvals, monitor payment status, and reconcile invoices and payments to accounting records.
  • Prepare monthly creditor reconciliations by matching supplier statements to the payable ledger. Investigate missing invoices, unallocated payments and credit notes, resolve differences with suppliers, maintain supporting schedules, and escalate overdue or disputed balances.
  • Prepare monthly balance sheet reconciliations for bank, credit card, receivable, payable, accrual, prepayment, client retainer, deferred revenue, unbilled revenue, intercompany, VAT, payroll, leave pay provision and commission accrual accounts. Substantiate balances, investigate and clear reconciling items, post approved adjustments, and submit supporting schedules for review within close deadlines.
  • Record intercompany transactions and prepare intercompany reconciliations across the South African and US entities, resolve differences monthly, and support consolidation and elimination entries in a multi-currency environment.
  • Prepare and review internal financial statements to ensure completeness and accuracy.
  • Assist in developing, improving, and maintaining financial controls and documentation.

Reporting, Analysis & Audit Support

  • Assist with monthly management reporting, including profit and loss, balance sheet, bank, credit card and cash flow reports.
  • Conduct variance analyses and support budget tracking and reforecasting efforts.
  • Prepare the year-end audit file and supporting schedules for the annual external audit, and respond to auditor queries, particularly on revenue, client retainers, and deferred and unbilled revenue.
  • Collaborate with leadership on ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed for financial planning and strategic decisions.

Internal Collaboration, Process Alignment & Systems Collaboration

  • Work cross-functionally with operations and finance teams to align accounting practices with business needs.
  • Partner with system administrators and ERP users to troubleshoot accounting data issues and ensure financial reporting integrity.
  • Monitor the flow of financial data across integrated platforms and support reconciliation efforts.
  • Use Asana to track finance tasks, project milestones, billing deliverables and month-end deadlines. Maintain task owners, due dates and supporting documents, coordinate dependencies with project teams, and escalate overdue items affecting reporting or billing.
  • Support vendor onboarding, banking updates, and compliance processes in line with company policies.
  • Participate in global accounting meetings, ensuring consistency and compliance across financial processes.
  • Prepare monthly VAT201 reconciliations and returns, and support provisional tax, payroll tax and other statutory filings for the South African entities, with equivalent support for US compliance as required.
  • Provide support to leadership by preparing financial data, reports, and insights for internal decision-making.

Key Attributes

  • Resilience and Adaptability: You excel in a global, fast-moving environment, balancing month-end deadlines, billing cycles and audit requests without compromising quality or timeliness.
  • Attention to Detail: Your experience in multi-entity, multi-currency accounting ensures accuracy in financial reporting, reconciliations, and compliance efforts. You take pride in delivering audit-ready financials.
  • Firm, Constructive Collaboration: You work closely with project managers, consultants and sales teams, and are confident following up missing timesheets, unbilled milestones and incorrect coding until they are resolved.
  • Revenue and Contract Understanding: You read contracts, statements of work and SLAs with an accountant's eye, understand how consulting and support revenue should be billed and recognised, and can explain the impact of contract terms on the balance sheet.
  • Problem-Solving and Analytical Excellence: With a data-driven mindset, you analyze financial trends, identify opportunities for efficiency, and use tools such as Sage Intacct, Ramp, Asana and Excel to drive operational improvements.
  • Ownership and Accountability: You own your reconciliations and close deliverables end to end, clear reconciling items rather than carrying them forward, and proactively raise issues and process improvements.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on accounting experience as an Accountant or Senior Accountant, including at least 2–3 years in a professional services, consulting, software or agency environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Professional designation, SAIPA Professional Accountant or ACCA) strongly preferred; completed articles advantageous.
  • Strong working knowledge of IFRS, specifically IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers (and ASC 606 for US entities), including performance obligations, revenue recognised over time, contract assets and contract liabilities.
  • Demonstrable hands-on experience owning deferred revenue, client retainer and unbilled revenue (WIP) schedules and reconciliations.
  • Proven track record of preparing month-end balance sheet reconciliations to audit standard.
  • Working knowledge of South African VAT and statutory compliance.
  • Strong Excel skills (Advanced level)
  • Experience preparing year-end audit files and dealing directly with external auditors.
  • Strong systems orientation and attention to process improvement and control
  • Strong analytical skills with a proactive problem-solving mindset.

Preferred Experience

Proficiency in Sage Intacct (strongly preferred), including projects, dimensions and multi-entity consolidation

Background in IT consulting, software implementation, SaaS or outsourced accounting businesses.

Familiarity with ERP implementations and financial technology integrations.

Experience with Ramp, Asana or similar spend-management and work-management tools.

Benefits

Work Environment

This is a remote role, with occasional travel based on business and management needs. This is a full-time position that requires the ability to work a flexible and regular full-time schedule. It requires the ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods of time and communicate effectively with a diverse audience in person, by phone and by computer.

About Us

Tydeco is an equal opportunity employer, along with our partner entities AWCape, Applico, and Lescault and Walderman Inc. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy, maternity, or any other legally protected characteristics.

We reserve the right to not fill this role

jobs.title: Implementation Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About InAir InAir is a forward-thinking, fully remote consulting firm with a stronghold in Texas.
jobs.description:
About InAir

InAir is a forward-thinking, fully remote consulting firm with a stronghold in Texas. We are proud experts in Airtable consulting services, partnering with mid-sized to large enterprises. Our mission is to harness the power of low-code platforms, enabling businesses to optimize their workflows, foster collaboration, and achieve ambitious outcomes through Airtable.

At our company, we foster a culture of honesty, responsibility, and accountability. These core values create a successful, innovative, and transparent workplace. Our remote work setting is built on trust, respect, and open communication, allowing team members to shine and grow.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a hands-on, client-facing Implementation Engineer to build, configure, and stand up tailored Airtable systems, custom interface extensions, and automated workflows for our mid-market and enterprise clients. Airtable is our bread and butter—it’s the platform most of our client work is built on.

At InAir, we distinguish clearly between Software Engineers (who build our core platform, SDKs, and reusable component libraries) and Implementation Engineers (who deploy those tools to construct bespoke client systems). As an Implementation Engineer, you will own the technical delivery for specific client engagements—taking a system from initial design to live production, on time and fully working.

You will work closely with Solutions Consultants, PMs, and client teams to translate complex business processes into robust, maintainable Airtable architectures, custom integrations, and automated pipelines.

WHAT YOU’LL DO
  • Build Client-Specific Systems: Stand up custom Airtable bases, advanced interface workflows, and complex data models tailored to individual client operational needs.
  • Develop Extensions & Integrations: Use InAir’s internal platform, reusable React component libraries, TypeScript SDKs, and automation runners to build custom client extensions, webhooks, and third-party integrations (via APIs, Make, or custom scripts).
  • Technical Client Validation: Join delivery calls alongside Solutions Consultants and PMs to evaluate technical feasibility, inspect edge cases in client workflows, and explain solution design to non-technical client stakeholders.
  • Own Go-Live & Delivery: Take full technical ownership of client engagements from kick-off through user acceptance testing (UAT) and launch. Ensure delivered systems are reliable, fast, and free of major defects.
  • Provide Feedback to Platform Engineering: Act as the first user of InAir’s reusable tools. Identify platform gaps, feed recurring client patterns back to our Software Engineering team, and influence the development of our core component libraries.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS
  • Experience Level: Mid-level, with at least 3 years of hands-on experience in client-facing roles, actively delivering and implementing solutions.
  • Frontend & Scripting Fluency: Hands-on experience with TypeScript and React for building frontend components, custom scripts, and API integrations.
  • Relational Systems Expertise: Strong command of relational data modeling, multi-table architecture, data integrity, access controls, and performance at scale, built in Airtable or a comparable platform (SQL, Retool, FileMaker, or similar). If you’ve built rigorous systems in a comparable tool, you’ll ramp on Airtable fast.
  • API & System Integration: Demonstrated experience connecting systems using REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON payloads, and an automation tool such as Make, with solid error handling and integration reliability.
  • Testing & Go-Live: Experience with functional testing and UAT support to get client systems live cleanly.
  • Solution Design & Documentation: Able to produce clear technical design documentation and hand off knowledge to clients and internal teams.
  • Client-Facing Delivery: Comfortable leading or co-leading technical conversations with clients—walking non-technical stakeholders through solution design, scope, and trade-offs.
  • Delivery & Time-to-Value Focus: High bias for action and project momentum. You enjoy delivery-paced, sprint-based client engagements with defined milestones.
  • Technical Communication: Able to articulate technical trade-offs, scope constraints, and workflow logic to clients and internal project managers clearly and professionally.
PREFERRED BACKGROUND
  • Airtable experience is highly preferred—it’s the core of our delivery work, and deep Airtable builders (scripting extensions, native automations, interface designer) will feel at home quickly.
  • Experience as a Solutions Engineer, Implementation Consultant, Delivery Engineer, or Technical Services Specialist at a B2B SaaS company or technical consulting agency.
  • Hands-on experience building enterprise workflow tools, custom CRM solutions, or operational databases for mid-market or enterprise buyers.
  • Familiarity with AI tools and LLM API integrations (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI) built into business workflows.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
  • On-Time Go-Lives: Client systems deployed on schedule, with no major post-launch defects.
  • Clean Code & Configuration: Client architectures that non-technical client teams can operate easily, with clean, maintainable custom scripts and React extensions.
  • Strong Client & Internal Alignment: Partnering seamlessly with Solutions Consultants so technical feasibility is validated before commitments are made to clients.
STRUCTURE & AVAILABILITY
  • Engagement: Contractor agreement via Rippling. Full-time.
  • Location: Fully remote.
  • Availability: Dedicated availability aligned with US business hours (EST, CST or PST), agreed with your manager before you start.
  • Language: English, C1+ (fluent professional working proficiency).

jobs.title: FPGA Designer
jobs.excerpt: Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose.
jobs.description:
Fidus is a global high-tech design firm headquartered in Ottawa, with additional design centres in Kitchener-Waterloo and San Jose. We specialize in leading-edge electronic product development, with hardware, embedded software, FPGA/ASIC, and signal integrity teams working together to design and deliver next-generation products for clients in emerging technology markets.

Position Overview/Mandate:

The FPGA Designer plays a key role in designing and delivering complex FPGA-based systems for Fidus clients. You will work directly with customers and internal Fidus teams to define architectures, implement RTL, integrate IP, run simulations, close timing, and support lab bring-up and debug.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working with new FPGA families and tools, is comfortable moving between different application domains (video, communications, storage, signal processing), and takes pride in producing high-quality, well-documented designs.

Make an Impact with US:

At Fidus, you'll work on high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems, often using emerging technologies before they reach the broader market. You'll collaborate across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design as part of cross-functional teams delivering real products for our clients.

In practice, that means contributing to projects across Communications, Aerospace & Defence, Life Sciences & Medical Devices, Space & Satellite, Industrial Automation, Automotive, and Semiconductor engagements. You won't be limited to a single product or industry—your work will follow the technology, not just one roadmap.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Work with our clients and other Fidus Employees to develop complex FPGA and/or CPLD based systems, including architecture, custom development, integrated IP, simulations, and timing analysis and closure.
  • Design FPGA based systems using Xilinx and Intel based devices and tools
  • Participate in design reviews (hardware-software interface, input-outputs etc.) to ensure Fidus quality standards and customer requirements are being adhered to
  • Perform lab testing, debug of prototypes and supporting hardware/software engineer, as needed
  • Perform customer prototype demonstrations and author test plans, design description and user documentation
  • Provide technical insight to customers during the pre-sales and implementation phase of projects
  • Provide technical support to the Business Manager and Sales team by providing detailed estimates on project scope, schedule, and deliverables and to present the technical aspects of Fidus proposals to the client

Who You are:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience designing using RTL/Verilog/VHDL on FPGAs.
  • Experience with video systems and specification standards, video algorithms, and high-speed memory and bus interfaces, communications protocols, and DSP or processor instantiations.
  • Created designs using Xilinx or Altera FPGA families and have a solid understanding of tool flow
  • Experience with Verilog, SystemVerilog, VHDL, Xilinx Vivado, Altera Quartus, and/or ModelSim
  • RTL design and verification including test benches, functional simulations, and timing closure
  • Exhibit strong communication skills, are fluent in English, have great customer interaction presence, and quickly learn new technologies and processes
  • Proven techniques and habits that lead to high quality design
  • Embraces AI as part of a modern engineering toolkit
  • Degree as a B.A.Sc., B.Eng. or equivalent
  • As AMD Embedded Premier Partner, you will be certified to highest level of FPGA qualification – this will be your first “to-do” item upon joining us.

Location and travel: Position is based in Canada. Travel may be required domestically and internationally to support customer engagements and project delivery.

This position may require access to export-controlled information. Candidates will be required to complete background checks and security screening under Canada's Controlled Goods Program (CGP) and may also be required to obtain a security clearance under the Contract Security Program (CSP) administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC, formerly PWGSC).

This role is an evergreen position.

Annual base salary ranges from $125,000 to $160,000. The final offer within this range takes into account the variations in knowledge, skills, experience, and market conditions, and with consideration to internal equity.

Our competitive compensation package also includes a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, matching GRSP contributions, annual profit-sharing bonus, along with other supplementary benefits.

We also recognize that candidates show interest throughout different career stages and welcome all applications. When there is a great fit, the level of the role may be shifted as applicable.

About Fidus & Why Work Here

Since 2001, Fidus has completed over 4,000 projects for more than 400 customers across industries including Telecom/Datacom, Aerospace & Defence, Consumer, Semiconductors, Industrial/Automotive Controls, and Medical. As a Premier Adaptive Computing Partner for AMD North America, we combine deep technical expertise with industry-leading tools to solve complex design challenges.

Fidus designs high-speed, high-complexity electronic systems using emerging technologies, often well before they reach the broader market. Our teams work across FPGA/DSP, hardware, embedded software, verification, SI/PI, PCB layout, and mechanical/thermal design to deliver real products for our customers.

At Fidus, collaboration is at the core of how we work. We value openness, trust, and shared ownership, and we create an environment where people are encouraged to contribute ideas, learn from one another, and have a meaningful impact through the work they do.

If all of this excites you, has your attention, and you can’t wait to join our amazing team and work environment, then we want to hear from you!

Curious what it's actually like to work here? Take a look at our page.

Fidus has a commitment to ensure a fair and transparent recruitment process. Automated tools (including AI) support our initial screening of applicants against our job posting to identify candidates whose qualifications, experience, and skills align most closely with the position requirements. All further candidate assessments and final selection are conducted by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

Thank you for your interest in Fidus. We welcome and encourage diverse candidates to apply. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Fidus is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
