jobs.description:
Your Leadership.

Our Power.

Unlimited Potential.


Taylor Corporation has big plans for the future and we need talented leaders to get us there. We power the world’s leading brands ― and our employees’ careers ― by unlocking potential everywhere we see it. If you love to lead, are open to new ideas and inspire the best in others, we should talk. We’re passionate about our work, we believe there is always a better way, and we’re looking for professionals like you.


Want to be part of something powerful? It’s time to look at Taylor.


Your Opportunity: Taylor Corporation is looking for a Senior Director of Enterprise Architecture & Innovation to join their team!


The Senior Director of Enterprise Architecture & Innovation is a senior technology leader of Taylor IT COE, responsible for defining and governing enterprise-wide architecture standards, driving modernization and innovation of our application portfolio, and establishing an integrated DevOps, Security, and Financial operating model (DevSecFinOps).


The Senior Director ensures modernization and innovation efforts translate into repeatable, scalable engineering capabilities. The core mandate of this role is to establish modular composable architecture framework and DevSecFinOps practices to drive our modernization efforts to rearchitect legacy applications and lead innovation initiatives.


Work Authorization: To be considered for the Taylor opportunities, candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Enterprise Architecture Strategy & Governance

  • Define and maintain enterprise architecture (EA) frameworks, standards, and reference architecture across business domains (application, data, infrastructure, and integration).
  • Establish modular composable architecture like MACH (Microservices, API‑first, Cloud‑Native, Headless) and AI-first SDLC practices.
  • Collaborate with Governance Committee and Architecture Review Board (ARB) to ensure compliance with standards.
  • Develop and enforce architecture principles, design patterns, creating capability maps, technology selection criteria, and future-state architecture roadmaps.
  • Provide architectural oversight for major programs, ensuring scalability, interoperability, and long-term sustainability.

2. Reference Architecture & Standards Development

  • Lead the development and adoption of enterprise reference architectures for on-prem and cloud applications, eCommerce & digital platforms, data, integration, and security.
  • Standardize technology stacks, APIs, and integration patterns (e.g., microservices, event-driven architecture).
  • Define best practices for hybrid/multi-cloud environments and platform engineering.
  • Ensure alignment with regulatory, compliance, and cybersecurity requirements.

3. DevSecFinOps Operating Model

  • Establish and scale a unified DevSecFinOps model integrating development practices, security posture, and cost optimization across Taylor.
  • Drive adoption of AI-first software engineering practices, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), automated testing, and release management frameworks.
  • Embed security controls into development workflows and SDLC processes.
  • Drive FinOps discipline, including cloud and AI cost governance, usage optimization, and financial transparency.
  • Define KPIs and dashboards for engineering productivity, security posture, and cost optimization.

4. Application Portfolio Modernization

  • Assess current application landscape and define modernization strategies (rehost, replatform, refactor, retire, replace).
  • Lead transformation toward Microservices, API-first, cloud-native, and composable architectures.
  • Reduce technical debt and eliminate redundant or underperforming systems.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to prioritize modernization initiatives based on value and risk.
  • Establish modernization playbooks, tooling, and migration frameworks.

5. Innovation & Emerging Technology

  • Identify, evaluate, and incubate emerging technologies (Spec-Driven Development, AI/ML, Agentic AI, automation, data platforms, etc.).
  • Drive innovation programs, including proofs of concept (POCs) and pilot initiatives.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and business teams to translate innovation into scalable solutions.
  • Build partnerships with technology vendors, startups, and system integrators.

6. Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with CIO, CISO, and other IT/Business leaders to align architecture strategy with organizational goals.
  • Mentor architects and engineering teams, fostering a culture of engineering excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Lead architecture communities of practice and promote knowledge sharing.
  • Influence executive decision-making with data-driven insights and architectural trade-offs.

You Must Have:

  • 12–15+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, or senior engineering leadership roles.
  • Experience with architecture frameworks such as MACH, TOGAF, Zachman, or similar.
  • Proven track record of leading large-scale digital transformation and modernization initiatives.
  • Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), microservices, APIs, and distributed systems.
  • Demonstrated success implementing DevOps and integrating security and financial governance practices (DevSecFinOps).
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, compliance, and risk management.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.

We Would Also Prefer:

  • Experience in manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, eCommerce, or enterprise SaaS environments.
  • Experience supporting ERP transformations (e.g., Oracle Fusion, SAP S/4HANA).
  • Certifications in cloud platforms or architecture frameworks.
  • Familiarity with data architecture, analytics platforms, and AI/ML integration.
  • Experience working with global teams and complex organizational structures.

Key Competencies:

  • Strategic Thinking & Systems Design
  • Governance & Operating Model Design
  • Innovation Leadership
  • Financial & Cost Optimization Mindset
  • Risk Management & Security Integration
  • Influence Without Authority
  • Change Leadership & Transformation Execution

Success Metrics (KPIs):

  • Adoption rate of reference architectures and standards
  • Reduction in technical debt and legacy footprint
  • Reduction in security vulnerabilities and compliance gaps
  • Measurable cloud cost optimization and FinOps maturity improvements
  • Acceleration of application modernization milestones
  • Business satisfaction and alignment with technology outcomes

Reporting Structure:

  • Reports to: Chief Information Officer (CIO)
  • Direct Reports: Enterprise Architects, Domain Architects, Platform Architects (as applicable)

Role Impact:

This role is instrumental in shaping Taylor Corps application portfolio across all business units by establishing comprehensive architectural standards and repeatable patterns, governance models, embedding DevSecFinOps practices, and leading modernization at scale. The Senior Director of Enterprise Architecture & Innovation will enable faster innovation, improved resilience, and optimized cost structures—directly contributing to competitive advantage and long-term growth.


The anticipated annual salary range for this position is $180,000 - $230,000. The actual base salary offered depends on a variety of factors, which may include as applicable, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job. The range listed is just one component of Taylor Corporation’s total compensation and benefits package for employees.


About Taylor Corporation

One of the largest print and communications firms in North America, Taylor’s family of companies provides a diverse set of products, services and technologies that address the toughest business challenges. We work diligently each day to create printed and digital marketing communication solutions that help power many of the world’s most recognizable brands.


With more than 50 years of category expertise and 10,000 employees spanning dozens of U.S. states and multiple countries, Taylor serves businesses and distributors both large and small. Customers

Customer Care Support plays a vital role in ensuring a seamless fiber installation process, from initial inquiry to post-installation support. Their primary objective is to enhance customer satisfaction by providing timely, accurate, and professional assistance throughout the service lifecycle.

Roles and Responsibilities:

1. Responding to Customer Inquiries: Address customer questions regarding fiber services, installation procedures, timelines, and technical requirements through various communication channels.

2. Scheduling and Coordinating Installations: Coordinate with customers and technical teams to schedule installation appointments, ensuring timely and efficient service delivery.

3. Providing Pre-Installation Guidance: Inform customers about the installation process, necessary preparations, safety measures, and what to expect during the service visit.

4. Monitoring Installation Progress: Track installation status, update customers proactively, and resolve scheduling conflicts or delays promptly.

5. Resolving Customer Issues: Handle concerns related to delays, technical difficulties, or service disruptions with professionalism and urgency.

6. Technical Support and Troubleshooting: Assist customers with basic troubleshooting steps or guide them to technical specialists for complex issues.

7. Post-Installation Follow-up: Verify successful installation, ensure customer satisfaction, and provide assistance with activation or setup.

8. Record Maintenance: Maintain accurate documentation of customer interactions, installation details, and issues reported for future reference.

9. Escalation Handling: Identify issues requiring escalation and coordinate with relevant departments while keeping the customer informed.

10. Customer Satisfaction and Loyalty: Build rapport, gather feedback, and ensure positive experiences to foster long-term relationships.

11. Compliance and Safety: Follow company policies, safety protocols, and industry standards during all customer interactions and installation activities.

Educational Background:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Communications, or related fields Experience:
  • Previous experience in customer service, technical support, or call center operations is advantageous
  • Familiarity with fiber optic or telecommunications services is a plus

Skills and Competencies:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Filipino • Strong interpersonal and active listening skills
  • Problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities
  • Customer-focused attitude with patience and empathy
  • Ability to handle difficult situations professionally
  • Basic technical knowledge of internet, networking, and fiber installation processes

Technical Knowledge:

  • Understanding of fiber optic technology and installation processes (training provided if not initially skilled)
  • Familiarity with customer relationship management (CRM) software and support tools Personal Attributes:

• Adaptability and willingness to learn

  • Attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to work under pressure and meet targets

• Team player with a positive attitude

Certifications (Optional but Beneficial):

• Customer Service Certification

• Technical Support Certification

  • Communication or Language Proficiency Certifications

Customer Care Support in fiber installation is essential for delivering excellent service, ensuring customer satisfaction, and maintaining the company's reputation for quality and reliability.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.excerpt: Position: Director, Business Development Location: Remote / U.
jobs.description:
Position: Director, Business Development

Location: Remote / U.S.

Type: Full-time


The Opportunity:

Ohalo™ is seeking a Director of Business Development to source, structure, and close the partnerships that bring our agriculture products to market worldwide. This is a deal-driving role at its core. You will build and own relationships across the supply chain — growers, packers and shippers, processors, distributors, and retail/QSR buyers — and convert them into revenue-generating commercial agreements. You will be the commercial face of Ohalo in the field, moving partnerships from first conversation to signed deal to scaled execution, in close collaboration with breeding, commercial, and regulatory teams.

As Ohalo expands into new regions, you will also help shape where and how we enter — identifying the right partners, mapping the value chain, and building the strategic roadmap for markets where we don't yet have a playbook.

This is a high-impact role for a self-starting operator who thrives on ownership and execution. You will succeed if you are relationship-driven and persuasive, relentless about moving deals forward, and equally at home in a grower's field, a processor's boardroom, and an internal cross-functional huddle.


Areas of Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Supply Chain Partnerships

  • Source, negotiate, and close strategic, revenue-generating partnerships across the supply chain — growers, packers and shippers, processors, distributors, and retail/QSR buyers.
  • Build and own durable relationships with commercial partners, serving as Ohalo's primary commercial point of contact from first outreach through signed agreement.
  • Drive deals end to end: structure terms, align internal stakeholders, and steward agreements through to execution and scale.
  • Serve as a key commercial face of Ohalo in global markets, representing our product vision directly to external stakeholders, growers, and customers.
  • Build the commercial alliances that secure demand and route Ohalo's portfolio through the value chain to end customers.

Strategic Roadmap & Partner Identification — New Expansion Regions

  • Build the analytical backbone for commercial decisions — run market sizing and pricing analysis that informs priority markets, which partners to pursue, how to structure terms, and where Ohalo's portfolio commands premium value.
  • For new and emerging markets, identify and prioritize the partners, segments, and value-chain entry points that unlock commercial traction.
  • Build the strategic roadmap for regions where Ohalo lacks an established playbook, mapping grower economics, processor demand, and downstream value-chain incentives well enough to enter with conviction.
  • Develop focused business cases and entry plans for new product introductions, sizing the opportunity and sequencing the partner approach.
  • Where a region is new, shape the volume and adoption assumptions and coordinate launch readiness enough to align supply availability and partner enablement, drawing on field trial data and partner pipeline intelligence.


Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in business development, commercial strategy, or sales in the agricultural industry, with a track record of personally closing deals.
  • Proven success forging and closing new strategic partnerships across multiple geographies — you have carried a number and hit it.
  • A true self-starter who sets their own pace and consistently delivers high-quality work without needing to be managed to it.
  • High drive and high output: you move fast, run multiple deals in parallel, and are relentless about pushing partnerships forward to close.
  • An exceptional communicator — clear, concise, and compelling both in writing and in person, able to command the room with growers, executives, and internal teams alike.
  • Strong understanding of crop production systems, grower decision-making, and value chain economics.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex agronomic or technical attributes into clear commercial value propositions.
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration, working closely with R&D, operations, marketing, and regulatory teams.
  • Comfortable with frequent travel across regions to engage directly with growers and partners.

The anticipated base pay range for this role is $150,000 - $200,000 per year for our South San Francisco location. The pay offered to a selected candidate will be determined based on factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the qualifications of the selected candidate, budget availability, internal equity, geographic location and external market pay for comparable jobs. This role is also eligible for variable compensation in addition to base pay.

About Ohalo:

Ohalo™ aims to accelerate evolution to unlock nature's potential. Founded in 2019, Ohalo develops novel breeding systems and improved plant varieties that help farmers grow more food with fewer natural resources, increasing the yield, resiliency, and genetic diversity of crops to sustainably feed our population. Ohalo's breakthrough technology, Boosted Breeding™, will usher in a new era of improved productivity to radically transform global agriculture. For more information, visit .

Ohalo is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Ohalo is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

Environmental Compliance Team Member

As an Environmental Compliance Team Member on Intersect's Environmental & Permitting team, you'll support environmental compliance programs for assigned projects within a portfolio of renewable and natural gas power plant projects. This role is responsible for ensuring permit and regulatory compliance, environmental reporting, managing environmental risk, and supporting the environmental management system for assigned construction and operating projects.

The Team Member provides expertise and support for restoration, environmental compliance, air quality compliance, spill prevention, stormwater management, wildlife management, waste management, environmental audits, regulatory engagement, and the environmental management system. This position partners closely with EHS, Asset Management, Operations, Construction, Engineering, Legal, Procurement, Community Engagement, and Insurance.

Team overview

The Environmental & Permitting team plays a critical role in executing on Intersect's mission to accelerate the clean energy transition. This team ensures that our utility-scale power, clean energy, and data center infrastructure projects are sited, constructed, and operated with rigorous environmental stewardship and regulatory integrity.

Environmental Incident Response

  • Support response efforts for environmental incidents, spills, releases, and permit deviations.

  • Support investigations, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and regulatory notifications.

  • Support emergency preparedness and environmental response exercises.

jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobs.excerpt: Avante is the enterprise AI platform for benefits teams.
jobs.description:
Avante is the enterprise AI platform for benefits teams. Benefits is one of the most complex, high-stakes functions in any company, and Avante’s purpose-built agents take on end-to-end benefits work, from checking vendor contracts against claims to preparing leadership reports to helping employees use and understand their benefits. Samsung Semiconductor, Real Chemistry, Zscaler and News Corp use Avante today to keep costs in check, support employees across the globe, and get more from their benefits investment.

The Role

We're looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to run a full enterprise patch of self-funded employers, spanning the 2,500-employee mid-market on the low end up through Fortune 500 strategic accounts. You'll own the entire deal, from first conversation through signature, with the goal of landing new logos that look like the customers already on our roster: Samsung, Zscaler, News Corp, SurveyMonkey, Navan, Real Chemistry, Datavant, Calix, Personify, and F5.

The buying committee for Avante is multi-stakeholder by default. You'll multi-thread across Total Rewards, Benefits, HR Operations, HRIS, IT Security, and Finance, and you'll need to credibly explain to each of them why Avante is different from the ben admin platform, the decision support tool, and the point solutions they already own. Avante is not a replacement for any of those. It's the intelligence layer that connects them. Selling that distinction well is the hardest and most important part of the job.

You'll also work hand-in-hand with our channel partners. About half of enterprise benefits decisions run through brokers and consultants, and Avante has formal partnerships with OneDigital, Howden, and Segal Benz, plus growing relationships across the broker ecosystem. The right person for this role treats brokers as force multipliers, not gatekeepers, and knows how to co-sell without losing the buyer relationship.

This role reports to the CRO. We're hiring across a range of experience. If you're a senior enterprise closer who has carried seven-figure quotas at F500 accounts, you'll find one of the largest greenfield opportunities in HR tech sitting in front of you. If you're earlier in your enterprise career and ready to step up, you'll get a patch big enough to grow into and the support to win in it. What we care about most is whether you can run a complex, multi-threaded enterprise deal, build durable relationships with executive buyers, and operate with the urgency of a founder.

What You'll Do

  • Own a named enterprise patch end-to-end. You'll work a defined account list spanning mid-market enterprise through Fortune 500. Build the territory plan, prioritize the accounts, develop the relationships, run the cycles, and close the business. The patch is yours.
  • Multi-thread into complex buying committees. Avante deals are won and lost on access. You'll build relationships with CHROs, Heads of Total Rewards, Benefits Directors, CFOs, and the IT and Security leaders who clear the path. You'll know who the economic buyer is, who the champion is, who the blocker is, and what each of them needs to see before they sign.
  • Sell the closed-loop story, not a feature list. Avante is in a new category. Buyers compare us to ben admin platforms, decision support tools, care navigation vendors, and point solutions, and none of those comparisons are quite right. Your job is to teach the market what benefits intelligence is, why the closed loop between Carly and Ava matters, and why purpose-built agents beat generic AI bolted onto legacy systems.
  • Co-sell with brokers and consultants. Roughly half your pipeline will touch a broker or consultant. You'll work side-by-side with OneDigital, Howden, Segal Benz, and the broader broker ecosystem. That means knowing the consulting firms in your patch, building real relationships with the consultants who influence your accounts, and structuring co-sell motions where everybody wins.
  • Run rigorous demos and POCs. Ava reasons live. Carly answers real benefits questions. The product sells itself when it's in front of the right people, on the right data, asking the right questions. You'll partner with our Sales Engineering team to scope and run technical evaluations, including 30-day implementations that get customers live before most vendors finish a security review.
  • Build a quarterly forecast you can defend. You'll own a clean pipeline, a defensible forecast, and a clear plan to hit. Stages have meaning here. We expect MEDDPICC-level rigor on every six-figure-plus opportunity, and we expect you to bring deal risks forward early rather than at the end of the quarter.
  • Use AI as a core part of how you work. Sellers at Avante use AI tools daily to research accounts, draft outbound, prep for executive meetings, build mutual close plans, and turn call transcripts into next-step plans before the customer is off the Zoom. If you've been operating like a traditional AE who occasionally tries ChatGPT, this is not the right seat. We want sellers who are already rewiring their workflow around what Claude, Granola, and similar tools make possible.
  • Partner across GTM. You'll work tightly with Sales Development, Sales Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product. You'll bring customer signal back into the company with urgency, and you'll trust your peers to do their parts so you can stay focused on what only you can do: closing.
  • Adapt as we grow. The patch, the playbook, and the partner motion will evolve as Avante scales. You should expect your territory and product surface to expand over time, and you should welcome that.

What We're Looking For

  • 5–10+ years of quota-carrying SaaS sales experience, with at least 3 years closing enterprise deals at $150K+ ACV into HR, Benefits, Finance, or adjacent buying centers
  • A track record of consistently hitting or exceeding quota in a complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sale
  • Demonstrated ability to run new-category or evangelical sales, where you have to teach the buyer what the product is before you can sell it
  • Experience co-selling with channel partners, ideally brokers, consultants, or systems integrators
  • Executive presence and written communication strong enough to credibly engage CHROs, CFOs, and their direct reports
  • Active, hands-on use of AI in your day-to-day selling motion, not just curiosity about it
  • A clean, methodical approach to pipeline, forecast, and deal qualification (MEDDPICC or equivalent)
  • Comfort operating at startup pace with startup ambiguity, while running enterprise deal cycles with enterprise discipline

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience selling into benefits, HR tech, or healthcare to self-funded employers
  • Existing relationships in the benefits broker and consultant ecosystem (Mercer, Aon, WTW, Gallagher, Lockton, OneDigital, Howden, Segal Benz)
  • Experience selling AI-native or data-intensive platforms where buyers need to be educated on what the product actually is
  • Early-stage startup experience where you helped build the playbook, not just run it
  • A network of CHRO, Total Rewards, or Benefits leader relationships you can reactivate from day one

What We Offer

The OTE for this role is $300,000-$350,000. Where you land in that range depends on your experience, your skills, and how well your background fits what the role needs.

We also offer:

  • Equity: Stock options, so you share in what we’re building
  • Health coverage: Medical, dental, and vision, with employee premiums covered by Avante
  • Unlimited PTO: Take the time you need to rest and recharge, plus paid company holidays
  • Retirement: 401(k)
  • Commuter benefit: $150/month toward transit or parking

Avante is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re building a diverse, inclusive team and welcome candidates of all backgrounds.

How We Work

Our four values aren't aspirational. They translate into concrete operating tenets that shape how we make decisions every day.

Beat Yesterday. We re-evaluate our own toolkit every quarter, because the workflows that made you effective three months ago may already be outdated. We act on 70% of the information rather than waiting for certainty. We timebox, execute, and iterate, getting work in front of real people quickly instead of polishing in isolation. And we own our output regardless of how we produced it. AI can get you 80% of the way there. Everything that goes out with your name on it is your responsibility to review, refine, and stand behind.

Embrace Type 2 Fun. We take on hard problems and find meaning in the work, even when it's uncomfortable. We assume good intent and follow up directly rather than venting in side channels. We celebrate wins loudly and specifically, naming the actual behavior so the whole team learns what great looks like. We are on by default, because we owe it to each other and to our customers to be available beyond what a regular corporate job would demand. And we do unscalable things today that build scalable advantages tomorrow: every hand-built account play and late-night proposal turnaround earns us the right to scale later.

Stay Hungry, Stay Curious. We expect everyone to be the expert on AI in their function before anyone asks them to be. The landscape changes weekly. When you learn something, teach it. Learn enough about adjacent functions to ask good questions. Ask the question you think is too basic, because in complex domains like benefits, the cost of a wrong assumption can be a lost account. And remember: curiosity without urgency is a hobby. Learning has to translate into action on a timeline that matches the opportunity.

Act Like an Owner. We say the uncomfortable thing early, raising missed commitments or quality gaps directly with the person within 48 hours. We surface problems when they're small, not the week they become a crisis. Customer-facing work gets priority, always. And we close the loop every time, because over-communication is a feature at our stage, not a bug.

jobs.description:
About fullthrottle.ai

At fullthrottle.ai, we're focused on delivering cutting-edge applications & data services to our clients, including advertising agencies, media companies and brands. Our patented, privacy-compliant technology powers next-level marketing by unlocking first-party data at scale—giving advertisers the edge they need in a cookieless world.

The Role: DevOps Engineer

As a DevOps Engineer at Fullthrottle.ai, you will work directly under the guidance of our DevSecOps Manager, contributing to the secure, reliable, and scalable delivery of our SaaS platform. You’ll collaborate closely with development, operations, and business teams, helping to embed security, compliance, reliability, and automation into every stage of our software delivery lifecycle.

This is a hands-on role requiring ownership, technical curiosity, strong troubleshooting skills, and a proactive approach to problem-solving in a fast-moving startup environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Platform Operations: Own the operational health, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and continuous improvement of our AWS-based SaaS platform. Ensure systems remain secure, reliable, and scalable.
  • CI/CD Pipeline Development: Build, optimize, and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable rapid, secure software delivery. Partner with development teams to improve deployment processes and developer productivity.
  • Security & Compliance: Implement and maintain security controls in line with SOC2 and other compliance requirements, working closely with the DevSecOps Manager. Support vulnerability remediation activities, access management, audit requests, and security monitoring initiatives.
  • Incident Response: Participate in incident response, business recovery planning, root cause analysis, and post-incident reviews. Help develop corrective and preventative actions to improve platform resilience.
  • Operational Excellence: Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, networking, application, and CI/CD issues. Demonstrate the ability to identify root causes, implement solutions, and prevent recurring problems.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Create and maintain runbooks, recovery procedures, operational documentation, architectural diagrams, and technical knowledge articles to support team scalability and business continuity.
  • Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with engineering, operations, product, and business teams to deliver seamless, secure solutions.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve automation, reliability, security, observability, and operational efficiency across our infrastructure.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience: 4+ years in a DevOps, Site Reliability, Platform Engineering, or Cloud Infrastructure role, preferably in a SaaS or cloud-native environment. Experience supporting production AWS workloads is strongly preferred.
  • AWS Skills: Hands-on experience with core AWS services (EC2, ECS, S3, VPC, IAM, Lambda, RDS) and familiarity with AWS security tools (GuardDuty, Inspector, Config, CloudTrail).
  • DevOps Methodologies: Solid understanding of DevOps principles, secure software development practices, release management, and CI/CD pipeline best practices.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Strong hands-on Terraform experience required. Experience with CloudFormation and infrastructure automation practices is beneficial.
  • Containers & Platform Technologies: Experience supporting containerized workloads using Docker, ECS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration technologies.
  • Compliance Awareness: Exposure to compliance frameworks (SOC2, ISO, etc.) and security controls in cloud environments.
  • Technical Acumen: Proficiency in scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell, etc.), infrastructure-as-code solutions, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and monitoring or observability platforms.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Soft Skills: Strong communication, collaboration, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities. Proactive, accountable, adaptable, and eager to learn.
  • Exposure/experience with AI architectures such as AWS Bedrock would be a plus.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as New Relic, Datadog, Grafana, or similar technologies is a plus.

Our Core Principles:

  • Customer Centricity: Always put customers first.
  • Growth Mindset: Continuously learn and evolve
  • Accountability & Integrity: Take ownership and act with honesty.
  • Collaboration & Humility: Value every voice and work together.
  • Open Communication: Practice transparency and direct feedback.

Not a Fit If…

  • You have limited experience supporting production cloud environments.
  • You prefer a slow-moving environment or are uncomfortable with the pace and ambiguity of a startup.
  • You are not interested in hands-on technical work, operational ownership, troubleshooting, or proactive problem-solving.
  • You require highly prescriptive direction and are uncomfortable working independently.
  • You prefer narrow responsibilities rather than broad ownership across infrastructure, security, automation, and operational support.

If you are an experienced DevOps professional who enjoys building reliable systems, solving challenging technical problems, taking ownership of outcomes, and driving continuous improvement, we want to hear from you. Candidates who value clarity, consistency, and careful attention to detail tend to thrive here. This is an opportunity to make a real impact at a dynamic and growing company.

With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Job Summary

The Senior Solution Consultant, Destination CRM Optimization, serves as a strategic advisor to destination organizations, helping clients improve how they use CRM technology, data, workflows, and reporting to support their business objectives.

This role leads both the pre-sales and delivery of Destination CRM Optimization & Benchmarking engagements, partnering with Sales and clients to identify opportunities, understand business needs, assess current CRM practices, benchmark approaches, and develop practical recommendations and prioritized improvement roadmaps. The CRM Optimization offering includes discovery, assessment and benchmarking, collaborative workshops, and roadmap development, with recommendations spanning immediate improvements, near-term enhancements, and longer-term strategic investments.

The role also helps lead the development of Destination CRM best practices, bringing together insights from customers, Product, Client Success, Services, Sales, Support, and Destination Insights. The focus is on identifying effective practices, validating them with destination customers, and translating them into reusable playbooks, tools, training, advisory offerings, and product input.

This is a highly collaborative role that combines client consulting, solution delivery, CRM expertise, facilitation, and practice development. Success requires the ability to move comfortably from client discovery and assessment to strategic recommendations, while turning lessons from individual engagements into scalable value for the broader Destination customer community.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

    Destination CRM Best Practices & Thought Leadership

jobs.description:
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the development of our customer support AI automation product line. You’ll help reduce operational costs, increase automation and improve the customer experience.

This role is focused on complex operational processes rather than primarily user-facing features. You’ll turn high-level business needs into clear, measurable automation initiatives - from discovery and business case through pilot and production.

What you’ll do

  • Own the roadmap and prioritisation for the product line: decide what to build, in what order and why, and deliver against measurable savings targets.
  • Work with support operations to understand how processes work in practice, identify automation opportunities and turn operational pain points into shipped solutions.
  • Analyse processes, volumes, costs and expected outcomes; build data-driven business cases and assess whether initiatives should be piloted or scaled.
  • Define scope, business logic and requirements for automation initiatives, including exceptions, dependencies and cases that need to remain under human control.
  • Partner with BPM engineers, backend developers, the LLM team, QA and process owners to align on solutions and delivery.
  • Run several initiatives in parallel, balancing new automation opportunities, active projects and infrastructure work.
  • Help shape how the team works, including product documentation standards, phased delivery and the path from pilot to production.
  • Use AI tools such as Claude Code or Codex in your day-to-day work for analysis, prototyping and documentation—and critically validate their outputs.

Requirements

  • 4–6 years of experience in product management, ideally with automation or AI initiatives that delivered measurable business results.
  • Strong analytical and research skills, including process analysis, opportunity sizing, project economics and data-informed prioritisation.
  • Experience taking initiatives from discovery and business case through delivery, pilot evaluation and production rollout.
  • Confidence working with complex processes, multiple stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills: able to align business and technical teams, manage competing priorities and advocate for automation without losing sight of service quality.
  • Hands-on, regular experience with AI agents such as Claude Code or Codex, as well as a working understanding of prompt engineering, model selection and LLM integrations.

    Nice to have
    • Experience with customer support or contact-centre operations.
    • Familiarity with BPMN and workflow tools such as Camunda.

jobs.description:
COMPANY 🌱

RYZE was founded in 2019 by Andrée Werner and Rashad Hossain, out of a parents' basement, with a mission to change daily health, starting with the morning routine: a nutrient-dense mushroom coffee delivering clean energy, mental clarity, and immune support. Built on a Direct-to-Consumer foundation with a performance marketing engine, RYZE achieved hockey-stick growth and a community of over 1 million active subscribers.

DTC remains the foundation, but RYZE has expanded into mass retail, quickly becoming the #2 items in Target's overall coffee category and is now executing a multi-channel expansion, with a cross-category launch coming in early 2027. RYZE is uniquely positioned to redefine how people think about daily wellness.

We’re a lean, fast-moving, mission-driven team who believe daily rituals create the foundation for living your greatest life, and we’re just getting started!

WHAT YOU'LL DO 🎯

The Director of Manufacturing & Supply is a critical leadership hire responsible for owning the full production value chain — from co-manufacturer management and production execution through raw material sourcing and supplier relationships. This role is the production and sourcing engine of RYZE’s Operations function.


This role requires someone who will roll up their sleeves. RYZE is at a stage where the manufacturing function needs both strategic thinking and hands-on execution. The Director must be comfortable operating at the co-man floor level while simultaneously building the systems, processes, and team that will scale to $1B.Responsibilities will include:


Co-Manufacturer Management

  • Own full accountability for all co-manufacturing partners, serving as the single point of ownership for output, quality, cost, and delivery
  • Lead onboarding and stabilization of new co-manufacturers, including recipe transfer, production validation, equipment installation, and ramp-up execution
  • Manage transitions away from legacy partners, ensuring zero disruption to supply continuity
  • Establish and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with each co-manufacturing partner in collaboration with Quality
  • Develop and implement performance scorecards tracking delivery, quality, cost, and responsiveness

Production Execution

  • Oversee production scheduling, capacity planning, and line allocation across all manufacturing sites in coordination with Supply Chain Planning
  • Ensure production commitments are met while proactively resolving constraints, bottlenecks, and line conflicts
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase yield, reduce waste, and optimize per-unit costs
  • Implement inventory buffer strategies for packaging and raw materials to stabilize operations and eliminate reactive supply issues

Sourcing & Procurement

  • Own sourcing, purchasing, and supplier management across all raw materials and inputs
  • Hire and lead sourcing leadership to manage day-to-day supplier relationships, negotiations, and vendor onboarding
  • Define and execute a supplier diversification strategy to mitigate single-source risk
  • Lead supplier negotiations, contract management, and cost optimization at scale
  • Manage critical raw material supply challenges and ensure continuity of supply for key inputs

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop a team supporting production, supply, and sourcing operations
  • Provide coaching, performance management, and day-to-day leadership
  • Build and scale a high-performing, execution-focused team aligned to business growth

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Supply Chain Planning: Align on demand forecasts, production priorities, and inventory targets while providing feedback on constraints and lead times
  • Quality: Partner on audits, inspections, batch release processes, and QBRs while maintaining a collaborative relationship within an independent governance structure
  • New Product Introduction (NPI): Support production readiness for new SKUs, including trials, validation, and commercialization ramp-up
  • R&D / Innovation: Collaborate on formulation feasibility, pilot runs, and scale-up of new products

WHAT WE OFFER 🌟

PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations, or supply chain, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role
  • Proven experience managing co-manufacturing partners, with full accountability for output, quality, cost, and delivery
  • Demonstrated success onboarding new co-manufacturers, including recipe transfer, production validation, equipment installation, and ramp-up
  • Experience leading transitions between manufacturing partners with no disruption to supply continuity
  • Track record of owning sourcing, procurement, and supplier management across raw materials and packaging, including negotiations and contract management at scale
  • Experience building and leading teams across production, supply, and sourcing functions
  • Strong command of production scheduling, capacity planning, and line allocation across multiple sites
  • Proven ability to drive continuous improvement that increases yield, reduces waste, and lowers per-unit costs
  • Experience developing supplier diversification strategies and mitigating single-source risk
  • Ability to design inventory buffer strategies for raw materials and packaging that prevent reactive supply issues
  • Working knowledge of food safety and quality systems, including audits, inspections, and batch release (e.g., GMP, HACCP, SQF/BRC)
  • Strong financial acumen, including cost modeling, budgeting, and negotiation of commercial terms
  • Proficiency with ERP and supply chain planning systems and data-driven decision-making

Job Description Summary

Are you a problem solver who can analyze complex risk and find insurance solutions that balance customer needs with business goals? If you can take initiative, use both your analytical and creative abilities to make sound decisions and have a desire to help people solve real challenges, we want to know more about you!

As a Consultant, you'll be responsible for reviewing and analyzing numerous, highly complex lines of business. You'll underwrite individual risk for acceptability, pricing, coverage, terms and conditions. You'll lead in the development and integration of new and existing programs and identify new program opportunities. You will participate in making reinsurance decisions; assist in developing and implementing loss control and risk management strategies. You'll collaborate between business partners for development and implementation of program specific tools (i. e. underwriting guidelines, forms/rate filings, etc) for new programs or modifications to existing programs. You'll communicate program updates to program managers and other business liaisons. In order to succeed, you will need to build and maintain effective relationships with internal business liaisons, external program managers, and other key partners. You will be responsible for the training and mentoring of underwriting team members.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drives the sales and underwriting relationship for Programs products and services. Provides input and data to help drive and implement strategic underwriting plans. Provides business forecasting related to trends, and profitability within Program vertical. Responsible for achieving established goals for assigned programs.

  • Analyzes program manager relationships/results and recommends corrective actions if necessary. Understands business needs and identifies new business opportunities.

  • Reviews highly complex ((e.g. including D&O, E&O, Employment Practices Liability, Medical Professional Liability, Contractual Liability, Cyber Liability, Shared and Layered Property, General Liability, Excess, auto, Recreation Marine, Energy, Environmental, Inland Marine, Warranty and Workers Compensation) individual risks, programs, or referrals within assigned territory from program managers and declines or accepts business based upon information necessary to make the decision. Some of the risks could be multinational or have alternative arrangements in place that make them unique. Acts as a subject matter expert in analyzing exposures to losses; develops adequate premium charge for the exposure. Determines appropriate endorsements and exclusions to address loss exposures for the insurance contract.

  • Actively engages in discussions with reinsurers per department guidelines verifying the appropriate use of all reinsurance facilities used by the department, including various treaty, semi-automatic and facultative reinsurance. Responsible for compiling data to be provided for reinsurers presentations. Maintains good working relationship with reinsurers.

  • Develops and implements underwriting guidelines, rates, forms, product endorsements and procedures. Assists in the development of department policies and underwriting and standard methodologies.

  • Interacts with various business partners (i.e. claims, actuary, compliance, etc.) to achieve company goals and objectives. Acts as an internal consultant responsible for resolving escalated issues and communicating to business liaisons and external sources regarding program initiatives.

  • Responsible for audits of individual risks/programs for compliance with company guidelines, state regulations and reinsurance conditions. Development and implementation of specific action plans may be required. Responsible for the resolution of advanced complex technical issues.

  • Independently establishes and maintains effective relationships with Program Managers in order to generate growth and profitably. Travels to existing and potential program manager offices, as required for marketing visits. Frequently entertains Program Managers to market services and ensure strong relationships to write profitable business.

  • Leads in the implementation of all new programs from development of underwriting guidelines, form/rate filings, compliance/regulatory matters, finance, reinsurance, claims, legal, accounting, actuarial and marketing matters to ensure proper program integration.

  • Attends industry functions to promote E&S/S Programs brand and capabilities of the programs team in order to help identify new program business opportunities.

  • Acts as a resource for direction, training and guidance for less experienced staff. May be responsible for underwriting and support staff.

  • Maintains knowledge of insurance regulations; provides consulting regarding legislation that impacts the organization.

May Perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Director/AVP. Acts primarily as an individual contributor; may have three or less direct reports.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate studies with focus in Finance, Accounting Economics, and/or Risk Management. Graduate degree preferred.

Experience: Typically five or more years related experience as a Professional, Financial and/or Specialty lines underwriter. Program leadership experience in professional lines of business is preferred. Some experience in the technical aspects of data management, imaging and procedures and processes helpful.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Demonstrated knowledge of Professional, Financial, and/or Specialty lines underwriting policies, practices and procedures, insurance law and underwriting marketing principles and techniques. Strong understanding of financial documents, financial analysis, investments, market conditions essential. Legal knowledge related to insurance, contract and business law preferred. Understanding of employment principles and practices.

Must possess strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with internal/external business partners at all levels. Must have skills to influence and negotiate with internal/external business partners at all levels. Must have the ability to manage large programs; develop and apply innovative approaches to program initiatives and problem solutions. Proven ability to analyze and interpret mathematical, statistical and logical data, and evaluate its reliability and significance. Must have project and process management skills. Must have ability to evaluate, analyze and devise solutions to complex programs; implement the most appropriate solution and monitor the effectiveness. Ability to support numerous internal/external business partners and make decisions that reflect the goals of the company, both financially and ethically. Ability to lead, train, motivate employees and set work priorities. Ability to apply/learn job related software.

Job Title: Derivatives Counsel (ISDA Specialist)

Job Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

Job Summary: We are seeking seasoned Derivatives Counsels for a part-time role at the forefront of legal AI. This opportunity is for elite lawyers who want to help shape how advanced AI is trained, evaluated, and applied in real-world legal work, especially those with deep experience drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and redlining ISDA Master Agreements and related derivatives documentation.

In this role, you will review, assess, and contribute to contract redlining workflows used to train and evaluate state-of-the-art AI models. Your work will directly improve how these systems identify risk and interpret derivatives documentation to create tools with improved precision and legal judgment.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Perform simulated negotiations and redlining exercises on ISDA Master Agreements.
  2. Review and assess AI responses to derivatives contract scenarios, providing expert feedback to improve model performance and output precision.
  3. Create objective evaluation frameworks and grading criteria to assess AI performance on derivatives documentation tasks with rigor and consistency.
  4. Collaborate with product and research teams to refine data, guidelines, and best practices for AI-driven contract review solutions.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. Minimum of 3 years of experience in derivatives documentation, with hands-on negotiation of ISDA Master Agreements, LPAs, CSAs and other types of commercial agreements.
  2. Deep familiarity with key ISDA provisions, including events of default, termination events, close-out netting, and collateral terms.
  3. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with meticulous attention to detail.
  4. Strong analytical capabilities and ability to translate legal expertise into actionable feedback for AI systems.
  5. Experience working with cross-disciplinary teams in fast-paced environments.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Prior exposure to AI, legal tech, or training initiatives.

Why Join:

  1. This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of law and technology.
  2. You will help define how AI is developed for a new generation of legal practitioners.
  3. You will apply your experience in a high-impact research environment.

Compensation Structure:

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a strategic and commercially minded Product Director to lead the evolution of our audience, media, and advertising platform capabilities. This leader will define and deliver product strategy across audience solutions, programmatic advertising, and the integration of owned media into a unified commercial experience.

The role will turn audience insights, media assets, and performance data into differentiated products that are easy to sell, plan, activate, measure, and optimize. It is an opportunity to shape a foundational growth platform at the intersection of product, data, advertising technology, and commercial transformation.

What You Will Own

Audience Strategy & Product Development

Define and execute the vision, product strategy, and roadmap for audience capabilities.

Build differentiated products using first-party, behavioral, contextual, geographic, and advertiser-permissioned data.

Create packaging, activation, pricing, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

Advance segmentation, enrichment, identity, insights, and responsible data use.

Owned Media Integration & Unified Workflows

Integrate owned media inventory and audience signals into planning, selling, delivery, and reporting workflows.

Define the target experience across planning, order management, inventory, campaign delivery, optimization, and measurement.

Connect advertising, commercial, data, and reporting capabilities through clear platform boundaries.

Simplify fragmented workflows and reduce manual handoffs.

Programmatic Monetization

Own the strategy for direct and automated media offerings across multiple buying models.

Improve yield and inventory utilization while protecting customer value and premium experiences.

Advance forecasting, pricing, packaging, decisioning, and campaign optimization.

Use performance data and market insights to prioritize investment and validate product-market fit.

Commercialization & Leadership

Build business cases, launch plans, adoption strategies, and success measures.

Lead across Sales, Client Success, Marketing, Data, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Privacy.

Guide roadmap, investment, dependency, and trade-off decisions with senior stakeholders.

Develop product talent and influence matrixed teams across the organization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of product management experience in digital advertising, advertising technology, media platforms, data products, or related fields.

5+ years leading complex platform products, major integrations, or multi-team transformation initiatives.

Strong understanding of programmatic advertising, digital media monetization, audience products, campaign workflows, and advertising operations.

Experience translating customer and commercial problems into platform strategy, roadmaps, product requirements, and measurable outcomes.

Strong analytical and commercial judgment, executive communication, and cross-functional leadership skills.

Technical & Domain Expertise

Deep working knowledge of Google Ad Manager or a comparable enterprise ad server, including orders, line items, targeting, pacing, creative trafficking, and reporting integrations.

Experience with advertising order-to-cash ecosystems, including booking, pricing, fulfillment, billing, and revenue-recognition processes to connect with ad-serving and reporting platforms.

Understanding modern cloud data platforms and warehouses, such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks, including audience tables, identity graphs, data marts, and scalable reporting layers.

Expertise in audience and identity architecture, including first-party identity resolution, consumer graphs, segment taxonomies, known and anonymous audiences, and deterministic and probabilistic matching.

Experience defining API and integration patterns, including REST or GraphQL, event-driven contracts, system-of-record boundaries, and data synchronization across commercial, advertising, and reporting systems.

Strong understanding of media monetization and yield concepts, including CPM pricing, rate cards, floor strategies, margin structures, premium and remnant inventory, and cross-channel revenue attribution.

Knowledge of cross-channel audience activation from owned environments into social, video, and demand-side advertising platforms.

Knowledge of data-modeling and SQL, including dimensional models for campaign, impression, audience, and revenue data; sold-versus-delivered reconciliation; complex joins; window functions; and performance optimization on large datasets.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience launching audience-based solutions and enabling commercial teams to bring new capabilities to the market.

Experience integrating advertising, customer-management, order-management, reporting, or revenue platforms.

Familiarity with AI-assisted media planning, campaign optimization, and decision-support products.

Experience integrating customer relationship management and commercial workflow platforms, including campaign planning, quote-to-cash, and opportunity-to-order processes in a media sales environment. Experience with Salesforce or an equivalent platform is beneficial.

Experience with business intelligence and reporting platforms that surface campaign, audience, and revenue insights to commercial teams and customers. Familiarity with tools such as Looker, Tableau, or comparable reporting solutions is beneficial.

Understanding of creative fulfillment workflows, including how creative assets are requested, produced, approved, and routed into advertising delivery systems. Experience with commercial creative workflow platforms is beneficial.

Working knowledge of Python or a similar language for prototyping, data validation, analysis, and workflow automation.

MBA or equivalent experience leading product strategy and commercial transformation.

Variable incentive compensation, including commissions, is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, education level, location, and union representation, if applicable

Location: Fully remote

About Us

We are a Latvia-based startup building a finance function that combines accurate accounting, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and practical AI automation.

We are looking for a finance professional who can personally manage our accounting, configure the systems supporting it and use AI agents to carry out the work more efficiently.

Job Description

You will personally perform and take ownership of our accounting and financial operations, using AI agents to support your work. Your responsibilities will cover daily bookkeeping, reconciliations, closing, financial reporting, cash planning and applicable Latvian tax reporting.

You will personally carry out the complete migration from QuickBooks to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, using AI agents to support your work. You will be responsible for all implementation tasks, from planning and data preparation through configuration, import, validation and go-live. No external implementation partners will be involved. As part of preparing and importing the data, you will review the complete accounting records for the past five years, identify gaps and errors, and reconcile the migrated data to the source records. You must be comfortable both doing the accounting and setting up the accounting system.

AI agents will assist with document processing, transaction preparation, matching, reconciliation and reporting. You will define their tasks, supervise their execution, investigate exceptions and verify their outputs. You remain responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, expense accounting and bank reconciliations.
  • Complete month-end and year-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and supporting documentation.
  • Set up, configure and maintain Business Central, including the chart of accounts, posting groups, dimensions, VAT setup, bank accounts, accounting periods and relevant financial workflows.
  • Personally execute the complete migration from QuickBooks to Business Central, including data extraction, account and tax mapping, cleansing, system configuration, trial imports, reconciliation and go-live. Review all accounting records for the past five years during migration preparation and import, investigate missing or incorrect entries, document corrections and preserve supporting documents and a traceable audit trail.
  • Prepare and manage applicable Latvian tax and statutory reporting, including VAT, corporate income tax, payroll-related obligations and VID/EDS processes.
  • Handle international customers, suppliers, contractors, foreign currencies and cross-border transactions.
  • Manage cash-flow forecasts, budgets, runway monitoring and management reporting.
  • Prepare payments and administer payroll and contractor payments within agreed approval controls.
  • Configure, instruct and supervise AI agents supporting accounting workflows; improve their performance through clear instructions, reliable source data and systematic verification.
  • Maintain traceability from original documents to accounting entries, resolve exceptions and protect confidential financial information.
  • Identify practical opportunities to reduce costs, improve financial controls and apply lawful tax efficiencies.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven experience personally performing the full accounting cycle for companies in one or more European countries.
  • Practical experience with accounting, taxation and statutory reporting in one or more European countries, and the ability to apply and verify Latvian requirements. Direct Latvian accounting and VID/EDS experience is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience independently setting up and configuring Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for real accounting operations, with the ability to personally execute a complete accounting-system migration.
  • The ability to translate business requirements into appropriate accounting configuration and verify that postings, reconciliations and reports work correctly.
  • Practical experience using AI agents or AI-supported automation in finance or accounting, including supervising outputs and handling errors.
  • Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate incomplete records and reconcile inconsistent data.
  • Independent working habits, ownership of deadlines and clear communication with the founder.
  • Professional working proficiency in English and the ability to work effectively with Latvian-language financial documents and reporting requirements.
  • A relevant accounting or finance qualification, or equivalent substantial practical experience.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building or improving the accounting function of a startup or small international business.
  • QuickBooks to Business Central migrations, Business Central implementations and comprehensive reviews and correction of historical accounting records.
  • Configuring integrations with banks, payment platforms, document systems and Microsoft 365.
  • Power Automate, Power BI, APIs or comparable tools used in practical finance workflows.
  • Accounting for digital services, subscriptions and international contractor relationships.
  • Preparing financial information for funding discussions or due diligence.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote role with direct collaboration with the founder.
  • Responsibility for both the accounting work and the systems supporting it.
  • The opportunity to shape how Business Central and AI agents work together in a startup.
  • A practical environment where reliable execution, sensible automation and cost awareness matter.

Remote Working Arrangement

You will organize your work independently, communicate progress clearly and meet agreed accounting and reporting deadlines. Financial systems and confidential information must be handled securely.

This is a full-time role with flexible working hours. You will organize your schedule around agreed accounting and reporting deadlines.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and briefly describe:

  • The European countries in which you have personally handled accounting and tax reporting, and your specific responsibilities.
  • A Business Central implementation or accounting-system migration you personally executed, including the setup, data migration and validation you performed yourself, and any experience with QuickBooks or historical accounting reviews.
  • How you have used AI agents or automation to perform accounting work and verify its accuracy.

Use anonymized examples and clearly distinguish your own work from work delivered by others.

Job Title: Junior Customer Excellence Associate (Full Time)

In 2017, our founders started Sarwa due to a lack of financial services offered to most of the world, and out of a need to help empower people in the region to invest in their financial future. Sarwa is poised to continue growing into the go-to platform for people to grow their wealth.

We are a remote-first team. Where you choose to work is up to you — we have an office in Abu Dhabi that you can utilize as often or little as you'd like.

We are seeking a Junior Customer Excellence Associate to deliver exceptional customer service to Sarwa clients and potential clients, promote our brand and values, and help Sarwa set the standard for customer service in the region.

At Sarwa, we prioritize people and customer satisfaction. As a Junior Customer Excellence Associate, you will be the primary point of contact for our clients, representing the company to them. jobs.title: Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer - iOS/Android, KMP & DevOps
jobs.excerpt: Location: 100% Remote Employment: Full-time, long-term position Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility About UsWe are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies.
jobs.description:
Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position
Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement
Salary: Based on experience, technical expertise, and level of responsibility

About Us

We are developing a mobile application that combines real-world interactions with location and proximity technologies. Our team uses AI coding tools and autonomous coding agents to accelerate development, improve engineering workflows, and share practical knowledge.

We are looking for a senior engineer who can connect mobile development, backend services, databases, and infrastructure into a reliable development and delivery process.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Senior Mobile & Platform Engineer who can work across Android and iOS, contribute to our Kotlin Multiplatform architecture, and support our dedicated developers on both platforms.

Your main focus will be enabling the team to deliver effectively: resolving technical challenges, maintaining shared components, improving development workflows, and managing the backend and infrastructure that support the application.

You will also contribute directly to implementation where needed. Depending on your experience and suitability, the role may include technical team leadership for our Android and iOS developers.

Strong GitHub, GitHub Actions, and runner-management experience is essential. Practical experience with AI-assisted and agentic development is equally important.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support our Android and iOS developers with technical decisions, debugging, code reviews, and integration challenges.
  • Develop and maintain shared application logic using Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Contribute to native Android and iOS development where platform-specific work is required.
  • Maintain a clear architecture across mobile applications, backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Develop and maintain backend functionality and server-side integrations.
  • Manage database changes, investigate data-related issues, and maintain reliable migration, backup, and recovery processes.
  • Build and improve CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot GitHub runners, including self-hosted runners.
  • Improve build reliability, automated testing, deployment processes, and development environments.
  • Manage server-side application deployments, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
  • Establish effective AI-assisted and agentic coding workflows across the team.
  • Review AI-generated code and ensure that changes are tested, understandable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Help developers and junior team members use AI tools effectively through practical demonstrations and knowledge sharing.
  • Where appropriate, act as technical team lead: coordinate dependencies, guide implementation, review technical decisions, and help the team resolve blockers.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience in mobile software development.
  • Strong Kotlin and Android development experience, together with practical Swift and iOS development experience.
  • Solid hands-on experience with Kotlin Multiplatform and integrating shared code into both mobile platforms.
  • The ability to investigate problems across mobile clients, APIs, backend services, databases, and infrastructure.
  • Practical backend development experience and a sound understanding of API design, authentication, and application security.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including schema changes, migrations, and performance troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on DevOps experience with Linux servers, application deployment, configuration, and operational troubleshooting.
  • Excellent Git and GitHub knowledge, including pull requests, code reviews, branch workflows, and repository configuration.
  • Strong experience with GitHub Actions and configuring and maintaining GitHub runners.
  • Substantial experience using AI coding assistants and coding agents to deliver working software.
  • The ability to establish development workflows that combine coding agents, automated checks, and human review.
  • Clear communication, practical documentation skills, and a willingness to share knowledge.
  • The ability to work independently while supporting other developers constructively.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time position and availability to start promptly after an agreement is reached.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Previous experience as a technical lead or senior engineer supporting a mobile development team.
  • GPS, BLE, UWB, NFC, or other location and proximity technologies.
  • Testing mobile applications on real devices and investigating platform-specific behavior.
  • Container-based application deployment and reproducible development environments.
  • Monitoring, incident diagnosis, and maintaining reliable backend services.
  • Coordinating changes that affect mobile applications, backend APIs, and database structures together.

Potential Technical Team Lead Responsibilities

For a suitable candidate, the role can include technical leadership of our Android and iOS developers.

This would involve helping the team make consistent technical decisions, breaking down implementation work, coordinating shared dependencies, and maintaining the quality of delivered changes. You should be comfortable mentoring developers and taking responsibility for the technical direction while remaining actively involved in engineering.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Compensation based on your experience, expertise, and responsibilities.
  • A central role supporting our mobile development team.
  • The opportunity to shape our architecture, infrastructure, and agentic development workflows.
  • Potential technical teamlead responsibility, depending on suitability.
  • Close collaboration with a team that values practical knowledge sharing.

Remote Working Arrangement

Our remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to Apply

Please submit your CV and a short overview of relevant projects.

Include:

  • Your experience developing for both Android and iOS, including Kotlin Multiplatform.
  • Your backend, database, and server infrastructure responsibilities.
  • Examples of GitHub Actions workflows and runner environments you have configured or maintained.
  • The AI coding tools and agentic workflows you use, with examples of delivered results.
  • Your experience supporting developers, mentoring colleagues, or leading a technical team.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations.

Public portfolio links, GitHub repositories, and released application references are welcome where available.

Harrow (Nasdaq: HROW) is a leading provider of ophthalmic disease management solutions in North America. Harrow is an incredible entrepreneurial company – where we celebrate the ability of every member of the Harrow Family to be the CEO of their job. Harrow’s values have driven interest over the past decade in attracting high-performing professionals in a variety of disciplines. Members of our Harrow Family often express their pride in being a part of our commitment to (1) innovation, (2) patient access to affordable medicines, and (3) our track record of having never turned down an ophthalmologist doing mission work around the world – providing free medicines in support of mission work aimed at giving or maintaining the gift of sight to those most in need. About Rebound

Rebound’s mission is to make recovery from trauma the norm, not the exception.

We are a specialized telehealth provider that helps people heal from the lasting impact of trauma and PTSD. PTSD affects millions of people, yet many struggle to find therapists trained in evidence-based trauma treatments. Through Rebound, members can access live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Prolonged Exposure Therapy (PE), a "gold standard" in PTSD treatment. Our work is grounded in rigorous psychological science and a survivor-centered approach. We help members get out of survival mode after trauma, break intergenerational cycles, and reclaim their lives.

Rebound was founded by a team of trauma survivors and clinicians, and that perspective shapes how we build: serious about outcomes, rigorous about science, and uncompromising about integrity. We’re looking for people who are deeply motivated by the mission to offer clinically proven treatment and remove barriers to care.

About The Role

At Rebound, we believe therapists should be able to focus on what matters most: providing meaningful care to the people who need it.

Rebound is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists to join our network.

As a Rebound Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources. Providers will collaborate with our network of psychiatrists and therapists to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions.
