Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Contracts & Pricing Strategy Senior Manager – IMDELLTRA & BLINCYTO


Live

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world! In this vital role you will report to the Director, Oncology and Ophthalmology Contracts & Pricing Strategy and be part of the US Value & Access Organization. The Senior Manager will be responsible for helping shape the development and execution of the access and contracting strategy for Imdelltra and Blincyto. This role will lead both developing and executing our payer coverage and pricing contracting strategies to achieve brand objectives.


This role will work closely with our US and global brand partners, Oncology field-based account and sales teams, Market Access team, Patient Access, and across all our US Value & Access functions. This individual will engage with subject matter experts and business unit leadership while leading qualitative and quantitative pricing/contracting analyses to support product pricing and provider/payer contracting strategy to enable patient access to these innovative products.

The Senior Manager will also have responsibility for C&P financial related deliverables, launch price scenario modeling, payer/provider deal modeling, and ASP modeling. This role involves conducting comprehensive quantitative and qualitative analyses, partnering with finance to evaluate the impact of contracting strategies on sales volume, discount rates, and long-term planning.

This individual will lead planning and logistics for Coverage & Pricing-sponsored workshops and training sessions in partnership with the brand. They will contribute to coverage tracking and support leadership reporting activities. This role will require a strong foundation in the U.S. healthcare market and is a good avenue to many future commercial healthcare roles. Amgen has strong training, education, and mentoring programs to ensure staff are successful.

  • Lead analysis to inform pricing and coverage decisions and negotiation strategy for customer engagements in collaboration with coverage and pricing director, Account Management Team (AMT), and Market Access Team (MAT)
  • Lead all aspects of the Latest Estimate Discount Rate (LEDR) process, pricing and contracting scenarios, contract decisions, and LRS (long-range strategy) management
  • Support inputs for major US (brand planning, quarterly business reviews, access strategy alignment, semester meetings) and Global milestones, including collaborating with Global Access Leads on product strategy
  • Support development of Launch Readiness plans, Brand Strategy, Contracting Strategy and ensure coverage and pricing proposals are aligned with these strategies

jobs.excerpt: About QuilrAI QuilrAI is an agent-native security company founded by security veterans to secure and operationalize the agentic enterprise across the entire agent lifecycle.
jobs.description:
About QuilrAI

QuilrAI is an agent-native security company founded by security veterans to secure and operationalize the agentic enterprise across the entire agent lifecycle. We treat AI as a deployment problem—ensuring agents are assessed, governed by policy, and deployed via approved blueprints before they reach production, with every agent action decided before execution and verified afterward.

Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we partner with high-growth tech firms and enterprise customers across financial services, legal, and business operations to protect critical workflows against prompt injection, data exfiltration, and non-deterministic model behavior.

The Role

The Forward Deployment Engineer (FDE) works directly inside customer environments to deploy, adapt, and operationalize AI and Data security solutions. This role is deeply hands-on and customer-facing, focused on making AI, DLP, and Identity controls work under real-world constraints—often ahead of full product maturity. In addition to technical execution, the FDE plays a critical role in explaining architectural decisions, DLP limitations, and trade-offs to customer technical teams. You will combine hands-on deployment with clear technical storytelling and collaborative problem solving, helping customers understand not only what is being deployed, but why it works and where its boundaries are.

What You Will Do

• Deployment & Integration

  • Deploy AI security solutions across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises customer environments.
  • Integrate AI agents and workflows using LangChain, LangGraph, and agent orchestration patterns involving human and non-human identities.
  • Integrate identity and access management solutions, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Okta, OAuth, token enforcement, and service identities.
  • Implement data protection and enforcement workflows, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP) inspection, policy enforcement, and audit logging.

• Hands-On Engineering & Troubleshooting

  • Develop custom scripts, connectors, and workflows using Python and Docker to support AI security deployments.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues across AI pipelines, agent workflows, identity flows, authorization boundaries, data movement, and policy enforcement points.
  • Design and implement practical workarounds to address missing features, product limitations, and customer-specific technical challenges.
  • Maintain deployment artifacts, scripts, and configuration files in GitHub to ensure version control and consistency across deployments.

• Customer Workshops & Collaborative Problem Solving

  • Participate in and co-lead technical workshops, architecture reviews, and whiteboarding sessions during customer deployments.
  • Collaborate with customer engineers and architects to refine AI access paths, define identity trust boundaries, and validate data protection and enforcement strategies.
  • Identify environmental constraints, integration dependencies, and deployment challenges early to drive technical alignment.

• Technical Communication, DLP & Customer Alignment

  • Explain AI security architectures and deployment designs, demonstrating how AI workflows, identity controls, and data protection mechanisms work together.
  • Communicate where security enforcement occurs, identify enforcement limitations, and highlight potential coverage gaps.
  • Lead technical discussions on DLP detection and enforcement capabilities, including the structural limitations of traditional DLP in AI-driven and agent-based workflows.
  • Address common misconceptions about DLP coverage and help customers understand risk trade-offs, enforcement gaps, and compensating controls without overstating security capabilities.

• Feedback & Continuous Improvement

  • Document deployment learnings, edge cases, technical challenges, and failure modes encountered during customer implementations.
  • Provide structured feedback to Product and Engineering teams to influence the product roadmap, improve capabilities, and strengthen product reliability.
  • Standardize successful deployment patterns, reusable configurations, and troubleshooting procedures to improve deployment efficiency across customer environments.

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualification

  • Hands-on experience with AI/LLM systems, AI security architectures, and data protection mechanisms.
  • Strong understanding of Data Loss Prevention (DLP), including data classification, content inspection, policy enforcement, real-world limitations, blind spots, and potential bypass scenarios.
  • Solid knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM), including Single Sign-On (SSO), OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), token management, service identities, and policy engines.
  • Proficiency in Python, Docker, and cloud-native technologies across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with familiarity in endpoint security and device trust integrations such as Microsoft Intune and Jamf Pro.
  • Strong debugging, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and systems-thinking skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and work directly with customers in high-stakes technical environments.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangChain and LangGraph, including security considerations for agentic workflows.
  • Experience integrating identity and access management solutions such as Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, OAuth/OIDC, and service identities.
  • Knowledge of AI security risks, DLP enforcement mechanisms, data leakage prevention, prompt injection, and agent permission boundaries.
  • Experience with cloud security, containerization, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub, and infrastructure-as-code tools across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Experience conducting customer workshops, technical demonstrations, proof-of-concept deployments, and documenting reusable integration patterns and deployment best practices.

jobs.excerpt: At Broadway Ventures, we transform challenges into opportunities with expert program management, cutting-edge technology, and innovative consulting solutions.
jobs.description:
At Broadway Ventures, we transform challenges into opportunities with expert program management, cutting-edge technology, and innovative consulting solutions. As an 8(a), HUBZone, and Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB), we empower government and private sector clients by delivering tailored solutions that drive operational success, sustainability, and growth. Built on integrity, collaboration, and excellence, we’re more than a service provider—we’re your trusted partner in innovation.

Position Summary

The Application Developer builds the Java services that ingest public health IT data, observe deployed FHIR endpoints, validate what they find, and assemble reproducible evidence cases for Project Argos. You write the deterministic validators that make pass/fail determinations, plus the retry, rate-limiting, and instrumentation logic that keeps monitoring safe and repeatable. Agentic components may summarize and draft, but they do not make final compliance calls, and your code enforces that boundary.

Type:

  • The position is open to both W2 and 1099
  • Part-time, variable hours, 10 - 29 hours a week
  • 1 year contract

Pay:

  • W2: pay rate of $55 - $60/hr
  • 1099: $65 - $70/hr

Works with: Technical Lead, AI/Engineering Lead, Senior Systems Engineer, and Project Manager.

About Broadway Ventures and Project Argos

Broadway Ventures, LLC is a Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) and HUBZone federal contractor headquartered in Vicksburg, Mississippi, with operations in the Madison/Huntsville, Alabama area.

Project Argos is an agentic AI proof of concept for the Office of the National Coordinator for Health IT (ONC). Broadway is the prime contractor, with Audacious Inquiry as subcontractor. The pipeline pulls published API endpoint data for roughly 290 certified health IT products from the Certified Health IT Product List (CHPL), tests those endpoints on a repeatable schedule, and builds reproducible evidence cases for compliance gaps under 45 CFR Part 170. It runs in a contractor-hosted AWS GovCloud environment, and a qualified human reviews every finding before it becomes a confirmed issue.

Key Responsibilities

- Build ingestion connectors for CHPL, Service Base URL Lists, developer-published FHIR Bundles, Lantern, and other approved public sources. Preserve raw artifacts, timestamps, request metadata, response headers, and hashes.
- Normalize developer, product, version, criterion, CHPL ID, endpoint, organization, and validation records into the project's common data model in DynamoDB, with lineage and source-of-truth precedence rules.
- Implement publication checks that fetch endpoint lists and classify availability failures: URL not found, timeouts, obscuring redirects, malformed responses, and non-machine-readable content.
- Build safe, non-authenticated endpoint observation for metadata and CapabilityStatement retrieval, and detect drift as endpoints are added, removed, moved, or changed.
- Run FHIR R4 validation against Endpoint, Organization, and Bundle resources, preserving both raw and normalized results.
- Build the evidence case package with source metadata, request and response logs, validation outputs, severity, and rule traceability. Support deduplication, clustering, and export to Government-designated systems.
- Design scheduling, retry and backoff, rate limiting, error handling, and audit logging for pipeline and agentic components.
- Make test runs replayable so a reviewer can re-run a test for any evidence case.
- Write unit and integration tests, including stub and mock endpoints for failure scenarios. Participate in code review and keep technical documentation current.
- Keep the code from requesting, collecting, or storing patient data, PHI, credentials, or tokens unless the Government authorizes it in writing.

Required Qualifications

- 5+ years of Java (17+) development, including concurrency and networked services
- 3+ years of Spring Boot or an equivalent framework
- 2+ years of JavaScript/Node for tooling and front-end development
- 4+ years building REST APIs and working with JSON
- 3+ years of working knowledge of HTTP and TLS fundamentals
- 3+ years with the AWS SDK, DynamoDB data modeling, and S3
- 2+ years building and running containerized services
- 4+ years of automated testing (JUnit, integration tests)
- 3+ years of code review and technical documentation
- 1+ year building with LLM APIs or using AI coding assistants in development, including testing and validating AI-generated output
- Authorized to work in the United States

PreferredQualifications

- HAPI FHIR or other FHIR R4 validation experience (US Core, CapabilityStatements)
- HTTP client internals, including timing and connection instrumentation
- Scheduling, retry and backoff, and rate-limiting design
- Testcontainers or stub and mock services for failure testing
- SMART on FHIR, Inferno, or ONC certification testing
- Health IT or federal program experience

What to Expect Next:

After submitting your application, our recruiting team will review your qualifications. This may include a brief telephone interview or email communication to verify resume details and discuss compensation expectations. Interviews will be conducted with the most qualified candidates. Broadway Ventures conducts background checks and drug testing prior to the start of employment. Some positions may also require fingerprinting.

Broadway Ventures is an equal opportunity employer and a VEVRAA federal contractor. We do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations are available for applicants with disabilities. Broadway Ventures utilizes the OFCCP-approved Voluntary Self-Identification of Disability Form (CC-305).

The pay range shown is a good-faith estimate of the compensation Broadway Ventures reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. It is not a guarantee of any particular wage, salary, or total compensation. Actual pay offered depends on job-related factors, which may include skills, experience, education, certifications and licensure, geographic work location, contract funding and budget. For positions covered by the Service Contract Act, pay is also governed by the applicable Department of Labor wage determination, which the government may revise.

Location Eligibility: Broadway Ventures cannot consider applicants who live in, or would work from, any of the following locations: California, Colorado, Connecticut, the District of Columbia, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, North Dakota, Ohio, Oregon, Rhode Island, Washington State, and Wyoming. Candidates must live in and work from an eligible U.S. state when they are hired and for as long as they are employed. Applications from residents of the locations listed above will not be considered.

Notice: Use of Artificial Intelligence in Our Hiring Process

Broadway Ventures uses an artificial intelligence (AI) tool to help review applications for this position.

  • Who built it: Broadway Ventures developed the tool in-house.
  • What it does: It compares your resume to the requirements in this job posting and gives a score from 0 to 100 showing how closely your qualifications match.
  • What information it uses: The text of your resume, your name, your current or most recent job title, your location, and this job posting.
  • What it cannot see: Your answers to voluntary demographic or equal employment opportunity questions, interview feedback, or offer information.
  • How it is used: The score is one factor in our initial review of applications. The tool does not reject anyone. A member of our recruiting team reviews every application before any decision is made.
  • Your options: If you would like your application reviewed without the AI tool, or you need a reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, contact us at . Making a request will not affect whether you are considered for this position.

Some positions are posted in support of a contract proposal that has not yet been awarded. Where that is the case, the position and its final compensation are contingent upon award of the contract to Broadway Ventures and on the terms of the awarded contract, including any government-approved labor rates and the applicable wage determination.

About Us

We are an early-stage startup preparing to launch a mobile dating app competing in the same market as Tinder, Bumble and Hinge.

You will help shape the product, build the brand and bring the app to market. Initially, you will personally deliver much of the work across marketing, content, partnerships and automation. As the business develops, the role may expand to include building and leading a team.

Job Description

You will play a central role in deciding how the app is positioned, how the brand looks and communicates, which audiences we serve and how the product develops to meet their needs.

Working closely with the founding and development teams, you will turn market research, user insights and performance data into recommendations for product priorities, features, onboarding and the overall user experience. Your involvement starts before launch and continues through ongoing product development and growth.

You will also own the marketing strategy and its practical execution. This includes creating the content and systems needed across websites, social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, advertising, influencer campaigns and partnerships.

Exceptional practical expertise in AI is essential. You must be able to use AI to produce high-quality work independently and build reliable content pipelines and automations. n8n and similar tools should be part of your everyday workflow.

Key Responsibilities

  • Shape the product: Research user needs, competitors and market opportunities. Help define the product's value proposition, contribute to roadmap priorities and turn insights into clear feature proposals and briefs.
  • Improve the user experience: Work with the product and development teams on onboarding, activation, engagement, retention and monetization. Help define experiments and assess whether changes improve the experience.
  • Build the brand: Develop brand positioning, messaging, tone of voice, visual direction and storytelling. Translate these into a consistent identity across the app and all marketing channels.
  • Own go-to-market: Develop and execute the pre-launch, launch and growth strategy, including target audiences, market selection, channel priorities and campaign planning.
  • Create marketing content: Personally plan, produce, edit and publish the content the business needs, including websites, landing pages, social posts, advertising assets, graphics, email campaigns, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts and other short-form video.
  • Build content pipelines: Use AI and automation to support research, scripting, visual production, video editing, repurposing, publishing and performance analysis while maintaining creative quality.
  • Develop influencer marketing: Identify suitable creators, establish relationships, negotiate collaborations, develop campaign briefs and measure results.
  • Establish partnerships: Find and develop relevant brand, community, event and distribution partnerships that support awareness, trust and user acquisition.
  • Drive measurable growth: Run acquisition and lifecycle experiments across paid, organic, referral and community channels. Connect marketing activity to activation, retention and commercial outcomes.
  • Automate operations: Build and maintain n8n workflows and integrations that reduce repetitive work across marketing, content production, partnerships and reporting.
  • Support future team growth: As needs and resources develop, help identify hiring priorities, document effective workflows and onboard colleagues or external specialists.

Required Qualifications

  • Substantial hands-on experience launching and growing consumer mobile apps, with a demonstrable personal contribution to apps reaching six-, seven- or eight-figure download totals.
  • Evidence of your own impact: the decisions you owned, the work you delivered and the measurable results achieved.
  • Experience contributing directly to product development through user research, feature definition, prioritization, experimentation and collaboration with designers and developers.
  • Strong brand-building ability, including positioning, messaging, visual judgment and consistent execution across product and marketing.
  • Exceptional practical AI skills across research, writing, design, image generation, video production, editing and content workflows.
  • The ability to independently produce marketing content across multiple formats, including social media, YouTube long-form videos, Shorts, websites and advertising creatives.

  • A solid understanding of mobile acquisition, attribution, activation, retention, customer acquisition cost and lifetime value.
  • The judgment to prioritize the channels and activities that matter most, balancing quality, speed and limited startup resources.
  • A willingness to take ownership across disciplines and personally execute the work required at an early-stage business.
  • Resilience under pressure, strong prioritization skills and the ability to maintain quality and sound judgment during demanding launch phases.
  • Comfort working with uncertainty, changing priorities and limited startup resources, with the confidence to communicate trade-offs, flag constraints early and propose practical solutions.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Experience with dating apps, social discovery products or consumer platforms that depend on network effects.
  • Growing mobile apps to millions or tens of millions of downloads.
  • Taking a product from pre-launch through launch and subsequent growth.
  • Building local user density, communities and market-by-market launch strategies.

  • Building a YouTube presence, repeatable video formats or creator-led acquisition channels.
  • Establishing partnerships that delivered measurable distribution, engagement or revenue.
  • Growing from an individual contributor into a team leadership role within a startup.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to build practical systems and workflows from the beginning.

jobs.excerpt: Twingate is building a modern remote access solution that simplifies and improves the way businesses secure access to their cloud, SaaS, and on-prem resources.
jobs.description:
Twingate is building a modern remote access solution that simplifies and improves the way businesses secure access to their cloud, SaaS, and on-prem resources. Twingate is backed by leading investors such as BOND, WndrCo, 8VC, Green Bay Ventures, SignalFire, and Dropbox founders Drew Houston and Arash Ferdowsi. Our investors share our belief that in a world where workforces are becoming increasingly distributed, it is critical to be able to effectively secure access to apps, data, and environments.
As part of our company culture, our belief in putting the customer first permeates our thinking in everything from our customer communications to the design process behind the product itself. If you take pride in creating experiences with the customer firmly at the center of the picture, we'd love to work with you.

About Twingate

Twingate makes Zero Trust Network Access simple enough for any organization to adopt. Our platform replaces legacy VPNs with identity-based, least-privilege access to private resources, whether they live in the cloud, a data center or a home lab.

Teams deploy Twingate in minutes, not months. It works with the identity providers, device management tools and infrastructure-as-code workflows customers already use. The result is stronger security, faster connections and far less work for IT and DevOps teams.

Twingate is backed by BOND, WndrCo, 8VC and SignalFire, and serves companies of every size, from fast-growing startups to global enterprises.

About the role

This is a new-business hunting role. Your primary goal is to create pipeline and close net-new logos within your assigned commercial territory. You will run deals end to end: prospecting, discovery, demo, technical evaluation, negotiation and close.

You will sell to IT leaders, security teams, DevOps engineers and founders at mid-market companies. Many buyers are replacing a VPN or adopting Zero Trust for the first time, so you will need to teach as much as you sell.

You will work closely with Sales Development, Solutions Engineering, Marketing and Customer Success. Expect a fast-paced, collaborative team that shares what works and coaches each other to win.

Responsibilities

  • Meet or exceed a quarterly new-business quota by sourcing, qualifying and closing net-new logos.

  • Generate your own pipeline through outbound prospecting: calls, email, LinkedIn, events and creative multi-threaded outreach.

  • Partner with SDRs and Marketing to convert inbound leads and product-led signups into qualified opportunities.

  • Run the full sales cycle, including discovery, tailored demos, proof-of-value evaluations, pricing, negotiation and contract close.

  • Lead disciplined deal qualification using a framework such as MEDDPICC.

  • Position Twingate against legacy VPNs and competing ZTNA and SASE vendors, clearly articulating our differentiation.

  • Collaborate with Solutions Engineers to scope technical requirements and deliver successful trials.

  • Hand off new customers smoothly to Customer Success and identify early expansion opportunities.

  • Keep activity, pipeline and forecast data accurate in Salesforce, and forecast your business with confidence.

  • Share customer and competitive feedback with Product and Marketing to sharpen our go-to-market.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience as a SaaS Account Executive in a full-cycle, quota-carrying closing role.

  • A proven track record of meeting or exceeding new-business quota.

  • Demonstrated ability to build your own pipeline through outbound prospecting, not just working inbound leads.

  • Experience running complex sales cycles with multiple stakeholders, including technical buyers and economic decision-makers.

  • Strong discovery, presentation and negotiation skills, plus the ability to explain technical concepts in plain language.

  • Comfort with a modern sales stack such as Salesforce, Gong, Outreach or Salesloft, ZoomInfo and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

  • Self-direction and discipline to thrive in a fully remote environment.

  • Curiosity, coachability and a sense of urgency.

  • Ability to travel occasionally for customer meetings, team gatherings and events.

Major Plus

  • Experience selling cybersecurity, networking, identity or infrastructure software.

  • Familiarity with Zero Trust, VPNs, SASE or identity providers such as Okta, Entra ID and Google Workspace.

  • Experience selling into a product-led growth (PLG) motion, converting free or self-serve users into paid customers.

  • Experience selling to technical buyers such as DevOps, platform engineering and IT teams.

  • Prior success at a high-growth startup.

Benefits

  • Medical (PPO, HMO, HDHP), dental and vision insurance – employees covered 100%
  • Basic Life, AD&D and disability insurance
  • Flexible Spending Accounts - Healthcare, Dependent Care and Commuter
  • Health Savings Account
  • Flexible Paid Time Off - Paid Holidays (approx. 11 days), Sick Leave (10 days), Paid Parental Leave (6 weeks), Maternity Leave (14 - 16 weeks)
  • Retirement - Traditional 401k, Roth 401k
  • Additional Benefits - Equity
  • Competitive OTE
  • Strong equity upside in a high-growth Series B company
  • Remote first culture with intentional in-person collaboration
  • A supportive GTM team including Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing

What We Value

  • High Agency: We own the problem and don’t think in silos. “Not my job” is not an acceptable excuse if something is not working. Figure out what’s wrong and take initiative to solve the problem. Speak up. Company success is everyone’s job.
  • Deliver Customer Value: Company success follows customer success (not the other way around). Everything we do starts and ends with delivering value to our customers.
  • Continuous Improvement: Making small improvements consistently is preferred to aiming for big leaps. We embrace that we may not get it right the first time, so we learn by doing, making mistakes, and course correcting constantly. 1% better every day is how we accomplish great things over time.
  • Go Find Out: We seek a deeper understanding beyond the surface, and get our hands dirty with ground truth data (no matter the seniority). We know anecdotes can be more powerful than aggregate stats because they can reveal hidden truths. Always be learning.
  • Startup DNA: We operate at a higher clock speed and believe small committed teams can make the impossible possible. We embrace that great results only come with great effort, and we lift each other to achieve more than we could achieve alone.

The position will primarily work with TNC’s Northeast Division within the United States, with additional work as assigned across the United States. The Senior Attorney will provide legal services on complex matters to advance Conservancy priorities and appropriately manage risk for assigned programs and ensure that transactions and activities are legally sound and consistent with the Conservancy’s values, mission, policies and procedures. The Senior Attorney will clearly articulate complex legal concepts and options to assigned programs. They will be responsible for providing legal advice and support regarding matters relating to all aspects of the Conservancy’s programs for assigned business units, particularly conservation real estate and financing matters.


The Senior Attorney may also provide advice on complex non-real estate conservation projects; contracts and grants, legal support for the Conservancy’s engagements and relationships with large corporations, advice regarding dam removal projects, public policy, tax-exempt law issues and philanthropy. They will work as part of a team of attorneys, paralegals and support staff. While this is a remote role that may be located anywhere in the United States, this position will be expected to work on Eastern Time Zone hours. This position may have supervisory responsibility for paralegals and may be asked to supervise other attorneys, legal volunteers, and/or outside counsel.


Some examples of the type of TNC projects implemented in the Northeast Division:

Kennebec River Restoration

Living Shorelines in New England

Northeast Habitats & Highways

We’re Looking for You:


At TNC we strive to embody a philosophy of work that you can believe in, where you are helping to address the most pressing environmental issues and making a difference every day. You can help make an impact on nature and its fate in a rapidly changing world; apply practical and innovative solutions; and achieve results through teamwork and new partnerships.


The Nature Conservancy’s Global Legal Team is seeking an experienced transaction attorney with real estate experience and strong communication, collaboration and problem-solving skills. The ideal candidate will have excellent judgment and be able to advise multiple decision-makers about uncertain risks and challenging choices in a matrixed organization. They will also have the emotional intelligence, authenticity, integrity and disposition to build trust and guide the organization forward in ways that are equitable, fair and inclusive, while navigating difficult or potentially contentious conversations in result-oriented, non-confrontational ways.

  • Experience negotiating complex transactions and agreements.
  • Experience with real estate transactions.

  • Experience in one or more of the following areas of law: environmental law, Federal Indian law, energy law, tax-exempt law, complex grants and contracts, and/or land use law.

  • In-house experience and/or law firm experience advising sophisticated clients and senior management.
  • Experience developing, directing and managing multiple projects and implementing strategic program goals.

We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

jobs.excerpt: Ready to accelerate your career? Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact.
jobs.description:
Ready to accelerate your career?

Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.

Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.

We’re searching for a Junior Data Analyst to turn raw data into accurate, useful reports and dashboards for our customers and internal teams. You’ll help stakeholders understand their data, answer questions, and find ways to make reporting more efficient through reusable templates and automation.

Reporting to the Senior Manager of DevOps, Data, you’ll work alongside an experienced data team while taking ownership of the reports you deliver—from understanding the underlying question to validating the final results. This is an individual contributor role with support, feedback, and opportunities to develop your skills.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain customer-facing dashboards and custom reports that meet agreed requirements and delivery timelines.
  • Work with customers and internal stakeholders to understand the problem behind each request and shape reports that answer the right questions.
  • Answer ad hoc data questions using SQL, and explain your findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Own the quality of every report you build. Validate data, check calculations, and resolve issues before sharing results with a customer or stakeholder.
  • Choose effective approaches to writing queries and designing reports within our BI tools and team standards.
  • Document report logic and metric definitions so your work is clear, consistent, and easy to maintain.
  • Identify recurring requests, build reusable report templates, and automate manual reporting tasks.
  • Improve how report requests are handled and bring larger process improvements to the team.
  • Partner with the data team for reviews and guidance as you build your understanding of our data.

In your first 30 days, you’ll get set up on our BI tools, deliver your first reports for review, and agree on measures and targets with your manager. Within three months, you’ll independently build and maintain customer-facing reports, validate every report before release, and identify opportunities for templating or automation. Within six months, you’ll develop a deep understanding of our internal data schema and take ownership of the end-to-end reporting process.

Your initial focus will be reporting. The data team owns the underlying pipelines and warehouse, with opportunities to grow into that work over time.

What You Bring

    • 1–2 years of experience in an analytics role, internship, or equivalent project work.
    • Strong working knowledge of SQL, including joins, aggregations, CTEs, and window functions.
    • A bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, or engineering—or equivalent experience.
    • A strong understanding of descriptive statistics, including averages, distributions, percentages, and sampling.
    • Experience with a BI tool such as ThoughtSpot, Looker, or Power BI. ThoughtSpot experience is preferred.
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel or other spreadsheet tools.
    • Strong attention to detail. You check your numbers, proactively identify issues, and take responsibility for the accuracy of your work.
    • An interest in making reporting more efficient by turning repeated work into reusable templates or automated reports.
    • Clear verbal and written communication, including the ability to explain data and findings to non-technical audiences.
    • Exposure to data pipelines and dbt; data warehouses such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift; version control tools such as GitHub or GitLab; or data model design patterns is a plus.

Why you’ll love working at Cardata:

We’ll be honest — Cardata isn’t for everyone. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take extreme ownership, and constantly push yourself (and your work) to be the best, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll be surrounded by driven teammates who genuinely care — about the work, about our customers, and about helping each other succeed. Together, we take on ambitious goals and celebrate the wins along the way.

  • Remote work and flexible working hours
  • Mentorship and development opportunities (to help you achieve your career goals!)

  • Healthcare spending account
  • $3,000 annual Health and Wellness Spending Account to support your overall wellbeing

jobs.title: Manager, Technical Accounting and Equity Reporting
jobs.excerpt: Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential.
jobs.description:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

As Oura scales and prepares for life as a public company, equity compensation and non-routine technical accounting questions are becoming larger and more complex. We’re looking for a Manager, Technical Accounting and Equity Reporting to own stock-based compensation accounting and equity reporting end to end, and to serve as a technical accounting resource on complex and non-recurring transactions.You’ll own ASC 718 accounting and the equity roll-forwards, reconciliations, footnotes, and disclosures that flow from it; work through the accounting for share repurchases; document accounting positions in clear memos; and build SOX-ready processes and controls. You’ll partner closely with Legal, Stock Administration, Payroll, Tax, Corporate Finance, FP&A, Business Systems, and our external auditors.

What You Will Do:

Stock-based compensation accounting (ASC 718)

  • Own the monthly stock-based compensation close: validate grant, vesting, forfeiture, and termination data, calculate and record expense by function, and prepare the related journal entries.
  • Review valuation inputs and assumptions (e.g., Black-Scholes, 409A) with valuation specialists and support the related audit evidence.
  • Account for modifications, cancellations, repurchases, and settlement mechanics, including net share settlement.
  • Reconcile the cap table and equity administration platform to the general ledger, and resolve differences promptly.

Equity reporting and disclosures

  • Prepare and review equity roll-forwards, APIC and stockholders’ equity activity, and stock-based compensation disclosures for quarterly and annual financial statements.
  • Maintain audit-ready support and tie-outs for every equity figure in the financial statements and disclosures.

Liquidity events and capital structure

  • Lead the accounting analysis for tender offers, secondary transactions, IPO-related events, and corporate reorganizations as they affect employee equity.
  • Lead the modeling process around the expected financial statement impact of an IPO on equity awards, including expense recognition, net settlement, and tax withholding, and keep the model current as timing and terms evolve.

Technical accounting and policy

  • Research complex accounting questions under US GAAP and write clear, well-supported technical memos that document facts, guidance, analysis, and conclusions.
  • Serve as a technical resource on non-routine transactions beyond equity, as needed - areas could include: debt vs. equity accounting (ASC 480), debt (ASC 470), leases (ASC 842), business combinations (ASC 805), and global entity matters.
  • Assist with drafting, updating, and maintaining accounting policies, and monitor new standards and SEC guidance for their impact on Oura.

Controls and audit

  • Design, document, and operate key controls over equity and technical accounting in partnership with the SOX team, and remediate gaps promptly.
  • Serve as a primary contact for external auditors on equity and technical accounting, including walkthroughs, PBC requests, and technical discussions.

What you'll bring

  • 6+ years of progressive accounting and financial reporting experience, including Big 4 or national firm experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance; active CPA strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on expertise in ASC 718, including options, RSUs, performance-condition awards, modifications, repurchases and tender offers.
  • Strong working knowledge of US GAAP and SEC reporting, with experience in ASC 718.
  • Experience producing equity roll-forwards, footnotes, and disclosures for audited financial statements, and reconciling an equity administration platform (e.g., Carta, Shareworks) to the general ledger.
  • Demonstrated ability to research complex technical matters independently and write defensible accounting memos.
  • Experience designing and operating SOX or other internal controls over financial reporting.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including explaining complex topics to non-accounting partners, and a record of mentoring or managing others.

Nice to have:

  • Public company or IPO-readiness experience.
  • Workiva and Shareworks experience.
  • Experience in consumer hardware, health technology, or subscription businesses.

Benefits

At Ōura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Ōura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
  • An Ōura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
  • 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
  • Paid sick leave and parental leave

Ōura takes a market-based approach to pay, which may vary depending on your location. US locations are categorized into tiers based on a cost of labor index for that geographic area. While most offers will be closer to the starting range, successful candidates' pay will be determined based on job-related skills, experience, qualifications, work location, internal peer equity, and market conditions. About the Role

McKesson is seeking a Senior Cybersecurity Analyst to strengthen enterprise security monitoring and incident response capabilities. In this role, you will monitor and investigate security activity, serve as a senior escalation point for complex events, and help determine when an event should be managed as a cybersecurity incident.

You will work with technical and business partners throughout investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery. You will also improve detection logic, response playbooks, and operational processes based on threat intelligence, investigation findings, and lessons learned.

This position is well suited for an experienced security operations professional who combines hands-on technical knowledge with sound judgment, structured problem-solving, and clear stakeholder communication. You will also help develop junior analysts through mentoring and knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Do

  • Monitor, detect, analyze, and triage security alerts and events across enterprise environments.
  • Serve as a senior escalation point for security events and help determine when a cybersecurity incident should be declared.
  • Support incident investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and post-incident reporting.
  • Identify common attacker tools, tactics, and procedures using threat intelligence and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Improve SIEM and EDR detections, investigation playbooks, alert quality, and incident-response processes.
  • Conduct or support proactive threat-hunting and security analysis activities.
  • Contribute to post-incident reviews, operational reporting, security metrics, and continuous-improvement initiatives.
  • Mentor junior analysts and communicate security risks and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Basic Requirements

  • 6+ years of professional cybersecurity experience, including experience in security operations, threat detection, or incident response.
  • Hands-on experience using Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) technologies.
  • Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and the NIST incident-response lifecycle.
  • One or more relevant cybersecurity certifications, such as SANS GCIH, GCIA, CompTIA CySA+, or an equivalent credential.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate security events, analyze incomplete or conflicting data, and develop defensible conclusions.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and prioritization skills.
  • Ability to communicate security findings, risks, and recommended actions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Skills/Experience

  • Experience with digital forensics, threat hunting, malware analysis, or security automation and orchestration.
  • Familiarity with cloud security, cloud-native security monitoring, and identity and access security.
  • Experience developing or tuning SIEM correlation rules, EDR detections, alerts, dashboards, or response playbooks.
  • Knowledge of cyber threat intelligence and common attacker tools, tactics, techniques, and procedures.
  • Experience working in healthcare, pharmaceutical distribution, supply chain, or software environments.
  • Familiarity with scripting or automation using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or SOAR technologies.
  • Ability to rapidly learn, assess, and recommend new cybersecurity tools and technologies.
  • Experience mentoring analysts or sharing technical knowledge across a security operations team.

jobs.description:
About bunny.net

Some people accept the internet as it is. We see what it could be.

At bunny.net, we don’t wait for change. We make it happen. You won’t find layers of red tape or play-it-safe thinking here. You’ll find people who move quickly, take ownership, and push ideas all the way to the edge. Literally.

You’ll build things that solve actual problems, not add to them.

We’re not perfect, and we don’t pretend to be. But we’re always improving. We’re looking for people who want to do the same, who take pride in their work, and aren’t afraid to challenge what’s possible.

Because everyone deserves a better internet. And we’re here to help it hop faster.

Senior Technical Content Writer

Great technical stories can start anywhere. In developer communities, customer questions, or problems nobody has explained well enough yet. It takes curiosity to spot their potential and skill to bring them to life.

As our Senior Technical Content Writer, you'll shape our content strategy, turn complex technology into stories developers actually want to read, and help us build a stronger editorial approach. Your work will help developers solve problems, make better technical decisions, and build a faster, better internet.

Working closely with our VP of Growth and teams across Product, Engineering, Developer Experience, and Marketing, you'll have the freedom to experiment, own your work, and make a real impact on bunny.net's growth.

What will you do?

  • Discover content opportunities through developer communities, customer questions, and technical discussions

  • Develop content pillars and propose a strategy focused on developers, technical buyers, and growth

  • Research and write compelling, technically accurate content that makes complex topics easier to understand

  • Identify content gaps and create stories that address genuine developer needs and questions

  • Establish writing standards that help everyone at bunny.net create better content

  • Guide editorial priorities and work with our Content Editor to raise the quality of our content

  • Make content easier to discover through search and AI-powered answer engines

  • Collaborate across teams to turn technical insights into stories that build trust and drive adoption

What will you bring?

  • Exceptional technical writing and storytelling skills, backed by a strong portfolio

  • Technical fluency in developer tools, infrastructure, or related technologies

  • A track record of finding and developing content ideas independently

  • Experience shaping content strategy and making strong editorial decisions

  • Genuine curiosity about developers, the challenges they face, and how they look for solutions

  • An understanding of modern content discovery, including AI search, and its contribution to growth

  • Strong ownership and the ability to move work forward independently across distributed teams

  • Experience collaborating across teams and improving others' writing

  • Sound judgment when using AI to research, write, and edit technical content

What will make us extra happy?

  • Experience writing for CDN, networking, security (WAF, DDoS protection, bot mitigation, API security), or cloud computing space (containers, serverless, databases)

  • A portfolio of original technical stories you've discovered and developed yourself

  • Experience creating editorial frameworks or coaching other writers

  • Experience connecting content to measurable growth or self-serve adoption

Where should you be located?

Europe, ideally within CET ±3 hours so collaboration with the team feels natural rather than scheduled. This job is full time.

What's in it for you?

Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.

  • 100% flexible hours - Your work, your rhythm. Whether you thrive at 3 am or on a beach at noon, we've got you.

  • Remote-first by design - No offices, no commute, just the freedom to work anywhere. Miss the office? We’ll give you a 3-night voucher for visiting our headquarters.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance - Coverage worldwide.

  • Paid time off - Love the slopes or the sea? Enjoy them with 25 vacation days, plus an extra loyalty day each year, capped at 5 years (30 days total), on top of your local public holidays.

  • Meeting-free Thursdays - We keep Thursdays meeting free internally so you can focus on deep work without interruptions.

  • Home office budget - We believe everyone is more efficient working in a comfortable office, and we're happy to help you set it up with an annual budget of €500.

  • Paid sick leave - Feeling ill? Take time off to fully recover without having to worry about your finances.

Take your leave all at once or split it across the first year for maximum flexibility. After paid leave, your local statutory rules apply.

Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world.

Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space.

We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team of around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.

Sphera's Development Operations team builds, runs and secures the cloud environments behind our software products. The DevOps Manager leads part of the team day to day and works as a peer with the other managers in Development Operations: one set of standards, one way of planning and reporting, and cover for each other when someone is away.


As a DevOps Manager you make sure your team's work is planned, delivered on time and done safely. You are the person product teams, Customer Care and Professional Services rely on to turn their requests into working environments, and the person your engineers rely on for

clear priorities, unblocking and growth.


This is a hands-on leadership role. You don't need to write every pipeline, but you need to read one, review a change request, and challenge a design with confidence.


What you'll do

Lead and grow your team

  • Lead a team of DevOps engineers and leads, including staff from partner vendors, by setting clear expectations, holding regular 1:1s, and giving specific, actionable feedback.
  • Balance workloads across product-line support, projects, and tickets, and catch over-allocation and burnout risk early, before they affect delivery.
  • Own the hiring process: define role requirements, conduct interviews, and onboard new engineers so they become productive quickly.
  • Develop talent by coaching engineers toward lead roles and leads toward management.

Deliver the work

  • Own your team’s backlog in Azure DevOps, turning requests into well-scoped epics, features, and backlog items with clear owners and due dates.
  • Drive DevOps projects through milestones, schedules, and SLAs, and report status candidly, especially when something is running late.
  • Review and approve customer environment and integration setups, ensuring requirements are complete before work begins.

Run safe, reliable operations

  • Make sure every production change goes through change management, with the right approvals, testing and rollback plan.
  • Own operational readiness for the services your team supports: monitoring, alerting, backups, DR validation and handover to support.
  • Lead incident response and follow-up for your area and turn every significant incident into a lasting fix.
  • Apply Sphera's information security rules in day-to-day work: least-privilege access, no shared or hard-coded secrets, and evidence for audits.

Work as one team with your fellow managers

  • Agree shared standards with your fellow DevOps Managers for planning, estimation, reviews, on-call and reporting, so engineers and stakeholders get the same experience whichever team they work with.
  • Cover each other's teams during absences and move people between teams when priorities call for it.
  • Bring the Director a joint view of capacity, risks and priorities across the teams, rather than separate ones.

Keep improving the platform and the way we work

  • Push for automation and infrastructure as code over manual steps, and standard patterns over one-offs.
  • Partner with FinOps on cloud cost: right-sizing, decommissioning and making cost visible to product owners.
  • Keep runbooks, handbook articles and the wiki current, so the next engineer can follow the process without being walked through it.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Customer Care and InfoSec on roadmaps and dependencies.

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years in DevOps, SRE, cloud infrastructure or platform engineering, including 2+ years leading engineers as a people manager or team lead.
  • Deep, practical experience with Microsoft Azure: virtual machines and App Service; virtual networks, NSGs, private endpoints and Application Gateway; Entra ID, managed identities and RBAC; Key Vault; and Azure Service Bus.
  • Strong working knowledge of Azure DevOps Boards and Pipelines, and of CI/CD for .NET and SQL Server applications.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform or Bicep) and scripting (PowerShell, plus Bash or Python).
  • A track record of running production systems under change control: CAB processes, incident management, DR and audit evidence.
  • Comfort managing a distributed team across time zones, including contractors and vendor partners.
  • Clear written and spoken communication. You can explain a technical risk to a product owner and a business priority to an engineer.

Nice to have

  • Experience with a multi-tenant SaaS platform alongside single-tenant customer deployments.
  • SSO and identity federation (Azure AD B2C, SAML, OIDC).
  • ISO 27001 or SOC 2 environments.
  • FinOps practice or tooling.
  • Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-400)

Visio Lending is the nation’s leader in rental home financing. Founded in 2012 in Austin, Texas, Visio enables small- to medium- sized investors to grow their rental home, and vacation rental portfolios. Headquartered in fantastic Austin, Texas, since late 2015, Visio has financed more than $1 billion in Rental360 loans. With more than $400 million in capital onboard, a proven record of investment grade bond issuance on Wall Street, and an outstanding 100+ team, Visio is poised for continued success.

Why We Love Working at Visio:

We at Visio are passionate about working together towards our goals to continually push this company forward. We innovate, collaborate, celebrate team successes, and recognize individual accomplishments. At Visio Lending, you’ll work on meaningful initiatives that directly support real estate investors nationwide. We offer a collaborative culture, growth opportunities, and flexibility with remote work options.

To be considered for employment, please submit your application online. While we appreciate all the interest we receive, only candidates selected for phone screening, or an interview will be contacted directly. You will receive application status alerts via email so make sure your email address is accurate.

Note: Incomplete applications will not be considered. Unanswered application questions or responses indicating “see resume” will be considered incomplete and you will be removed from consideration.

Visio Financial Services, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer

The Opportunity

The Vice President, Transformation & Implementation owns the successful delivery of Visio Lending's largest enterprise implementation and the operating change that comes with it. This leader oversees the Implementation Program Leader, and both the Business Systems Analyst (BSA) team and the Project Management Office (PMO) report into this role.

You will be the bridge between technology delivery and the business. You know how a loan moves from application to funding to servicing to its ultimate exit, whether it’s a securitization or sale to a third-party whole loan buyer, and you use that knowledge to make sure every requirement, workflow, and system change actually works for the business.

Location: 100% Remote

Employment: Full-time, long-term position

Start date: As soon as possible after selection and agreement

Salary: Startup-aligned starting compensation, based on experience and responsibilities, with the potential for substantial growth during the first few years

About UsWe are a startup developing software products, web applications, AI-powered tools, integrations, and business automations across different projects.

Our delivery model combines internal ownership with outsourced development. We work with external developers and specialists, and we need strong technical leadership to turn their contributions into reliable, maintainable software.

AI-assisted and agentic development are central to how we work. We want to move quickly, make sensible technical decisions, and build solutions that our team can understand, operate, and improve.

We are looking for an experienced engineer who wants to join at an early stage, take meaningful responsibility, and grow with the company.

Job DescriptionWe are seeking a Senior AI & Full-Stack Engineer who can develop applications across frontend and backend, integrate AI capabilities, and manage the Linux infrastructure, databases, and deployment processes supporting them.

You should be comfortable taking a project from an initial business requirement through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation. You will work across different products and internal initiatives, helping us choose practical solutions and deliver them efficiently.

Alongside hands-on engineering, your responsibilities may include leading developers, mentoring less experienced colleagues, coordinating outsourced contributors, and reviewing externally delivered work. Previous team leadership and mentoring experience are therefore important.

This is an opportunity to help establish the engineering foundations of a growing startup and develop into a broader technical leadership position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend.
  • Build AI-powered features, integrations, internal tools, and business automations.
  • Use AI coding assistants and coding agents effectively, with appropriate testing and human review.
  • Translate business requirements into clear implementation tasks and verifiable acceptance criteria.
  • Design APIs, business logic, authentication, authorization, and third-party integrations.
  • Manage database schemas, migrations, query performance, backups, and recovery procedures.
  • Administer Linux servers, including application services, permissions, updates, networking, and troubleshooting.
  • Build and maintain Docker environments, including container networking, persistent storage, configuration, and health checks.
  • Manage DNS records, domain routing, TLS certificates, and reverse proxies.
  • Maintain CI/CD workflows using GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines, and appropriate build agents or runners.
  • Carry out deployments with migration checks, rollback procedures, and post-deployment verification.
  • Investigate production incidents and address their underlying causes.
  • Coordinate outsourced developers and specialists, clarify requirements, review deliverables, and manage technical dependencies.
  • Mentor developers through code reviews, practical demonstrations, and constructive feedback.
  • Keep implementation proportionate to the problem, controlling unnecessary complexity, infrastructure costs, and maintenance overhead.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated senior-level experience delivering and maintaining production web applications.
  • Strong frontend development skills using a modern framework, JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Strong backend development experience, including secure APIs, integrations, validation, and error handling.
  • Practical experience integrating AI or LLM capabilities into software, including checking output quality, handling failures, and managing latency and usage costs.
  • Substantial hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic development workflows, with examples of working results you independently verified.
  • Strong SQL and relational database experience, including migrations, indexing, performance analysis, and backup and recovery.
  • Hands-on Linux administration and Docker deployment experience.
  • A working understanding of DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, ports, and reverse proxies.
  • Practical CI/CD experience with GitHub Actions and familiarity with Azure DevOps repositories, pipelines, and build agents.
  • Strong Git, pull-request, code-review, and release-management skills.
  • Previous experience leading a development team or coordinating technical delivery.
  • Proven mentoring experience and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly.
  • Experience working with outsourced developers, contractors, or distributed teams.
  • The ability to work independently, prioritize competing needs, and make sound decisions with a limited startup budget.
  • Interest in a long-term, full-time role with increasing responsibility.

Especially Valuable Experience

  • Building products or engineering processes in an early-stage startup.
  • Taking responsibility for several applications or services at the same time.
  • Evaluating outsourced work for correctness, security, maintainability, and operational readiness.
  • Developing AI agents, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, or reliable automation.
  • Operating PostgreSQL and multi-service Docker environments.
  • Establishing deployment standards, monitoring, incident procedures, and practical documentation.
  • Helping junior developers become more effective through structured mentoring.

Growth, Responsibility and CompensationJoining at this stage offers the opportunity to influence how we build software, organize delivery, and develop our engineering team.

Initial compensation will reflect our startup budget, your experience, and the agreed scope of responsibility. As your contribution and responsibilities grow alongside the business, we aim to provide substantial salary progression during the first few years.

For a strong contributor, the role can develop into positions such as Technical Lead, Engineering Lead, or Head of Engineering. Progression will depend on demonstrated results, leadership capability, company growth, and financial capacity. Compensation expectations and progression milestones will be discussed openly during recruitment.

What We Offer

  • A fully remote, full-time role with a long-term perspective.
  • Direct involvement in technical decisions across multiple products and initiatives.
  • The opportunity to build, lead, and mentor a distributed engineering team.
  • Broad ownership across software, AI integration, infrastructure, and delivery.
  • Close collaboration with startup leadership.
  • The potential for significant career and compensation growth as the company develops.

Remote Working ArrangementOur remote working setup includes a time-tracking tool that records mouse-click and keyboard-activity metrics and captures screenshots of the screen. This monitoring is part of the working arrangement and will be explained during the recruitment process.

Applicants should be comfortable working with this setup.

How to ApplyWe are looking to fill this core engineering role promptly. Applying early gives us the opportunity to discuss how you could help shape our technical direction from the beginning.

Please submit your CV and a short overview covering:

  • A production application you helped deliver and your own frontend and backend contributions.
  • An AI feature or agentic workflow you implemented and how you verified its results.
  • Your Linux, Docker, database, and deployment responsibilities.
  • A team you led or developers you mentored, including the outcomes.
  • Your experience coordinating outsourced development and reviewing external deliverables.
  • Your earliest start date and salary expectations, taking our startup stage into account.

Public portfolio links and GitHub repositories are welcome. Please do not share confidential customer information or credentials.

jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!

3. Semantic Models, Reporting, and Visualisation

ModMed Benefits Highlight: At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

United States

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution,
  • 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep.
  • Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs,
  • Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs,

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address ().
